Requirements: 1. The text contains page numbers in square brackets, such as [01], [02], etc. - These must be passed through unchanged. - Each page number must appear in exactly the same position in the translation as in the source. - The number of page markers in the output must match the input exactly.
2. Personal names, place names, titles, and other proper nouns should be rendered in Hànyǔ Pīnyīn with tone marks.
3. Do NOT transcribe the full Classical Chinese text into Pinyin.
4. Do NOT include explanatory notes, annotations, or commentary — output only the $lang translation.
5. The target language is $lang.

p.seg: 1.1 "Tàipíng Jīnquē Dìchén Hòushèng Dìjūn Shīfǔ Lìjì Suìcì Píngqì Qùlái Zhàohòu Xiánshèng Gōngxíng Zhǒngmín Dìngfǎ Běnqǐ"
It was asked:
"The three cycles revolve,
with departures and returns,
the people must have a lord,
can his surname and name be known?"
"Excellent!
Why do you ask this again?"
"An enlightened teacher is hard to encounter,
favorable times easily pass,
I cannot contain my earnest longing,
wishing to inquire and hear,
though foolish and ignorant, I venture forth,
fearing my presumption is excessive and profound."
"Alas!
It is not excessive,
Heaven has sent you to ask,
to enlighten future generations,
so the awakened may recognize the truth,
discard falsehood and attain the genuine.
If I wished not to speak,
I fear Heaven would be distressed,
and chaos would not be pacified in time.
Walk calmly and sit,
I shall explain it for you.
It will naturally become clear,
without any doubts.
The heavens and earth of old and those of today,
have a beginning and an end,
alike without difference.
Good at first, evil later,
with rise and decline in between,
one success and one failure.
The yang nine and hundred six,
six and nine complete a cycle,
and the cycle brings great ruin.
Heaven and earth mingle in chaos,
beings and things disintegrate.
Only those who accumulate goodness escape it,
long becoming the seed people.
The seed people's wisdom and knowledge,
still have gradations,
not yet uniformly permeated,
still requiring a teacher and lord.
With a sage lord and enlightened teacher,
teaching transforms towards immortality,
accumulating refinement to become sages,
hence they are called seed people.
Seed people,
are the category of sages and worthies with long life.
The great lord of long life is called the Truly Great One Marvelous Qi of Great Peace,
the Nine Mysteries Imperial Lord of the Later Sage of the Golden Palace of the Highest Clarity of the August Heaven,
surnamed Lǐ,
is a descendant of the Supreme High Ultimate,
a scion of the Jade Emperor of Emptiness and Non-being,
during the time of the Mysterious Origin Imperial Lord, in the fifteenth year of Tàihuáng,
in the cyclical sign bǐngzǐ, the primordial qi emerged,
in the first year of Huángpíng, jiǎshēn, he took form,
in the seventh year of Shànghé, gēngyín, ninth month, third day, jiǎzǐ, at the mao hour,
punishment and virtue constrained each other,
the hour of direct conjunction,
he was born in the Northern Mysterious Jade Kingdom,
in the Heavenly Ridge Spiritual Realm,
within the Rényuǎ Gé Pénglái Mountains,
among the Lǐ Valley,
there was the Mother of Upper Mysterious Empty Birth,
in the chamber of the nine mysteries,
residing in the valley's shade.
When the Mysterious Empty Mother first conceived,
she dreamed of dark clouds, sun, and moon encircling her form,
the lightning of the six qi stirred her spirit,
then darkly sensing the yang way,
she conceived the Perfected One in her womb.
On the morning of his birth,
three suns rose in the east.
After his nurturing,
nine dragons spewed divine water.
Thus, by the spiritual valley, his clan was established,
using the shining light as his name.
At the age of three,
his body embodied the Dao, concentrating truth,
his words formed golden blossoms.
At five years,
he often gazed at the sun, delighting in the dawn,
facing the moon, sighing at its end.
Looking up, he observed the blazing brilliance of yang qi,
looking down, he saw the yin way's decline and damage.
Thereupon, he gathered his hun and harmonized his po,
guarded the womb, treasured the spirit,
collected essence, replenished blood,
solidified fluids, congealed sinews.
At seven years,
he learned to swallow light and ingest effulgences,
chewing the roots of the sun.
Reaching fourteen years of age,
he possessed a golden demeanor and jade countenance,
abandoned vulgarity, detached from emotions,
embraced transformation to save the world,
his essence sensed the Grand Simplicity,
received teachings from the Three Originals,
studied the Three Caverns,
practiced the Nine Methods.
At twenty-one years of age,
he used solitary dwelling to subdue sharpness.
At twenty-eight years,
he used harmonious interaction to blend his light.
At thirty-five years,
he disseminated the mysterious ford,
his merit and virtue spread far and wide.
At forty-two years,
he received the writ as the Later Sage Imperial Lord,
no different from those who attained the Dao before heaven and became Imperial Lords.
He received the prophecy in the present,
hence called the Later Sage.
The former sage and the later sage,
their Dao is one.
He ascends to the palaces of Upper Clarity,
roams the halls of the Great Ultimate in the middle,
governs the heavens of the ten directions below,
rules over billions of millions of common people,
oversees all rivers, seas,
and earthly sources, mountains, and forests,
all look up and follow,
commanding over nine layers and ten folds,
hence called the Nine Mysteries.
At seventy years of age,
he established the lifespan of the limitless,
suited the appropriateness of concealment and manifestation,
edited the arts of immortality,
compiled the methods for longevity.
Precious scriptures, talismans, and charts,
the wondrous methods of the three antiquities,
secreted in jade caskets,
attended by divine officials,
transmission and reception follow regulations,
action and storage have their timings,
he established canons and set up classics,
bestowing them upon the seed people.
Those who cannot practice them,
are not seed people.
Now, since heaven and earth opened,
pure customs have gradually receded,
the qi of imperial peace is hidden,
calamities and pestilence run rampant.
After the era of the Supreme August,
since the Three and Five,
warfare, epidemics, water, and fire,
have arisen in competition with each other,
all because the multitudes,
have evil hearts and false forms,
destroying the five virtues,
contending with the six emotions,
indulging in cruelty and violence,
mutually invading and oppressing,
respect between noble and base, elder and younger,
precious and cheap, is disordered and lost.
Causing the two principles to lose order,
the seven luminaries to deviate from their courses,
the three powers to change and vary,
evil falsehoods to abound.
Spirits and ghosts harm each other,
beings and things wither and perish,
calamities and misfortunes repeatedly arrive,
unawakened and unrepentant,
ten thousand poisons run wild,
beyond count.
The great evils are four:
warfare, disease,
water, and fire.
When the yang nine completes a cycle,
and yin solitude peaks, then water overflows.
When the hundred six completes a circuit,
and yang prevails, then fire arises.
Before Yáo's time,
there is no need to recount.
After the Táng era,
I shall now briefly state it.
You should carefully remember and recognize,
and urgently prepare defenses and avoidances.
After Yáo's flood,
Tāng's fire brought disaster,
after that, small floods and fires occur everywhere,
summoned according to the gravity of sins,
not the great yang nine or great hundred six.
Within the great nine and six,
there are sure to be great and minor Jiǎshēn.
Jiǎshēn is the appointed time,
when ghosts confront humans.
Disasters have severity and lightness,
sins and blessings have thickness and thinness,
years and lands differ,
changes and shifts vary.
Among the middling people, the middling ones,
arrive automatically at the appointed time.
The upper and lower among the middling,
can move up or down,
ascending and descending, advancing and retreating,
without fixed pattern.
Doing evil shortens it,
doing good prolongs it.
Unable to make diligent progress,
one cannot attain the Way.
It is only possible to extend the timeline,
according to the degree of merit achieved.
Thus, during the calamitous cycles of one hundred and six and nine times nine,
some come earlier, some later,
following the constant numbers of the great calendar,
calibrated by the depth of one's practice.
Calculating from the Dīnghài year of the Táng era,
there are another forty-six years.
Between before and after,
in the year of Jiǎshēn,
it is a minor Jiǎshēn,
where warfare, pestilence, and fire
alternate as disasters,
but there is no great flood.
Minor floods occur widespread,
with slightly severe annual and regional impacts.
After another fifty-five years,
in Dīnghài,
between before and after,
there is a year of Jiǎshēn.
This is the great Jiǎshēn, where three calamities occur simultaneously,
and a great flood sweeps through.
Whenever the great and minor Jiǎshēn arrive,
they eliminate the wicked people
and deliver the good people.
The good become the seed people,
while the wicked become mixed chaff.
Before the arrival of the minor,
various demons run rampant and arise alternately,
epidemic toxins strike from above,
warfare and fire encircle from below,
floods emerge without fixed direction,
and the wicked successively sink into oblivion.
During these fifteen years,
extending up to thirty years,
calamities intensify annually,
and sages and worthies withdraw into obscurity.
The Great Dao's divine beings again dispatch true immortals and superior adepts to expound scriptures and conduct transformation,
guiding them with detailed instructions.
They encourage those above and exhort those below;
followers become the seed people,
while non-followers sink into oblivion,
becoming mixed chaff.
The wicked are all swept away completely.
The seed people, being of superior goodness,
only one-tenth remain.
Of the medium and lower good,
Heaven destroys more than half,
the remaining half multiplies and prospers daily,
awaiting the sagely lord and enlightened teacher,
whereupon great ministers descend and appear.
After the minor Jiǎshēn,
before Rénshēn,
the ruler of the minor Jiǎshēn is sagely and virtuous,
strict yet benevolent and kind,
causing no harm in governing chaos,
enjoying extended years and longevity.
Through diligent study, one can attain immortality,
but without deep study of the Tàipíng scriptures,
one cannot long practice the affairs of Tàipíng.
The names in the era of minor Tàipíng
cannot be determined.
Those who practice are recorded by the Director of Fate in the green register,
and cannot be recorded by the Director of Records in the black document.
Those in the black document die,
those in the green register live.
The register of life and death
resides in the Heavenly Bright Hall.
The Way of Heaven shows no favoritism;
it only bestows upon the good.
The good cultivate and practice Tàipíng,
thus achieving Tàipíng.
Achieving minor Tàipíng,
they unite in virtue with the great Tàipíng lord.
The great Tàipíng lord, whose name is determined,
is Lord Lǐ.
In the year of Rénchén, on the sixth day of the third month,
he manifestly descends into the world,
riding a carriage of three pure radiances,
followed by ten thousand dragons and flying chariots.
He elevates the good as seed people,
and scholars become immortal officials.
He establishes codes and classics,
rewarding good and preventing evil,
blocking the roots of sin,
supervising and advancing people in blessed deeds,
who do not slacken but diligently progress,
attaining divine authenticity,
and uniting in virtue with the Emperor;
those who regress and fall into evil,
with evil deeds daily recorded,
will later fill the mixed chaff.
Superior and lofty adepts,
with wise and penetrating understanding,
clear and without doubt,
diligently apply themselves with vigor,
preserving and practicing the Emperor's instructions,
remembering and recognizing the assistance of the great divine lord,
daring not to forget any.
The sagely lord and enlightened assistants,
with spiritual officials protecting people,
naturally attain deathlessness,
eternally becoming seed people.
They ascend to become officials of the immortal authenticity,
and eventually attain the position of the later sage.
"The later sage Lord Lǐ's grand tutor's surname is Péng.
He studied the Dao before Lord Lǐ,
holding the position of Left Authentic of the Great Tenuity,
and during the human sovereign era, the Preserver of the Imperial Way Lord, together with constant mandates, enfeoffed and appointed the myriad people,
serving as Lord Lǐ's grand tutor,
governing in the Luminous Upper Light Terrace of the Northern Wall Palace in the Great Tenuity,
changing names every twenty-five hundred years,
traversing the great void,
circulating through the eight obscurities.
Ascending to the supreme,
descending to the utmost below,
true officials rarely get to see his radiant countenance.
"The later sage Lord Lǐ's prime minister is the Green Lad Lord of the Fāngzhū Palace.
"The later sage Lord Lǐ's chief protector is the Southern Pole Primordial Lord of the Great Cinnabar Palace.
"The later sage Lord Lǐ's senior tutor is the Grand Simplicity True Lord of the White Mountain Palace.
"The later sage Lord Lǐ's chief minister is the Lord of Total Authenticity of the Western Wall Palace.
"These five individuals,
constitute one master and four supports.
The term 'support'
means father,
meaning to uphold.
They are revered like fathers,
enabling one to act with their support,
collectively referred to as supports.
Differentiating them,
there are the left support and right assistant,
the front doubter and rear bearer.
The bearer
speaks and initiates affairs,
fills in omissions and ensures completeness,
makes decisions and promotes them,
acting as the steward.
The doubter
ponders unresolved matters,
enlightening to achieve clarity,
serving as the mentor.
The assistant
resolves uncertainties,
acting as the protector.
Upholding the ruler and following the master,
comprehensively entering the Way,
is the role of the minister.
Through divination and observation,
all details are assessed for feasibility,
supporting the expansion of righteous transformation,
collectively termed the supporting master.
In times of leisure,
if there are doubts ahead,
consult the mentor.
If concerns arise behind,
consult the bearer.
If there is obscurity on the right,
consult the assistant.
If clarity is lacking on the left,
consult the support.
Consulting the four supports,
the minister, protector, mentor, and steward,
the ultimate success lies with the master,
none can be omitted.
The sage emperors set examples,
for later generations to follow.
Inwardly, there is the protector,
the protector handles affairs.
Yin belongs to the right,
tranquility preserves the true essence.
Outwardly, there is the master,
the master handles affairs.
Yang belongs to the left,
movement returns to stillness.
This point is most difficult,
hence the focus on the supports and minister, but ultimately on the master.
Looking forward, there is the mentor,
the mentor is in front,
expounding on discussions and interests.
Looking back, there is the steward,
the steward is behind,
deciding right and wrong.
The remaining dukes, ministers, officials, immortals, sages, dignitaries, and others number three hundred sixty-one,
with thirty-six thousand subordinates,
leading three hundred sixty thousand,
and the people are ten, a hundred, a thousand, ten thousand, a hundred million times more.
Constantly, twenty-four true men secretly teach those with sincere hearts,
all under the jurisdiction of the Fāngzhū High Minister,
which cannot be fully described.
Only contemplate the greater aspects,
and naturally understand the smaller ones."
"Excellent!
Today's inquiry into doubts,
I have heard the command."
The question asked:
"What constant practices did Lord Lǐ undertake,
to attain such high authenticity,
can the teachings of the Grand Master and four supports be heard?"
"Excellent!
You, as one ignorant,
confused and unbelieving in the Way,
learning not steadfast,
advancing and retreating improperly,
falling into lowly and bitter states,
thus diligently ask about this?
Now, I shall explain it to you.
From the beginningless past,
accumulated actions over long ages,
each good and evil deed,
cannot be fully recounted,
speaking of it is futile.
Now, taking recent practices,
the essential for achieving high nobility is the 'Líng Shū Zǐ Wén'.
The Dōnghuá Yù Bǎo Gāochén Shī Qīngtóng Dàjūn,
the Great Lord purified and fasted in the Hánlíng Dān Diàn,
within the Huángfáng,
for three years,
then ascended to the Shàngqīng Golden Palace.
The Golden Palace has four Celestial Emperors,
with Tàipíng Dàojūn at their sides.
Residing in the Tàikōng Qióngtái Dòngzhēn Palace,
in the Píngyù room,
within the Jīnhuá,
with fifty thousand attendants and true beings,
venomous dragons and electric tigers,
fierce beasts of heaven,
displaying toxic postures,
guarding the gates and holding the passes,
giant serpents a thousand fathoms long,
protecting the walls and banks.
Flying dragons and swift sparrows,
ocean rocs and exotic birds,
pecking and clawing vigorously,
arrayed in the vast courtyard.
The celestial majesty radiant,
flowing light illuminating eight directions.
Winds drumming dark banners,
swirling dance of feathered canopies;
jade trees stirring sounds,
gem branches naturally resonant;
myriad pipes playing spiritual songs,
phoenixes crying in profound peace;
divine consorts singing in chorus,
unicorns dancing, phoenixes striding;
celestial harmony in eight tones,
nine harmonies and hundred gatherings.
Qīngtóng crawled forward,
requesting to receive the 'Líng Shū Zǐ Wén',
with twenty-four oral transmission methods in the text:
first, true remembrance and contemplation,
deep familiarity and recollection;
second, detailed observance of immortal taboos without forgetfulness;
third, gathering flying roots,
swallowing solar essence;
fourth, ingesting the Kāimíng spiritual talisman;
fifth, consuming lunar effulgence;
sixth, ingesting the Yīnshēng talisman;
seventh, restraining the three ethereal souls;
eighth, controlling the seven corporeal souls;
ninth, wearing the Huángxiàng talisman;
tenth, taking Huā Dān;
eleventh, drinking Huáng Shuǐ;
twelfth, consuming Huí Shuǐ;
thirteenth, eating Huán Gāng;
fourteenth, consuming phoenix brains;
fifteenth, eating pine pears;
sixteenth, consuming plum dates;
seventeenth, taking water broth;
eighteenth, stabilizing white silver and purple gold;
nineteenth, ingesting Yún Yú;
twentieth, creating white silver and purple gold;
twenty-first, performing stabilizations;
twenty-second, eating bamboo shoots;
twenty-third, consuming wild goose jerky;
twenty-fourth, wearing the five spirit talismans.
With these twenty-four complete,
transformations become endless,
transcending beyond the three realms,
roaming within the six directions.
Disasters cannot harm,
demons dare not challenge.
All submit of their own accord,
reaching the pinnacle of the Way,
grace flowing to all,
both hidden and manifest relying on it.
Those who do not believe or follow,
unaware and unseeing,
persist in their own darkness,
forever diverging from the Way.
Suffering fierce poison,
troubles mingled like minced herbs.
With great compassionate thought,
yet helpless.
Alas,
those with aspiration,
plan early, plan early,
do not disregard these words."
It was said:
"Excellent,
excellent!
Today's inquiry into doubts,
I have heard the command."
2.1 "The Method of Harmonizing Yin and Yang and Following the Way"
Returning to youth without aging,
the Great Way is about to return,
and everyone's years will be tested accordingly.
Close your eyes and look inward,
seeing a pure, brilliant white.
It is like approaching dawn,
with the body resting peacefully on the mat.
As if dwelling in warm steam,
at this moment the sinews and bones do not wish to move,
the mouth does not wish to speak.
Each bending and stretching brings increasing pleasure,
the heart feels joyful,
with a sense of harmonious moisture,
the nose ventilates freely,
sweetness arises in the mouth—
these are the signs.
Therefore, those who follow Heaven and Earth
will enjoy long-lasting governance.
Those who accord with the four seasons
will see their prosperity daily increase.
The Way has no mysterious words;
the interaction of one yin and one yang
is its functioning.
Those who attain its proper order prosper,
those who lose its proper order fall into chaos;
those who attain its proper order become divine and enlightened,
those who lose its proper order find the Way impassable.
Carefully ponder this meaning,
and become one with the Way.
2.2 The Method of Recording the Body and Correcting the Spirit to Let People Know Themselves
Heaven employs the Way to create humans,
each receiving one method and one body,
with seven vertical and horizontal aspects of yin and yang,
half yin and half yang,
thus achieving mutual completion.
Therefore, the upper part resembles yang,
the lower part follows yin,
the left follows yang,
the right follows yin.
Yang favors life,
yin favors destruction.
Yang represents the Way,
yin represents punishment.
Those who act with yang (goodness)
are aided by yang spirits;
those who act with yin (evil)
are aided by yin spirits.
Accumulate goodness without cease,
and the blessings of the Way arise,
making one increasingly auspicious daily.
Yang resides in the head,
yin resides in the feet.
Thus, the noble values the Way and its virtue,
subordinates punishment,
taking this as the model.
The petty person, in contrast, subordinates the Way and its virtue,
elevates punishment,
also taking this as the model.
Therefore, humans are the root and handle of the Way,
the elders of the spirits.
One should understand this meaning,
and diligently nurture oneself,
to attain longevity and old age.
Failing to nurture the body well
brings blame from the various spirits.
If the spirits rebel and abandon the person,
how can the body remain well?
In doing good, one dares not stray from the guidelines,
daring not to deceive oneself.
Doing good is known by the spirits themselves,
as is doing evil.
It is not other spirits,
but the spirits within one's own body.
When words come from the heart and belly,
others can still learn of them—
this is the report of the spirits within the body.
Therefore, rectifying the spirit and calming the body
is the foundation of order,
the sign of longevity.
The affairs of non-action
arise from this.
First learn from your own body,
to understand fortune and misfortune.
Thus, the wise and enlightened sages
only learn from their own bodies,
not from others,
deeply contemplating the meaning of the Way,
and thus can achieve great peace.
The noble person attains it and prospers,
the petty person practices it and falls.
2.3 The Method of Cultivating Unity to Repel Evil
Heaven and Earth, in their creation, value the fundamental root,
which is the origin of qì.
To achieve great peace,
contemplate the fundamental root.
Not thinking of the root
is called great trouble;
undertakings will not succeed,
and disasters will come together.
This is not the person's fault,
but the loss of the foundation.
Leaving the root to seek the branches
brings unmanageable calamity,
so one should deeply ponder this.
Now, Unity
is the root of the Way,
the beginning of qì,
that to which life is connected,
the master of all hearts.
If you wish to know its reality,
it lies at the center as the root,
the mansion of life.
Therefore, you should deeply understand it,
and turn to benevolence and worthiness to practice it.
The root of a person lies within,
the branches and leaves are outside;
in guarding Unity, make all return from the outside,
urgently bring order to the inside,
pursue the distant,
and order the near.
Those who guard Unity
are aided by celestial spirits.
Those who guard Duality
are aided by earthly spirits.
Those who guard Trinity
are aided by human ghosts.
Those who guard Four or Five
are aided by material beings.
Thus, guarding Unity prolongs life,
guarding Duality aligns with misfortune,
guarding Trinity brings chaotic order,
guarding Four or Five invites daily disaster.
Deeply ponder its meaning,
and you may be called one who knows the Way.
Thus, the Unity of the head
is the crown.
The Unity of the seven orifices
is the eyes.
The Unity of the abdomen
is the navel.
The Unity of the vessels
is qì.
The Unity of the five viscera
is the heart.
The Unity of the four limbs
is the palms and soles.
The Unity of the bones
is the spine.
The Unity of the flesh
is the intestines and stomach.
If you can steadfastly guard these,
understand the meaning of the Way,
those who attain the Way become benevolent,
those who lose the Way become greedy.
2.4 The Method of Using Joy to Repel Disasters
Through joy, cultivate the body, preserve the form, harmonize thoughts, and ward off calamities.
What is it to be joyful in the Dao?
Joy can harmonize yīn and yáng,
silently guiding all affairs,
enabling people to attain the essence of the Dao.
Thus, when primordial qì is joyful, great prosperity arises;
when nature is joyful, things grow strong;
when heaven is joyful, the three lights shine brightly;
when earth is joyful, it achieves constancy;
when the five phases are joyful, they do not harm each other;
when the four seasons are joyful, all that is born flourishes;
when the king is joyful, the world is free from illness;
when crawling creatures are joyful, they do not harm or injure each other;
when all things are joyful, they maintain their constancy;
when humans are joyful, they are not troubled and their hearts remain steady;
when ghosts and spirits are joyful, it benefits the emperor.
Therefore, joy
is made from the virtuous qì and essence of heaven and earth,
to reach the divine and luminous,
hence tranquility gives birth to brightness,
and brightness serves to await the spirits.
Being able to communicate with the divine and luminous,
having the Dao as a neighbor,
one may attain long life and enduring existence.
Seeking the Dao is often bitter,
unable to return one's thoughts to it,
but now, by transforming customs and changing habits,
directing the mind's intent,
who would still contend with it?
Does the joy of great peace emerge from the palace?
It surely purifies and calms the state,
pacifies the body to enter the Dao,
repels the Yí Dí,
and divine auspices respond and come.
The suspended images return,
and malevolent spirits depart.
The human spirit is born within,
but wanders outward;
if it wanders untimely,
its return becomes harmful to the body.
If one can pursue and bring it back,
self-governance will not fail.
How to pursue it?
Make the inner chamber empty with no one around,
draw images corresponding to the colors of the organs,
matching the qì of the four seasons,
and hang them in the window's light while contemplating them.
Above are the images of the organs,
below are the ten directions,
when lying down, think of them as near the suspended images,
and do not cease contemplation.
The spirits of the five organs can respond to the qì of the twenty-four hours,
and the spirits of the five phases will come to aid and save,
curing all diseases.
Men contemplate male images,
women contemplate female images,
all using one foot as the standard,
shifting with the four seasons.
In spring, ten green youths;
in summer, ten red youths;
in autumn, ten white youths;
in winter, ten black youths;
in the four seasons' transition,
twelve yellow youths.
The twenty-five spirit persons and true humans all share in the Dao and virtue,
practicing the correct methods,
where yáng transforms into yīn,
and yīn transforms into yáng,
yīn and yáng harmonize,
and the Dao can then be practiced.
Heaven needs earth to give birth,
earth needs heaven to achieve completion.
Spring and summer need autumn and winter,
day needs night,
the ruler needs ministers,
to accomplish governance.
Ministers need the ruler,
to carry out their duties.
Thus, jiǎ needs yǐ,
zǐ needs chǒu,
all complete each other.
Practicing the Dao and governing should follow the way of heaven;
not corresponding with others
is to go against the heavenly Dao.
Just as the Eastern Sea lies low and loves water,
all rivers return to it.
Because it attains the Dao,
whales emerge from it,
and the bright moon pearl is born there,
which is the effect of attaining the Dao.
Where Dao practitioners gather,
extraordinary methods for prolonging life will surely emerge,
and great auspicious signs will respond.
When many worthies gather, they bring about peace and order;
when many texts gather, there is minor disorder;
when the five weapons gather, governance is greatly ruined.
The ruler should uphold the Dao,
ministers should uphold virtue,
for the Dao and virtue
are like the outer and inner layers of clothing.
If heaven were not vast,
it could not encompass all things.
All things are half good and half evil,
all must be endured,
and the ruler mirrors this,
next is the empress and the inner court's image.
These two
follow the method of loving parents.
Thus, parents raising children
love the good ones,
pity the bad ones,
and only then can family harmony be achieved.
The sun symbolizes the ruler,
the moon symbolizes the great ministers,
the stars symbolize the hundred officials,
and with all worthies shining together,
all things harmoniously come to life.
Therefore, the clear attaches to heaven,
the turbid attaches to earth,
and the harmonious middle attaches to humans.
I wish to make all the spirits under heaven harmonize and be kind,
no longer recklessly harming people,
so heaven and earth are perpetually pleased,
all spirits are joyful,
and people have no suffering.
The emperor receives heaven's strength,
and all endeavors are blessed;
how could there be any gap?
Thus, the sage can uphold the Dao,
and in times of clarity and tranquility, at dawn while eating,
all the spirits call out and speak with him,
much like how people today call guests.
The hundred spirits say they are heaven's officials and heaven's envoys,
the myriad essences are earth's officials and earth's envoys,
and the hundred ghosts are envoys of the harmonious middle.
These three
are envoys of yīn, yáng, and the harmonious middle.
They assist heaven and earth in governance,
together bringing benefit to the emperor.
The method of preserving the One and achieving brightness
is the root of longevity.
All spirits can be revered,
emerging from the gate of radiance.
At the moment of singular clarity,
like the initial birth of a flame,
swiftly guard it without loss.
It begins with true crimson,
culminates in true white,
and after prolonged time becomes true azure.
Penetrating brightness extends infinitely far and beyond,
returning to govern the One,
so that within nothing remains unilluminated.
All ailments are eliminated;
preserve this without slackening—
this can be called the art of ten thousand years.
The method of preserving the One and achieving brightness
manifests the light of the rising sun,
the brilliance of midday,
this foremost excellence attains heaven-endowed longevity.
Dwelling peacefully in tranquil places,
for ten thousand generations without fail.
Preserving the method of the One at all times,
the practice of the Way has superior and inferior aspects.
What, then, is the Way?
It is the primordial head of all things,
that which cannot be named.
Within the six extremes,
nothing can transform without the Way.
Primordial qi practices the Way,
giving birth to all things;
whether heaven and earth, large or small,
none come into being without the Way.
Thus, formless primordial qi
controls the formed,
yet the expression of primordial qi
does not arise dependent on the Way.
What is spontaneous
is the natural state of all things.
Without practicing the Way,
one cannot encompass heaven and earth,
each finding its proper place,
enabling the high to be unaware of peril.
Heaven practices the Way,
unceasing day and night,
swifter than wind and rain,
yet still fears losing the intent of the Way—
how much more should a king?
The three luminaries practice the Way unceasingly,
thus they are fixed in heaven and illuminate the eight extremes;
if they lose the Way, their light perishes.
The king, his officials, and all things correspond;
all living beings dwell together,
with the five stars observing their faults.
If the king cultivates virtue,
the virtue star comes to guard him.
If he practices martiality,
the martial star comes to guard him.
If he practices softness,
the soft star comes to guard him.
If he practices strength,
the strong star comes to guard him.
If he practices faithfulness,
the faithful star comes to guard him.
Though distant in separation,
the response is near.
Heaven and humanity are one body—
can one not be cautious?
2.7 《The Method of Superior and Inferior Practice of the Way》
The king of spring should be warm,
the king of summer should be hot,
the king of autumn should be cool,
the king of winter should be cold—
this is the virtue of kingship.
The kingly qi connects with the emperor's qi,
the minister's qi corresponds with the prime minister,
the subtle qi corresponds with minor officials,
the resting qi aligns with the inner palace,
the depleted qi corresponds with the common people,
the punitive, deadly, and imprisoned qi correspond with criminals in jail,
resonating remotely according to their kinds.
If the Way is such that kingly qi does not come,
the king's grace cannot be bestowed.
The ancient sage kings contemplated the Way through this,
thus the signs of gain and loss,
they examined their meanings in detail.
When the king practices the Way,
heaven and earth rejoice;
when he loses the Way,
heaven and earth manifest disasters and anomalies.
If the king quietly contemplates virtue and the Way,
practices the Way to secure his person,
and seeks longevity through self-cultivation,
harmonizing the way of husband and wife,
so that both yin and yang attain their proper places,
then heaven and earth are at peace.
Heaven and the emperor are separated by millions of miles,
yet they correspond with the Way—
is this not divine?
2.8 《The Divine Formula》
Primordial qi is spontaneous,
collectively forming the nature of heaven and earth.
If the six directions and eight dimensions are joyful,
then good responses arise;
if not joyful,
then evil responses arise.
Their forms resemble images,
their sounds echo in harmony.
The Great Yin,
Great Yang,
and Central Harmony—these three qi together create order,
mutually influencing each other,
with humanity as the pivotal mechanism,
thus one should deeply understand this.
If all know to value their lives,
nourish their bodies,
then they know to honor those above,
love those below,
delight in life and detest death,
causing the three qi to be joyful,
together creating great harmony,
then corresponding manifestations arise in unison.
Simply gather numerous worthies,
solely contemplate the way of longevity,
thus securing those above,
making them treasured vessels of the state.
If one can nourish one's nature,
then one can nourish one's people.
Heaven has no private favor;
it blesses those who have integrity.
Spirits have no private attachments;
they take the virtuous as their standard.
Within a single person,
one can become a worthy,
become divine,
or become unworthy—
what is the reason for this?
It is error,
or the revelation of spiritual intelligence.
Therefore, the way of preserving the One,
nourishing one's nature,
lies in learning it.
Among the multitude, those with many auspicious signs
are people of integrity.
Those without auspicious signs
are people of erroneous conduct.
Observing these, right and wrong can be known.
What the scale measures
is human sentiment.
Heaven's reflection of people
is no different from a mirror.
Scrutinize this meaning in detail:
align with heaven's will,
act in accord with true spirits—how can this not bring good fortune?
Accomplishing affairs□□,
not missing a hair's breadth,
one seeks to attain the intent of heaven and earth's central harmony.
Thus, when heaven and earth are harmonized, all things are at peace;
when the government is just, all people are well-governed.
Therefore, if purely yang is practiced,
the earth will not fully complete;
if purely yin is practiced,
heaven will not fully generate.
One must unite the three unities,
so that yin and yang harmonize,
achieving balance within.
The ancient sages governed to attain great peace,
all seeking the heart of heaven and earth's central harmony;
if one qi is blocked,
a hundred affairs go awry.
2.9 《The Method of Harmonizing the Three Qi to Revive the Emperor》
Penetrate the harmony of Heaven, Earth, and the Central Harmony in discourse,
follow the great enterprise,
and roam with the three energies,
so that the ruler may govern without turmoil,
the virtuous all emerge,
assisting and uplifting the sovereign,
and Heaven greatly rejoices.
The sincere disciple asked the divine being:
"I wish to enable the sovereign to immediately bring about great peace;
may I hear how?"
The divine being said:
"Simply greatly align with Heaven and Earth,
without losing a hair's breadth,
and great peace will be immediately achieved,
with auspicious signs arising together.
The primordial energy has three names:
Great Yang,
Great Yin,
and Central Harmony.
Forms have three names:
Heaven, Earth,
and humanity. Heaven has three names:
sun, moon,
and stars, with the North Pole as its center.
Earth has three names:
mountains,
rivers, and level land.
Humanity has three names:
father, mother,
and child. Governance has three names:
ruler, minister,
and people, desiring great peace.
These three should always be as close as heart and mind,
without losing a hair's breadth,
sharing the same concerns,
uniting as one family,
then great peace is immediately achieved,
and longevity is assured without doubt.
Thus, the male symbolizes Heaven,
so his heart yearns for the female;
this is Heaven's clear effect on humanity.
The minister communicates discourse for Earth;
Earth always desires to move upward,
uniting its heart with Heaven.
Thus, all things born from Earth
grow upward without ceasing,
and clouds rise to Heaven to form rain.
Therefore, loyal ministers' concerns are always directed upward,
eagerly never forgetting their ruler;
this is Earth's clear effect.
The people primarily engage in discourse of Central Harmony;
Central Harmony
is what harmonizes all things.
Central Harmony is like the infant;
the child is born through parents,
its life belongs to the father,
its lineage lies above,
entrusted to the mother for birth,
so in grievance, it thinks of its ruler and father.
These three represent the images of husband and wife, father and child.
They should communicate with words,
join forces and share concerns,
then the three energies merge into the Great Harmony.
From Great Harmony emerges the energy of great peace.
If these three energies are cut off,
one energy severed and unattained,
Great Harmony does not arrive,
and great peace does not emerge.
In yīn and yáng,
the key lies in Central Harmony.
When the energy of Central Harmony is attained,
all things multiply,
the people are harmonious and well-regulated,
and the king's governance achieves great peace.
The ruler of men
is like Heaven;
if his grace does not extend downward,
beings cannot come to life,
and people cannot prolong their years.
If the ruler's heart is not open and penetrating,
Heaven's heart cannot reach below,
and wife and children do not receive the ruler-father's instructions,
leading to a rebellious household.
If the minister's energy does not reach,
Earth's energy cannot complete,
how can loyal ministers then assist the enlightened king in governance?
Injuring Earth's heart,
like a widow in her chamber,
often suffers bitterness and sorrow,
good ministers cannot come forward.
If the people's energy does not rise upward,
how can harmonious energy flourish?
Central Harmony should harmonize with the sovereign's rule,
and all harmonizers of things should each attain proper governance.
Now, if the three energies do not well interconnect,
how can great peace be achieved?"
2.10 The Method for the Peaceful and Joyful Sovereign
The ruler should transform all things with the Dào and virtue,
enabling each to attain its proper place.
If one cannot transform all things,
one cannot be called a ruler.
Just as a husband and wife,
together bearing a child,
are called parents.
This is the image of a family;
if unable to bear a child,
how can they be called parents?
Thus, one who cannot transform and generate all things
cannot be called the parent of people.
Therefore, fire can transform the other four phases and itself makes five,
so it is called the image of the ruler.
Wood's nature is harmonious yet focused,
but meeting fire, it scatters into ash.
Metal's nature is firm and rigid,
but meeting fire, it becomes soft.
Earth's nature is very soft,
but meeting fire, it hardens into tile.
Water's nature is cold,
but meeting fire, it becomes warm.
Fire itself is one with the five phases,
yet can transform without constancy,
its nature active and rising upward.
Yīn follows yáng,
the minister follows the ruler,
and it also illuminates and inspects clearly,
distinguishing right from wrong,
hence it can be called the ruler;
the others cannot.
Earth does not transform immediately,
but over time it does transform,
so it is called the Queen Earth.
The three others assist in their duties,
representing the minister's image.
The Dào can transform all without exception,
thus the primordial energy abides by the Dào,
then circulates its energy,
giving birth to Heaven and Earth,
standing without pillars,
all things born without moving categories,
and so it continues through later generations,
though spoken of as having categories.
Like plants and trees growing from the earth,
do they truly have categories?
This is the primordial energy abiding by the Dào to generate thus.
Naturally abiding by the Dào and acting,
all things attain their proper places.
Heaven abides by the Dào and acts,
thus called divine and without fixed direction.
It images the ruler and father above,
with nothing it cannot control and transform,
truly grasping the Dào's intent.
Earth abides by the Dào and acts,
the five directions uniting in the center,
all things return to it.
The three lights abide by the Dào and act,
thus illuminating and inspecting all without exception.
Thunder and lightning abide by the Dào and act,
thus able to stir the world,
riding energy to come and go.
The four seasons and five phases abide by the Dào and act,
thus able to transform all things,
giving them constancy.
Yīn and yáng, female and male, abide by the Dào and act,
thus able to transmit through generations.
In all matters, great or small,
if they abide by the Dào and act,
there is no calamity.
But today, losing the Dào,
leads to great chaos.
Thus, when yáng is peaceful, all things naturally generate;
when yīn is peaceful, all things naturally complete.
Yīn and yáng govern the Dào,
teaching reaches their ministers,
transformation flows to their people,
receiving mandate from Heaven,
receiving substance from Earth,
receiving teaching from the master,
then one hears the essential Dào of the world.
Those who guard the root become kings;
those who guard the stem become ministers;
those who guard the superficial and ornate, even if good, bring chaos and inconstancy.
The sovereign
is the son of Heaven.
The empress
is the daughter of Earth,
and is the first divine energy of Heaven and Earth.
Heaven and Earth always wish them to be joyful,
not to suffer sorrow,
pitying them thus;
this is the primary intent and energy of Heaven and Earth's heart.
Therefore, if the sovereign is sorrowful,
the energies of the four seasons and five phases go awry,
and life and death become erratic.
2.11 The Method of Hanging Images and Returning the Spirit
The spirit is born within,
in spring, ten green youths;
in summer, ten red youths;
in autumn, ten white youths;
in winter, ten black youths;
in the four seasons,
twelve yellow youths.
This is the stored spirit of men,
and the spirit of women follows the same count.
Men think of men,
women think of women,
all using one foot as the standard.
Paint them well,
to make people love them.
If unable to enjoy restraint,
then the soul and spirit quickly return.
2.12 "The Doctrine on Resolving Inherited Burdens"
Since the creation of heaven and earth,
ominous energies have not ceased;
when they cease, they arise again later.
Why is this?
Lifespan,
is a precious treasure of heaven.
Thus, it privately rewards the virtuous,
and cannot be falsely obtained.
To understand this treasure,
heaven, earth, the six directions, eight distances, and all things,
must all be free from grievances and entanglements,
all greatly joyful,
then one can gain increased lifespan.
If one matter is displeasing,
there will be injury or death.
In the conduct of ordinary people,
some strive to do good,
yet反常ly receive evil,
or some strive to do evil,
but反常ly receive good,
thus claiming to be virtuous is incorrect.
Those who strive for good but receive evil,
are inheriting the faults of their ancestors,
the flowing disasters accumulated from past and present harm this person.
Those who do evil but receive good,
are due to their ancestors having deep accumulations of great merit,
flowing down to benefit this person.
If one can perform great merit ten-thousandfold,
even if ancestors have remaining calamities,
they cannot reach this person.
Instead, they pass on,
flowing to later generations,
forming inheritance up to five ancestors.
A small cycle spans ten generations,
then returns to the beginning.
Some perform minor good deeds insufficient to counteract,
the inherited disasters from their ancestors' flowing evils,
leading to extinction without descendants in middle age,
truly unjust.
Regarding inherited burdens,
heaven has three divisions,
emperors inherit over thirty thousand years,
ministers inherit over three thousand years.
Common people over three hundred years.
All inherit burdens interconnected,
one subsiding, another rising,
continuing with the rise and fall of human governance.
Now if one can emulate this,
using the celestial sovereign's rule to sever it,
ponder deeply and do not forget.
All people have three lifespans,
corresponding to three energies,
the lives of Tàiyáng, Tàiyīn, and Zhōnghé.
Upper lifespan is one hundred twenty,
middle lifespan eighty,
lower lifespan sixty.
One hundred twenty corresponds to heaven,
as the great calendar ends a year completing heaven and earth's realm.
Eighty corresponds to Yīnyáng,
distinguishing eight pairs corresponding to earth,
separately对应 earth,
distinguishing all things,
the dead depart,
the living remain.
Sixty corresponds to the Zhōnghé energy,
attaining the sixth month's Dùn hexagram.
Dùn means,
to flee or escape,
thus it governs the meeting of life and death.
If one ceaselessly does good,
exceeding this lifespan is called transcending the world.
If one ceaselessly does evil,
not reaching the three lifespans,
all is premature death.
Those dying in the womb or before adulthood,
are called innocent, inheriting the ancestors' faults.
Those with frequent head ailments,
are due to heaven's energy displeased.
Those with frequent foot ailments,
are due to earth's energy displeased.
Those with frequent internal organ ailments,
are due to the five phases' energies battling.
Those with frequent limb ailments,
are due to the four seasons' energies discordant.
Those with frequent deafness or blindness,
are due to the three lights losing their measure.
Those with frequent chills and fevers,
are due to Yīn and Yáng energies contending angrily.
Those with frequent confusion and disorder,
are due to all things losing their place.
Those frequently afflicted by ghostly entities,
are due to heaven and earth's spirits angered.
Those frequently dying of warm diseases,
are due to Tàiyáng energy killing.
Those frequently dying of cold diseases,
are due to Tàiyīn energy harming.
Those frequently dying suddenly,
are due to punitive energy too urgent.
Those with frequent Qi distension or shortness of breath,
are due to the eight nodes disordered.
Now heaven, earth, Yīn, and Yáng,
internally completely lose their proper places,
thus causing harm and affliction to all things.
If the emperor's governance is discordant,
floods and droughts become irregular,
bandits and thieves frequently arise,
yet instead he hastens punishments,
or increases them severely, chaos multiplies,
entanglements unresolved,
people all cry out to heaven,
officials' governance perverse and chaotic,
losing rhythm, irregular,
all things harmed and lost,
above, moving the azure heaven,
the three lights turbulent and多变,
constellations moving chaotically;
thus, only the ultimate Dào can save it.
I know heaven's intent does not deceive you.
Once heaven's majesty is stirred,
it cannot be restrained.
To offend heaven,
causes people to die prematurely.
At the beginning of heaven and earth's creation,
since the great sages each comprehended one aspect,
sincerely knowing the truth,
they no longer had doubts.
Thus, each could establish a great undertaking,
for later generations to cultivate,
without error or mistake.
Therefore, sages each excel in one great undertaking,
unable to fully know heaven's Dào,
thus their virtues differ.
Compare this to heaven,
how much more so for humans?
Heaven and earth each excel in one,
thus heaven excels in height and clarity,
earth excels in depth and turbidity,
Zhōnghé excels in nurturing all things.
Even they cannot encompass all,
how much less can ordinary people?
Hài is the northwest pole of heaven and earth,
Sì is the southeast pole of heaven and earth,
if Hài's cold is not timely contained,
the next year Sì will be harmed in return.
Zǐ is the north pole of heaven and earth,
Wǔ is the south pole of heaven and earth,
if Zǐ's winter is not well followed in storage,
Wǔ will inherit the burden and perish in return.
Chǒu is the northeast pole of heaven and earth,
Wèi is the southwest pole of heaven and earth,
if Chǒu does not timely initiate growth,
by the sixth month, it will suffer punishment in return.
Heaven and earth's nature and movement,
are all like this.
Now if the emperor resides within a hundred layers,
and employs Dào and Dé,
benevolence and goodness extend ten thousand Lǐ,
the common people receive his grace.
Fathers are kind,
sons are filial,
households are sufficient, people provided for,
no one commits evil.
If the emperor resides within,
but loses his Dào and Dé,
ten thousand Lǐ away,
the people and officials neglect their duties,
this all, though separated by millions of Lǐ,
stems from the same cause.
Practicing good words,
is not as good as practicing them in person.
2.13 "Untitled"
The Perfected One asked the Divine Being:
"In my life, I do not know what can be said to bring constant joy?"
The Divine Being replied:
"Do you not observe the vast Perfected Ones of old?
The reason they are born first and age later
is because they discard what is false, is it not?
When a person exclusively cherishes the True Dào,
the True Dào is constantly preserved while the false diminishes.
Though all ordinary people end up in hardship and poverty,
I alone endure eternally,
and this is constant joy."
"If one is brightly and uniquely joyful,
what is there to resent?
But if one ultimately fails to achieve longevity,
what should be done?"
The Divine Being said:
"Accumulated practice leads to near accomplishment,
contemplating goodness leads to near life.
Now, the Dào
is the scripture of the infinite.
In ancient times, Divine Beings governed with it,
employing Perfected Ones as ministers
to rule their people,
so the people did not know that above them there was a Son of Heaven,
but governed themselves naturally and effortlessly through the Dào.
Next, when Perfected Ones governed,
they used Immortals as ministers,
and though the people did not always know there was a Son of Heaven,
they heard his teachings and respected their ruler.
Next, when Immortals governed,
they employed Dào practitioners as ministers,
and their rule slightly involved punishments, with laws and decrees becoming evident,
so the people's hearts were stirred and they felt fear,
and cunning deceit began to arise.
Next, under hegemonic rule,
without carefully selecting ministers,
the people suffered many injustices and chaos emerged,
moving gradually away from order,
and closer to disorder,
beyond control again.
Therefore, thinking of divinity attracts divinity,
thinking of truth attracts truth,
thinking of immortality attracts immortality,
thinking of the Dào attracts the Dào,
thinking of wisdom attracts wisdom.
When a sage concentrates on thinking of worthy people,
it draws the spirits of the worthy to aid him;
if he thinks of falsity,
it draws the ghosts of foolish people to confuse him.
Whatever a person can contemplate,
can be attracted,
depending only on the quality of what is contemplated.
Thus, when a superior person becomes a ruler,
he thinks of the divine and true;
when a middling person becomes a ruler,
his heart is perceptive and full of wisdom;
when an inferior person becomes a ruler,
he has nothing worthy to contemplate,
but follows fate in what he does."
2.14 Untitled
The Perfected Person asked:
"How can one know whether an emperor thinks good or evil thoughts?"
The Divine Person said:
"Is it not easy to know?
When an emperor thinks benevolent and good thoughts,
auspicious signs appear specifically for him,
charts and texts are born specifically for him.
Imperial benevolence and wisdom are born from wood and fire,
martial prowess and intelligence are born from metal and water,
gentleness is born from earth.
Heaven's manifestations
are never mistaken."
The Perfected Person asked:
"In ancient times, when specially created charts and extraordinary methods appeared,
who would obtain them?"
"Those officials or commoners who obtained them would present them to the sovereign.
When the emperor's seasonal energy becomes harmonious and excellent,
governance becomes increasingly enlightened,
and those skilled in the Way and its methods, along with sages and philosophers, emerge to assist him,
the emperor's Way
grows stronger daily.
Barbarian tribes are extinguished and silenced,
he governs with folded hands,
punishments naturally cease,
the people have no warfare,
these are proofs of the emperor thinking good thoughts.
How could one not know this?
Without seeing the person,
one already knows it."
The Perfected Person asked:
"How can a Divine Person know this?"
The Divine Person said:
"Through attaining soundlessness.
When the ruler desires benevolence and loves life,
he emulates the Way of Heaven;
when ministers desire gentleness and compliance, loving nourishment,
they model themselves on the Way of Earth,
then good responses appear.
Thus Heaven and Earth do not speak yet endure eternally,
their governance is uniquely spiritual,
divine spirits do not speak yet achieve long-lasting transcendence,
all because they are luminous within and obscure without,
thus they form the beginning of the myriad ways.
The coming and going of divine spirits
has no holes or nests,
they are tranquil and without sound,
lying down with peaceful pillows,
divine light naturally arises;
how could this not bring auspicious joy?
Those who use their mouth excessively exhaust their essence,
those who use their strength excessively torment their body,
those who use force excessively harm their person,
these are where misfortune and disaster are born.
Be careful of my words,
do not think recklessly.
Thinking good thoughts may bring virtue,
thinking evil thoughts returns to harm oneself,
between safety and danger,
the distinction is as fine as a hair's breadth,
be warned not to have mixed thoughts.
When people lose the Way, their life is cut off,
if one truly understands the meaning of the Way, life can be preserved,
diligently nourish your essence,
do not torment yourself.
Learn from and serve an enlightened teacher,
then calamity and chaos cannot arise."
The Perfected Person dared not disregard the Divine Person's words.
The Divine Person said:
"Learners each act for themselves,
not for others.
Therefore they should love and care for themselves,
studying the Way over time,
they become truly divine,
transcending the ordinary masses,
this is what is meant."
The Perfected Person asked:
"How can one know the efficacy of the Way?"
The Divine Person said:
"Decide through an enlightened teacher,
practice it in your own person;
when your body transforms and changes,
you join the same gate as the spiritual Way,
becoming neighbors with the True,
sharing the same household with divine persons.
Seek it within your own person,
why not observe the troubles?
If you lose the meaning of the Way,
and instead seek it in the wilds,
searching without finding,
you will reach destitute old age.
Then you leave your root,
saying there is no Way in the world,
constantly alone and sorrowful,
leaving your root,
this is great disaster.
Great persons losing it cannot bring order to their governance,
middle-level persons losing it bring chaos to their ruler,
benevolent persons losing it have no means to become worthy,
petty persons losing it destroy themselves.
The conduct of ancient sages and worthies
was the same as today.
The destitution of ancient petty persons
was also the same as today,
the clear evidence is like this."
The Perfected Person asked:
"How can one know whether a person will prosper or decline?"
The Divine Person said:
"When a great person is about to prosper,
extraordinary texts appear,
worthies assist him in governance;
when a family is about to prosper,
those seeking obtain life,
one can know their children will be good."
The Perfected Person asked:
"How to attract such worthies?"
The Divine Person said:
"All through thought,
concentrated thinking without cease,
then such matters will come."
"Divine indeed,
the Way's governance,
should one not strive to practice it?"
The Divine Person said:
"The reason the three bonds and six disciplines can long remain auspicious
is because they preserve the Way,
not losing their governance, thus constantly auspicious.
Heaven's lifespan
does not override human wishes.
The nature of wood is benevolence,
thinking benevolence thus reaches the East,
the East governs benevolence.
All five directions are like this.
All matters under heaven
follow their respective categories.
Thus when an emperor thinks of tranquility,
his governance is also tranquil,
attracting through categories.
Ancient learners
emulated it in their own persons;
today's learners
instead emulate it in others.
Ancient learners used it to secure their persons,
today's learners pursue flashy ornamentation.
Not accumulating essence in their persons,
instead accumulating essence in ornamentation,
this is not knowing the root."
"Perfected Person, come forward,
you have been coming to study the Way continuously,
is your understanding truly complete and sufficient or not?"
"Now the Celestial Master no longer explains for me,
thinking I am already sufficient,
but hearing the Celestial Master speak again,
I realize there are still deficiencies.
Now my understanding is exhausted,
I don't know what else to ask.
I only hope the Celestial Master will further reveal what I have not reached."
"Very well,
Perfected Person, come.
What in the world is called wealthy and sufficient,
and what is called poor?"
"Well,
those who have much are wealthy,
those who have little are poor."
"Well,
your words are correct,
yet actually incorrect."
"What does this mean?"
"Now if there are many wicked, false, flattering thieves and robbers,
can that be considered wealth?
Now if common people are many,
and rulers few,
can that be called poverty?"
"This ignorant one, upon hearing the Celestial Master's instruction,
dares not refrain from speaking,
lest I be at fault."
"You yourself say you are inadequate,
how could ordinary people know the meaning of wealth and poverty?"
"Now I only ask the Celestial Master to instruct your ignorant disciple,
like an ignorant infant
who needs parents to teach before gaining knowledge."
"Excellent,
your words.
Very humble,
yet not mistaken.
Very well.
Perfected Person, concentrate your essence,
I will explain fully for you.
Wealth in speech
means complete and sufficient preparation.
Heaven considers the complete birth of all things as wealth and sufficiency,
thus when the primordial imperial energy emerged,
all twelve thousand things were completely born,
called wealth and sufficiency.
The middle imperial things slightly decreased,
unable to fully produce the twelve thousand things,
thus called minor poverty.
The later imperial things were fewer than the middle imperial,
called great poverty."
Without auspicious responses,
good things do not grow,
resulting in extreme poverty.
If you wish to know its major manifestation,
it is truly comparable to a farming family
that possesses no rare objects or treasures,
thus being a poor household.
When all things cannot be fully provided, it becomes the poorest household,
which is the poverty of Heaven and Earth.
When all twelve thousand creatures emerge,
and the Earth nurtures them without harm, it is Earth's wealth;
if not well nurtured,
causing minor harm is Earth's minor poverty;
major harm is Earth's major poverty;
when good things fear to appear,
harmed by the Earth's form and thus not growing,
it reaches the extreme of poverty;
having no precious treasures,
with half of all things harmed,
is great destitute poverty.
Complete harm is empty poverty of the household.
This takes Heaven as father,
and Earth as mother.
When these parents are extremely poor,
then the children suffer poverty.
This corresponds with royal governance.
Therefore, when sage kings of antiquity governed,
they could attract all twelve thousand creatures,
becoming the most wealthy rulers.
When good things are less than two-thirds,
it is moderately wealthy rulers.
When less than one-third,
it is lesser wealthy rulers.
Having no rare and good things,
makes the poorest rulers.
When half of all things are harmed,
it is a declining household.
When all are harmed, it is the poorest people.
The sages and worthies of antiquity would dwell deeply in secluded chambers,
reflecting on the Way and its Power,
and the extent of poverty and wealth they attained -
why need they ask?
Sitting quietly, they knew it themselves."
"Excellent, excellent!
Now may the Celestial Master take pity on the emperor
who has long been anxious and suffering,
unable to act according to his will.
How can one achieve such poverty or wealth?"
"Excellent, excellent!
Your difficult question
has already touched upon subtle and essential words.
However, it is achieved through the gains and losses of one's conduct.
Those who diligently practice the true Way
will have spirits born of Heaven assist their transformation,
thus heavenly spirits and good things are fully provided.
Those who practice virtue
will have nurturing spirits of Earth's yang emerge,
assisting their governance,
thus achieving half wealth.
Those who practice humaneness
will have spirits of central harmony and humaneness emerge to assist their governance,
thus achieving minor wealth.
Those who practice ornamentation
enter the steps of concealment and deception,
thus deceptive spirits emerge to assist them,
therefore their governance becomes slightly chaotic.
Those who practice militarism
will have spirits of bandits and thieves emerge to assist them,
thus their governance contradicts the heart of Heaven,
and harms good people.
The Way
is what Heaven follows in its operations.
Heaven is most divine,
thus true spirits emerge to assist its transformation.
Earth is nurturing,
thus virtuous spirits emerge to assist its transformation.
Humans should be humane,
thus humane spirits emerge to assist their transformation.
Ornamentation primarily involves mutual embellishment and deception,
losing its fundamental root,
thus deceptive spirits emerge to assist it;
when superiors and inferiors mutually embellish,
their affairs become chaotic.
Militarism uses punishment and killing to subdue people;
bandits and thieves also use punishment and killing to subdue people;
using anger, pleasure, and fierce authority to subdue people
is the way of bandits and thieves.
Therefore, when many bandits and thieves emerge,
the governance is ominous.
Bandits and thieves mostly harm through material goods,
thus such governance fails in wealth and goods.
Therefore, superior rulers of antiquity used the Way to subdue people,
greatly obtaining Heaven's heart,
their governance was like that of spirits,
without anxiety -
this is because they used the true Way to subdue people;
middle rulers used virtue to subdue people;
lesser rulers used humaneness to subdue people;
chaotic rulers used ornamentation to subdue people;
ominous and failing rulers would use punishment and killing to subdue people.
Therefore, superior rulers of antiquity used the Way, its Power, and humaneness to govern and subdue people,
not using ornamentation, punishment, or killing to subdue people.
The reason for this
is that the latter is base usage.
Superior gentlemen resemble Heaven and Earth,
thus Heaven prefers life and does not harm,
therefore it is called ruler and father.
Earth prefers to nurture all things,
therefore it is called good minister and mother.
Humans should use their hearts humanely,
loving and nurturing similar to Heaven and Earth,
therefore called humane.
These three are good,
thus they can jointly govern all things,
serving as their teachers and leaders.
Deception and punishment
cannot be used to govern,
daily leading to ominous outcomes,
unable to bring peace to imperial rule,
thus they should be eliminated.
Now you, the Perfected, should deliver my writings to rulers with the Way and its Power,
diligently practice them to achieve results,
immediately correspond with Heaven,
and attain great peace,
which can be called a wealthy household -
do not doubt this,
so as to not cause emperors anxiety and suffering,
instead being called poor households.
Now among common people, sometimes they call each other wealthy households -
what does this mean?
This is merely common people's reckless talk.
Wealth in speech
means complete and full provision.
If one thing is not available,
then it is considered incomplete.
Therefore, when sages and worthies of antiquity did not demand completeness from one person,
they meant that one cannot be complete,
thus they did not demand completeness.
Now in the eighty-one regions and states,
each has insufficient goods,
unable to be constantly sufficient,
thus they take from other states.
So how can a single household be considered wealthy?
Do you, Perfected, prefer to follow common people's reckless talk?"
"I dare not, I dare not."
"Since you are learning, be careful in speech,
do not talk recklessly.
Reckless talk
disorders the proper patterns of Heaven and Earth,
cannot serve as models for people -
be careful of this."
"Yes, yes.
Now that the Celestial Master has bestowed gracious love,
taking pity on the emperor's position,
his anxious and suffering heart,
not obtaining Heaven's intent,
and for each matter thoroughly explaining
the path that can lead to supreme peace:
this ignorant student has received numerous writings,
greatly confused in childish ignorance,
not knowing what more to ask.
May the enlightened teacher
fully present his instructions."
"Excellent, excellent!
Now according to heavenly law,
yang numbers one,
yin numbers two.
Thus yang is odd,
yin is even.
Therefore, rulers are few while ministers are many.
Yang is honorable,
yin is humble,
thus two yin should serve one yang together,
therefore Heaven's number is one while Earth's number is two,
thus two women should serve one man.
Why must two people support one person?
The honorable one's side cannot be empty;
when one person moves,
another should stand or sit beside them,
attending to their deficiencies.
Thus the number one
represents Heaven.
The number two
represents Earth.
Humans
are children of Heaven and Earth,
thus should resemble their parents.
Since the world lost the Way,
many have despised women,
instead harming and killing them,
causing women to be fewer than men,
Thus causing the yin energy to be severed,
it does not correspond with the laws of heaven and earth.
The way of heaven follows the principle,
that solitary yang without a pair,
leads to withering,
causing heaven not to rain in season.
Women correspond to earth,
yet they are uniquely despised,
the world together despises their true mother,
collectively harming and killing the earth's energy,
causing the earth's energy to be severed and not produce,
the earth greatly angered and displeased,
disasters and calamities increase,
causing the king's governance to be unstable.
Why is this?
For men,
are the essence spirit of heaven.
Women,
are the essence spirit of earth.
Things move each other according to their kind,
the king's governance is unstable,
fundamentally it is not solely the king's fault.
It is because ordinary people have lost the way and trivialized matters,
together doing wrong,
their faults are not just one,
but myriad;
thus making governance difficult to stabilize and full of errors.
In the nature of heaven and earth,
among the twelve thousand beings,
human life is the most precious,
this harming and killing of women,
deeply disrupts the king's governance,
the great fault lies herein. "
"Now the celestial master opens the path to great peace for the king,
the true scripture of great peace emerges,
for the king, he should only roam without troubles,
but now this injury to women causes great disasters,
what should be done about it?"
"Excellent,
your question,
has captured the heart of heaven.
However, the reason the world despises and detests women,
originally the fault lies in their conduct."
"What does that mean?
I wish to hear it,
so I may record it on bamboo and silk,
for ten thousand generations never to discard."
"Excellent,
that you now can record it,
the world will no longer kill women."
"Yes, yes.
I wish to record it,
to remove the disasters of the emperor,
which pleases me,
and to save the lives of wronged women."
"Excellent,
you have already gained increased lifespan from heaven."
"What does that mean?"
"Well,
saving people's lives is called saving oneself,
killing people is called killing oneself.
Heaven loves you, and you have already gained added lifespan from heaven,
the Director of Fate has changed your register."
"I dare not,
I dare not."
"There is no need to decline further,
this is the natural law of heaven.
However, the reason the world kills women,
is that when people are young,
their parents worry and suffer,
cutting back on food and clothing to raise them together.
Not only humans,
even crawling creatures are the same.
As they grow old and large or small,
each should seek food and clothing according to their strength,
thus all beings leave their parents to feed and clothe themselves.
The virtuous find joy,
the unworthy find suffering.
Moreover, children are young,
their strength daily grows abundant.
Parents daily age and decline,
their strength daily diminishes and is insufficient.
Whether son or daughter,
the wise and virtuous with abundant strength,
should still repay their parents' efforts and kindness by supporting them.
Therefore, parents should not follow them for food and clothing.
This is called the weak supporting the strong,
the insufficient in strength supporting the abundant,
called perverse governance.
The young instead cause worry and suffering to the old,
not benefiting their parents,
hence parents often kill them.
Now, merely for lack of food and clothing to harm and kill them,
how does that compare to nurturing them alive,
and letting them each feed and clothe themselves?
True man!
This truly unjustly severs earth's order,
the people's folly is extreme."
"Now hearing this,
my heart is greatly saddened and fearful,
knowing the wronged are indeed many,
what should be done?"
"Well,
those who love learning but lack food and clothing,
their studies will slacken and the way stop,
but if they gain food and clothing,
then the virtuous will learn without ceasing.
Each should have their own benefits,
not causing them to instead worry and impoverish each other."
"What does that mean?"
"For women without households,
a woman joining a husband,
is like a man taking office,
she should gain food and clothing.
A woman joining her husband's family,
should unite efforts and同心协力 manage livelihood,
together transmitting heaven and earth's order,
until death still sharing the same flesh and blood,
should unite efforts,
and thereby gain food and clothing.
Let the virtuous be joyful,
let the unworthy suffer.
Like land,
good soil produces good things,
heaven also entrusts it to them;
poor soil produces bad things,
heaven also entrusts it to them;
not depriving them of their capacity to grow.
Heaven and earth do not deprive you of your efforts,
how much more should people?
Thus, no one will kill their daughters anymore."
"Excellent, excellent,
one great harm is removed,
the emperor's great peace has arrived."
"How does the true man know this?"
"Well,
parents and children,
represent the deepest bond under heaven,
should not be troubled with worry,
should not kill them.
If one kills their child,
it responds to the energy of bandits,
greatly rebellious and utterly without dao.
Hence it most deeply disrupts the emperor's governance.
Women,
now able to live without seeing harm or killing,
thus great joy has arrived."
"Well,
what you say is right,
you may be said to understand.
Now if one family under heaven kills one daughter,
how many hundred million families are under heaven?
Some families kill ten or more daughters,
some harm them while pregnant, before birth,
even injuring them,
their energy of injustice gathers and moves heaven above,
how can there be no principle?
Thus I truly value understanding this.
If people each feed and clothe themselves by their own strength,
then women will not have divided hearts,
their minds专心 on tasks,
no longer hesitant.
If suffering without achievement,
it causes constant discord in people's minds.
This,
is the natural technique of innate nature.
True man, be cautious,
do not discard this book,
give it to a benevolent and worthy ruler,
it can remove one great injustice and disaster.
Heed my words in this book,
show them to ordinary people,
none will again abandon women,
then it will correspond to heaven and earth's laws,
one man obtaining two women.
Thus heaven establishes laws,
yang numbers are odd,
yin numbers are even.
Since the great middle antiquity,
people have lost the meaning of heaven's way,
often harming and killing them,
instead causing men to be many and women few and insufficient.
Greatly contrary to heaven's way,
causing mutual inherited burdens,
becoming common custom.
Later generations intensify the world's evil faults,
deeply painful and without dao.
For men inherit heaven's order,
women inherit earth's order;
now severing earth's order,
causing it not to be transmitted for life,
thereafter many lines end extinct without posterity,
how heavy is this crime!
These should mutually produce and transmit kinds,
now severing earth's order,
exterminating humankind,
thus heaven long cuts off their lineage.
Moreover, all humans are conceived carrying the celestial energy and are born with it fully developed.
The head is round,
symbolizing Heaven;
the feet are square,
symbolizing Earth;
the four limbs,
represent the four seasons;
the five organs,
correspond to the five phases;
the ears, eyes, mouth, and nose,
embody the seven regulators and three luminances;
these correspondences are too numerous to record fully,
only the sage understands them.
All humans inherently possess yīn and yáng,
when the moon is full, the womb opens and they emerge,
gazing upon Heaven and Earth which continue to grow,
jointly transmitting the legacy of their ancestors,
assisting Heaven in generating life,
and aiding Earth in nurturing forms.
Now Heaven and Earth's spirits trust this household,
thus the spirits of Heaven and Earth come to dwell within this person,
yet humans instead harm them,
Heaven greatly condemns this,
and people do not restrain each other,
therefore Heaven sends me to produce this
book to reveal it to later generations.
Once the matter is exposed,
and one still deliberately repeats it,
it is called intentionally violating Heaven's law,
the crime is doubled,
annihilation of the lineage is certain.
Perfected ones, be cautious of this,
exert yourselves, exert yourselves!"
"Yes, yes."
"You, having now uncovered this matter,
if you flee and abandon this book,
you will bear the guilt on behalf of others."
"I dare not, I dare not."
"Go forth,
each of you plan for your own well-being."
"Yes, yes."

The above distinguishes and explains how poverty, wealth, and rulers' actions establish auspiciousness by prohibiting people from severing Earth's lineage to revive balanced gender relations and restore kingly governance.
"Perfected one, come forward.
Now the great harmonious energy of Heaven is about to arrive,
the king's rule will soon be peaceful,
should people practice chastity or not?
Why should they practice chastity?"
"Chastity means
having few desires and not acting recklessly."
"Ah,
the Perfected one's explanation is simplistic.
Since the mid-antiquity,
it has been the error of common people,
their teachers internally jealous,
instead instruct people to act recklessly."
The Perfected one said:
"What does this mean?"
"The chaste man does not emit,
the chaste woman does not transform.
When yīn and yáng do not interact,
it leads to extinction without descendants.
Two people together sever Heaven and Earth's lineage,
coveting minor, hypocritical reputations,
resulting in no posterity,
losing their true essence,
this is a great harm to the world.
Had you not received life transmitted by your parents,
how could you exist?
Yet you instead sever it,
this is what Heaven and Earth both detest,
naming such persons as those who cut off principle and commit great rebellion.
The response will be that Heaven and Earth become estranged,
Heaven refuses to rain,
Earth refuses to transform and generate.
Why is this?"
"When Heaven does not rain,
it is its chastity in not emitting;
when Earth does not produce all things,
it is its chastity in not transforming.
If Heaven does not rain,
and Earth has nothing to generate,
this is a great calamity for the world.
How can this be considered good?"
"Observing the Perfected one's explanation,
it disobeys the teaching of Heaven and Earth,
causing rebellion against the celestial way,
not joyfully assisting Heaven and Earth in generation and transformation,
instead wishing to sever it.
When you speak these words,
do you feel no debt to the great Heaven and posterior Earth?"
"Ignorance does not excuse fault,
hearing the Celestial Master's explanation,
do I not realize the gravity of my offense?"
"Let me tell you,
in matters one should not oppose the celestial way,
and follow common people's words,
disobeying Heaven's will.
The reason yīn and yáng are often estranged
fundamentally stems from men and women not harmonizing.
Men and women
are the root of yīn and yáng.
If governing affairs loses this root,
how can it be auspicious?"
"Now only the Celestial Master
can say what should be done?"
"Indeed,
the great imperial Heaven's harmonious energy is about to arrive,
one should purely emulate Heaven.
Therefore, one man should obtain two women,
to symbolize yīn and yáng.
The number of yáng is odd,
the number of yīn is even.
This is the arrival of the great harmonious energy.
If there are too many women,
then yīn energy prevails;
if there are too many men,
