then yáng energy lacks its pair and has no method,
also leading to inauspiciousness.
Why?
Human numbers should correspond with Heaven and Earth,
if not corresponding, strength is insufficient,
thus incurring calamities."
"The emperor's harem corresponds to Earth,
what is the meaning?"
"What the Perfected one now says
supports my words.
Women
are the essence-spirit of Earth.
The king
is the essence-spirit of Heaven.
It is feared that Earth may not receive yáng's essence-spirit,
and the king's energy not harmonizing.
To prevent Earth from having untransformed generation,
each province selects one woman,
to connect its energy.
To delight in its transformative generation,
fearing its bestowed favor may not reach all,
the king's bestowal not permeating,
thus corresponding to Earth, they are taken.
When bestowed everywhere,
then Heaven's energy connects,
timely rain is obtained,
and Earth can transform and generate all things.
As the great peaceful energy arrives,
one cannot value chaste people,
internal isolation creates profound error,
causing the king's rule to be disharmonious and unwholesome.
Common people also must not exceed moderation,
therefore one man and two women are established."
"Excellent, excellent!"
The above follows Heaven and Earth,
models the union of yīn and yáng,
prevents grievances between men and women,
brings timely rain and Earth's transformative generation,
and ensures the king's rule is peaceful and harmonious.
"Before the True Man,
now the Tàipíng qì approaches,
desiring to make the cautious and good increasingly prosper,
and the wicked daily decline and retreat.
Because they inflict harm and kill people,
and bandits arise,
how should governance be conducted?"
"What do you mean?"
"It refers to approaching and initiating what is known.
Like when a ruler sits with doubts,
yet wishes to make the good greatly flourish,
and the wicked immediately decline.
When bandits arise,
they should be captured right away."
"How then should governance be conducted?"
"Now the True Man should diligently record this."
"Today the Celestial Master commands it,
how dare I not speak,
though my words often miss the Celestial Master's standards."
"Why speak with such humility?
Since ancient times, great sages do not demand perfection from one person.
Now if your words miss the mark,
why be humble?"
"Yes, yes.
Simply reward the good and punish the wicked,
making distinctions clear,
then the good will daily prosper,
and the wicked daily decline."
"Your words are correct,
but are there no specific names for rewards and punishments?"
"I cannot diligently offer a single word,
dare not repeat it.
Now only the Celestial Master can greatly enlighten us."
"Well then,
you, host, record it,
and I will explain it fully for you.
When senior officials arrive at the place of occurrence,
summon all the local people of the area.
Have former great ministers and officials sit facing east,
those versed in classics and moral principles sit facing north,
the filial and brotherly sit facing west,
diligent farmers' careful sons sit in the southeast corner facing northwest,
wicked youths sit in the southwest corner facing northeast,
while the ruler sits facing south.
Why must seating be arranged exactly so?
Each follows their kind,
thus the Way of Heaven aligns with humans to establish goodness.
Bandits are easily captured,
what does that mean?
Former great ministers and officials are placed in the position of righteousness,
these people have left office,
desiring them to joyfully assist with righteousness.
Those versed in classics and morals are placed in the position of clarity,
wanting them to illuminate their classical ways and help observe wickedness.
The filial and brotherly return to their native direction,
the most filial devote their hearts,
hence they are directed to their native place;
the filial and brotherly are to remain constantly respectful as in courtly times.
Things are born in the east,
rejoicing in their daily progress.
Diligent and hardworking sons are placed in the southeast corner,
as southeast is the region of growth and nourishment,
wishing them to joyfully cultivate all things without slacking.
Wicked youths are placed in the southwest,
southwest being
where yang declines and yin arises,
where wicked desires scheme and deceive,
punishments and crimes emerge there,
hence clever and crafty monkeys
are placed in a declining position.
Those facing east, west, and north all sit in front,
while the careless and wicked sit behind.
Those with wine are given a vessel each,
those without are given good words,
to help each other become clear-minded, and then it is completed.
The ruler sits in a secluded spot,
inside the door, closing himself off.
Call them one by one,
teaching these people beginning with respect for rank,
each speaking one thing,
each recording the responsible name.
What is said and recorded,
should later correspond,
those that do not correspond will be held accountable.
Those whose words do not match
are great flatterers and deceivers,
later the location of deceitful people will be known.
Those whose words correspond,
after a long time, then reward them,
advance those individuals,
why not immediately?
It would cause resentment.
For a ruler or father,
to make his ministers or sons resentful,
is not the way of a kind father or wise ruler.
So after completion, send all the good people away.
Wicked youths and officials together pursue and arrest, failing to catch the bandits,
they must not stop.
True Man, use this text,
to present to the virtuous ruler above,
to show ordinary people,
each knowing this teaching exists,
the good will daily prosper,
the wicked daily decline,
bandits and evil deceit will be captured."
"Excellent, excellent,
why show it first?"
"When Heaven is about to bring rain,
there must first be wind and clouds,
letting people know.
The reason for this
is to delight in their storing and collecting,
so showing first
delights in the good daily prospering,
and the wicked daily ceasing.
Now the Tàipíng qì is about to arrive,
fearing people doing evil disrupts its order,
hence forewarning them.
Governance should emulate Heaven.
Heaven does not cover up people's shortcomings,
the great ancient sages did not do so either,
called obscure and dark governance,
repeatedly leads to misfortune,
not attaining the intent of Heaven and Earth,
hence showing it first."
"Excellent, excellent,
why must the ruler sit inside the door, closed off,
while those speaking are outside?"
"Indeed,
when people are about to hear secret words,
they may not be self-aware beforehand.
With heads and faces close,
bystanders would know,
causing the speaker to be harmed.
For a ruler or leader,
receiving people's clarity,
then allowing that person to be harmed,
is called injuring loyalty and trustworthiness,
worthy and good supporters,
afterwards none will dare speak again.
Clarity and intelligence blocked off,
governance becomes chaotic and endangered.
Moreover, the ruler,
being yang,
resides within yin;
the ministers,
being yin,
are situated within yang.
When yin and yang harmonize,
it makes people pleased with what is said,
and advances will be fully trusted,
this is the natural law of Heaven.
True Man, do you understand this?"
"Yes, yes."
"Go now,
do not speak recklessly.
This is the text leading to Tàipíng."
"Yes, yes."
Right: The method for prospering goodness, stopping evil, achieving clarity, establishing, capturing bandits, and gaining loyalty and trust.
"Come forward, Zhēnrén."
"Yes, yes."
"Among all ordinary people's activities in the world,
how many are of great urgency?
How many are of lesser urgency?
And how many increasingly bring about calamity and misfortune yet are not urgent?
You should carefully and thoroughly explain this."
"Yes, yes.
I will speak sincerely from my heart,
daring not to conceal anything."
"Then speak."
"In all matters under heaven,
those that are useful are urgent,
those that are useless are not urgent."
"Your words are correct,
yet they are also incorrect.
What we seek are those constant urgencies that cannot be abandoned,
for if abandoned, the world would perish with no one left.
The patterns of heaven conjoined,
without names or labels,
thus constitute the great urgency.
What you now speak of,
merely temporarily satisfies human desires,
but instead fosters the conditions from which all misfortunes and calamities arise."
"Come forward, Zhēnrén,
what I now ask you
is precisely this: who are those constant urgencies that cannot be discarded?"
"Now only the Tiānshī can expound upon this,
differentiating and explaining it clearly.
This unworthy student overstepped,
and since one word missed the mark,
I dare not speak again."
"Indeed,
your words are correct.
One can only speak of what one knows;
to forcefully speak of what one does not know
will lead to one's own exhaustion."
"What ordinary people cannot reach,
whether matters great or small,
cannot be forcefully known.
To reach it is not difficult,
but not reaching it makes it no easier.
Therefore, since the Tiānshī has begun to enlighten this dull-witted student,
I wish for you to open up the beginning,
and I promise to listen attentively."
"There are two great urgencies under heaven,
one lesser urgency,
and all the rest are entirely non-urgent.
Instead, they clutter people's ears and eyes,
appearing good in the moment and lasting,
yet summoning calamity upon people.
All people thereby meet with ruin and failure.
What does this mean?"
"How foolish!
Yet when the people of the world first received life,
they separated from Heaven and Earth,
embracing the primal breath from spontaneity,
neither drinking nor eating,
but living by inhaling and exhaling the breaths of yīn and yáng,
unaware of hunger or thirst.
Over time, they drifted far from the divine way,
gradually losing its essential meaning.
Later generations could no longer know it;
the true way became empty and hollow,
daily flowing towards falseness,
thus regenerating hunger and thirst.
Without drinking and eating, they would die—
this is the first great urgency.
Heaven and Earth took pity on them,
together providing what could be drunk and eaten.
Once they drank and ate,
Heaven governs yīn and yáng,
which must be transmitted,
for the continuity of Heaven and Earth must not be interrupted.
Its transmission should mirror Heaven and Earth:
one yīn, one yáng.
Thus, Heaven caused them to have one man and one woman,
their appearances pleasing each other,
so that they could then produce life.
Why must it be exactly one yīn and one yáng?
Because when yáng reaches its extreme, it can generate yīn,
and when yīn reaches its extreme, it can generate yáng.
These two transmit to each other,
just as when cold ends, it turns to heat,
and when heat ends, it turns to cold—
this is the way of spontaneity.
Thus, they can endlessly generate each other,
generation after generation without cutting off Heaven and Earth's continuity.
If man and woman do not come together,
then there would be no posterity.
If the world had no people,
how could there be husband and wife, father and son, ruler and minister, teacher and disciple?
By what means would they generate and govern each other?
If between Heaven and Earth there were no female and male,
by what would they be transmitted?
It would be silent and empty—
this is the second great urgency.
Therefore, yīn and yáng
transmit the continuity of Heaven and Earth,
making it endless and limitless.
Ruler and minister
bring order to chaos.
Sages, teachers, and disciples are responsible for communicating the teachings of Heaven,
assisting the帝王 in transforming the world.
Hence, drinking and eating, and man and woman are interdependent;
these two are the great urgencies.
The way of Heaven has cold and heat,
which do not conceal themselves,
and can half injure and kill people.
Therefore, Heaven produces the myriad things
that can be used for clothing.
Without clothing,
one could only live hidden in caves,
worrying about being half injured and not completely perishing,
this is called the half urgency.
What is called the great urgency of the way of Heaven
refers precisely to extinction and death.
No urgency surpasses this.
If a person has no clothing,
certainly they cannot eat, drink,
or unite yīn and yáng—
it does not benefit them.
With clothing, worthy offspring are born;
without clothing, unworthy ones are born.
Therefore, clothing
serves only to protect against harm.
Thus, the sages and worthies of old did not emulate the dark and yellow.
Drinking, eating, and yīn-yáng cannot be cut off;
if cut off, the world would have no people
and could not be governed.
By upholding these three,
one can fully live out their natural lifespan,
transmit Heaven's continuity,
ending and beginning again,
without any limit.
Therefore, the sages of old governed by this principle.
All other non-urgent matters,
those that summon misfortune and harmful things, have been entirely removed.
What does this mean?
These three correspond to the movement of Heaven.
The male
is Heaven.
The female
is Earth.
Clothing
is reliance.
It is what Heaven, Earth, and parents rely on to nurture the human body.
Beyond these three,
all other strange and artificial things are not necessary for life
or for transmitting and generating kinds.
Instead, they often lead to falseness and deceit,
causing governance to be unjust,
preventing the imperial breath from arriving,
and making the way of Heaven err and go astray.
This brings heavy worries to the noble person,
as the six emotions' desires,
which everyone delights in,
are not restrained by themselves.
Their minds turn to delight in them,
thereby incurring calamity.
The noble person loses their governance and commands,
while petty people steal, rob, and assault—
all summoned by these non-urgent things.
The world becomes impoverished, distressed, and sorrowful,
disasters and changes arise continuously,
the lower levels deceive those above—
all consider this a great harm.
This has been so for a long time,
and it is not only the fault of people in recent antiquity or later generations.
It is passed down through cumulative burdens,
losing the original truth and reality.
All turn to superficial elegance,
thereby bringing sorrow and harm upon themselves,
unable to live out their natural lifespan.
Later generations are troubled by numerous and chaotic affairs,
all because they engage in non-urgent matters,
leading to unfortunate events.
Thus, they often rush about without cease."
"The reason why high antiquity governed through non-action,
attained the essence of the Way,
and obtained the will of Heaven's intent,
was because they guarded the root and did not lose the three essentials.
Middle antiquity had slightly more affairs because
they had slightly more diversions.
Lower antiquity has great many worries because
they have too many diversions, giving rise to falsity and deceit;
moreover, they compete to surpass one another and trouble each other,
hence evil and treachery emerge from within.
Internally losing their genuine truth,
departing from their fundamental root,
they turn to harm one another,
causing people to be confused and disordered.
Even though the noble man is troubled at heart,
wishing to joyfully rectify it,
the actions taken are in millions of ways,
impossible to fully manage,
thereby disrupting their governance.
The Perfected, deeply ponder this meaning."
"Excellent, excellent!"
The above explains guarding the three realities: balanced qì comes, evil falsity leaves, and craftiness ceases.
"Perfected one, come forward.
How many great essentials do the crawling creatures have?
How many small essentials?
And how many non-essentials?"
"Well,
each has its own essentials,
in thousands of strands and myriad ways,
all named as what kind of essential.
Crawling creatures each have their own aims,
impossible to name specifically."
"Perfected one, you are already troubled and confused.
Are you intentionally acting foolish,
why so extremely?"
"I truly do not comprehend."
"You yourself admit you do not comprehend,
how then can you speak of ordinary people losing their plans?
They are just as uncomprehending in this matter."
"Only the Celestial Master can resolve this for my foolish darkness."
"Indeed!
Crawling creatures all receive the governance of heaven and earth, yīn and yáng, and are born,
similarly having two great essentials
and one small essential.
What does this mean?
When crawling creatures first receive the governance of yīn and yáng,
they similarly, as if breathing faintly,
contain the qì of spontaneity,
not yet knowing eating and drinking.
After a long time, they also depart far from their root.
The great Way diminishes and exhausts,
heavenly qì cannot always follow to protect and watch over them,
hence they become hungry and thirsty.
Heaven provides them with food and drink,
and they should also transmit the governance of yīn and yáng.
Therefore, there are males and females,
generation after generation giving birth without ceasing.
Cease their food and drink,
and the transmission of yīn and yáng does not occur,
under heaven there would be no crawling creatures—
these are the two great essentials.
The one small essential:
those with fur, feathers, or scales can live,
but even naked creatures can also live.
However, those with fur or feathers
are often fine and lovable,
protecting against cold and heat;
those with scales
often ward off harm;
these are not absolutely necessary for life,
hence they are considered small essentials.
All other activities
are entirely places of calamity.
Not guarding these three fundamentals,
recklessly acting without cause,
one will entirely meet death.
This is the law naturally suspended by heaven and earth.
The Perfected should ponder its meaning:
those who guard these three practices
harmonize with heaven, earth, and the central harmony;
those who lose these three and have many diversions
will entirely suffer misfortune and harm."
"Excellent, excellent!
Since the Celestial Master has opened and shown this,
I wish to ask one more thing."
"Speak plainly."
"Now, those that spread roots and hang branches—
they do not eat, drink, or wear clothes—
how should they be considered?"
"Alas!
Your learning does not daily advance,
instead daily becoming without knowledge—
why is this?"
"They also have two great essentials and one small essential?
What does that mean?"
"Listen clearly."
"Yes, yes."
"All things need rain to be born—
this is their food and drink.
They need to obtain day and night,
one exposure (to sun) and one shade,
day then the yáng qì provides warmth,
night then the yīn qì provides moisture,
only then can they grow and develop,
dwelling in their place—
this is their union of yīn and yáng.
Hanging branches and spreading leaves—
this is their clothing.
A plant with many leaves can live,
with few leaves can also live—
this is its substance and ornamentation.
Therefore, without timely rain,
then under heaven the myriad things would not be born.
If under heaven not a single thing existed,
then there would be great misfortune—
this is the first great essential.
Without obtaining day and night,
the union of yīn and yáng qì,
things would have no means to achieve completion.
If under heaven there were no completed, substantial things,
then there would be great misfortune—
this is the second great essential.
A plant with sparse leaves can bear fruit,
with numerous leaves can also bear fruit—
both can bear fruit,
it is not necessary to have numerous leaves—
this is its small essential.
The fruit—
this is its core.
Therefore, the sages of antiquity guarded the three realities,
governed to attain great peace,
obtained the heart of Heaven and were long auspicious,
lived out their heavenly years—
it was a matter of substance alone,
not necessarily requiring many diversions of mystery and yellow.
Therefore, those lost in the branches should return to the center;
those lost in the center should return to the root;
those lost in ornamentation should return to substance;
those lost in substance should return to the root.
The root—
is to share the origin with heaven and earth,
hence order is achieved.
Those confused and disordered in lower antiquity
should think to return to middle antiquity;
those disordered in middle antiquity
should think to return to high antiquity;
those disordered in high antiquity
should think to return to the pattern and laws of heaven and earth;
those doubting the pattern and laws of heaven and earth
should think to return to the form of spontaneity;
those confused by spontaneity
should think to return to the primal spiritual qì of the highest origin.
Therefore, the sages and worthies of antiquity ingested qì and governed,
dwelling deeply in secluded chambers contemplating the Way,
reflecting on the images of gain and loss,
not daring to depart from Heaven's law even by a fraction.
Residing in clear and quiet places,
having attained its meaning,
their governance was established in peace,
how similar to heaven and earth!
Perfected one, deeply ponder and consider my words of the Way—
do you understand them?"
"Excellent, excellent!"
"Go,
you have now awakened.
And to emulate my writings in governing disorder—
it can be tested immediately without delay.
Do not conceal this text,
so that ordinary people may themselves know where they lose substance and ornamentation,
deeply reflect on its meaning,
and should return to the three truths,
not troubling themselves with falsity and deceit.
Perfected one, be cautious of this!"
"Yes, yes."
The above explains the myriad things guarding the root:
obtaining the three essentials brings good fortune,
losing the three essentials brings harm.
"Before the Perfected One."
"Yes, yes."
"A filial son serves his parents;
when the parents pass away,
he continues to serve them thereafter.
Should this be equal to when they were alive?"
"No,
serving them should surpass the time when they were alive."
"Why is that?"
"Humans are born from their parents,
and grow to adulthood through them.
Seeing one's parents pass away,
with no chance of their return,
one's heart cannot forget them even for a moment.
When they were alive, we saw them daily,
received their teachings and instructions,
and could report back upon going out and returning;
after death, we can no longer see them,
and we grieve over their absence,
hence serving them should surpass the time when they were alive."
"The Perfected One's words are correct,
but they have greatly lost the true way of Heaven's principles,
straying far indeed.
Now, if even the Perfected One speaks thus,
how much more so the deluded common people?
It is clear they have lost Heaven's laws."
"What does this mean?
I beseech the Celestial Master."
"Well then,
in life,
humans resemble Heaven and belong to Heaven.
In death,
they resemble Earth and belong to Earth.
Heaven is the father.
Earth is the mother.
Serving the mother must not surpass serving the father.
The living
are yang.
The dead
are yīn.
Serving yīn must not surpass serving yang.
Yang is the ruler.
Yīn is the subject.
Serving the subject must not surpass serving the ruler.
If serving yīn instead surpasses yang,
it leads to rebellious energy;
a minor excess brings minor rebellion,
a major excess brings major rebellion.
This is called rebellious energy,
this is called rebellious governance.
Its harm causes yīn energy to overcome yang,
the lower deceives the upper,
ghosts, spirits, and evil entities flourish greatly,
together encroaching upon the human way,
often roaming by day without avoiding people.
Now, diseases cannot be eradicated,
and ranks of ghosts roam unchecked.
The great fault lies herein.
Do you know this,
do you understand it?"
"This ignorant student is greatly unaware and has erred, has he not?
Now hearing the Celestial Master's words,
I am sorrowfully awakened.
I beg the Master to pardon my diligence and caution in service,
and enlighten my lack of understanding.
If this fault is minor,
why does it lead to such consequences?"
"Serving yīn excessively over yang,
serving the lower excessively over the upper—
this is among the gravest faults.
Reaching this extreme,
how can you call it minor?
The Perfected One has again failed to grasp it.
Moreover, the living
are yang.
Ghosts and spirits
are yīn.
The living belong to the day,
the dead belong to the night.
If you wish to understand its depth, consider this analogy:
if the day greatly flourishes and lengthens, it shortens the night;
if the night flourishes and lengthens, it shortens the day.
When yang flourishes, it overcomes yīn,
and yīn submits, not daring to appear recklessly;
thus, ghosts and spirits hide.
When yīn flourishes, it overcomes yang,
and yang submits,
hence ghosts and spirits can appear by day.
The living
accompany the sun;
treacherous ghostly beings
accompany the stars.
The sun
is yang.
The stars
are yīn.
Therefore, when the sun appears, the stars flee;
when the stars appear, the sun sets.
Thus, when yīn prevails, ghostly beings together cause profound harm,
beyond description.
This is called promoting yīn
and instead weakening yang.
It causes governance to lose order,
and instead harms the living.
This fault is extremely grave;
reflect on it deeply."
"Yes, yes."
"Thus, the Way of Heaven establishes rules,
where the yin should always be weaker than the yang.
It is like how a minister should be weaker than their ruler,
so that the minister serves the ruler with compliance;
a child weaker than their parents,
so the child serves the parents with utmost filial piety.
If the strong cannot be moved or changed,
the harm caused is profound and severe.
Therefore, although a filial child has deep affection,
they must not forget their parents;
in serving them, they must not exceed how they were treated in life.
Do you, the enlightened one, understand this or not?"
"Yes, yes."
"Be cautious, be cautious!
In all matters, one must not act recklessly and without restraint."
"Yes, yes."
"If you wish to serve the dead more than the living,
you would exceed the mandate of Heaven.
Why is that?"
"It is because you disrespect the yang and
instead revere the yin,
which is called turning the back upward and the face downward,
thus transgressing against Heaven."
"This humble student is greatly at fault;
I only beg the Celestial Master to forgive me!"
"It is not so,
but you must carefully consider it yourself;
all actions and words should correspond to the laws."
"Yes, yes.
As the Celestial Master enlightens me,
I wish to fully understand the meaning of not exceeding how they were treated in life.
In burial rites,
the clothing and items,
the provisions for handling the funeral,
should not exceed what they had in life.
All such acts are contrary to proper governance,
and even the deceased may incur blame for it.
If the funeral does not align with the records of the underworld,
and the examinations find it untrue,
it instead becomes deceitful conduct,
thus incurring even deeper blame.
By excessively revering and promoting inauspicious matters,
it instead gives rise to misfortunes,
causing ghosts and spirits to flourish greatly,
bringing harm and illness to people,
and creating strange disturbances in abundance.
How can this be made clear?"
"Excellent,
your question is profound!
In ancient times, when the sages handled funerals,
it was with sincerity of heart alone,
not daring to make them grand.
For death and mourning
are the most inauspicious and evil matters under heaven.
To promote inauspicious events is to cause harm,
so it was done with sincerity of heart alone,
and the offerings mirrored what they had in life without excess.
Thus, in those times, people were mostly fortunate and free of illness,
all able to live out their natural lifespans.
In the middle ages, handling funerals and mourning
slightly lost the proper measures,
failing to focus solely
on sincerity of heart,
losing its true intent,
and instead showing minor reverence,
drifting toward extravagance,
to impress the living,
with only half the sincerity reaching the deceased.
Half of the deceased's spirits would come to partake,
and if the funeral slightly strayed from truth,
and sacrifices were made,
it immediately attracted malevolence,
not knowing what ghosts or spirits came to share the offerings,
thus lingering to haunt people,
so people frequently fell mildly ill.
In later ages, inheriting the faults of the middle ages,
the errors worsened greatly,
not even with sincerity toward their kin,
but instead seeking to greatly impress the living,
to emulate the ancients in making a show of honor,
acting against the laws,
and even uniting in falsehood,
unable to move Heaven,
so that the deceased
could not regularly come to partake.
Instead, they excessively expanded the sacrifices,
beyond the proper measures,
strengthening the yin and thereby injuring and weakening the yang.
Not knowing what ghosts and spirits all gathered to feast,
they instead became unrestrained,
acting as harmful thieves,
killing people incessantly,
even collectively killing individuals.
Seeing the events unfold without facing blame,
why would they not strive to do so?
Thus, evil energies increased daily,
turning back to attack and harm their originators,
accustomed to following the living to feed, never ceasing.
The yin grew strong, the yang weak,
oppressing the living,
with ministers deceiving their rulers,
children deceiving their fathers,
the king's governance becoming unjust,
yet the people remained unawakened,
so evil intensified daily,
no longer restrained.
Therefore, the sages of old in serving the dead
dared not exceed how they were treated in life,
thus observing the clear prohibitions.
Have you, the enlightened one, now understood?"
"How terrifying,
how terrifying!
Had the Celestial Master not revealed this,
this humble student would have had no way to know it."
"Come forward, enlightened one;
you and I are of one mind,
surely Heaven has destined you to inquire into these matters,
do not take it lightly.
Hence, I have told you everything.
The reason for this is
that now harmonious energy is about to arrive;
all matters should be in accord,
for if one energy is contrary,
it may not come.
What does this mean?
The Way of Heaven
should elevate the yang and diminish the yin
to achieve harmony;
if instead it elevates the yin and oppresses the yang, weakening it,
that is contrary.
Conversely, by revering inauspicious matters,
one attracts inauspicious energies,
causing governance to lose its proper order,
and this is no minor fault."
"Enlightened one, do not conceal this text;
disseminate it,
so that ordinary people may know their own gains and losses.
For disharmony in governance
is not solely the fault of Heaven, Earth, or the ruler;
the blame lies with the people, each having their own faults,
mutually inheriting and bearing them,
accumulating increasingly,
all resulting from not adhering to truth.
By departing from reality,
straying from the root and turning to false conduct,
they remain unaware of it.
What does this mean?
The living
are the root.
The dead
are the artificial.
Why are they called artificial?
Because one cannot see the actual person to desire them,
yet the living create for them,
knowingly crafting false images exceeding their appearance in life.
They cling to emptiness without verifying the truth.
When a person dies,
the soul and spirit return to Heaven,
the flesh and bones are given to the earth to decay,
the essence can be summoned by thought,
and can still be offered food.
The flesh and bones no longer remain,
returned to the earth.
The earth
is humanity's true mother.
Humans are born between Heaven and Earth,
yet the root differs from life in its affairs;
do you not know what its proper function is?
Thus, a filial child should serve it according to the root,
only then attaining its reality.
What was not enjoyed in life
should not be presented to the dead,
so one must not exceed life's treatment,
or it will cause profound strange disturbances.
Do you understand, enlightened one?
Be cautious, be cautious."
"Yes, yes.
Excellent, excellent,
the truth has indeed been revealed!"
"You may be said to have understood it.
Go forth now."
"Yes, yes."
The above is the admonition on how serving the living to the end should correspond from beginning to end.
"The greatly stubborn and dull student, Yì Ànmèi, bows twice.
Now I have further doubts,
and beg to ask the Celestial Master, the supreme divine being."
"What matter do you inquire about?"
"I beg to ask about the writings in this book -
their general essence and main points,
for what matters were they created?
For what purpose were they produced?"
"Excellent, excellent!
Your questioning of matters
can be said to have already grasped the heart of August Heaven.
This is the explanation of its main essence.
Since the creation of heaven and earth,
emperors, kings, and common people have inherited burdens through their lives -
this work was produced for this matter."
"Now that it has been produced for this matter,
why does it instead first speak of nurturing one's nature?"
"Indeed,
you, the true person, remain truly ignorant,
obscured and uncomprehending.
Earlier when I saw you present your words,
I thought you were being modest,
but instead you are truly dark and obscure - why is this?"
"Yes."
"True person, open your ears wider and listen.
Well then, the reason why people bear responsibility for faults
is all because they cannot properly nurture themselves,
completely losing their fundamental principles,
thus they bear the responsibility of inherited burdens.
It is like when parents lose the ultimate Way and Virtue,
and commit offenses against their neighbors,
their descendants are subsequently harmed by these neighbors -
this clearly demonstrates the responsibility of inherited burdens.
Now the former kings governing,
not obtaining the intent of heaven and earth,
it was not just one person who collectively disturbed Heaven.
Heaven was greatly angered and displeased,
hence illnesses and disasters arose in countless forms,
and later those in positions of authority again inherited these burdens -
is this not evident?
Therefore, this book was precisely produced for this reason.
Thus, the great worthies of antiquity fundamentally knew the way of self-cultivation,
therefore they understood governance,
and had little failure in bearing inherited burdens.
Later, the teachers of learners
mostly concealed and hid the essential truths of the Way in their writings,
transmitting learning through superficial elegance,
violating and losing the essential meaning of the Heavenly Way.
Causing later generations to daily become more superficial,
unable to properly nurture and love themselves,
this accumulated over time,
thereby distancing themselves from the Way,
claiming that under heaven there is no method for self-preservation,
instead generating negligence in affairs and contending for emolument,
thus creating the calamity of inherited burdens.
Do you understand the meaning? Do you know this?"
"Excellent, excellent!
Hearing the Celestial Master's words,
is as clear as clouds parting to see the sun,
no different."
"Proceed,
you may be said to have grasped the meaning of the Way."
"This ignorant student has received grace,
and is greatly enlightened.
Now my questions are endless,
I only ask the Celestial Master to earnestly and repeatedly admonish me."
"Well then,
if a person can deeply cultivate themselves,
then they can nurture others.
If a person can deeply love themselves,
then they can love others.
If one has a body but neglects oneself,
cannot nurture oneself,
how can one generously nurture others?
If one has a body but cannot love and value oneself to preserve one's form,
carefully maintaining the ancestral tradition of predecessors,
how can one love others and preserve them?
How foolish!
Do you deeply understand or not?"
"Yes, yes.
Excellent, excellent!"
"Proceed,
if you think my writings cannot be trusted,
try taking the writings of the ancient people who acted according to the heart of Heaven and achieved lasting fortune,
again take the documents of the middle ancient people who acted according to the heart of Heaven,
again take the writings of the later ancient people who thoughtfully acted according to Heaven's intent and achieved lasting self-preservation,
you should examine them thoroughly from top to bottom,
and they will certainly match perfectly without difference.
Then you will be enlightened and greatly understand,
and afterwards will greatly trust my written words.
Now Heaven afflicts people -
later generations daily become more frivolous,
contending with fate and testing their abilities.
The lowest fools then say that Heaven lacks understanding,
that Heaven shows no proof.
But Earth does not deceive people -
plant millet and get millet,
plant wheat and get wheat.
Those who use more effort
have better crops.
How much more so with Heaven?
Now therefore Heaven accumulates resentment -
the lowest ignorant fools
further teach each other to treat matters lightly as foolishness,
later generations daily become more extreme,
thus generating disasters, anomalies, and strange occurrences,
not just one.
Heaven alone shows deep affection to human rulers,
like a father's kindness to his son, thus teaching them.
When fools see this,
instead of timely reporting to their ruler,
they repeatedly conceal and hide it,
cutting off the path to Heaven.
Heaven again becomes more and more angry,
later again bearing inherited burdens,
increasingly severe and immovable.
Even if emperors and kings have ten thousand good qualities,
they still inexplicably suffer harm.
Thus causing those who do good to be unclear,
as if there is no benefit.
Making the lowest fools say Heaven is unknowing -
is there reason for this?"
"Now hearing the Celestial Master's words,
my heart is enlightened no differently than being reborn.
Excellent, excellent!
Although this disciple has often troubled the Celestial Master,
risking death to ask matters,
initially seeming at fault,
having asked and obtained understanding,
my mind is greatly joyful,
with no regret.
To be ignorant and not ask
leaves no way to gain understanding."
"Your words capture the meaning.
Proceed, the writings are numerous and completely prepared,
head, feet, belly, and back,
surface and interior completely provided.
Study them together with the various worthies -
do not ask again."
"Yes, yes."
The above questions to the Celestial Master about the numerous documents from top to bottom concerning their production and decisive principles.
The benighted disciple bows again and says:
"When a great worthy hears the master explain one aspect,
he understands the explanations of all four aspects;
when a lesser worthy hears the master explain one burden,
he understands the explanations of all four burdens,
thus they are easy to teach.
But those who are foolish, benighted, and obstructed,
if not thoroughly taught and explained to,
will still harbor doubts in their hearts,
thus I dare to inquire fully of the Celestial Master.
Since the master has already resolved for August Heaven the enmity of inherited burdens,
resolved for Hòutǔ the calamities of inherited burdens,
resolved for the sovereign the adversities of inherited burdens,
resolved for the common people the faults of inherited burdens,
resolved for all things the responsibilities of inherited burdens."
He further says:
"This foolish disciple now inquires on behalf of Heaven,
not daring to avoid fault by withholding any details.
I wish to fully hear what these meanings truly are?"
"Speak plainly."
"Now that sovereigns and people have inherited burdens,
does everything also inherently have its own inherited burdens?"
"Excellent!
You inquire on behalf of Heaven,
truly thorough and careful."
"Now whenever I face the Celestial Master in audience,
you often say that this disciple inquires about doubtful matters for Heaven,
thus I dare not be less than thorough."
"Excellent!
You possess careful and good intention,
and may be entrusted with affairs to conduct.

conversely acts upon earth as two—
what is the meaning of this?
Now earth,
being two,
conversely acts upon humans as three—
why is this?
This ignorant student wishes to hear about the meaning of their mutual actions."
"Well,
earth is employed by heaven,
and humans are employed by earth.
Therefore, if heaven is pleased and joyful,
it causes all things on earth this year to be greatly good.
If heaven is not joyful,
even if earth wishes to nurture,
it makes things bad.
If earth is good,
then the people dwelling on it are good and virtuous.
This is the clear evidence of their mutual employment.
Thus, order and chaos arise from having too many aspects,
failing to attain the heart of heaven—
one should return to their root origin.
When a person speaks too much and fails to see what is right,
they should return to the fundamental essence,
then their words and affairs can be established.
Therefore, what is accomplished in one word
is its root text;
what stops at two turns of words
becomes chapters and sentences;
thus, stopping at three words
instead becomes explanation and difficulty,
moving away from truth,
hence there is explanation of difficulties;
stopping at four words
instead becomes literary rhetoric;
stopping at five words
instead becomes falsity;
stopping at six words
instead becomes deception;
stopping at seven words
instead becomes destruction;
stopping at eight words
instead becomes dispersal far from the Way,
far and yet farther;
stopping at nine words
instead becomes great chaos;
stopping at ten words
instead becomes annihilation and ruin.
Thus, classics reaching ten change,
and as they are passed down further, they decay and ruin.
In all affairs, when there is ruin, one should return to the root,
hence returning to guard the One as the primordial beginning.
Therefore, the numbers of heaven start from one
and end at ten,
which is the natural nature of the heavenly Way.
Thus, when the sages of old inquired about affairs,
the first divination
revealed the auspicious or inauspicious truth,
guarding the root,
and then the heavenly spirits would descend to inform them.
The second divination
was informed by the earth spirits emerging.
The third divination
was informed by the human spirits emerging.
Beyond this,
all are deceptions and cannot be divined.
Thus, exceeding the number of hexagrams misses the mark,
and human words with excessive literary embellishment are not valued."
"Excellent, excellent!
Now, since the Celestial Master often pities my inadequacies,
I wish to beg for one more word!"
"Speak evenly!"
"Why do the numbers stop at ten and end?"
"Excellent!
You deeply and steadfastly inquire about the method of this matter.
Well,
the numbers of heaven start from one
and end at ten.
"Why is that?"
"Heaven is first as one,
below it combines with earth to make two,
yin and yang are complete and generate together.
All things begin to sprout in the north,
the primal qi arises at zǐ,
turns to the northeast,
spreads roots at jiǎo,
turns to the east,
where growth emerges and reaches out,
turns to the southeast,
where branches and leaves fully grow,
turns to the south where they flourish,
turns to the southwest where they peak in abundance,
turns to the west where they mature,
turns to the northwest where they end.
When things end, they should return to the beginning,
hence it is hài, two people embracing one marks the beginning of the Three Sovereigns.
Therefore, hài means kernel,
it is the beginning of coagulation into a kernel,
thus water begins to congeal in the tenth month.
Rén means to bear,
once borne, it must multiply and grow increasingly large.
Thus, zǐ means to multiply,
three brings the harmonious qi of yin and yang, all complete
and then returns to the initial beginning,
hence returning to the root
is named jiǎzǐ.
Now the heavenly Way generates things,
it should circulate completely
and be fully equipped, observing the qi of heaven, earth, the four seasons, and the five phases,
then it is accomplished.
If one qi is insufficient,
then there is immediately a deficiency.
Thus, it is rooted in the circulation of heaven and earth through the eight directions,
and all numbers reach ten.
Perfected One, do you understand this or not?"
"Yes, yes.
Excellent, excellent!
I sincerely receive this great kindness."
"Do not thank me,
why?"
"The merit of master and disciple is immensely heavy,
akin to parents giving birth to a child—
it cannot be thanked and resolved."
"What does that mean?"
"Before parents give birth to a child,
ignorant ones might merely cast their essence into the wild,
which then attaches to earth and produces plants and trees,
without even knowing it should become a human;
the diffuse essence—
how could it speak?
Thus, it becomes plants and trees.
Only when yin and yang combine,
does it result in a human—
how could it become plants and trees?
Once a person is born,
if they easily do not serve a good teacher,
but instead serve a lowly, foolish teacher,
who teaches them evil,
leading them into deviance,
it may cause their death and extinction,
with sins remaining on their person,
and exhausting their entire family.
Some people are born and do not know to seek learning,
thus becoming ignorant fools.
Those without knowledge
only suffer愁苦 and die,
and still have transgressions in the underworld.
Their hun and pò are troubled and cannot roam in joy,
and upon death, they cannot even become good ghosts.
Now, a good teacher educates people,
enabling lowly, foolish individuals to become good people;
being good and not stopping,
they become worthy;
being worthy and not stopping,
they then approach sagehood;
being sage and not stopping,
they then deeply know the true Way;
guarding the Way and not stopping,
they then attain immortality and do not die;
being immortal and not stopping,
they then become Perfected;
being Perfected and not stopping,
they then become spirits;
being spirits and not stopping,
they then match heaven in virtue;
matching heaven and not stopping,
they then match the primal qi in virtue.
The primal qi envelops heaven, earth, and the eight directions—
nothing is not born from receiving its qi.
Virtue then covers heaven, earth, and the eight directions,
the spirit then feeds from heaven and earth,
and all under heaven sacrifice and feed it together,
yet often fear slackening,
unable to attain it.
This is the merit of an excellent teacher producing excellent disciples—
can it be thanked or not?"
"How alarming!
This ignorant student has touched on taboos
and spoken excessively."
"Why such humility without cease,
Perfected One?
Proceed,
and realize that I have made you understand whether thanks are due or not."
"Yes, yes."
The above resolves the text on the numbers of root and end, beginning and conclusion, and the essential merit of father and son, teacher and disciple.
"Before the True Man,
in the conduct of ordinary people,
and in the governance of rulers,
what is the best approach?"
"Extending compassion without harm,
like the way of Heaven, is the best."
"Your words have grasped the essence of the Way,
yet governance is best when it emulates Heaven;
however,
there must be an order of priority."
"What does that mean?
This ignorant student dares to speak once,
but not a second time,
and only awaits the Celestial Master's explanation."
"Well then,
in the conduct of ordinary people,
and in the governance of rulers,
the best for a person
is none other than constantly desiring to rejoice in life,
eagerly as if thirsty,
and only then is it acceptable.
The next best is to excel in rejoicing in success,
always earnestly wishing to achieve it,
as if concerned for oneself,
and only then is it acceptable.
The next best is to excel in benevolent giving,
and upon seeing others in poverty,
feeling sorrow for them,
as if worried about one's own hunger and cold,
and only then is it acceptable.
The next best is to excel in establishing laws,
not desiring to delight in harm,
but instilling caution and setting them in place,
and only then is it acceptable.
The next best is when people have faults, to excel in correcting them
without letting them fall into crime,
and only then is it acceptable.
The next best is when people have already committed crimes,
the mind should not wish to deeply harm them,
and only then is it acceptable.
The next best is when people have committed offenses punishable by death,
and the situation is unavoidable,
to prevent it from affecting their families and neighbors,
and only then is it acceptable.
The next best is when crimes involve families and neighbors,
to point out the guilty,
carefully avoiding the complete extermination of human lineages,
and only then is it acceptable.
For humans
are the divine lineage of Heaven and Earth.
Extermination
is called severing the divine lineage of Heaven and Earth,
which can damage the body of Heaven and Earth,
and its harm is very profound,
leading later to Heaven exterminating human generations.
Being ancestors and grandparents to later generations is not easy;
one must plan for the descendants,
so that they do not suffer the calamity of inherited burdens.
Therefore, in the governance of sages,
they constantly think of great peace,
making punishments obsolete and unused.
The reason for this
is to plan for the descendants.
Do you, True Man, see this subtle point?"
"Yes, yes."
"Come forward, True Man."
"Yes, yes."
"True Man, True Man,
are you unable to speak?
Or are you merely being modest?"
"To speak once,
my lineage is tied to the Earth,
and my fate belongs to Kūnlún.
Now the Celestial Master's fate is in Heaven,
at the Běijí Zǐgōng.
The Earth should be empty and receptive,
humbly receiving Heaven's gifts,
and as a disciple, I should comply and accept,
emulate the Earth's emptiness and openness,
and respectfully receive the Celestial Master's teachings.
Only then can the essential words of the ultimate Way
be obtained without neglecting the duty between teacher and disciple.
Merely exchanging talents is called chaotic learning and impurity.
To command teachings and obscure the Way,
making one right and one wrong,
such discourse cannot be passed on as a model for emperors and kings,
hence I dare not speak carelessly."
"Why such modesty!
I wish to discuss and deliberate with you, True Man, for the good,
and it does no harm to speak.
Why not?"
"There is order in birth,
knowledge varies in amount,
conduct has nobility and humility,
and positions have high and low.
For me to speak now
would not match what the Celestial Master has said.
The words of a lesser person
cannot compare to the insight of the elderly who have witnessed the Way,
or the clarity of the wise leaders.
Since the Celestial Master has awakened this ignorant and inadequate student,
enabling enlightenment,
and understanding the difficulty of distinguishing good and evil,
how can one achieve it all at once?
I hope not to be abandoned midway,
but only for the sake of the August Heaven and Later Earth."
"Well,
since we are speaking of heavenly matters now,
I will not yield to you.
But you are often silently troubled,
hence I asked."
"I dare not be troubled.
Now, hearing the Celestial Master speak,
I am both accumulating joy and feeling awe;
why?
The joy is
the joy of encountering a teacher;
the awe is
the fear that my stubborn and dull learning may be incomplete,
and the teacher may depart.
Now I wish to ask eagerly,
always like one greatly thirsty desiring to drink;
why?
I hope to receive the Celestial Master's Way and transmit it to disciples,
entrusting it to virtuous rulers who can use it.
So that yīn and yáng each find their place,
and all the great illnesses of inherited burdens under heaven
may be completely healed."
"Excellent,
your words;
carefully examine my text,
and the Way will be fully revealed;
order its sequence from top to bottom,
bright as the sun and moon,
turning and influencing each other;
if you think and practice it today,
all ailments will be entirely eliminated and healed without exception,
and many will rejoice and praise."
"Yes, yes."
The above is the method of governing priorities and returning to the heart of Heaven, with the teacher and disciple deferring in discourse.
"Your disciple grows increasingly foolish and benighted, daring to bow twice and
inquire about one matter."
"Speak plainly."
The Perfected then said:
"Having devoted myself to learning with renewed effort without slackening,
I seek to inquire of Heaven about matters."
"My duty is to administer and impart meaning to the Perfected,
I dare not hold anything back,
speak quickly."
"Yes, yes.
Nowadays, the minor Way texts
are considered as Heavenly scriptures.
We compile and examine the words of the sages from high antiquity, middle antiquity, and recent antiquity to form the Sage Scripture;
we compile and examine the words of the greatly virtuous from high antiquity, middle antiquity, and recent antiquity to form the Virtue Scripture;
we compile and examine the words of the worthy and enlightened from high antiquity, middle antiquity, and recent antiquity to form the Worthy Scripture.
Now, reflecting on the Celestial Master's words,
I cannot deeply understand the intention behind this compilation and examination,
I wish the Celestial Master would illuminate the proper sequence and approach,
so that the Virtuous Ruler may obtain it for strict instruction,
and command all the worthies to enable each to generate and examine good intentions within it."
"Well,
how refined is the Perfected's question,
it should always be like this.
Excellent, excellent!
Very well, I shall explain it in detail,
you, Perfected, follow along and record it,
take care not to lose my words.
I am speaking on behalf of Heaven and Earth,
creating and establishing for the highly virtuous ruler,
to eliminate the calamitous meetings of inherited burdens since the opening of Heaven and Earth,
in principle I dare not speak recklessly,
for I would surely incur resentment from the August Heaven and Later Earth,
and moreover betray the highly worthy, enlightened, and virtuous ruler,
the crime and responsibility would be profound and great,
does the Perfected understand this?"
"Yes, yes."
"Well then,
what is meant by compiling and examining the Way texts of high, middle, and recent antiquity
is to have all the worthies collectively read and examine the various Daoist writings from past and present.
If in one scroll a good word is found,
or a good teaching is encountered,
note it down and extract it.
One scroll yields one good,
ten scrolls yield ten goods,
a hundred scrolls yield a hundred goods,
a thousand scrolls yield a thousand goods,
ten thousand scrolls yield ten thousand goods,
a hundred million scrolls yield a hundred million goods;
good words and good teachings,
if one scroll yields ten goods,
that's ten billion good words;
if one scroll yields a hundred goods,
that's a hundred billion good words.
Write them down and record them,
gather them in one place,
all worthies collectively examine the writings of past and present,
ultimately copy them all out,
group them by category,
each following its school,
remove the duplicates within,
then sequence the essential texts and compile them,
once completed,
one deeply understands the essential meaning of Heaven, Earth, humanity, and the myriad things throughout past and present.
Thereby, it becomes a text,
forming the Heavenly Scripture.
Do you understand?"
"Excellent, excellent!"
"You already understand.
Compiling and examining the good words and teachings from the Sage Scriptures of high, middle, and recent antiquity,
one scroll yields one good,
ten scrolls yield ten,
a hundred scrolls yield a hundred,
a thousand scrolls yield a thousand,
ten thousand scrolls yield ten thousand,
a hundred million scrolls yield a hundred million;
if one scroll yields ten good words,
that's already ten billion;
if one scroll yields a hundred good words,
that's already a hundred billion.
The worthy and enlightened collectively record and write,
gather in one good place,
after fully collating and examining them,
group them by category,
have the worthy and enlightened together arrange and sequence them,
remove the duplicates,
and thus form the Sage Scripture.
Does the Perfected understand?"
"Yes, yes."
"You already understand.
Compiling and examining the words of the worthy and enlightened from high, middle, and recent antiquity,
among them, the greatly good ones, note one per scroll,
ten scrolls yield ten,
a hundred scrolls yield a hundred,
a thousand scrolls yield a thousand,
ten thousand scrolls yield ten thousand,
a hundred million scrolls yield a hundred million;
if one scroll yields ten,
that's ten billion;
if one scroll yields a hundred,
that's a hundred billion.
After completion,
again sequence them by category,
make them follow accordingly,
have the worthy and enlightened together arrange them,
remove the duplicates,
compile and set them in order,
and thus form the Worthy Scripture.
Does the Perfected understand?"
"Yes, yes."
"You already understand.
If we compile and examine all Daoist texts and scriptures,
along with the writings of all worthies,
and the good sayings and teachings from the mouths of all people,
fully recording the good ones,
gathering them all together,
bringing them to one place,
after complete examination,
then deliberate with all the worthy, enlightened, and greatly virtuous,
mutually clarifying by category,
removing duplicates,
sequencing the texts and recording them,
this is called obtaining the writings of Heaven and Earth and the expressions of human sentiment,
ultimately and definitively settled,
the good teachings,
without any loss,
not even a hair's breadth.
This Way of the Way,
is named the Scripture Penetrating to the Ultimate of Heaven, Earth, and Yin-Yang,
for ten thousand times ten thousand generations it cannot be altered again."
"Excellent, excellent!"
"Proceed!
The Perfected can be said to have awakened."
"Your disciple is slow to comprehend,
now I wish to ask another doubt."
"Speak on."
"Now, since the opening of Heaven and Earth long ago,
the Hé and Luò rivers have produced writings and diagrams,
sometimes divine texts have emerged,
sometimes divine birds have brought them while hunting,
the accumulated writings are numerous,
originally not from one source.
What the sages and worthies created,
also accumulated in multitude,
each ultimately having its own matters.
What doubt does the Celestial Master have,
what has been observed,
what has been seen,
that you instruct the worthies and enlightened of recent antiquity all at once,
to collectively compile and examine the writings and words of past and present?"
"Well,
there is something observed and seen,
I dare not vainly trouble the worthy and virtuous of recent antiquity.
Now I am sent to the world,
to resolve the inherited burdens for the great moral and virtuous ruler,
since the opening of Heaven and Earth,
the calamities of flowing disasters and accumulated poisons.
The heavenly writings, sage texts, and worthy words of past and present are already complete and sufficient,
but the worry is their scattered residence,
each excelling in one matter only.
Now, if we apply the method of one school alone,
it cannot fully remove the disasters and changes of Heaven and Earth,
hence the flowing disasters do not cease,
further passing inherited burdens to later generations,
who thus suffer increasingly severe calamities and illnesses.
Therefore, Heaven pities the virtuous ruler,
and again bears the inherited burdens.
Heaven harmonizes for the later born,
who cannot survive alone,
due to the accumulated disasters and various faults.
The fault truly lies with the earlier sages and worthies,
each excelling in one area,
yet all having unattained aspects,
all having losses.
Heaven knows they are not fully complete,
thus from time to time produces Hé and Luò writings and diagrams, and other divine texts,
also with differing contents.
The great sages and worthies emerge in different eras,
each accomplishing one task,
also with differing contents,
hence each has shortcomings,
each has strengths and weaknesses.
This shows that all cannot fully know and penetrate the ultimate meaning,
thus causing in the space between Heaven and Earth,
constant residual disasters,
continuing unceasingly before and after,
only with severity or mildness.
Therefore, Heaven calculates above,
now with these writings,
from top to bottom, ultimate and fully complete,
then again gives birth to sages,
with nothing more to create,
nothing more to add,
nothing more to accommodate in speech,
nothing more to add for the greatly virtuous ruler of Heaven and Earth.
If Heaven again gives birth to a sage,
their words would again excel in one profession,
and there would still be residual flowing disasters and poisons never fully eliminated,
no different from the earlier sages and worthies.
Therefore, Heaven commands me to deeply instruct and enjoin the Perfected,
to deliver the writings to the moral and virtuous ruler,
to show to the wise and enlightened,
all were gathered and collated,
combining the oral teachings and writings of the literati under heaven,
so that the high and low would complement each other,
removing duplications,
selecting the essential words, key texts, and instructive matters,
recording them to form the canonical scriptures.
Only in this way could the true writings, correct characters, and virtuous expressions of heaven and earth
all be brought forth.
Evil and falsehood were entirely eliminated,
the great ailments of heaven and earth all removed,
flowing disasters completely extinguished,
so that the people and myriad things could each dwell in their proper places,
with no further calamities or sufferings.
Thus, heaven commanded me to collate them,
and my work in writing
does not rely on mere words,
but rather on the evidence of verification.
Follow my texts and act accordingly,
and the calamities, anomalies, strange diseases, treacherous officials, and ominous evils of heaven and earth
will all be entirely eradicated,
no different than clouds dispersing on an overcast day.
By this, the verification of my words and my writings,
not one in ten thousand will be lost;
but if my writings are not diligently applied,
even if I respectfully receive heaven’s decrees and messages,
if the texts are not used,
how can heaven merely remove disasters?
If the documents remain in internal chaos,
people will also be in internal chaos,
and disasters will have no way to be eliminated.
Do you, the enlightened one, understand this?"
"Yes, yes."
"Proceed,
you have already understood."
"I wish to ask about one doubtful matter."
"Speak plainly."
"Since the beginning of heaven and earth’s creation,
the divine sages and worthies have all been born of heaven,
successively serving as spokespersons for heaven and earth,
all establishing laws for the rulers,
capable of eliminating disasters and bringing peace to the world.
Now, if the emperor applies them,
without deviating from the principles of heaven’s will and yin-yang,
the documents they compose
each have their own names.
So, what should the moral and virtuous writings and characters composed by the Celestial Master be named?"
"Excellent,
the enlightened one’s question is profound."
"Indeed,
they are named 'The Governance of the Great Cavern and the Ultimate Heaven.'
Why exactly are they named 'The Governance of the Great Cavern and the Ultimate Heaven'?"
"Well,
'Great' means
vast;
those who practice this
will achieve the most supreme and unparalleled governance.
'Cavern' means
that its moral virtue, good and evil,
permeates heaven, earth, yin, and yang,
throughout the six directions, inside and out,
with nothing failing to respond.
All will be cautious and virtuous,
and every thing will find its proper place.
This Way involves collating from the beginning of heaven and earth’s creation,
selecting the best from the writings of heaven, earth, humanity, and the divine,
to form the canon of the ultimate cavern,
which the emperor applies,
enabling all worthies to jointly strive in its practice.
Within the four seas and the four borders,
disasters will be swept away and eradicated,
and the governance will be clear and penetrating,
resembling the state of heaven, earth, and the divine spirits.
Hence, it is named 'The Governance of the Great Cavern and the Ultimate Heaven.'
Do you, the enlightened one, understand this?"
"Yes, yes.
How awe-inspiring!
How awe-inspiring!"
"Proceed,
you have already awakened to this knowledge."
The above is the collation of the writings and oral teachings from the ancient, middle, and later ages.
"How does the division of nine types of people by celestial principle correspond with yin and yang?"
"Humankind,"
"are the administrators of all things in creation.
The formless divine beings of ethereal qi
are tasked with managing primordial qi;
great divine beings manage heaven;
perfected beings manage earth;
transcendent beings manage the four seasons;
great Daoist masters manage the five phases;
sages manage yin and yang;
worthy persons manage documents and texts,
all receiving instructions;
common people manage plants and the five grains;
servants and slaves manage wealth and goods.
Why is this?
All affairs are managed according to their kind.
Formless divine beings of ethereal qi resemble primordial qi,
thus they manage primordial qi.
Great divine beings have form,
and great divinities resemble heaven,
thus they manage heaven.
Perfected beings are sincere and faithful,
resembling the earth,
thus they manage earth.
Transcendent beings transform like the four seasons,
thus they manage the four seasons.
Great Daoist masters excel in divining auspicious and inauspicious signs,
resembling the five phases,
thus they manage the five phases.
Sages govern harmonious qi,
resembling yin and yang,
thus they manage yin and yang.
Worthy persons govern documents and eloquent speech,
resembling literature,
thus they manage documents and texts.
Common people are confused and ignorant,
resembling all things,
thus they manage all things.
Servants and slaves generate wealth,
resembling wealth and goods,
existing when rich,
nonexistent when poor,
able to circulate,
thus they manage wealth and goods.
When the august heaven assigns duties,
it does not override their nature,
each follows its kind,
without error;
contrariwise,
it causes great harm.
Therefore, all people appointed by heaven should follow this,
the sages of antiquity deeply understood this,
thus they did not lose heaven's intent,
and attained heaven's heart.
Do you, the Perfected, now understand this?"
"Excellent, excellent!"
"What I have said,"
"is to caution you, the Perfected,
so you do not lose it."
"Yes, yes."
"Go and strive."
"This student's mind is still puzzled,"
"these nine types of people each have different duties,
how do they benefit the king's governance or not?"
"When governance attains heaven's heart,"
"making these nine qi harmonize,
and these nine people share the same heart,
then it can achieve the supreme peace of the highest sovereign.
If these nine matters do not harmonize and conflict,
peace cannot be achieved.
These nine matters alternate in generating each other,
but people do not deeply understand this,
previous sages and worthies have not yet explained it,
thus it has long been obscured!"
"But if one matter is not properly governed,
there cannot be peace,
why is that?"
"When the supreme sovereign qi arrives in full,
these nine people all come to assist the king in governance.
If one qi is not harmonious,
there will be shortcomings,
thus yin and yang cannot be fully harmonized and governance cannot be peaceful.
How do they come?
Formless divine beings come to advise the king,
his heart becomes increasingly enlightened.
Great divine beings occasionally appear to instruct his governance intentions;
perfected beings, transcendent beings, and great Daoist masters all come as teachers,
assisting in education and transformation;
sages and worthies emerge,
recluses come to serve as ministers;
common people, servants and slaves all follow goodness and avoid evil,
this is the sign of heaven and earth's great joy.
If one qi is not harmonious,
then some will not come,
how so?
If primordial qi is not harmonious,
formless divine beings will not come;
if heavenly qi is not harmonious,
great divine beings will not come;
if earthly qi is not harmonious,
perfected beings will not come;
if the four seasons are not harmonious,
transcendent beings will not come;
if the five phases are not harmonious,
great Daoist masters will not come;
if yin and yang are not harmonious,
sages will not come;
if written words are not truthful,
great worthies will not come;
if all things are not harmoniously obtained,
common people become chaotic,
wealth and goods decrease,
servants and slaves flee,
all matters lose their proper functions.
This is precisely the harm.
Now that you, the Perfected, wish to save the chaotic qi of heaven,
you should strive to pacify it,
do not grow weary or slack,
be cautious."
"Yes, yes."
"When qi is obtained,
then these nine people all uphold the Dao,
and the accumulated calamities of past kings throughout generations are entirely eliminated.
If these people all lose their proper places,
the harm of accumulated calamities increases daily.
These nine people range from the supremely formless above
to servants and slaves below,
each regulating one qi,
and the nine qi and yin-yang become harmonized.
Humankind,
heaven will make them harmonize and regulate qi,
they must first feed on qi;
thus when superior individuals are about to enter the Dao,
they first abstain from eating physical food and feed on qi instead,
this is to unite with primordial qi.
Therefore, they should be nurtured in thatched huts,
make them observe fasting and abstinence,
not see evil,
daily refine their forms,
not deprive them of their desires,
able to emerge from non-interference and depart,
ascending to assist the celestial governance of transcendent perfected beings and primordial qi.
These are divine scholars,
officials of heaven.
Do not prohibit or stop them,
sincerely able to approach them,
they are called celestial scholars,
selected good people,
heaven greatly rejoices in them,
they return to benefit humankind,
what does this mean?
Well, those who attain the Dao and depart,
although not serving immediate human purposes,
all collectively harmonize yin-yang qi.
In ancient times, emperors and kings sacrificed to heaven, and celestial spirits descended to feed,
this refers to that.
"But do only heaven's essence spirits descend to feed?"
"Excellent,"
"your words are correct.
Indeed, these people above serve as heaven's officials,
heaven's essence spirits act as their rulers,
rulers and officials mutually employ each other,
officials' duty lies in executing affairs.
In all matters,
officials report people's goodness and achievements.
Thus the ruler and his subordinates,
when descending, then rejoice.
Therefore, they remove people's accumulated burdens.
If officials do not rejoice,

If both rulers and officials refuse to descend to feed among people,

Do you, the Perfected, also understand this or not?"

"Go,"
"strive, my son,

"Come forward, Zhēnrén,

Now, listen clearly:
after implementing this,

and people will also become entirely upright,
all entering the true Way,

Those born later will be especially so,
imitating and learning from one another,

later generations daily understand its ultimate intent and make it their family tradition.

Since the opening of heaven and earth,

Though the Way of heaven accumulates over distance,

Now, those above have nothing left to trust,

leading to mutual suspicion and doubt,
thus causing chaos in governance.
Later generations then successively inherit the burdens,
the calamities of ancestors gathering and combining,

Heaven now grieves over this,
therefore I speak to you,
Zhēnrén, strive and love yourself, exert effort.

"I dare not, I dare not."
Above is the method of verifying through practice and evidence to know the truth and falsehood.
"Before the Perfected One."
"Yes, yes."
"How many types of human conduct are there?"
"There are a hundred conducts and ten thousand aspects."
"Not so.
The Perfected One's words nearly resemble those of ordinary people!
Human conduct has four types."
"The first one,

"Well,
if a person's conduct is not good then it is evil,
neither good nor evil is floating ordinary conduct,
one good and one evil,
is impure inconstant conduct,
neither can be relied upon,
there is no fixed place for fortune or misfortune."
"Excellent,
how many types of conduct bring fortune or misfortune?

"The Perfected One's words nearly match those of ordinary people.

"The first,

in all affairs and conduct,

the nature of Heaven and Earth's conduct,

Too many to record?"
"You are already deeply intoxicated,

"What does that mean?"
"Well,
Perfected One, listen clearly,
now if a year of Heaven and Earth is not greatly joyful then it is greatly evil,

one good and one evil is a year of heavenly transformation and confusion.
If today is not greatly good then it is greatly evil,
neither good nor evil is a floating ordinary day or month,
one good and one evil is confusing conduct,
mainly causing strange disasters,
I am only raising the main points to show the beginning,

"What does that mean?"
"Well,
the myriad things and people under Heaven,
if they do not enter into goodness,
must fall into evil,
neither good nor evil is ordinary balanced conduct,
one good and one evil is deceitful and false conduct,
nothing can be established,
ordinary balanced conduct cannot be encouraged,

"Excellent,
your difficult question,

Well, great goodness,

great evil,

the combination of good and evil,

inconstant conduct,
is when Heaven, Earth, central harmony, rulers, ministers, people, and the myriad things lose their path.
Therefore, if one wishes to correct their conduct,
following Yáng mostly obtains goodness,
following Yīn mostly obtains evil,
following harmony leads to floating ordinary,
those with inconstant fortune and misfortune,
have conduct without repeated rules.
Therefore, the ancient sages deeply observed Heaven, Earth, years, months, days, people, and the myriad things,
watched their rise and decline, floating ordinary, advance and retreat,
to know for themselves whether their conduct was successful or not,
like using a clear mirror to look at oneself,
appearance and form can be seen as different."
"Excellent, excellent!
What should be done now?"
"Well,
conduct should guard the root,
emulating Heaven,
is the beginning;
emulating Earth,
is mostly harmful;
emulating harmony,
is next;
inconstancy,
is the end of conduct."
"Why do people nowadays reach the point of inconstant conduct?"
"Well,
ancestors slightly deviated and lost it,
next it became slightly erroneous,
next greatly erroneous,
next greatly lost.
The path and root became confused and disordered,
with nothing to rely on for their intentions,
thus instead engaging in inconstant conduct,
easily changing their words,
becoming years of inconstancy.
This shows the Dào is corrupted but not yet extreme,
and should return to the root.
The ancient sages saw this and knew it as the final decline,
the extreme then returns,
thus they did not lose governance,
and preserved their heavenly mandate.
Therefore, great sages see affairs clearly,
and thus are always uniquely fortunate.
Perfected One, do you wish to seriously know its true effect?"
"Only the Celestial Master can reveal it."
"If the year's root is flourishing but its end is evil,
it is the extreme of Yīn and Yáng.
If later generations are evil and shallow,
it is the extreme of the age.
If the myriad things' roots flourish but ends have no harvest,
it is the extreme of things.
If later generations' words are mostly empty deceit without substance,
it is the extreme of speech.
If documents are mostly stored in piles without truth,
it is the extreme of writing.
These all lose the root and follow the end,
lose substance and follow embellishment.
Thus causing Heaven and Earth to produce the myriad things,
all mostly have roots without ends,
the fault truly lies in losing the root and flowing to the end,
losing truth and following falsehood,
losing depth and following shallowness,
thus making it normal.
Therefore, customs do not know to return and oppose each other,
uniquely contradicting heavenly law accumulated over time.
Later generations daily trivialize affairs,
further creating deceit and falsehood,
accumulated habits become spirit-like,
unable to again restrain each other,
instead saying they understand affairs,
thus causing further mutual inherited burden,
forming heavenly faults and earthly calamities,
spreading rampant in all directions,
unable to be prevented.
Even if rulers are benevolent and worthy,
how can they stop this flow of error for ten thousand times ten thousand generations?
Beginning with losing a little,
each loss like a grain of millet.
If the heavenly Dào loses by a hair's breadth,
the error becomes a thousand miles,
grains following grains gathering together,
then fill the great granary with tens of thousands of billions of hectoliters.
Raindrops following each other flowing down without stopping,
become a hundred streams,
accumulating into the four seas,
water becomes too much.
Since the root is gone, one should measure with the true Dào,
return from the extreme end back to the root,
return from embellishment back to substance,
return from falsehood back to truth.
Those at the extreme end should return to the root,
those at the conduct extreme should return,
this is the way of Heaven.
Losing the correct Dào,
is no small ailment.
Until after life ends,
again mutually inheriting the burden of this fault,
later generations again confused again lost,
the correct Dào daily darkens,
obscurely again losing the Dào,
heavenly qì becomes perverse and contradictory,
how can governance achieve peace?
Every person suffers its poisonous harm,
how can people attain longevity,
the myriad things wounded mostly die young.
Therefore, repeatedly I command the Perfected One to transmit my book,
so that every person reflects on losing the Dào's meaning,
the body becoming ill,
each worrying and laboring,
then Heaven, Earth, rulers, people, and the myriad things will all be peaceful.
Perfected One, if you wish to harmonize with Heaven's heart,
you should not slacken or neglect."
"Yes, yes.
I wish to ask another doubt,
Celestial Master, now these fortunes and misfortunes,

"Excellent,
the Perfected One has难得 grasped the Dào's meaning.
The extreme above should return below,
the extreme outside should return inside;
thus when Yáng reaches extreme it should return to Yīn,
when extreme below it should return above;
thus when Yīn reaches extreme it returns to Yáng,
when extreme at the end it should return to the root.
Since Heaven and Earth opened and divided,
slight continuous loss of the Dào's meaning,
mutually inherited burdens,
has now become extremely evil and false.
How can this be known?"
All things and people often start virtuous but end wicked,
achieving little in their endeavors.
Why speak of what's ahead?
The beginning holds substance,
the end becomes empty.
The ancient sages always observed the actions and stillness of the myriad people to understand this,
thus never failing in their insight."
"Excellent, excellent!
I wish to ask one more thing."
"Speak on."
"Now, as the Tiān Shī says,

and can the highest extreme also descend again,
