"Excellent,
your question.
Now, you, the Zhēn Rén, appear foolish and confused,
not yet comprehending the way of the Tài Jí.
This Wěi Qì Shén Rén,
unites form and strength with the Yuán Qì,
coexisting with the four seasons and five phases.
All matters of human spirit
are received from the Tiān Qì,
and the Tiān Qì is received from the Yuán Qì.
The spirit rides on the Qì to move,
so where there is Qì in a person, there is spirit;
where there is spirit, there is Qì.
If the spirit departs, the Qì is cut off;
if the Qì is lost, the spirit leaves.
Thus, without spirit, one dies;
without Qì, one dies.
Would a Wěi Qì Shén Rén ever enter a person's abdomen? No."
"Yes, yes."
"Moreover, the five phases arise and are born from the Yuán Qì,
and the spirit shares the same body and movement with the Yuán Qì.
Now, the five phases enter to become the organs within a person.
Among these nine types of people,
can the highest extreme descend again,
returning to a human body? No."
"Excellent, excellent!
Though I've studied for a long time,

"Indeed, your study should be refined;
without refinement, it is of no benefit."
"Yes, yes.
Hearing the Tiān Shī's words,
is it that the way of heaven naturally cycles like a circle?"
"Yes.
You may be said to have understood it already.
Go forth now,
and if doubts arise, do not hesitate to ask."
"Yes, yes."
The above simplifies the four aspects of heaven's reality, from origin to end, and the Tài Jí to reflect governance.
"This ignorant student, being dim-witted,

The Six Directions give minor admonishments through winds and rains chaotically issuing, madness and vicious poison together injuring people;
major admonishments by violently imposing irrationality,

Heaven, Earth, the Six Directions and Eight Extremes together give major admonishments, all wishing to correct and cause the writings of the Hé and Luò to appear,
Heaven's clear testimony,
auspicious response texts appearing under heaven,

if admonished but not heeded,

The Way of Heaven, when its classic assemblies should be used,

without worries or troubles,
without danger or perishings,

"Excellent, excellent!
This ignorant student has now understood.

"Excellent, excellent,

The image and effect

"Therefore the sages and worthies of antiquity, from morning to night with hands folded in repose,

all beings are near death and distressed,
following virtue to hide away,
so inside daily prospers,
while outside is empty and perished.
In the tenth month, punishment is at the top sixth,
Hài, when punishment reaches the six distant and eight regions,
the myriad beings of the four wilds, the bustling multitude, all hide away and flee,
following virtue to arrive at the bright hall,
crawling creatures naturally harbor inside,
the wilds outside empty without masses,
is this not evidence that those who favor using penalties see followers leave?
But if the mind intends to harbor punishment inside,
to govern its masses,
then daily they decline and diminish.
Thus, harboring one punishment inside in the fifth month,
one group of the masses rebels.
Harboring two punishments inside in the sixth month,
two groups of the masses rebel.
Harboring three punishments inside in the seventh month,
three groups of the masses rebel.
Harboring four punishments inside in the eighth month,
four groups of the masses rebel.
Harboring five punishments inside in the ninth month,
five groups of the masses rebel.
Harboring six punishments inside in the tenth month,
six groups of the masses rebel.
Thus, outside is completely devoid of things,
all having fled inside,
this is clear evidence and effect.
Therefore, those who govern with punishment,
are outwardly respectful and cautious but rebel inside,
so the masses daily decrease.
Thus, harboring one virtue inside in the eleventh month,
one group of the masses enters and follows.
Harboring two virtues inside in the twelfth month,
two groups of the masses enter and follow.
Harboring three virtues inside in the first month,
three groups of the masses enter and follow.
Harboring four virtues inside in the second month,
the masses from the four directions enter and follow.
Harboring five yáng flourishing virtues inside in the third month,
five groups of the masses, including the worthy, enter and follow.
Harboring six virtues inside in the fourth month,
all beings emerge and appear together,
none not bustling,
both inside and outside return to it.
This is the evident effect of Heaven's law.
In the second and eighth months,
virtue and punishment are half and half,
so in the second month, beings are half harmed by cold,
in the eighth month, beings are also half harmed by cold;
in the second month,
virtue wishes to send its masses out the gate,
punishment wishes to bring its masses inside the gate,
both are at the boundary;
thus in the second and eighth months, the punishment and virtue of all beings just meet,
life and death are half and half,
so half are harmed.
You now joyfully wish to know the constant laws of Heaven and Earth,
the clear evidence of yīn and yáng,
this is it.
Punishment daily wounds and kills,
causing fear and aversion,
and fails to gain the strength of the masses,
instead saying there are no people;
virtue relaxes and daily gives life,
Without punishments yet fearing nothing under heaven,
on the contrary, they submit,
all returning to the king's assistance in governance,
which is the clear evidence of Heaven,
manifest and beyond doubt.
Nowadays, people without authority and fear cannot be governed,
so what can be done?
However, the sages and noble figures of antiquity instilled awe through the Way and virtue,
not through physical force or penalties.
Those who do not delight in doing good,
with inferior virtue, instead wish to use punishments to intimidate and assist in rule,
yet they are seen to depart.
Punishments can only address poverty and relieve burdens,
but are insufficient to generate all things,
clearly showing that the chaotic masses follow their leaders.
Now, if people do not submit internally,
but instead deceive and cheat,
the great fault lies herein.
"You have come to learn frequently of late,
asking many questions,
accumulating much text,
yet you have not fully trusted the words in my book;
having this, do you still not understand?"
Chún kowtowed respectfully and bowed,
"I have committed great errors,
failing the words of the enlightened teacher and spiritual being,
feeling ashamed within and sweating;
but being foolish, of little virtue, and utterly lowly,
though my days of study are many,
my mind is dull and cannot fully grasp the teacher's words,
thus I dare to repeatedly ask questions,
showing great lack of humility,
long causing worry for the teacher, have I not?"
"It is only that your learning is not yet refined,
be cautious of this.
Heaven has set forth signs and established models for humanity,
creating teachings and decrees for emperors and kings,
which can be followed in governance,
without a single error in ten thousand.
If you wish to know its meaning,
this is precisely it.
Governing without this method,
often causes Heaven to be distressed,
angry and unresolved,
hence many disasters occur.
Take heed of this.
Those whom Heaven will prosper,
take their model from virtue;
those who will decline,
take their law from punishment,
this is what is meant.
My words,
carefully align with the norms of Heaven, Earth, yīn, and yáng,
following the principles of Heaven and Earth,
speaking clearly for Heaven,
recording with teachings and decrees to show you.
My words,
are as sharp as arrowheads, no different,
following them leads to daily prosperity,
opposing them brings self-imposed limits.
How divine, how divine is the law of Heaven!
Therefore, the spiritual beings, true humans, and great sages of antiquity could deeply establish laws and measures,
creating norms for emperors and kings,
all because they saw the essence of celestial patterns,
and alone understood inwardly the meaning of yīn and yáng,
only then could they follow Heaven and Earth in governance,
uniting their hearts with the divine and bright,
observing what can be done,
hence their rule erred not once in ten thousand.
"Now, foolish officials and people think the laws of Heaven can be recklessly violated,
indulging themselves without regard to laws and measures,
thus often disrupting their ruler's governance,
the great fault lies herein.
Now that you have obtained this book,
why not carefully focus your mind,
ponder it earnestly,
in quiet rooms and secluded places?
Reflect on the actions of Heaven,
then you can transmit Heaven's teachings,
to instruct foolish people,
and assist emperors and kings with laws and measures.
If you intend to employ punishments,
deeply consider where punishments reside,
all are seen to follow and depart,
silent and alone without masses.
Thus, winter punishments are in the wilds with no people,
all things rebel and hide inside,
avoiding them intensely.
Summer punishments are inside,
all things go out and return to virtue,
the lower chambers empty within,
punishments silent and alone,
all follow virtue to the open fields.
When virtue is outside,
all things return outside;
when virtue is in the void, things return inside.
Heaven's punishments, their awe extremely potent,
fortunately can subdue people and all things,
why then can they not restrain their own masses?
Is it not strange indeed?
Clearly, punishments cannot be lightly or recklessly used:
harm one upright breath,
and Heaven's breath becomes chaotic;
harm one harmonious breath,
and Earth's breath turns adverse;
harm one scholar,
and all scholars vanish;
harm one worthy,
and all worthies hide.
All affairs are thereby shaken.
Therefore, the sages, sage-kings, and emperors of old deeply perceived this heavenly admonitory text,
thus fearing it and not daring to act recklessly;
fearing they might not attain Heaven's heart,
and unable to secure their own persons.
Those of supreme heavenly virtue,
alone deeply see the clear effects of the Way and virtue,
not weary or stubborn,
not fearing or startled,
and the masses return to them and adhere,
thus they guard the Way to preserve themselves,
and guard virtue not daring to lose it.
If you virtuously read my book,
and have doubts in your heart,
always keep this one volume,
near you morning and night, constantly consulting it,
using it as clear warning and proof,
then you will gradually attain Heaven's intent.
Those who violate this,
have already turned against Heaven.
It is like the Qián and Kūn of the Yì,
which cannot be reversed;
like the cycle of the six jiǎ,
which cannot be altered;
like the fixed laws of the five phases,
which cannot be lost;
like the brightness of the sun and moon,
which cannot be covered;
as if the ruler is above,
and the minister below,
thus it cannot be disordered.
This clarifies the governance of Heaven, Earth, yīn, and yáng,
that there are those who prefer to practice virtue.
Some foolish people instead prefer punishments,
they should always observe this book,
to resolve confusion,
striving to teach people to be good scholars,
guarding the Way and virtue,
thinking to reduce punishments,
my book rectifies the heavenly laws and measures.
Is it easier to practice the Way and virtue?
Or is it harder to use punishments?
Loving them leads to daily increase,
awing them instead leads to daily nothingness.
Go quickly now,
transmit my book for Heaven,
do not doubt.
My words do not fail the chaos of Heaven, Earth, and the six directions."
"Yes, yes.
I sincerely return to reflect on my faults,
only discussing above and below,
not daring to miss a single point."
"Go,
be warned and cautious.
If you cannot differentiate and ponder in detail the meaning of my book,
simply observe the great divisions of Heaven, Earth, yīn, and yáng.
From the spring equinox to the autumn equinox,
virtue resides outside,
all things without exception go out and return to the king outside,
hibernating insects leave their burrows,
people leave their homes.
From the autumn equinox to the spring equinox,
virtue is inside,
all things without exception return to the king inside,
hibernating creatures all enter their burrows,
people enter their homes;
this is the clear effect of virtuous governance.
From the spring equinox to the autumn equinox,
punishment governs inside,
all things follow and go out to the outside,
inside empty,
silent and alone.
From the autumn equinox to the spring equinox,
punishment resides outside governing outside,
without things or breath,
empty without masses,
all follow and enter with virtue;
this is evidence that punishment clearly cannot govern.
Therefore, virtue unites in heart and strength with Heaven,
thus when yáng emerges, it emerges,
when yáng enters, it enters;
punishment unites in strength and heart with Earth,
thus when yīn emerges, it emerges,
when yīn enters, it enters.
Virtue unites in strength with the breath of life,
thus when the breath of life emerges, it emerges,
when it enters, it enters;
punishment unites in strength with the breath of killing,
thus when the breath of killing emerges, it emerges,
when it enters, it enters.
Virtue ascends with Heaven in the same rank,
Virtue and punishment move alongside the same ranks.
Virtue always dwells with the substantial,
while punishment resides with emptiness and nothingness.
Virtue constantly accompanies prosperity,
thus when prosperity is external, it emerges;
when prosperity is internal, it enters;
hence it enters in winter and emerges in summer.
Punishment coexists with decline and deathly energy,
so it emerges in winter and enters in summer.
Deathly energy is clear,
thus where it abides becomes clear.
Therefore, virtue shares the same energy as emperors and kings,
so when kingship is external, it emerges from the yin;
when kingship is internal, it enters into punishment;
punishment occupies the same position as petty individuals,
thus where it resides lacks scholars and masses.
That to which all things return
accumulates the virtue of emperors and kings,
constantly seen as the destination,
hence they are called emperors and kings;
punishment has never coexisted with things,
lacking scholars and masses,
thus it cannot be called noble.
Therefore, the sages of antiquity deeply contemplated alone,
observing the actions of heaven, earth, yin, and yang,
taking them as models to emulate,
knowing their great principles so as not to err even once in ten thousand,
thus daring not to violate them,
this is the clear evidence of heaven and earth's correctness,
can one not carefully consider it?
Can one not be cautious?
It is the law of nature,
not altered for anyone,
this is the constant operation of heaven and earth,
now I have fully revealed it to you.
You should repeatedly ponder its meaning,
and in your actions, do not act lightly. "
"Yes, yes,
I dare not neglect it. "
"Go now,
I have completely transmitted the true dharma words to you,
my worries are relieved;
to remove calamities for heaven,
to honor ultimate virtue,
and to prosper the kingly way.
If you dare to cut it off,
you will suffer its harm. "
"Yes, yes. "
The above records the heavenly method to clarify the principles of gains and losses favored by rulers throughout ancient and modern times, past and present.
"This humble and foolish student cannot bear
the questions in my heart,
for I offend against the Celestial Master's taboos,
and my transgression is severe.
The thoughts I wish to express
cannot be restrained by myself;
this petty person cannot endure these feelings,
and my inner organs feel vexed and distressed.
May I ask about a great doubt?
Since the Celestial Master treats me with the affection due to an infant,
you will surely pity and understand my eagerness and thirst!"
"Speak forth.
Why such humility?"
"Yes, yes.
Now the Celestial Master constantly unites in essence and thought with August Heaven and Sovereign Earth;
your heart deeply resonates with the intent of Heaven and Earth,
like compasses fitting together with squares,
not straying by even a hair's breadth.
Knowing what Heaven and Earth constantly worry about,
therefore this foolish and unworthy student, despite feeling ashamed,
dares to ask in advance,
wishing to know what are the great taboos of Heaven, Earth, and the divine spirits?"
"Excellent,
student, you progress diligently!
Your question now enters directly into the heart and intent of Heaven and Earth.
If people can know this,
and engrave it in the hearts of the worthy,
it will not depart for ten thousand generations.
I have always been eager to speak,
but had no one to converse with.
Now that I have your question,
my heart feels resolved and joyful,
and I will explain it to you in detail,
not daring to conceal anything.
The reason for this is
that I fear Heaven, Earth, and the divine spirits would deeply detest me,
and that would bring great disaster upon myself.
You, the Perfected, should sit calmly and listen clearly."
"What Heaven and Earth greatly suffer and hate
is people's disobedience and lack of filial piety.
What does this mean?
I wish to hear it."
"Excellent,
your questioning is profound.
Now, Heaven, Earth, and the Harmony have three qì in total,
internally united as one family,
mutually governing and nurturing life,
together nourishing the myriad things.
Heaven is responsible for birth,
called Father;
Earth is responsible for nurturing,
called Mother;
Humanity is responsible for ordering and governing,
called the Child.
The Father should teach and transform according to the seasons;
the Mother follows the Father's actions in nurturing;
the Child receives life and mandate from the Father,
and is nourished and fed by the Mother.
As a child, one should respect and serve the Father and love the Mother."
"What does this mean?"
"Well, the Father's teaching has measures and seasonal timings,
so Heaven teaches through the four seasons to bring life, nurturing, and completion,
with beginnings and ends each having their proper time.
When wicked people oppose this,
it is the child disobeying the Father;
the celestial qì loses its governance and commands,
and cannot attain its heart's intent.
Heaven thus greatly detests such people and generates calamities and anomalies,
using illness to harm its children,
just like in a family,
when the father is angry and disciplines his child,
changes immediately arise.
When father and child are not in harmony,
and the father resents the child for not obeying the strict father's teachings and commands,
then the yīn overcomes the yáng,
the lower deceives the upper,
and many rebellious children appear.
Ministers neglect their duties,
ghostly beings greatly arise,
together harming people;
the cunning and crafty dwell by the wayside;
all yīn and submissive types that are disobedient—
the fault lies in opposing Heaven and Earth.
Should the Perfected, then, be disobedient?
This is the method of spontaneity,
like the shadow responding to the form,
following the horse without detachment.
Take this as a warning."
"Yes, yes."
"Now I have reverently received the Master's explanation of Heaven's teachings and commands;
I wish to hear about the prohibitions against offending Earth."
"Well then,
Perfected, listen clearly."
"Yes, yes."
"Heaven
is the Father;
Earth
is the Mother.
Father and Mother are both human,
how are they different?
Heaven is also Heaven,
Earth is also Heaven;
Father and Mother are only distinguished by yīn-yáng and male-female,
their likes and dislikes are of the same kind.
Heaven nourishes human life,
Earth nourishes human form.
But people are greatly foolish, obscured, and ignorant,
not knowing to deeply honor their parents,
often causing Heaven and Earth, in producing ordinary people,
to feel regretful, distressed, and unresolved."
"What does this mean?"
"Excellent,
your words,
deeply grasp the intent of Heaven and Earth.
Great disasters and harms will cease,
and people will surely be auspicious and good."
"What does this mean?
May the Celestial Master explain it."
"Well,
now all people under heaven together steal and harm,
wronging their parents."
"What does this mean?"
"The qì of the four seasons
is what Heaven carries out in due order.
To oppose it
is to steal and harm one's Father."
"What does this mean?"
"Now people take Earth as Mother,
obtaining clothing and food from her,
yet they do not together love and benefit her,
but instead together steal and harm her."
"What does this mean?"
"Well,
Perfected, listen clearly.
People are utterly without propriety,
together digging and piercing the Earth,
greatly undertaking earthworks,
without using the proper principles.
The deep ones go down to the Yellow Springs,
the shallow ones several zhàng.
The Mother internally alone feels sorrow and anger;
her many children are greatly not careful or filial,
often suffering bitterly, resentful and distressed,
with no way to communicate her words.
In ancient times, the sages' timely fortune did not allow them to reach this Way,
thus letting people act recklessly,
saying Earth does not feel pain or illness.
But Earth internally alone feels pain and illness beyond measure,
and thus appeals upward to Heaven,
while people remain unaware of it.
Distressed and constrained, her children cannot be controlled;
she appeals to the Father about the people.
As the appeals accumulate over time,
and further accumulate in number over a long period,
the Father's anger does not cease,
disasters, transformations, and anomalies arise in myriad ways together.
The Mother also becomes displeased,
often angry and unwilling to strenuously nourish the people and myriad things.
When both parents are not pleased,
the myriad things and people die.
Not using the proper principles,
the fault lies here.
The actions of later generations daily become more severe,
not attaining the intent of Heaven and Earth,
instead hating Heaven and Earth, saying they are not harmonious,
and together hating their emperors and kings,
saying they cannot bring peace to their governance within,
while instead each person considers themselves beyond reproach by Heaven and Earth, unaware of their own faults,
instead shifting their faults to blame those above.
Therefore, Heaven and Earth no longer love people.
They see people's deaths as sudden;
even if people have illnesses,
crying out at the point of death,
their crimes and offenses are clear,
Heaven, Earth, and the parents no longer save them.
For their crimes are deeply excessive,
the blame and responsibility for collapse and exhaustion
lies instead here.
The actions of later generations become even more severe than before,
imitating each other,
taking it as the constant rule,
no longer restrained,
no longer knowing to prohibit each other,
hence disasters daily increase.
Truly, together they wrong Heaven and Earth.
Heaven and Earth
are the parents of people;
for children instead to together harm their parents, stealing, injuring, and making them ill—
this is no minor crime.
Therefore, Heaven and Earth most of all resent unfiliality and disobedience,
and no longer pardon it.
Even if people die young with countless deaths,
there is no one to blame.
Does the Perfected understand this now?"
"Yes, yes."
"Now Heaven sent you to come and ask in detail,
knowing that I can speak.
You, the Perfected, must not take it lightly;
you must be cautious."
"Yes, yes."
"Nowadays people collectively harm their parents,
oppose their governance decrees,
in your esteemed opinion,
could they be long nurtured without evil?
Therefore, Heaven does not greatly pity them."
"Now the Celestial Master pities this ignorant student and explains in detail,
how can we know that Heaven and Earth are constantly angry and distressed,
and resent humans frequently excavating earth?"
"Excellent,
Heaven has sent you to humbly inquire,
sufficiently showing Heaven and Earth have made you ask this."
"Yes."
"I greatly fear Heaven,
dare not conceal anything,
fearing personal disaster,
now I shall make you clearly understand,
eternally engrave it in your heart,
never to be forgotten.
If one household undertakes construction and earth-moving,
several families suffer illness,
some meeting death,
some incurring banditry or government punishment,
some leading to warfare and disputes,
some causing snakes, bees, tigers, wolves, or vicious birds to harm people.
Major earth-moving brings great calamity,
minor earth-moving brings minor calamity,
this is Earth's anger,
making spirits create these disasters.
Thus Heaven and Earth make many people ill,
this is clear evidence,
do you understand?"
"Yes, yes.
But sometimes earth-moving brings good fortune without harm,
why is that?"
"Excellent question,
all cause harm,
but if obtaining good soil,
it doesn't immediately sicken people;
instead, surrounding areas receive the misfortune,
eventually it will harm people;
obtaining bad soil makes it unbearable for people to act,
immediately harming them.
Why does it also harm distant places?
This is like a good-intentioned person,
though wronged,
can forcibly endure momentarily,
not forgetting in heart,
later will retaliate;
bad people cannot endure,
immediately acting out."
"Excellent, excellent!
Now Earth's body is immensely vast,
humans compared to Earth,
are tiny,
their actions trivial and insignificant,
how could they possibly harm Earth?"
"Excellent,
your challenging question!
Heaven makes your distinction unclear,
how to know this,
through your deeply sincere words.
Now what you wish to say,
what distress in your heart,
speaking will bring relief.
Heaven and Earth's divine essence resides in your belly,
respecting your urgent speech,
you naturally don't realize it yourself.
All human desires to act,
are ordained by Heaven."
"Yes.
Dare not conceal anything."
"You understand virtue."
"Yes, yes."
"Now you say,
humans are small,
their actions cannot harm Earth.
Consider a tall man measuring ten feet,
with girth of ten arm-spans,
having tooth-decay worms,
tiny and insignificant,
inhabiting human teeth.
When severe pain strikes,
the person cries out repeatedly,
and teeth eventually all decay and fall out.
Humans compared to Heaven and Earth's size,
are like these worms harming people.
Teeth are harder than metal, stone, or bone.
The worms are merely flesh,
why can they harm this person?
Similarly, humans harm Earth like this.
Do you understand?
Proceed, enlightened one, open your understanding further."
"Yes, yes."
"Some people grow over ten feet tall,
with bodies exceeding ten arm-spans,
yet ulcer maggots less than an inch long,
their bodies minuscule,
accumulated smallness insignificant,
residing in human skin,
gnawing day and night,
making the person ill,
even to death.
Humans compared to Earth's size,
are like this.
These maggots accumulate smallness,
why can they kill this person?
Enlightened one, your ignorance,
why so profound,
resembling ordinary people?"
"Truly inadequate."
"You尚且不及，
何况凡人乎？"
"有過失愚昧，
唯願天師告知不足之處，
請為愚生詳解其意。"
不隱瞞。
我知天地病重，
故反覆告知你。
再為你說一事，
讓你清楚明白知曉。"
"唯唯。"
"今壯士力士無不能制服疥蟲，
小小不足為道。
有一斗之多共食此人，
使之病痛臥床不得，
重者臥床不起。
今疥蟲跳蚤蝨子微小，
積聚眾多，
共食人，
蠱蟲能殺人，
疥蟲跳蚤使人煩躁鬱悶，
不得安坐，
皆生瘡瘍。
人與地大小之比如此，
可明白否？"
"唯唯。"
今你或見我所說，
似不足為憑，
現為你說明。
人雖小，
其冤害地形之情狀，
使人清楚自知，
深有過錯責任，
立即可見。
今一大里有百戶，
有百井；
一鄉有千戶，
有千井；
一縣有萬戶，
有萬井；
一郡有十萬戶，
有十萬井；
一州有億戶，
有億井。
大井一丈，
中井數尺，
小井三尺，
今穿地至黃泉。
天下有多少呢？
或一家有數井。
今僅以小井計算，
十井長三丈，
百井長三十丈，
千井三百丈，
萬井三千丈，
十萬井三萬丈。
天下如此之井共有多少？
穿地皆得水，
水乃地之血脈。
今穿你身，
得其血脈，
豈不病邪？
今一億井，
廣袤共幾里？
你自行細算。
天下有幾億井乎？
故人冤害天地已明。
你賊害病你母，
為病甚重，
地氣漏泄，
其病人極深，
而人不愛不憐，
反自說常冤天地，
何不純調和，
此不反邪？
此僅記述諸井而已。
今天下大屋丘陵墳墓，
及穿鑿山岡，
采取金石，
燒陶瓦立柱，
妄掘溝渠，
或閉塞阻斷，
當通不得通有多少？
今此水泉，
或當流，
或當通，
How much of the blockage and excavation has been spoken of?
Now water springs should flow freely,
benefiting when they are unobstructed,
utilizing the natural waterways of heaven and earth,
following the high to reach the low.
But nowadays some act otherwise,
recklessly digging into the earth's form,
all causing sores and wounds;
some block and cut off,
what should flow freely does not.
When the king's governance is disharmonious,
the earth falls severely ill,
yet none are willing to speak of it as sickness, pain, or ailment.
The vital essence of the earth,
appeals to heaven above, but the communication is blocked,
unceasingly.
Thus heaven and earth together become displeased,
making it difficult to attain the harmonious pure energy.
Do you, the enlightened one, understand this or not?"
"Yes, yes.
Now humans live between heaven and earth,
they ought to have dwellings to shelter themselves,
and wells to drink from,
how is that?"
"Excellent,
your words.
Heaven does not despise humans having dwellings,
but when they dig too deep into the earth,
all becomes sores and wounds,
sometimes reaching the earth's bones,
sometimes reaching the earth's blood,
what does this mean?
Springs are
the earth's blood;
stones are
the earth's bones;
good soil is
the earth's flesh.
Piercing a spring is obtaining blood,
breaking stone is breaking bones,
digging deep into good soil,
and throwing tiles, stones, or hard wood into it burdens the earth,
the earth internally suffers from this alone,
not just one person severely,
so what should be done now?
The earth is
the mother of all things,
joyfully nurturing them,
not knowing her own importance,
like a child in the womb,
if it abides by the way and does not recklessly pierce its mother,
the mother remains without illness;
if it recklessly pierces its mother to seek life,
the mother becomes ill from it.
If humans do not recklessly dig deep into the earth,
but dwell upon it,
sufficient to shelter themselves modestly,
then the earth does not fall ill from it.
Great love for people brings them good fortune,
now I wish to know how much modest shelter is acceptable.
Whenever moving earth into the ground,
do not exceed three feet,
why stop at three feet as the rule?
Because one foot

jointly governing one duty,
collectively accomplishing one task,
and if one element is lacking, it becomes inauspicious.
Thus, having yang without yin,
it cannot exist alone,
and governance will perish;
having yin without yang,
it also cannot exist alone,
and governance will perish;
having both yin and yang but without harmony,
it cannot propagate its kind,
and will also perish.
Therefore, with heaven but no earth,
all things have no place to rest;
with earth but no heaven,
all things have no means to live;
with heaven and earth connected but without harmony,
things cannot coexist and sustain themselves.
Thus, a man cannot live alone,
a woman cannot provide alone,
and without man and woman, there are no children to bear;
how then can a family be formed,
and be named father and mother?
Therefore, the law of heaven decrees that only through the union of three can completion be achieved.
Thus, the sages of ancient times deeply understood the nature of heaven,
modeling themselves after it to govern mutually.
Hence, the ruler is the father,
symbolizing heaven;
the ministers are the mother,
symbolizing earth;
the people are the children,
symbolizing harmony.
The mandated law of heaven
dictates that all bustling beings
must interconnect in triple union,
joining forces and uniting hearts,
to collectively govern and accomplish one task,
form one family,
and become one body,
as heaven mandates they rely on each other to act,
none can be missing.
If one matter bears grievance,
not finding its proper place,
then threefold ruin and threefold misfortune ensue.
Thus, the ruler needs ministers,
ministers need the people,
the people need ministers,
ministers need the ruler,
only then can one task be accomplished;
lacking one,
makes the three incomplete.
Therefore, a ruler without people and ministers
has no claim to be called ruler;
having ministers and people but no ruler,
they do not constitute ministers and people;
ministers and people without a ruler
also fall into chaos,
unable to govern themselves,
nor can they become good ministers and people;
these three rely on each other to stand,
achieving completion through mutual fulfillment,
so ruler, ministers, and people should follow heaven's law,
interconnect in triple union,
join forces and unite hearts,
collectively becoming one family.
This is like husband, wife, and child forming one family,
none can be without the others;
this is the essential way of heaven.
It is like a person having head, feet, and belly,
then forming one body;
none can be removed;
removing one makes it incomplete,
and it does not constitute a person.
This is the natural order of heaven and earth.
Therefore, the sages of old took heaven as their model,
so men must obtain virtuous women to govern with,
and thus have good children.
The man,
is the ruler;
the woman,
is the minister;
the child,
is the people.
Thus, the way heaven mandates governing a state
involves making wise and enlightened ministers as friends,
for a good woman can then harmonize with her child,
and good ministers can then harmonize with the people.
A good woman can then bear good children,
good ministers can then nurture good people,
and when both people and ministers are inclined toward goodness,
then the ruler above can long be at peace.
If you, the enlightened one, wish to know its evidence,
heaven,
is the ruler;
earth,
is the minister;
when heaven's rain circulates everywhere,
raining on good earth,
living things thrive;
raining on bad earth,
living things suffer;
this illustrates the point.
Now, parents, ruler, and ministers
still only hold the great guiding principles together.
The essential need is to rely on children for food and clothing;
a person without children
truly has no posterity;
a ruler with few people
leads to insufficient food and clothing,
causing constant worry and distress.
Therefore, the way to govern a state
fundamentally relies on the people.
Without people,
the ruler and ministers have nothing to govern,
nothing to manage.
Hence, the great sages and worthies of old in governing affairs
focused day and night on prioritizing the people as most urgent,
worrying about their people.
Like family parents worrying about having no children,
without children, how can they call themselves parents?
Without people, how can a ruler call himself ruler?
Therefore, the law of heaven
always makes ruler, ministers, and people unified,
sharing the same fate,
the same fortune and misfortune;
if one duty or one task loses its correctness,
it becomes greatly inauspicious.
Since the middle ancient times,
many have lost the guiding principles of governance,
thus inheriting burdens,
and later generations suffer increasingly severe flowing disasters,
truly due to ruler, ministers, and people losing their strategy,
not deeply reflecting,
failing to love and connect well with each other,
join forces and unite hearts,
instead increasing mutual worry and distress.
The ruler is but one person,
and may reside in deep seclusion,
while grievances结 from all around,
truly blocked and uncommunicated,
governance fails to align with heaven's will,
disasters, anomalies, and strange occurrences
accumulate and remain unresolved.
What heaven and earth wish to express,
the human ruler cannot know;
the great fault lies here,
in not joining forces in triple unity,
intelligence is cut off,
and evil energies结 unresolved.
Above, it becomes the great enmity of the august heaven;
below, the great fault of the earth;
for the emperor, it is a great worry;
disasters multiply unresolved,
becoming a great harm to the people,
a severe illness for all things;
this has accumulated uniquely for a long time,
not solely due to the faults of people today or in the past.
Do you, the enlightened one, also know this?"
"I have known this for so long,
but truly do not know the cause of it all;
thus, my question stems from genuine perplexity;
what should be done about it now?"
"Well,
the heavenly breath of great peace is about to arrive,
governance should align with heaven's will,
and then these evils will naturally dissipate;
hence, heaven has made me elaborate on it.
Wanting me to remedy their failures,
to produce the correct texts,
thus I have made you, the enlightened one, come and ask all this;
this is the origin of misfortune.
Not modeling the natural law of heaven and earth's primal breath,
not interconnecting in triple unity,
joining forces and uniting hearts,
thus leading to this.
If triple interconnection occurs,
joining forces and uniting hearts,
now establishing great peace and joy,
establishes a state without disaster."
"I wish to hear, how should governance be properly conducted?"
"Urgently emulate the law of heaven,
as described above.
The law of heaven
dictates that in all matters, three must join forces and unite hearts.
Thus, heaven uses the three lights as its pattern,
the three lights constantly interconnected, shining together,
never ceasing.
Since the heavenly covenant emerged,
humans use writing as their pattern to govern,
modeling the three lights of heaven;
thus, heaven from time to time causes the Héluò writings to appear,
reiterating the decrees in written texts for humanity.
Wanting to emulate heaven's profoundly ultimate and divine governance standards,
to make goodness daily flourish,
and evil daily extinguished.
Writing,
merely involves communicating through three pathways of document circulation.
The ruler should skillfully guide those below,
To issue clear decrees and commands,
instructing the people to each reside in their places and submit writings,
fully describing the good and evil they have witnessed.
Thus, by acting accordingly,
they may also simply send them by convenient means,
or entrust them to merchant carts for delivery,
or properly state their full names upon arrival.
By establishing such laws,
the good and evil of the world will all be revealed.
The ruler guides the celestial qi downward to communicate,
the ministers guide the terrestrial qi upward to communicate,
and the people guide the harmonious qi upward to communicate.
The Zhēnrén transmits the writings,
delivering them to the virtuous ruler,
who carefully listens to my words,
establishes peace and joy,
eliminates disasters and anomalies,
without missing a hair's breadth.
My writings are respectfully received from the celestial laws,
not merely empty statements of false words.
If Heaven were to execute my child,
would you also know this is a heavy punishment?"
"Yes, yes."
"To obtain my writings,
truly obtain and implement them accordingly,
responding in resonance with Heaven and Earth,
this is the credibility of my text.
With such clear and great evidence,
you need not harbor doubts.
The way to govern the state,
to joyfully attain the heart of Heaven and find self-peace,
simply practice this proof,
responding in resonance with Heaven,
which is the clear contract of Heaven speaking with humanity.
I only see the Zhēnrén often delighting in assisting virtuous rulers,
wishing to repay Heaven's heavy merit,
hence I speak of it one by one.
I know the fault lies here,
in blocking and failing to receive the writings,
so the ruler must create clear teachings and good decrees.
Say that from now on,
officials and people should each reside in their places,
diligently submit writings,
fully describing good and evil,
to illuminate the ruler's governance,
and communicate with the celestial qi,
without hindering each other;
those who hinder will be punished for three years for the offense.
Only those who submit writings with complete honesty,
without deceptive text,
shall be summoned and appointed to office.
How shall they be appointed?
Inquire each about their abilities and strengths,
assigning positions according to their physical and mental capacities.
Why must assignments match their capacities?
Heaven's service to people
is according to each one's ability;
if not based on their abilities,
it is called deliberately wronging people,
which then accumulates grievances and increases disasters.
The reason for this is,
what people cannot achieve,
even if forced to live or die,
they still cannot accomplish.
What people delight in now
is the utmost joy of obtaining good things like gold and jade.
If an enlightened ruler decrees,
saying that whoever can gather all the state's rare and counterfeit gold and silver treasures by hand,
without fault to you,
will be given all to you,
that person would be extremely joyful to obtain it,
but if their strength falls short of the task,
even tying their hands and exhausting them,
they still cannot achieve it.
Now, as parents and rulers of the people,
when appointing subjects to positions,
if not using their strengths,
it is directly killing them,
as they cannot manage their duties,
only disrupting the offices pointlessly,
and causing the people distress;
when offices are disordered,
and the people and officials are distressed,
they again look up and cry out to Heaven,
claiming injustice,
stirring Heaven above,
increasing disasters and anomalies.
Thus, the ancient sages and worthies, wishing to attain Heaven's heart,
carefully and gravely made appointments,
all of which won people's hearts,
hence they could match Heaven's heart.
How do they match Heaven's heart?
In practice, they gain response from the people,
officials daily report goodness and faithful loyalty,
this is the proof;
then promote them timely,
for they are those who assist the state in attaining Heaven's heart.
If some only seek pleasure,
coveting fame and office for a day,
their actions bear no fruit,
not matching Heaven's heart, with no response.
The emperor carries Heaven's heart to govern,
must match Heaven's heart,
not matching it is a fault.
Thus, if governance lacks good response,
they should be dismissed to reflect on their faults,
so that Heaven is pleased,
and all under heaven are loyal and faithful,
exerting their full abilities.
Even the remote and hidden hear of it,
and none conceal their talents.
Those submitting urgent writings,
as human life is most precious,
cannot delay a moment.
People may again cry out in injustice,
now increasing anomalies and changes,
swiftly resolve and report it.
Matters that can wait should be until autumn and winter;
why must it be autumn and winter?
Because autumn is when things fully mature,
winter when things are fully stored,
and the celestial qi is settled.
Things mature in mid-autumn, the eighth month,
their fruits and kernels can be distinguished,
so follow the laws of Heaven and Earth,
begin in the eighth month to inspect and distinguish them.
The ninth month
is when the celestial qi reaches its conclusion,
things by the ninth month are about to die,
so in the ninth month, finally read and inspect them,
observing how much good and evil there is.
Ten,
is the end of numbers,
so things by the tenth month return to the beginning.
The celestial calendar takes the eighth month as the tenth,
hence things fully mature;
the terrestrial calendar takes the ninth month as the tenth,
hence things fully age;
the human calendar takes Hài as the tenth month,
hence things fully die.
The three calendars conclude,
and things should regenerate.
Thus, Qián is in the northwest,
all things begin to kernel in Hài,
the celestial law distinguishes them in the eighth month,
concludes in the ninth month,
and kernels solidify in the tenth month,
so the three systems of Heaven, Earth, and Humanity all end,
kernels solidifying in Hài.
Therefore, in the tenth month, kernels solidify,
and are delivered below.
The reason for this is,
these three months—eighth, ninth, and tenth—
the correct periods of Heaven, Earth, and Humanity all conclude,
and should return to the start.
Without solidifying and kernelling,
the intent is not obtained,
Heaven and Earth will be displeased,
disasters will not be removed,
and harm will recur the next year.
So, distinguish and inspect in the eighth month,
conclude in the ninth month,
solidify kernels in the tenth month,
and deliver them below.
Have all officials and people reflect on their faults again,
daring not to repeat them.
The next year, officials and people will be more cautious,
and all things will be wholly good.
If not delivered to make them reflect firmly on faults,
the people and officials below will fail in governance,
unaware of their faults,
their hearts unchanged.
The Way of Heaven is firm,
evil does not change easily,
so they must be delivered to.
If the Zhēnrén wishes to see the proof,
what is delivered this year,
copy one document and set it aside,
also teach officials and people to record one copy and set it aside,
observe how much good and evil,
called the Heaven's contract;
next year's delivery,
set aside another copy,
observe how much good and evil;
the following year's delivery,
set aside another copy,
observe how much good and evil;
compare the lower records with the upper ones set aside,
they should correspond accordingly,
called the Heaven's sign matching the tally.
Have officials and people change their hearts to goodness,
attain Heaven's will,
then what is submitted will be more good,
if greatly changed, it will be greatly good.
If they remain firm,
unchanged and unaltered,
what is submitted will be firmly bad,
and if evil persists unchecked,
what is submitted will worsen,
officials and people greatly deceive and anger Heaven.
What is presented above should be greatly detested as it exacerbates severity,
thus it is Heaven's clear mirror that illuminates the heart.
Not losing a hair's breadth,
it clarifies the governance and conduct of officials and people.
Heaven and Earth are like shadow and echo,
following humanity, they can be engaged with and not escaped.
You, the sincere one, are fortunate to have good intentions,
strive to complete them and be cautious.
Although you have come to ask about this,
if it is without substance and benefitless,
Heaven silently observes within,
your mouth may speak,
but with what can you illuminate it through words?
When people speak of matters,
if the words are detailed and good,
others will respond with goodness,
and the echo will also answer with goodness;
if the words are ominous and inauspicious,
others will respond with evil,
and the echo will also answer with evil.
All things that correspond and harmonize
are entirely arranged by Heaven.
Do you understand now?"
"Yes, yes."
"Heaven is lofty, distant, and dignified,
how could it condescend to speak with people on every matter?
Therefore, its methods all correspond and harmonize naturally.
Is your mind now enlightened?"
"Yes, yes.
I have understood,
and I wish to ask the Celestial Master one more question."
"Proceed with it."
"In the middle antiquity, the emperors had no writings,
and the three did not communicate with each other,
how could they then achieve peace?"
"Excellent,
your question.
The movement of Heaven made the people of that time straightforward and质朴,
they all embraced the Dào,
and their faith was singularly focused;
they only communicated through spoken words,
each person desired utmost sincerity and trust,
thinking to align with the heart of Heaven,
thus there was not a single instance of deception among them.
Therefore, the three—rulers, ministers, and people—
joined forces and were of one mind in communication,
hence they could govern together.
If they were not united in heart as one family,
there would be chaos.
Nowadays, due to inherited burdens,
documents are numerous,
and writings are used to deceive each other,
still indulging in superficial elegance,
wise scholars are all confused,
collectively losing the heart of Heaven.
Since Heaven has given rise to writing,
we cannot revert to mere spoken words.
But we must verify and obtain the truth,
and if the three communicate, the energy of Heaven will be pacified.
The laws of Heaven,
whether by the millions or tens of thousands,
vary from time to time,
governance differs in each case,
and methods are not the same.
Now the Qì of great peace is about to arrive,
we must substantiate the writing, return to the origin, and correct the characters,
then we may attain the will of Heaven.
If you cannot distinguish,
since Heaven and Earth established affairs,
their governance has myriad aspects,
in practicing these affairs,
those that fully receive Heaven's response are correct;
those that do not receive Heaven's response
are incorrect;
this is the great bright covenant and evidence of verification.
Do you understand?"
"Yes, yes."
"Go now,
do not ask again.
It is not that I cannot record everything for you,
since the affairs of Heaven and Earth were established,
explaining every matter and the writings under heaven,
but it would only add to the writings, too numerous to record,
and not useful for talent,
nor beneficial for royal governance.
Therefore, I only impart the essential path in speaking.
When governance is not in order,
it fundamentally stems from the writings of Heaven,
which is the great ailment and hatred of Heaven and Earth,
and what the sages of ancient times collectively detested.
Thus, the Dào emerges for the virtuous ruler,
who dares not produce writings,
but makes all return to uphold substance,
seek its root,
preserve its origin,
then the way of Heaven can be ordered,
and the state will naturally be at peace.
Although you, the sincere one, are fond of asking,
do not let it increase the writings further,
go and ponder it."
"Yes, yes."

The above encapsulates the natural unity of the primordial Qì, Heaven, and Earth, how all things in tripartite union communicate, join forces, and are of one mind, the bright covenant of Heaven, and the harmonious and imperial pacifying method of governance.
"Before the True Man,
now auspicious harmony has arrived in full,
humans should wander without official duties,
how should they clarify their minds and correct their intentions,
constantly making them spontaneously forget to commit wickedness and evil,
and daily prefer to do good,
unknowingly settled.
So that the emperor may rule with folded hands without needing to govern,
the court filled with the most virtuous people,
loyal, trustworthy, and filial children all fully present,
how can this be achieved?"
"The True Man has a natural heart fond of goodness,
constantly anxious about the Way of Heaven,
you should refine yourself,
and elaborate on it in detail."
"Yes,
but one must urgently learn the true Way, true Virtue, and true Benevolence."
"Why must one learn the true Way?"
"Indeed,
the Way can guide and transform without precedent,
loving life beyond measure.
Having the true Way
is the name of the highest goodness;
lacking the Way
is the designation of the most evil, decaying, ominous, and fatal."
"True Man, you speak only of true goodness now,
I have nothing to add.
Why must one learn true Virtue?"
"A person with true Virtue
can nurture the name of the boundless.
One without virtue
is the label of the most inferior, weak, impoverished, and petty individuals."
"Excellent!
The True Man's words,
I again have nothing to add,
truly correct.
Why must one learn the way of Benevolence?"
"Benevolence
enables love and kindness,
encompassing all without exception,
it is the name that delights in giving without limit.
Those who are not benevolent
instead of favoring virtue, oppose its principles and giving,
this is the designation of great greed and baseness,
sharing the same intent as birds and beasts,
with no means to distinguish themselves."
"Excellent!
The True Man's words,
I again have nothing to add.
Now the True Man has spoken of three matters,
I have nothing beyond this.
Should people nowadays learn to be good?
Or not?"
"They should strive to learn to be good."
"As for being good,
is there not a specific name or term for it?"
"I am unaware,
only the Master can enlighten me."
"Well,
being good
means actions align with the heart of Heaven,
not opposing human intentions,
thus named good.
Goodness
is supremely profound and unparalleled,
sharing the same designation as the Way;
loved by Heaven,
nurtured by Earth,
urgently needed by emperors and kings,
and should be united in heart and effort by officials and rulers.
Evil,
on the other hand, acts against the heart of Heaven,
often hurting human feelings;
it prefers to contradict the Way of Heaven,
disobeys the four seasons,
is hated by spirits and deities,
what parents do not wish to see as great harm,
what gentlemen find distressing,
the most withered, ominous, and ruinous name under heaven.
Therefore, in human conduct,
missing good fortune leads to misfortune,
leaving misfortune enters good fortune;
one good, one bad,
one good, one evil,
are those of impure and careless followers,
do you understand this?"
"Yes, yes."
"According to the True Man's opinion,
how should ordinary people conduct themselves?"
"Well,
if people do not strive to learn the Way now,
they become those who do not know the Way,
named people without the Way.
Those without the Way
are the most evil and ominous individuals.
If they do not strive to learn Virtue now,
they become those who do not know Virtue,
and those without virtue who enjoy harming others
are signs of ruin and misfortune.
If people do not strive to learn Benevolence now,
they are already not benevolent;
those who are not benevolent
share the same path as birds and beasts,
having the same heart as animals,
they are little better than dead.
If people do not strive day and night to learn goodness,
losing goodness means falling into evil.
Evil is the place of death and misfortune,
so if ordinary people do not strive to learn good fortune,
they will fall into misfortune,
and misfortune is the name of evil under heaven."
"Excellent!
You have deeply entered the true Way,
no longer returning to evil.
Now, True Man, you long harbored wisdom but acted foolishly,
why is that?"
"I did not dare to proceed."
"You are fortunate to have the ability,
to fully express what you say,
I am very pleased.
Now that you can reach this extent,
have you only seen my words,
and then abandoned them and stopped?"
"I dare not.
Seeing the Master repeatedly command me to speak,
I sometimes fall short in understanding,
and dare not say everything."
"Excellent your words,
always very humble."
"Now I can fully intend towards the true gate,
only the Celestial Master can record and show what I have missed."
"Well,
what you said earlier is all correct.
Therefore, the great sages of antiquity, the Three Sovereigns,
constantly strived day and night to learn the true Way,
seeing those who did not like learning the true Way,
named them people without the Way.
Those without the Way,
their actions are countless,
greatly resented by Heaven.
Those without the Way,
Heaven does not wish to cover them,
Earth does not wish to support them,
spirits, essences, and ghosts do not wish to protect them,
they are suffering for all under heaven.
Sages, worthies, and gentlemen greatly despise those without the Way.
Thus, in the time of the ancient highest sovereign,
everyone learned purity and tranquility,
deeply understood the ultimate nature of Heaven and Earth,
so all learned the true Way,
and only then obtained the heart of Heaven and the intent of Earth.
If one does not strive to learn Virtue,
they are named people without virtue.
Those without virtue,
Heaven does not love,
Earth does not delight in,
people do not wish to be close to them,
their actions often do not accord with virtue;
they bring harm to the king,
cause disasters for gentlemen,
ghosts and spirits, following Heaven's teaching,
will not long assist in governance.
Therefore, the sages, worthies, and great scholars of antiquity,
upon seeing those without virtue,
did not even speak with them;
if one does not strive day and night to learn Benevolence,
they will soon neglect affairs and become not benevolent.
Those who are not benevolent,
their words contradict all matters,
hurt people's hearts,
do not match Heaven's intent,
instead resembling birds and beasts,
hence the sages and worthies of old did not share their path.
If people nowadays do not serve a teacher,
or strive to learn goodness,
they will become foolish and obscure,
not knowing how to be good,
instead indulging their ignorant hearts,
lightly committing evil.
Evil people, the lowly and obscured,
their actions do not follow the Way of Heaven and Earth,
yet they cause gentlemen to encounter troubles,
bring harm to their parents,
distress their clan relatives,
act without law,
ghosts and spirits, following Heaven's heart, are made to dislike them,
causing harm in three severe aspects,
deserving punishment by law.
The sages and worthies of antiquity considered this a great grievance,
so they all thoroughly examined their learning,
ensuring it aligned with the heart of Heaven,
engaging only in matters of the Way, Virtue, Benevolence, and goodness,
their conduct must match the heart of Heaven and Earth,
not using flashy words in affairs.
The reason for this is
that otherwise, they would lose the laws of Heaven,
losing them means entering misfortune and premature death,
or harming later generations.
The Way of Heaven does not err,
it has its standard laws."
Those who do not diligently study the path of great auspiciousness,
but instead engage in affairs with negligence and self-ease,
are bound to fall into misfortune.
Misfortune is what heaven, earth, humanity, and all things detest,
and it cannot long endure.
It is the root of great calamity,
the gateway to disaster.
Those who err and sink into it will perish,
unable to turn back, repent, and return to their former state.
All under heaven know this well,
yet the inferior and greatly foolish
often mock the Way together,
unaware of upholding the Way
and avoiding harm early.
They pass down foolishness generation after generation,
inheriting and bearing one another's burdens.
Later generations grow even more foolish and benighted,
worse than before.
Thus, the true Way is blocked and does not flow,
causing people to act with negligence,
unable to exhaust their heavenly allotted years.
This great fault and error
arises precisely from this.
When the Perfected see my writings,
they should deeply reflect upon them,
take care not to conceal them,
but entrust them to the worthy, gentle, and wise,
to awaken their understanding.
Therefore, the ancient Way embodies the heart of heaven
and conforms to the intent of earth.
With the great true Way and methods of high antiquity,
it constantly teaches them to learn the Way,
learn virtue,
learn longevity,
learn goodness,
learn caution,
learn auspiciousness,
learn antiquity,
learn peace,
learn long life.
The reason for fully presenting goodness is that
heaven, in its methods,
always opens the gate of the Way;
earth, in its methods,
always opens the door of virtue.
The ancient sages and worthies, in their methods,
always opened the path of benevolence.
Thus, the sages and worthies of old
were of one heart with heaven,
united in intent with earth,
jointly nurturing and fostering the twelve thousand beings,
constantly transmitting to them through the meaning of the Way, virtue, and benevolence,
so that all things could flourish;
but if transmitted with malicious intent,
all things would daily decline and diminish.
Therefore, where there is the Way, virtue, and benevolence,
the people daily increase and incline toward goodness;
where there is no Way, virtue, or benevolence,
the people daily decline and diminish,
and their governance grows increasingly impoverished and bitter.
This is the fixed law of heaven and earth.
Those who possess the heart of the ultimate Way, bright virtue, and benevolent goodness
align above with the stars and celestial cycles,
and the spirits illuminate their conduct.
Thus, the sages and worthies of old constantly thought of doing good without limit,
exhausting their strength so as not to dare entertain evil thoughts or tread the path of misfortune.
As for the inferior and foolish,
their hearts are often闭塞,
truly ignorant,
and must not again be misled onto the evil path of decline and misfortune,
unaware that they greatly lose the Way of heaven,
following one another in evil as if it were normal,
unable to retreat from their customs.
Therefore, I above respectfully receive the heavenly texts and edicts,
complying with the heart of heaven to open and reveal them,
widely opening the path to the great peace of high antiquity,
causing those who delight in doing good
to no longer know the methods of evil.
The aspirations of people under heaven are often high,
yet their achievements are unexpectedly low,
failing to match their original intentions.
Thus, the superior individuals, detesting death and delighting in life,
go to learn the ways of immortality,
and through diligence can attain longevity.
These superior individuals are the ones with the highest aspirations.
The middling individuals have aspirations,
grieve over their ancestors' premature deaths,
and resolutely seek the Way to learn longevity,
diligently striving to complete their heavenly years.
These are the ones with firm determination.
Next are those with many illnesses who cannot attain constant peace,

Thus, healing with one loss in ten

two losses in ten

Yīn and yáng become disordered and reversed,

Therefore, ancient sage kings and emperors,

My text's phrases上下相集廁 to form writing,

The common people's children's songs and poems throughout ages,

divine texts occasionally emerging

The heavenly dao hates killing and favors life,

Therefore, all things flourishing,

roots in earth,
usage bringing peace depends on humans;

All things maintain constant relation with heaven and earth,

Wanting to understand all dao documents and classic meanings,

Recording all matters' ultimate meanings,

above connecting below linking,

Therefore, sages wanting to obtain heavenly dao's mind and will,
to harmonize and stabilize yīn and yáng,

individual words,

For all matters that one wishes to rectify,

Yīn and yáng do not interchange,

This leads the way of heaven to lose its correctness,

emperors and kings distressed in heart,

transformed energies continuously emerging,
the people not living long lives,

Moreover, as the sages have long passed,

The reason for this is that
the classical ways and all written records,

The beginning of all affairs

Just as when the day takes its course,

when petty men flee,

Carefully ponder these words,

If one thinks my writings incorrect,

chaos without end,

Hence, the sage king should emphasize the root,

Not honoring and respecting the root,

refine and illuminate it,

Heaven and earth have constant laws,

Far and near all share the same signs, energies and categories correspond,

This is called the record of celestial patterns,
named the celestial writings.
Hundreds of millions, tens of thousands, thousands, hundreds, tens,

the sixty-year cycle of jiǎzǐ is one,

Some coincide in billions of cycles,

Meticulously examine and combine these,

to know the present,

This is how to know heaven's constant operations,

If the written words are erroneous or not

Grasp their intent,
order their affairs,
to harmonize yīn and yáng,

Just like spring, autumn, winter, and summer,

Now the later generations all have short lifespans,

Is the ancient constant spiritual way lost?
Thus, they lose the correct path,

Just like a child born in spring who dies,

born in summer and ending,

Therefore, events do not appear emptily,

Thus, the works of ancient poets

Therefore, the sages, worthies, emperors, and kings of old,

Opposing it leads to floods, droughts, and energies clashing,

The many worthies are confused,

Later generations' energy flow prolonged,

When encountering its peace,

The way of heaven has constant cycles,

Those who can use it exert their own strength,

heaven's secret texts,

Moxibustion and acupuncture,
are means to regulate and pacify the three hundred sixty vessels,
to circulate the qì of yīn and yáng and eliminate harm.
The three hundred sixty vessels,

circulating outward over the body,
converging at the head's crown,

Their decline and prosperity move in response to the four seasons,
when ill, they do not correspond, the rhythm
of their coming and going becomes abnormal,

Moxibustion,
is the essence of the great yáng,
the light of impartial justice,

Acupuncture,
is the essence of the lesser yīn,
the radiance of the great white,

Treating a hundred and curing a hundred,
treating ten and curing ten,

people vary in size,

Dào texts accumulated through ages,

Thus, those who grasp the rhythm,
use it to nurture nature,

to divine six directions' fortune,

timely leaking to earth,

To know it in detail,
record past settled matters,
to test future events,

Know that our text,

The fundamental and weighty matter's
effect,
is the dwelling of the living,

Thus, whether great or small,

Set five sets of five, twenty-five mounds as the root text,
examine accomplished matters to verify it,

The true teacher should carefully ponder the text from beginning to end,
to dispel confusion and delusion,

to know the ancestors,
benefit later descendants,
pass it down for ten thousand generations,
take care not to conceal it.
All music,

transforming and moving the qì of the six directions and eight extremes;

Sounds each have their affiliations,
east, west, south, north,
jiǎ, yǐ, bǐng, dīng,

Sometimes sounds gather,
harmonizing to form patterns and words,

Listen to sounds to know subtle words,
predict good and bad fortune,
when the raised sound corresponds with the blown hair-pitch pipe,
then we know the sound of strings,
gōng, shāng, jué, zhǐ, yǔ,
distinguishing the six directions far and near,
how to name and identify good and evil?
The refined,
can see its spirit come to respond to matters.
Thus, the sages of old tuned music,
to influence all things,
harmonize yīn and yáng,
stabilize the four seasons and five phases.
When yīn and yáng are in harmony, the sound is easy to listen to;
when yīn and yáng are not harmonious,
contrary and disordered,

The strings should be tuned,
appropriately by nines,
ordering the silk strings,

If not tuned, the dance becomes chaotic,
without correct sound,
unlistenable,
harming the visceral spirit.
Thus, divine auspices and strange phenomena do not come.
Therefore, only when the right person is found,
one skilled in sounds,
can they harmonize yīn and yáng transformations.
How do we know this?
Because the spirits come in response,
auspicious phenomena gather,

if not,
all is chaotic sound,
unable to move and influence,
thus they do not come.
Therefore, in all matters,
if the right person is found, it is as if divine;
if not, it is like wild talk;
with the right person,
no matter the difficulty,
all can be done;
without the right person,
no matter the size,
nothing can be accomplished.
Thus, the ancient sages valued actions
seeking the worthy, without obscurity,
to achieve antiquity.
With the right person, there is order;
without, there is chaos.
Ancient texts are numerous,
too many to record fully.
Use one matter to analogize ten,
ten to analogize a hundred,
a hundred to analogize a thousand,
a thousand to analogize ten thousand,
ten thousand to analogize a hundred million,
a hundred million to analogize the limitless;
each matter has its own category and affiliation,
all place the root text of the matter in front,
let those who understand grasp the root,
let those skilled in use explain it,
observe what corresponds and harmonizes, what matches
is all correct,
what neither corresponds nor matches,
is entirely wrong.
To know whether the ancient sages' texts and ways are truly so,
this is like calling a person,
those who get the name and surname all respond.
So it is with ghosts and spirits,
without the name and surname, no response,

thus no response.
Therefore, in ancient times, learning was called pursuing refinement,
refinement means
to concentrate on the image of the matter, appropriately
reconsider the words;
deeply ponder this text and strategy,
and all matters will be complete.
The volumes of text, from beginning to end, are numerous,
each with its matters,
should be read in detail,
further complementing each other,
all grasping the meaning,
already fully prepared;
if the essential meaning is not deeply grasped,
speaking of the way without effective results,
thus when changes appear, one cannot resolve the battles of yīn and yáng.
Our text is born for the benevolent and worthy,
to be given to the virtuous,
the virtuous obtain it,
considering it a precious treasure;
obtaining it but not reading it well,
saying it is not the way,
thus cannot delight their person,
nor remove calamities and faults.
When the great way is about to appear,
is it like having no flavor?

All the worthy seek its origin,
can it harmonize firm and soft,
exhaust the positions of yīn and yáng?
When all texts are fully settled,
each in its place,
no longer confused?
All evils are gone,
the supreme deity greatly pleased,
the people without hauntings?
Favor reaches even the small and humble,
all things bustling,
not losing their qì?
Returning to the great beginning,
heaven and earth in their positions?
Evil texts already vanished,
guarding the primordial qì?
The one,
is the guiding principle of the way;
the two,
is the way's horizontal movement;
the three is already chaotic,
cannot be clarified.
My Way is the cycle of jiǎzǐ and yǐchǒu,
The six jiǎ cyclically succeed one another.
The five phases revolve in mutual succession,
The four seasons cycle and begin anew.
Though texts and scrolls are numerous,
Each has its own record to uphold.
Like a human body as one whole,
Head and feet function in mutual service.
One character yields as another arises,
The wise order them to complement each other.
Combine yīn and yáng in speech,
Inner and outer correspond like compass and square.
At first recitation seems flavorless, but with time,
Pondering it brings verification to the utmost.
Disasters leave the body, spirits gather anew,
People become prudent and good, free of wickedness,
Named as a state without punishments,
The transformation by the Way reaches perfection.
Follow my text to avert calamity,
Deceit and misfortune cease, people live long,
Originating from the root, without end or beginning.
Ten out of ten correspond—
This is the text of Tàiyáng;
Nine out of ten correspond—
This is the text of Tàiyīn;
Eight out of ten correspond—
This is the text of Zhōnghé;
Seven out of ten correspond—
This is the text of disruption and chaos;
Six out of ten correspond—
This is the text of mediocrity;
Five out of ten correspond—
This is the text of ignorance,
It can be said to be half auspicious, half inauspicious;
Four out of ten correspond—
This is a wicked text;
Three out of ten correspond—
This is the text of great chaos;
Two out of ten correspond—
This is a discarded text;
One out of ten corresponds—
This is an alternating, middling text;
Zero out of ten correspond—
Below this, it is unusable,
A text that misleads people.
According to the harm inflicted,
It returns to harm the user,
If used persistently without cease,
The method ends, descendants perish,
This is the ten-out-of-ten text.
Above is the method to reject evil and attain correctness.
Chún kowtowed trembling and bowed repeatedly.

"If you wish to joyfully obtain their substance,

the Daoist texts of middle antiquity,
the Daoist texts of later antiquity,

"Well, those who can rectify their speech

desiring to joyfully understand -
to achieve goodness, simply rectify the root.

harmonizing with sagely words.

the third transformation constitutes human culture,

all things then generate superficial embellishment,

to examine the fundamental correctness of beginnings,

to clarify principles in all writings
is the Way of Heaven.
Those who obtain proper speech
harmonize with the heart-mind of Heaven.
Wickedness leads to evil qi,
causing Heaven and Earth to lose harmony,
and all things to largely lose their proper places.
Rulers exert their hearts in distress,
again obtaining chaos.
Therefore, we must urgently examine and rectify this.

all documents are already fully prepared,
yet all worry that their collected residence is impure,
collected and混杂相乱,

and thus each following their own contradictions as right.
This causes them to greatly distance from the subtle meanings pointed to by the Heavenly Way,
all becoming wicked speech and wicked writings.
Writing such wickedness
results in failure to properly balance yin and yang,
with calamitous qi arising repeatedly,
the internal fault lying herein.
I see your questioning,
and accumulated concern makes me unable to bear,
therefore I repeatedly elaborate the meaning for you.
Quickly transcribe my words,
and deeply reflect upon them yourself.
In all matters,
obtaining without dedicated practice
is also useless;
if you can practice them,
you will remove great reprimands."
"When celestial patterns are disordered,

"Well, you seem foolish yourself,

Severe illness not treated timely

The four seasons lose their qi,

the three luminaries lack proper brightness,

People become clouded and chaotic,

the old and weak carrying burdens,

Is this not a most severe illness?
Therefore, we must strenuously rectify it.
Nowadays, foolish people daily learn to wander in superficial writings,
alternately contradicting each other,
to surpass one another,

The reason the world cannot mutually govern and rectify

The spirits and deities have sufferings,

When you see the texts, you should day and night,

Now the emperor has nothing to devote his heart to,

Although I now speak with you, just two people conversing,

I dare not recklessly speak empty falsehoods;

The reprimands from spirits and deities

"Yes, yes,

to pacify the emperor,

"Why does your wish alone tend solely towards goodness,

Thus, while others all age and die,

Truly I have received a thick destiny,

I constantly think of exhausting my strength fully,

Seeing Heaven and Earth not harmonized,
wind and rain not regulated,

"Now obtaining the divine person's words,

I think to exhaust death to devote myself to the bright Heaven,
to resolve the great illness,
and pacify the terrestrial order,

Now I don't know whether I can or not?
I wish to ask again,

"Excellent
are your words.
Now hearing your words,

My writings
are ten thousand without missing one.
You just strive without slackening and order them;

no longer doubt it.
If the emperor practices this,

I repeatedly see your words,

Proper texts
actually root in Heaven-Earth's heart,

In ancient times, sagely books emerged periodically,

the Way transforming through mutual causation,
subtle words explained,

The second transformation...

Three transformations form the chapters and sentences;

Five transformations,
differentiate divergent meanings,

Six transformations,
result in deceptive writings.
Chapters and sentences,
still value the fundamental principles in small measures,

This causes the Way of Heaven to lose its path,

You, fortunate one, wish to repay Heaven's grace,

Heaven,
does not delight in people offering it wealth and deceitful objects,

Now I observe your initial approach to learning,

If my words are not correct,

If you delight in rectifying heaven and earth,

Gather and examine the texts of the ancient, middle, and recent ages,
summoning them by category,

the original affairs and true essence of the words,

This can be said to resolve Heaven's worries,
the grave malady is removed,

This,
is ten thousand without missing one.
I see your words,

to deceive you now,

Causing Heaven to be displeased,

named as a burden upon myself,
and above, shaming the August Heaven,

the fault is great indeed,
strive to remember it,

"Yes, yes,

"I, a childish ignoramus,

"Try to speak,

"Now in my foolish opinion,

"Each should work according to their person,

Do not block my writings! "
"Yes, yes,

"Excellent,
your words.

"Yes, yes.

The divine being speaks,

The True Man Chún kowtowed trembling and said,

"Why do you ask this?

"Since my youth,

"There are four methods of governance:

human governance,

"In celestial governance,

serves them as teachers;

why then serve them as fathers and teachers?
It is because their position may be lowly,

Serving them as fathers and teachers

so as to join strategies with them and pacify the world.
In terrestrial governance,

for Earth is yielding and yin,

Though the minister's position is lowly,

In human governance, one belittles their usefulness;
ministers are young and small,
like a father begetting a son,
the son too young to strategize for the father,

In the governance of crawling creatures and all things,
the ruler views ministers and sons as dogs,
as grass and trees,

Why is that?
Resembling humans
means only imitating the human form,
just adequate internally,

hence they are good at contention.
Imitating celestial governance,
all ministers under Heaven
are the ruler's fathers and teachers,
thus he serves them as fathers.
When people love their children,
how can there be danger?
For fathers and teachers can all resolve calamities from the eight directions for their children,
how could there be failure?
Imitating terrestrial governance,
all ministers under Heaven
are the ruler's friends.
Sharing the same will and joining strategies forms a bond,
sharing worries and hardships,
desiring together to secure their positions;
for Earth
is yielding and supports what is above,
fully receiving Heaven's will and intent,
all attaining Heaven's heart—
how could there be insecurity?
Imitating human governance,
one attains the harmonious central ether,
but harmony can advance or retreat, hard to know;
it resembles a young son
unable to plan for the father,
thus deceiving the father.
Young ministers
cannot deeply strategize for the ruler,
thus deceiving the ruler.
The young,
having lived few days and months,
with shallow learning,
have nothing to fear,
hence they deceive,
and such governance is slightly chaotic.
Imitating the governance of crawling creatures and all things,
crawling creatures lack ritual and righteousness,
all things have little knowledge,
without Dao and virtue.
The nature of crawling creatures and all things
knows no high or low,
only seeking victory,
thus causing chaos and ruin.
Imitating celestial governance
means benevolence, loving life without harm.
Imitating terrestrial governance
means yielding and good, causing minor harm.
Imitating human governance
means mutual profit and many desires,
frequent mutual harm and injury,
mutual deception and negligence.
Imitating the governance of crawling creatures and all things
ultimately achieves no success,
with no regard for great or small,
only seeking victory.
Observing these modes of governance,
one can fully know whether the celestial ethers' high, low, and central extremes have lost proper order.
Those who desire the first joy should imitate Heaven;
those who desire the second joy should imitate Earth;
those who desire the third joy should imitate humans;
those who desire the fourth joy should imitate all things.
Imitating Heaven brings solitary longevity and old age,
attaining Heaven's heart;
imitating Earth brings minor lack of longevity,
attaining Earth's intent;
imitating humans reduces longevity;
imitating all things brings death,
untimely and countless.
Imitating Heaven
means three paths communicate with writings;
Heaven has three patterns,
brightness as three lights,
namely the sun, moon, and arrayed stars;
the sun observes the yang,
the moon observes the yin,
the stars observe the center.
Thus, when the three paths deliver writings,

When writings arrive as communications,
there is only the host's name;
do not ask who the communicator is.
Imitating Earth
means two paths deliver writings.
Imitating humans
means one path delivers writings,
still seeing careless retention.
Imitating crawling creatures and all things
means barely setting words,
with no writings thereafter.
Now, in this case,
is it Heaven that causes it to be so,

It is the fortune of the times.
Even so,
when imperial governance is about to achieve Great Peace,

when about to achieve medium peace,

when about to have minor chaos,

when about to have great chaos and disorder,

Why is this so?
How should it be remedied now?
Well, when Heaven is about to prosper it,
auspicious responses and patterned writings emerge, bestowed upon them,
causing great awakening and instruction;
when about to decline,
Heaven hides the writings, not revealing them,

As for worthy ministers,

No;
the old ones,
This refers to the elders who are well-versed in the Way and its Virtue.
