All would resort to deception,

All things under Heaven are in great chaos, countless in disorder.

Heaven and Earth

residing among them,

"Yes, yes,

I dare not be negligent."
The above distinguishes the methods for governing according to the patterns of safety and danger.
"The questions I have accumulated are many,

"Now I wish to understand the hearts and minds of Heaven and Earth, yīn and yáng, the people, crawling creatures, and all things in their affairs,

the people worried, suffering, trapped in poverty.
Then they look up and cry out to the August Heaven,
truly wronged, truly wronged,
their qi stirring and moving the six directions.
Hence, disasters and anomalies arise in multitude,
accumulating not just one,
cannot be swiftly eliminated,
the harm is extreme,
and this is losing the hearts and minds of all under Heaven.
Ultimately, it results in no success,
strange changes unceasing,
the qi of Great Peace,
how could it come about?
Thus, Great Peace cannot be achieved,
the fault lies precisely here."
"Even if one wishes to call it constant peace,
how can internal chaos be cleared for its governance?"
"Your question now,
seeks to deeply understand its truth!
The nature of Heaven and Earth,
is that all things each have what suits them.
One should employ their strengths,
what they can do,
and what they cannot do,
should not be forced;
though all things receive the qi of yīn and yáng,
just as fish cannot be without water,
swimming atop high mountains,
and when there is water,
regardless of high or low,
all can swim there;
great trees cannot be without earth,
born in the midst of rivers and seas.
Therefore, when the sages and enlightened kings of old assigned tasks,
they took from the five soils what each was suited for,
so that things could be good and excellent,
and each flourish luxuriantly,
the state thereby becoming wealthy,
enabling the ancestral temple to have varied flavors in its meals,
all under Heaven peaceful and tranquil,
without suffering or pain,
evil qi ceasing,
not acting to cause harm.
If one does not divine or assess the land before planting,
then all things cannot complete their natural lifespan,
all harboring unresolved grievances;
thus dying prematurely,
alone moving the August Heaven above,
with nothing to harvest from the myriad things,
the state then becomes extremely poor,
meals without varied flavors,
the ancestral temple hungry and thirsty,
causing all under Heaven to worry and suffer,
people harming each other in turn,
ruler and minister deceiving one another,
inside and outside using different words,
the fault precisely begins here.
This is merely about things not finding their place,
how much more so for people?
All under Heaven cannot govern and correct each other,
precisely because of this.
This,
is the root of great harm,
and the path to danger and ruin,
can it not be cautious?
Can one not deeply ponder it in heart and mind?
Thus in ancient times,
when great sages and worthies were to employ people,
they first tested their strengths,
and what they were weak in,
and then assigned their duties,
thus employing them.
If the person had faults,
they were blamed accordingly,
questioned about their strengths,
not faulted for their weaknesses.
This does not offend Heaven,
but instead practices and advances this family's learning,
thus being cautious,
hence able to win the hearts of all under Heaven.
Now later generations neglect affairs,
not deeply pondering the words of ancient sages,
instead assigning improper duties,
blaming what cannot be achieved,
asking about what cannot be seen,
the blind not seeing the sun,
the mute unable to speak,
yet each is pushed to their weaknesses,
considered grave faults,
thus punished for them,
not seeking mutual benefit and joy,
but instead skillfully deceiving superiors and subordinates,
successively harming each other,
this is the great ruin of all under Heaven.
Since ancient times, the lords of peace under the feudal lords,
had no strange divine ways,
all followed by employing what the heart and ability could reach,
hence able to bring about the qi of Great Peace,
without people harboring grievances.
When calamity and chaos are about to arise,
it is all due to employing what they cannot do,
making them do tasks not their duty and heavily blaming them,
even if punished to death,
they still cannot manage their duties.
Disasters and anomalies arise in succession,
cannot be stopped,
thus leading to chaos and ruin,
fortune, misfortune, safety, danger,
precisely begin here.
Therefore, when selecting scholars for the emperor in ancient times,
they first inquired and observed,
tested their abilities,
whether they corresponded and harmonized with the auspicious responses of Heaven, Earth, yīn, and yáng?
Those who could not correspond and harmonize,
all had false conduct.
How do they correspond and harmonize?
Great men get great responses,
small men get small responses.
Winds and rains come in their proper seasons,
all things flourish beautifully,
the common people are without complaints,
birds, beasts, and crawling creatures,
are tranquil and quiet,
this is the evidence.
Thus, those who govern and wish to pacify the state,
must carefully consider their appointments.
For Heaven gives birth to all things,
each has its material and ability,
and indeed each has what suits it,
just as the dragon ascends to the sky,
the fish swims in the deep,
this is what it means.
As for governance,
since established by Heaven and Earth,
it has myriad aspects,
Heaven's changes also vary with the times,
the key is to follow Heaven and Earth, grasp their intent,
and achieve what they desire to do.
Heaven,
uses the three lights as written records,
thus one rise and one decline,
with the wind as the ruler of people.
Earth,
uses mountains, rivers, and paths as patterns,
mountains emit qi,
waters connect the channels,
decline, prosperity, movement, shift, collapse, and union,
with differing winds as the ministers.
People,
pass on through spoken language,
written records and texts shift and change.
All things,
speak through decline and prosperity,
making people think and know.
People,
are at the center of yīn and yáng,
the teachers and elders of all things,
capable of the most numerous actions.
Resembling spirits yet having form,
changing and moving forward and backward,
should mainly record these anomalies,
speaking as their masters.
Thus, if one word does not connect,
then there will be grievances and entanglements;
if words do not flow in two aspects,
there will be blockages;
if words do not flow in three aspects,
there will be isolation;
if words do not flow in four aspects,
harmony will not respond in due time,
and its living things will be unstable;
if words do not flow in five aspects,
the flow of energy will be contentious;
if words do not flow in six aspects,
evil will arise in all six directions;
if words do not flow in seven aspects, there will be ruin and failure;
if words do not flow in eight aspects, it will be difficult to manage multiple households;
if words do not flow in nine aspects,
there will be mutual harm and injury;
if words do not flow in ten aspects,
there will be constant upheavals.
Therefore, one must strive to make words flow.
In ancient times, there was no writing,
so how was communication achieved?
Writing was meant to arise,
but it halted midway;
how did Heaven and Earth begin,
and how will they end?
But later generations do not see this.
In the middle antiquity, the Three Sovereigns,
established speech without writing.
In later antiquity, the energy of Heaven and Earth revived,
ceasing and rising again,
yet only the divine beings do not know from where old age comes,
having experienced many events,
they understand its principles,
and within, there should be writing,
but later generations truly do not see it,
claiming it does not exist.
Why is it that sometimes there is writing and sometimes not?
The energy of Heaven is deteriorating,
people are becoming foolish, shallow, and short-lived,
unable to make lasting records.
Thus, they were commanded to use written script,
so it could be passed on through the ages,
to know that in ancient times without writing,
people would argue and dispute,
unable to correct each other,
each claiming to be right,
hence writing was established.
This is only because people of the time were foolish,
so writing was created for them,
and Heaven issued its documented decrees."
"Having heard the master's words,
I already understand.
I wish to know how to facilitate the flow of energy now?"
"Simply allow the three paths to circulate the writings of the eight directions,
the words of common people and officials alike,
without arbitrary suppression.
Urgent matters should be resolved in a timely manner,
non-urgent ones should follow the course of Heaven, Earth, and all things,
awaiting the completion of things by the seventh month,
inspected in the eighth month,
rearranged in the ninth month,
and if not settled by the tenth month,
after three years of submitting writings with complete sincerity,
seek out such individuals and appoint them.
These people are the capable ministers of the state,
intelligent with sharp senses,
using their sight and hearing,
they do not miss the signs from all directions.
If an emperor obtains them,
it brings peace and clarity,
so they should be appointed."
"How should they be appointed?"
"Each must be asked about their abilities and limits,
have them record in detail what they can do,
what they can resolve,
what they excel at,
and appoint them according to their innate nature,
so that governance is without error.
Thus, winning the joy of all under Heaven,
their rule will daily flourish in peace,
without punishments,
without scarcity,
and no wronged people.
Heaven, Earth, and the central harmony
will be fully interconnected.
Therefore, one can achieve the longevity of the highest sovereigns,
the reason for their long life
is the absence of punishment and harm,
for much harm eventually returns to injure the person.
Thus, the sages of high antiquity did not favor punishments,
in middle antiquity, punishments were half-used,
so longevity was halved,
in later antiquity, punishments were多用,
hence longevity alone decreased.
Punishments involve evils that offend Heaven,
disrupt yīn and yáng,
accumulate as malignant energy,
which then harms people.
The reason ancient sages did not heavily rely on them
was to cherish their own being;
people of middle antiquity were half-foolish,
lightly using punishments, thus halved,
harming half;
in later antiquity, greatly foolish,
they recklessly used punishments,
considering it normal practice,
so most did not attain longevity,
the fault lies here.
Those who read this book
should reflect on it repeatedly,
value it and be cautious,
for life and death are grave matters,
not to be treated lightly.
A wise son plans deeply for his father,
a wise minister plans deeply for his ruler;
if a son is not wise,
he will not plan deeply for his father;
if a minister is not wise,
he will not plan for his ruler.
As for the youth,
is it their own person,
if they encounter fortune or misfortune,
it flows to later generations,
this is the standard rule.
Therefore, when the sage emperors of high antiquity appointed ministers,
they carefully selected those with virtue and principle,
who did not delight in killing or harming,
not just for the people's sake,
but for their own deep planning.
Thus, they aligned with the will of Heaven and Earth,
their actions as if accompanied by spirits,
this is called selecting the right person wisely,
and being a ruler who gains people's strength.
In this way, they moved the deities,
and later the true spirits of Heaven loved them,
hence they alone achieved longevity.
Fondness for punishments aligns with yīn energy,
yīn represents killing,
so one cannot achieve great longevity;
the mandate of Heaven,
can be somewhat seen and known,
for what Heaven, Earth, and people detest is the same."
The above on gaining the joy of Heaven, Earth, the people, and all things, leading to a prosperous state, peaceful homes, and a world without disputes.
"Can the great mandate be known now or not?"
"Although it can be known,
hearing the enlightened master's words,
great confusion has been resolved,
yet I have no choice but
to wish for repeated reminders."
"Indeed,
the meaning of my way can be perceived,
obtaining the book and reading it,
one often worries about not mastering it,
for mastery brings full understanding.
If one does not ponder its deepest meaning,
nor read it meticulously,
even with my book,
it is of no benefit;
obtaining it without diligent practice,
how is it different from not having it?
Seeing food but not eating,
how is it different from having no grains?
Seeing drink but not drinking,
thirst cannot be relieved,
this does not trouble others,
but harms oneself—
can one not be careful?
Therefore, sages exert their thoughts,
noble persons exert their learning,
ceaseless day and night,
striving to emulate Heaven,
which turns without stopping,
as all streams flow and gather,
forming rivers and seas.
Be cautious and remember my words,
I have repeatedly admonished,
may you be earnest,
your heart can be seen.
Share goodness with all the worthy,
be careful not to monopolize the market.
For a market with few people cannot meet demands.
Thus, if one does not study broadly,
what one sees will not be clear.
Therefore, even if shown the true way,
without grasping its essence,
one will not believe in the way,
doubts will not be firm,
this is how people bring themselves to a dead end.
So, one must deeply ponder its meaning,
to enable self-rescue and assistance."
The above in response to the pointer on longevity.
Heaven bestows affairs,
each with its own laws.
Destiny has what can be entrusted,
the Way has what can be accomplished,
emerging either earlier or later,
its gradual signs appear in advance.
It is like all things beginning to sprout at zǐ,
growing at mǎo,
branching out at wǔ,
maturing at yǒu,
ending at hài.
Although events are foreseen,
they cannot be guaranteed.
Each affair has what can be done,
when the light and shadows appear first,
the matter has not yet arrived,
but the path is opened in advance.
Heaven's display of omens
always comes beforehand,
never following after.
When the right person is found, it opens and flows;
those who receive protection and assistance are such;
if it does not open or flow,
acting without success,
then it is not the right person.
Take this as clear proof,
the Way is examined and spoken,
not one in ten thousand will be lost.
Only for the right person,
it clearly opens;
for the wrong person, it closes.
If the right person is truly found,
then diseases can be eliminated,
disasters and anomalies will vanish on their own,
barbarians will submit voluntarily,
no need for weapons or armor,
all will disappear naturally.
The birth of all things,
each has what can be arranged;
with the right person, it proceeds on its own;
with the wrong person, it hides itself.
In all affairs, if the right person is not found,
they cannot be forced;
what is not theirs,
cannot be taken by force;
land that is not theirs,
cannot be forcibly planted,
for it will not grow.
This means the seed is not good,
internally not in its proper place,
how can it last long?
The six extremes and eight directions,
each has what suits it,
all things are visible,
each affair is different.
Like metal's movement in the west,
wood's movement in the east,
each in its place thrives,
out of place, it perishes.
Thus, all things attach to the earth to live,
cannot attach to heaven;
the sun, moon, stars, and calendar instead attach to heaven,
to generate light.
The Way is like this,
so with the right person, stars are in heaven,
sometimes bright,
falling to earth, they lose light,
meaning they are not in their place.
Hence, disrupting the constant Way.
What can be done emerges without reckless action,
with the right person, it is clear;
with the wrong person, it cannot be done.
The Way is profound and immeasurable,
those who lose it fail,
those who gain it prosper.
If you wish to know your own rise and fall,
observe how the Way can manifest,
how spirits can be aroused.
Internally, there are signs of longevity to await,
with this, not one in ten thousand is lost.
This is a divine text,
the time to restore years,
its Way is most weighty,
how can one not ponder it?
Thus, it is passed to the benevolent, worthy, and wise,
tried and let them act to determine their own fate.
For the right person, all should emerge together,
sages and wise ones come together,
divine texts arrive together,
miraculous methods appear on their own,
all causing joy,
that is the right person.
Take this as evidence,
if not as said,
or only foreseen,
it cannot be enacted,
should be left for later generations,
the Way does not emerge recklessly.
Truly, there are those who can,
just ask the person,
let them think for themselves.
The Way can be returned to,
cannot be prohibited,
nor can it be commanded,
let those who can proceed,
observe their success,
the Way cannot be empty.
Even so,
talent is not as good as effort,
effort is not as good as persistent action.
All affairs under heaven,
are tested by failure,
heaven, earth, and spirits all test people,
so people also imitate the Way of heaven to test each other.
Those who see good,
their fate is already good;
those who see evil,
their fate is already doubtful.
From ancient times to now,
without utmost sincerity moving heaven,
it is called forced seeking;
some may still obtain it;
if forced seeking fails,
it truly is not theirs,
how can it be taken by force?
The matter thus becomes discordant and flawed,
contradictory and chaotic.
Human destiny has three grades,
returning the Way to the wilds,
entrusting it to those who can use it.
Those who cannot use it,
entrust it to the capital,
cast it in the city,
be careful not to close or cut it off.
Later generations without heirs,
pass the text to sages, worthies, and Daoists,
without owner or name,
entrust it to those who can use it.
The Way naturally has those who can,
not everyone can attach words to it.
Like a great tree returning to the mountain,
water flowing to the sea,
it cannot be stopped,
nature makes it so.
Those who follow it prosper,
those who oppose it fail and perish.
When a divine text wishes to emerge,
it also cannot be closed or hidden.
With the right person, it will surely spread;
with the wrong person, deaf, mute, and blind,
the body is displeased,
the eyes have no light.
Delight in studying this text thoroughly.
The time for extending life and heaven's prosperity,
the numbers are all herein.
The breath of great peace,
has all appeared;
people's compassion, love, caution, and goodness,
have all emerged;
sages and the wise,
are all pleased;
unusual methods and strange writings,
have all been entrusted;
strive to act without slack,
to assist yourself;
enlightened kings and sage rulers,
all prosper thereby;
barbarians retreat and submit,
all depart thereby.
The myriad people are most fortunate,
all without words,
heavenly longevity has been enacted,
no longer self-accusing,
the old depart by fate,
the young thus remain whole.
The text is passed down for ten thousand generations unbroken,
descendants hand it down.
Daily they teach each other,
called the true text,
ten thousand generations unchanged,
making people auspicious.
The Way is fully accomplished,
then becomes natural,
emolument comes on its own,
none dare refuse.
Great men obtain it to pacify the state,
middling scholars obtain it to be good ministers,
petty men obtain it to save themselves.
The above is the text on the meaning of the Way, right and wrong.
Respond to the heavenly principles so that above and below harmonize, celestial disasters are eliminated, and treacherous falsehoods are cut off, severing the texts of prognostication.
The people of high antiquity,
all had open hearts, clear eyes, and penetrating ears,
foreseeing events before they occurred,
deeply contemplating what was yet to come,
moving even the unfeeling with their sincerity,
standing out distinctly on their own,
with no undertaking left unaccomplished.
Whatever they spoke or expressed,
all was profoundly understood,
never losing the heart of imperial emptiness,
yearning for the wisdom of the limitless,
the words of the boundless.
Knowing the advance, retreat, length, and shortness of human lifespans,
each had its own division,
always aligning with yīn and yáng,
attaining the ebb and flow,
taking the essence from above, below, and the middle,
and making covenants with the multitude of spirits.
However, each must not violate the great taboos of heaven and earth,
what is upheld and obtained,
must align with the will of heaven,
documents mutually clarifying,
ascending to the celestial sovereign,
who, upon receiving the documents,
sees their clear self-restraint.
Only then are edicts issued,
ensuring no self-reproach,
uprightness naturally advancing,
without declaration, it becomes known,
voices penetrating thoroughly,
the laws of above and below,
each not missing their appointed times.
Fearing any inadequacy,
there has never been a time without self-accountability,
constantly wary of faults being overseen and recorded.
The spirits mutually report without ever slacking,
faults lead to demotion or dismissal.
Hence, repeated admonitions,
and reiterated texts,
should not contravene what is spoken.
This is what heaven ought to uphold,
what the deities revere,
all according to the law,
ever daring not to cease.
Fearing any failure to comprehend,
the responsibilities are not singular,
all should open their hearts and minds,
wary of missing deadlines.
Deities have ranks of high and low,
superiors and inferiors serving each other,
if not as spoken,
immediately noted with estrangement.
Anxious hearts full of sorrow,
always like hunger and thirst desiring food.
The celestial sovereign speaks,
knowing then issues teachings,
enabling mutual governance,
documents are not uniform,
but must grasp the intent,
thereafter each has its trust.
The people of high antiquity,
losing and gaining in matters to come,
inside and out, above and below,
observing the four directions,
beyond the four dimensions,
saw their guiding principles,
years and months pushing forward,
divine powers renewing beginnings,
when is there an end?
The degrees of stellar numbers,
each have their principles,
never having shifted,
events multiply accordingly,
without further doubt.
All know the origins of fortune and misfortune,
hence establishing calendars and records.
Three hundred sixty days,
calculated by greater and lesser,
held without filling the fractional parts,
that is a minor month.
Spring, summer, autumn, winter,
each have their divided principles,
the water clock's upper and lower,
water has slow and fast,
distinguishing the new and old by thirds,
each made knowable,
not missing a fraction or a grain.
Each sets its month,
around the twenty-four solar terms, seven or eight before and after the arrows,
long days also about seven or eight,
used for exits and entries,
sacrificing to celestial and earthly deities,
making all officials adhere to the water clock's schedule,
should not err,
omission counts as non-compliance,
offenses are not few.
Thus, making day and night distinct,
following the day's length,
with a hundred marks as the period,
no discrepancy allowed.
In virtuous nations,
days are longer,
water slower,
one inch in ten parts,
corresponds to the numerical laws.
Nowadays, many nations do not use this,
sun and moon slightly short,
one mark eight or nine,
hence causing the elderly's years,
when should be weak, instead robust,
their years naturally thin,
how again to hold long times?
As if making the nation full of ministers,
the pivot and balance relaxed and slow,
later generations blessed,
barely surviving,
not just having evils,
again facing subjugation.
Only the brightness of heaven and earth,
lies in the south,
Sì and Wǔ sharing the same home,
Lí as the true eye.
At the affairs of the Míngtáng,
sunlight illuminates from south facing north,
the advance and retreat of yáng energy,
also not losing constancy,
yīn and yáng pressing against each other,
reaching towards Zǐ's direction,
cold and warm directly opposing,
illuminating thoroughly and naturally,
very delightful.
The way of nurturing life,
Shàoyáng and Tàiyáng,
wood and fire mutually flourishing,
each attaining their wishes,
what contention remains?
Inside and out mutually supporting,
without losing names,
above reaching the imperial radiance,
down to the soundless,
tranquil and natural,
all things blooming in glory,
clearly knowable.
Without exertion, they form,
what heaven admires,
ought to receive its name,
where the mechanism and balance point,
life and death have their times,
the Director of Fate presents the records,
the register's numbers communicate in writing,
not corresponding to the summons.
Seeking the divine register to inquire and verify,
then ascending to the celestial sovereign,
who has charge over it.
The deities who report,
never leave the left and right,
revered inside and out,
also dare not privately receive,
what is presented up and down,
each does not miss the time.
The Tàiyīn official in charge,
dares not slacken or stop.
Properly managing the gates and pavilions,
fearing to speak of affairs personally,
always mutually undertaking goodness as the essential way,
recording their names,
receiving the teaching then acting,
not missing a fraction or a grain.
In the times of high antiquity,
there was wisdom and consideration illuminating all,
seeing everything,
receiving the way of the divine and bright,
clearly knowable,
also having their own laws and measures,
not losing their constancy.
Since the Tàichū era began,
calendars have had lengths and shortness,
very profound and essential.
From ancient times to the present,
the essence of issuing calendars,
lies in where they stop and what they accomplish.
Always using the mind to calculate and await,
what is accomplished and done below all succeeds,
and the numbers align with the marking line,
counting years, accumulating days and months,
major divisions making the calculation.
Now heaven and earth are greatly rejoicing in the harvest year,
the emperor should sit peacefully without worries,
the people should only wander without duties or few tasks,
the five grains no longer take precedence as before,
having no market value.
Throughout the land, people brew fine wine to drink together,
market practices become extreme,
this is called water commanding fire's movement,
which damages the transformation of yang.
Whenever people drink alcohol until drunk,
wild impulses immediately arise,
business transactions neglect duties,
they fight and kill each other,
some get injured or robbed;
some arrive early at the market,
but return at inappropriate times;
some fall into the hands of evil people,
some fall from heights,
some get crushed by carts and horses.
Considering the harms of alcohol - they are countless,
too numerous to record fully.
Consider how many markets exist within the four seas,
within a single month,
they consume hundreds of millions of hectoliters of the five grains,
and additionally cause unwarranted injuries and deaths,
occurring daily,
some orphans are thus left without heirs,
some create resentments with parents leading to harm,
some pass disasters down to descendants.
County officials and senior clerks,
unable to administer justice properly,
beat their chests and cry out to heaven,
stirring the imperial spirits,
causing the energies of yin-yang, the four seasons and five phases to become disordered,
again opposing the governance of the supreme emperor's peaceful rule,
making the great harmonious energy flow backward.
Indeed, mobilizing people without cause to make wine,
wasting and destroying the five grains,
leads again to such calamities.
If only virtuous rulers would issue clear decrees with instructions,
telling officials and people:
"From now onward,
whoever dares to drink one dou without cause in the market shall receive thirty lashes and
three days of penal labor;
those drinking two dou shall receive sixty lashes and
six days of penal labor;
those drinking three dou shall receive ninety lashes and
nine days of penal labor.
Each shall receive punishment according to the amount of wine consumed.
Wine shops likewise shall all be made to repair city walls, roads and government buildings,
the reason for assigning the repair of city walls, roads and government buildings as punishment
is because this constitutes major earth work;
earth overcomes water,
thereby suppressing and completely eliminating it,
preventing water from excessively damaging yang.
Water represents the great yin,
the common people,
yet conversely it is made to prosper and rule,
damaging and harming yang essence,
creating profound harm.
Repairing roads means adopting the great Way,
according to categorical correspondence,
gradually establishing peace.
Examining heaven, earth, yin-yang and all things,
those above and below love and govern each other,
establishing merit and achieving fame,
making hearts govern each family,
making people no longer hate each other,
constantly delighting in shared hearts and common purpose.
Making the great harmonious energy emerge daily of itself,
and greatly flourishing in peace,
the six directions united in heart,
the eight quarters united in planning.
What is governed matches human intentions,
none fail to respond and rejoice.
Rooted in the primordial energy of heaven and earth,
aligned with the positions of yin and yang,
evil silently disappears,
the disobedient all become compliant,
illuminating the supreme Way of the great spirit,
beloved by gods and deities.
I thus above present the Way and virtue to the August Heaven,
below establish measures for mountains and rivers,
in the middle set laws and standards for emperors,
enabling medium worthies to generate good intentions.
Thereby resolving heaven and earth's great grievances,
making emperors no longer sorrowful,
people loving each other,
all things obtaining their proper places,
the celestial laws and constant norms naturally present without concealment.
In ancient times, sage emperors and enlightened kings
valued great ministers,
cherished scholars,
benefited the people,
without harming or injuring;
ministers likewise were loyal and trustworthy, not deceiving their ruler,
therefore governance was like spiritual power.
Thus worthy fathers constantly think of comforting their sons,
sons constantly think of making their fathers happy,
these two joining strength with united heart -
no household undertaking fails;
if not joining strength with united heart,
the family way becomes disordered.
Losing their proper work and duties,
empty and destitute in extreme poverty,

These two joining strength with united heart,

Emperors learning from this,

benefiting governance not at all,
nor nurturing their nature.
Classical texts tend to be superficial—
though worthy scholars daily recite them,
they should not be given.
However, one may collect excellent sage classics from high antiquity,
middle antiquity,
and recent antiquity,
using them as texts for bestowal.
Only fear they may not suit nature-nurturing Dao,
causing people to lack self-respect,
instead becoming preoccupied with writing.
Still, all excellent writings
may be bestowed,
enabling recitation and emulation,
transforming them toward goodness."
"Excellent, excellent!"
"The six disciples have awakened to this."
"Today the Celestial Master has graciously spoken for us ignorant students,
I wish to ask about the meaning of granting food to the hungry,
and clothing to the cold.
Indeed, the hungry think of food,
the cold think of clothing;
when they obtain this heartfelt wish,
they remember their sovereign,
never forgetting even in old age.
They think of devoting their utmost effort,
not daring to have divided loyalties.
Kindness and affection deeply permeate among the people;
if they obtain extraordinary, rare, or excellent texts and methods,
they dare not conceal them.
They fully intend to present them to their ruler,
to enable him to live a long life;
therefore, it is appropriate to bestow these upon them.
This is called aiding the destitute and relieving the urgent.
The virtuous favor culture,
the hungry favor food,
the cold favor clothing;
when a ruler bestows upon his subjects,
he must ensure that each obtains what they desire,
then all under heaven will be content and submit."
"Excellent, excellent!
Thus, by nature, Heaven esteems the Way and Virtue and disdains punishments and penalties.
Therefore, the East corresponds to the Way,
the South corresponds to Virtue.
The Way governs birth,
hence all things are born in the East.
Virtue governs nurturing,
hence all things are nurtured in the South.
According to Heaven's pattern and law,
all things return to the Way and Virtue;
thus, the myriad things all originate from the East and South and ascend upward.
The six yang energies of heaven, earth, and the four directions all give life to beings at Chén and Sì.
Do you understand this?"
"Yes, yes.
Heaven's law places punishments below,
hence the Northwest is lesser yīn,
and great yīn represents penal misfortune.
Penal misfortune
governs injury and killing.
Thus, things are injured and age in the West,
and die in the North.
The heavenly energies contend and struggle;
with six yīn and no yang,
all things hide and conceal themselves in inner burrows,
fearing the rise of penal misfortune,
not daring to emerge and appear.
The Way of Heaven detests and demeans this;
therefore, its domestic animals
all feed on what is vile and discarded.
Hence, the sages of antiquity, observing Heaven's laws clearly,
thus esteemed the true Way, good virtue, and extraordinary texts, and disdained martial force;
this is a clear proof.
Now penal misfortune and martial force arise in the Northwest and are esteemed;
this is called using yīn to override yang,
using the lowly to override the noble,
leading to frequent conflicts.
It causes the people and officials to be disloyal,
not benefiting the king's governance;
is such governance not difficult?
Do you, the Perfected, understand this?"
"Yes, yes."
"You may be considered awakened.
Therefore, the sages and worthies of antiquity always esteemed texts on the Way and Virtue,
often placing them in the highest, most excellent positions,
while weapons and military preparations were placed in lower positions;
when a person dwells alone,
they place the texts on the bed,
and weapons remain below the bed.
In this way, the barbarians naturally submit,
and thieves and robbers daily diminish and vanish."
"Excellent, excellent!"
"Proceed,
you may be considered to have already understood.
You six, carefully ponder the meaning of my writings,
deliver them to the sovereign who esteems the Way and Virtue,
show them to the multitude of worthies;
my words do not betray Heaven, Earth, or the wise and enlightened.
Go forth;
this minor discourse is concluded.
If there are other matters you doubt,
then come again to ask."
"Yes, yes.
Now we six Perfected have received the Celestial Master's stern teachings;
we shall reverently return to dwell each in quiet places,
contemplating the Celestial Master's words.
If we all have unresolved points,
we only ask the Celestial Master to reveal the key to us."
"Speak, what is it?"
"Now Heaven naturally has the energies of the four seasons,
Earth naturally has the positions of the five phases;
their flourishing,
prosperity, rest,
imprisonment, and abandonment have their own times;
it is merely that humans now initiate and use them.
How can they cause the vital energy
to flourish and prosper, and alternately overcome and harm each other?"
"Ah,
alas! Though you six study daily,
it is without benefit;
instead, you become increasingly foolish,
somewhat like ignorant people.
Why is this?
For Heaven and Earth establish the laws;
the rise and decline of the myriad things conversely follow humanity.
Whatever affairs people commonly engage in together,
whatever objects they value and use,
all flourish with vital energy;
what people rest and abandon,
all decline and are imprisoned.
Therefore, what people initiate and engage in
becomes their rulers, leaders, and teachers;
what people contend to use,
all becomes valuable without equal;
what people rest and abandon,
all becomes cheap and without market value.
Thus, what the people of the world initiate and use
naturally flourishes with vital energy;
it need not necessarily await the energy of the four seasons and five phases.
Therefore, according to Heaven's law,
the rise and decline of humanity
is the rise and decline of the myriad things;
value and worthiness all depend on humanity.
Hence, the sages of antiquity knew Heaven's pattern and laws,
which must not be recklessly violated.
Thus, people in high antiquity deeply understood Heaven's esteem for the Way,
using the Way,
and initiating the practice of the Way;
at that time, the Way flourished.
In middle antiquity, it was abandoned and not practiced;
then the Way rested and was imprisoned,
no longer esteemed;
in middle antiquity, they initiated and used Virtue,
then Virtue flourished.
In later antiquity, they abandoned the highest Virtue;
then Virtue again rested and was imprisoned.
Therefore, when people initiate and use culture, then culture flourishes;
when they initiate and use martial force, then martial force flourishes;
when they initiate and use gold and coins, then gold and coins flourish;
when they initiate and use wealth and goods, then wealth and goods flourish.
Whatever the people of the world initiate and use
naturally flourishes with vital energy;
what they collectively abandon and do not use
all becomes ordinary things.
Why must it necessarily await the flourishing of Heaven's four seasons and five phases to flourish?
Why does your learning not become daily clearer,
but instead increasingly dark and unknowing?
If the Perfected's intention is still like this,
how much more do common people jointly violate Heaven's prohibitions,
saying it is not so?
Truly, it is so.
Now comparing you to them,
humanity's folly has persisted alone for long.
If the Perfected's words resemble my exposition of Heaven's laws for the sake of Heaven,
to resolve for the virtuous sovereign the inherited burden of former kings' flowing disasters,
would there be errors that render them unusable?
If erroneous,
how could they be applied?
If you six have doubts,
wishing to know the great proof of my Way,
to know whether it is truly genuine or not,
quickly deliver it to a wise and enlightened sovereign of virtue,
have him apply and use it;
immediately it will resonate and correspond with Heaven and Earth—
this is the clear proof and verification for that person.
Now the Perfected still cannot deeply understand
that humanity can cause things to rise, decline, advance, and retreat;
compared to you, common people—
how do they differ from the blind in their darkness?"
"Now having heard the Celestial Master explain it for us ignorant students,
we are already resolved;
is there any fault or not?"
"Once a person has studied,
they should strive to ponder the essential meaning,
not merely practice words.
To know the meaning and key—
this is what Heaven, Earth, and the Way detest.
Moreover, learners should be refined and cautious."
"Yes, yes."
"Go forth;
record these heavenly governance matters,
to subdue cunning and evil omens,
and not let the virtuous sovereign lose the texts on governance."
"Yes, yes."
"The greatly ignorant and dull one, having long been perplexed,
this benighted living being bows his head repeatedly in reverence,
to ask about a great doubt."
"What is it?"
"Throughout the texts, it frequently mentions the celestial sovereign qi descending,
but until now, I do not know what this celestial sovereign qi actually is."
"You deeply question this,
which shows you have grasped the essence of the Way.
Listen clearly,
and I will explain it in detail for you, the Perfected One.
Heaven has its Three Sovereigns,
Earth has its Three Sovereigns,
Humanity has its Three Sovereigns;
Heaven has its Five Emperors,
Earth has its Five Emperors,
Humanity has its Five Emperors;
Heaven has its Three Kings,
Earth has its Three Kings,
Humanity has its Three Kings;
Heaven has its Five Hegemons,
Earth has its Five Hegemons,
Humanity has its Five Hegemons."
"What does this mean?"
"Heaven's Three Sovereigns are like the three lights (sun, moon, stars),
Earth's Three Sovereigns are like high, low, and level ground,
Humanity's Three Sovereigns
are like ruler, minister, and people;
Heaven's Five Emperors are like the five planets,
Earth's Five Emperors are like the five sacred mountains,
Humanity's Five Emperors are like the five phases and five viscera.
Heaven's Three Kings are like the three lights,
Earth's Three Kings are like high, low, and level ground,
Humanity's Three Kings are like ruler, minister, and people;
Heaven's Five Hegemons are like the five planets,
Earth's Five Hegemons are like the five sacred mountains,
Humanity's Five Hegemons are like the five phases and five viscera."
"Celestial Master, please take pity on this ignorant student,
compelled by necessity,
reveal the celestial principles to me.
I wish to hear about their relative superiority and inferiority."
"Excellent,
your challenging question
shows you have understood the celestial intent,
and entered the celestial mind,
which can be preserved for ten thousand generations without fading away.
Now, among Heaven's Three Sovereigns,
the superior is like the sun,
the middle is like the moon,
the inferior is like the stars,
their superiority and inferiority differ greatly as such.
Among Earth's Three Sovereigns,
the superior is like the five sacred mountains,
the middle is like level land,
the inferior is like low-lying fields,
their superiority and inferiority differ greatly as such.
Among Humanity's Three Sovereigns,
the superior is like the ruler,
the middle is like the minister,
the inferior is like the people,
their superiority and inferiority differ greatly as such.
"Among Heaven's Five Emperors,
the superior,
is like three parts out of four of the sun;
possessing three parts of it;
the middle,
is like three parts out of four of the moon;
possessing three parts of it;
the inferior,
is like three parts out of four of the stars;
possessing three parts of it.
Among Earth's Five Emperors,
the superior,
is like three parts out of four of the five sacred mountains;
possessing three parts of it;
the middle,
is like three parts out of four of level land;
possessing three parts of it;
the inferior,
is like three parts out of four of low-lying fields;
possessing three parts of it.
Among Humanity's Five Emperors,
the superior,
is like three parts out of four of a great state;
possessing three parts of it;
the middle,
is like three parts out of four of a great minister;
possessing three parts of it;
the inferior,
is like three parts out of four of the people;
possessing three parts of it.
Among Heaven's Three Kings,
the superior,
is like two parts out of four of the sun;
possessing two parts of it;
the middle,
is like two parts out of four of the moon;
possessing two parts of it;
the inferior,
is like two parts out of four of the great stars;
possessing two parts of it.
Among Earth's Three Kings,
the superior,
is like two parts out of four of the five sacred mountains;
possessing two parts of it;
the middle,
is like two parts out of four of level land;
possessing two parts of it;
the inferior,
is like two parts out of four of low-lying fields;
possessing two parts of it.
Among Humanity's Three Kings,
the superior,
is like two parts out of four of a great state;
possessing two parts of it;
the middle,
is like two parts out of four of a great minister;
possessing two parts of it;
the inferior,
is like two parts out of four of the people;
possessing two parts of it.
Among Heaven's Five Hegemons,
the superior,
is like one part out of four of the sun;
possessing one part of it;
the middle,
is like one part out of four of the moon;
possessing one part of it;
the inferior,
is like one part out of four of the great stars;
possessing one part of it.
Among Earth's Five Hegemons,
the superior,
is like one part out of four of the five sacred mountains;
possessing one part of it;
the middle,
is like one part out of four of level land;
possessing one part of it;
the inferior,
is like one part out of four of low-lying fields;
possessing one part of it.
Among Humanity's Five Hegemons,
the superior,
is like one part out of four of a great state;
possessing one part of it;
the middle,
is like one part out of four of a great minister;
possessing one part of it;
the inferior,
is like one part out of four of the people;
possessing one part of it.
This is because the Heavenly Way is not distant,
and the Three and Five each revert to themselves.
Thus Heaven has its Three Sovereigns and Five Emperors,
Three Kings and Five Hegemons,
Earth also naturally has its Three Sovereigns and Five Emperors,
Three Kings and Five Hegemons,
Humanity also naturally has its Three Sovereigns and Five Emperors,
Three Kings and Five Hegemons."
"Why are they so numerous?
I wish the Celestial Master would explain the meaning behind this principle."
"Well,
Heaven, Earth, and Humanity originally share the same primordial qi,
divided into three bodies,
each having its own ancestral beginning.
Thus the Three Sovereigns
are their ancestral heads;
the Five Emperors
are the rulers of their middle flourishing;
the Three Kings
are their average rulers;
the Five Hegemons
represent their end of exhaustion, decline,
and the qi of rising punishments and perilous chaos.
Thus when it comes to the Five Hegemons,
it is only one part out of four,
as the Heavenly Way's continuity is nearly severed.
Beyond this, what lies below
is too insignificant to restrain each other,
like the weak being unable to control the strong,
the soft unable to control the hard,
the few unable to control the many,
and the Way will fall into great chaos,
unable to govern itself again.
Therefore, it starts anew from above."
"What does that mean?"
"Well,
the Nine Sovereigns
all begin to sprout in the north,
the Five Emperors begin to be born in the east,
the Three Kings flourish abundantly in the south,
the Five Hegemons achieve completion through killing in the west.
When Heaven gives birth to all things,
the yang qi follows the primordial qi,
from the Great Yin, combining to sprout and grow,
life should emerge and reach out,
hence flourishing in the east;
once born, it should grow luxuriantly,
hence thriving in the south;
once luxuriant, it should bear fruit,
hence achieving completion through killing in the west."
The Way of Heaven and Earth, yin and yang, revolves completely.
Things cannot achieve full fruition,
dying only to end,
for their roots, seeds, and fruits must regenerate again.
Thus, yin and yang are made to coexist,
both entering the Gate of Heaven,
merging their qi in the Qian (Heaven),
to begin anew from the origin.
This is the natural disposition of Heaven and Earth."
"Excellent, excellent!
Why do Heaven, Earth, and Humanity not share the Three Huáng, Five Dì, Three Kings, and Five Hegemons?"
"Excellent,
your question captures the essence.
Heaven, Earth, and Humanity are divided into three domains,
each residing separately.
The Way of the Huáng is
like a family having a father;
the Way of the Dì,
like a family having a mother;
the Way of the Kings,
like a family having a son;
the Way of the Hegemons,
like a family having a wife.
Now, these three domains are each in different places—
how could they share father, mother, son, and wife?
It is as if people were split into three families—
could they then share parents, sons, and wives?
Do you understand, Zhēnrén?"
"Yes, yes."
"Be cautious,
and do not recklessly oppose it.
The Way of Heaven has its own constant laws and patterns,
which cannot be merely resisted by force.
I dare not fail to exert effort."
"Yes, yes.
Although I often ask questions,
offending the Tiānshī's taboos,
without asking, I have no means to gain understanding.
I wish to beg for one more word."
"Speak calmly."
"Now, there are forty-eight divisions;
how do these forty-eight divisions operate?"
"How thorough and detailed your question is!
Your inquiry into matters.
If this operation aligns with the will of Heaven,
calamities and anomalies will not arise.
Those who lose the essential Way of Heaven
will face unceasing disasters and changes.
Thus, for countless generations before and after,
they inherit burdens successively.
A ruler who excels in governance
can make disasters and faults subside on their own,
eliminating their losses.
Those who neglect the essential Way of self-cultivation
instead cause evil qi to spread,
pervading all under Heaven.
Hence, residual calamities arise,
becoming the critical juncture of inherited burdens."
"What does that mean?"
"Well then,
listen carefully to my words."
"Yes, yes."
"The superior ruler of Heaven is like the sun,
the middle one like the moon,
the inferior like the stars.
The superior ruler of Earth is like the Five Yuè,
the middle like level land,
the inferior like low fields.
The superior ruler among humans is like the sovereign,
the middle like ministers,
the inferior like the common people.
Where it is complete,
its people and all things
are entirely free from illness and at peace,
with no thieves, deceit, or flattery.
Heaven and Earth have no disasters or anomalies—
this is called superior excellence,
where it is complete.
Where three-fourths is present,
three-tenths of the people are peaceful, good, loyal, and faithful;
one-tenth suffer injury or death,
or become thieves,
collectively engaging in evil, anomalies, and strange occurrences—
the extent varies with this one-fourth.
Where half is present,
half of the people and all things are ill,
lacking trust,
half of the people have deceitful hearts,
and heavenly anomalies are half as many.
Where one-fourth is present,
three-tenths are all ill,
without sincerity, full of deceit and flattery,
all becoming thieves,
with no mind for mutual benefit;
only one-tenth are good."
"Heavenly anomalies occur incessantly,
not in place A then in place B,
yet never leaving their boundaries.
Why is that?"
"Excellent,
your words.
Where it is complete,
its Dào and Dé reach all,
and what Dé reaches can be controlled;
thus, all things are made excellent,
all covered by its Dào and Dé,
hence there is peace.
Where three-fourths is present,
its Dào and Dé do not reach one-tenth,
so one-tenth is ominous.
Where half is present,
half is not covered by Dào and Dé,
so half is ominous.
Where one-fourth is present,
Dé is minimal,
reaching only one-tenth,
not the other three-tenths,
so three-tenths are ominous.
Therefore, the ancient sage kings, wishing to know their own strengths and weaknesses,
used this to divine,
never failing even once.
What is not reached—
why does it cause illness?
Where Dào and Dé cannot reach,
there is inaction and no ruler,
all things lack leadership, hence chaos,
with much illness, cunning, and deceit,
and thieves unceasing.
The ancients used this to assess governance,
to know the thickness of Dé,
observing which qi it corresponds to,
thereby deeply understanding the gains, losses, decline, and prosperity of rule,
as clear as the sun and moon."
"Excellent, excellent!
How can its losses be remedied?"
"Excellent,
now that you, Zhēnrén, know the Heavenly Canon,
you should halt this flow of disasters and the inherited burdens of all things."
"How can disasters be stopped?
Only if the Tiānshī teaches all the worthy,
enabling them to reach the qì of the Superior Huáng."
"Well then,
each should discuss the true Dào to the fullest,
each contemplating the primordial beginning to govern their toils and illnesses;
then they will return to excellence,
making it complete."
"Excellent, excellent!"
"Go now,
Zhēnrén, heed these matters."
"Yes, yes.
I have reverently received the forty-eight divisions' precepts.
How long or short is the practice of this Dào?"
"How detailed your question is."
"I dare not be less than thorough;
the Way of Heaven is profoundly important,
the master's instructions are strict,
hence I dare to ask point by point."
"Excellent,
knowing your role as a disciple repeatedly,
you can comprehend the intent of the Heavenly Dào.
Now, the Heavenly Dào has three aspects:
the Dào corresponds to Tàiyáng, Tàiyīn, and Zhōnghé.
The superior practice the outer path,
the next the middle path,
the next the inner path,
while hegemons have no Dào.
They only borrow the path; the Three Kings' inner path is the shortest.
The Tiānhuáng, being most superior, practice the outermost path;
the Nine Huáng share one Dào in sequence,
the inferior within,
the superior walking without moving,
the next slightly moving,
the next slightly knowing.
The Fifteen Dì share one middle path;
the superior practice the outer path,
the next practice and know,
the inferior practice swiftly.
The Three Kings, nine individuals,
share one inner path, riding;
the next are slightly swift,
the inferior gallop.
The Fifteen Hegemons borrow the innermost path to the extreme;
the superior are as if flying outside,
the middle as if flying swiftly,
the inferior as if arrows.
Do you understand, Zhēnrén?"
"Excellent, excellent!"
"Zhēnrén, come forward.
Your questioning on this matter—
why so detailed?"
"Well,
since my birth,
I have wondered why the year sometimes lengthens, sometimes shortens,
one day thick,
one day thin,
one advancing, one retreating.
Without asking the Tiānshī,
I fear I would never know.
I wish to hear the meaning."
"Excellent,
Your words.
The most profound,
is the sun of Heaven;
the next most profound,
is the sun of Earth;
the next most profound,
is the sun of Humanity;
the most shallow,
is the sun of the myriad things.
Does the Perfected Person understand this?"
"Yes, yes."
"Go now,
do not press further with questions.
This matter,
is your personal concern,
it is not that it is difficult to exhaustively explain to you.
But under heaven, there is nothing to be done about it,
nor does it help with the inherited burdens and calamitous meetings of the emperors and kings,
the sorrows and sufferings of the common people,
therefore I do not elaborate and explain it to you,
not out of unwillingness."
"Yes, yes.
I have repeatedly offended the Celestial Master's taboos,
committing grave faults."
"It is not a lack of humility,
but if one delights in wishing to know the affairs of the heavens above,
having personal concerns, then come,
and I will explain it all to you."
"Yes, yes."
"Go now."
Right: The method of distinguishing the conduct and degrees of excellence and inferiority of the Nine August Ones, Fifteen Emperors, Nine Kings, and Fifteen Hegemons.
"Before the Perfected One,
how many crimes do ordinary people have?"
"Ordinary people who commit no wrongdoing,
what crimes could they possibly have?"
"Alas,
how clouded your perception is, Perfected One."
"This ignorant student lacks understanding;
since birth I have never heard
of people being guilty without violating laws."
"Your words align
with common understanding.
Yet you fail to see ordinary people possess six great crimes
that cannot be erased.
Some bear immediate consequences,
others pass to future generations.
As a learner of the Way,
how can you not perceive these clear offenses?
Does your study not suffer from confusion?"
"This ignorant student is oblivious,
and feels no such affliction."
"If even you remain unaware,
consider how commoners die with grievances unresolved.
Though truly destitute of knowledge in life,
upon death they awaken to understanding.
Since the separation of Heaven and Earth,
all humans first dwell in darkness before attaining clarity -
why criticize this principle?"
"I wish to hear more."
"Very well:
When humans accumulate the Way without limit
yet refuse to teach others enlightenment and life preservation,
their crime remains unforgiven.
Some bear immediate consequences,
others pass to future generations.
The reason for this
is they sever Heaven's innate Way,
making themselves Heaven's adversary.
When humans accumulate virtue without limit
yet refuse to diligently teach others to uphold virtue
and carefully nurture their nature,
their crime remains unforgiven.
Some bear immediate consequences,
others pass to future generations.
The reason for this
is they disrupt Earth's nurturing virtue,
making themselves Earth's adversary,
greatly offending humanity.
Some hoard wealth beyond measure,
refusing to aid the poor or meet urgent needs,
causing people to die of hunger and cold -
their crime remains unforgiven.
Some bear immediate consequences,
others pass to future generations.
The reason for this
is that these harmonious possessions
represent Heaven and Earth's implementation of benevolence,
meant to circulate sufficiently for all,
preventing poverty.
Now instead gathered and withheld,
preventing universal distribution,
they oppose the harmonious energy of Heaven and Earth.
Some bear immediate consequences,
others pass to future generations -
such gatherings cannot long endure,
but must circulate.
Heaven creates humans
granting them understanding,
to love good and hate evil.
Fortunately endowed with knowledge,
yet knowing Heaven has the Way, they scorn it
and refuse diligent study for self-preservation.
Though they might obtain longevity
through their heavenly inheritance from ancestors,
they instead belittle themselves,
neglecting learning while facing death.
Suddenly confronting death,
they harbor grievances -
their crime remains unforgiven.
Some bear immediate consequences,
others pass to future generations,
causing living beings to remain ignorant,
making themselves Heaven's adversary.
The reason for this
is that Heaven constantly practices the Way through action,
thus maintaining auspiciousness,
while losing the Way brings calamitous death.
Though loving humans and desiring their goodness,
embedding the Way within them,
if humans refuse to practice the Way,
they are called people without the Way -
Heaven cannot grant them the Way and longevity.
Thus they sever the Heavenly Way,
making themselves Heaven's adversary.
Humans know to cultivate virtuous goodness,
yet refuse to diligently learn virtue,
instead scorning virtue and rejecting cultivation,
belittling themselves through wrongdoing -
their crime remains unforgiven.
Some bear immediate consequences,
others pass to future generations.
The reason for this
is opposition to Earth.
Earth loves virtue and nurtures,
while these people neglect affairs,
take no pleasure in virtue,
and despite inheriting their ancestors' bodies,
make themselves Earth's offenders.
Heaven creates humans,
fortunately granting each person physical strength
to clothe and feed themselves.
Yet refusing to work diligently,
they bring upon themselves hunger and cold,
betraying their ancestral inheritance.
Lightly abandoning their labor,
though strength could provide clothing and food,
they constantly complain of hardship, hunger and cold.
Always relying on wealthy households,
dependent on others for survival -
their crime remains unforgiven.
Some bear immediate consequences,
others pass to future generations.
The reason for this
is that Heaven and Earth create all wealth for human sustenance,
each should gather according to their ability,
obtaining sufficiency without poverty.
Instead they abandon effort and cease labor, belittling themselves,
or seek gains through discord,
forcibly taking others' possessions -
all such acts oppose harmony,
their crimes clearly deserving death.
These six great crimes are hated by Heaven,
and cannot be forgiven.
Does the Perfected One understand?"
"Yes, yes.
May I ask the Celestial Master,
why are these crimes so severe?"
"Ah!
How increasingly foolish you become!
These are exterminating-family crimes!
Why ask about their severity?"
"This ignorant student finds it very strange,
and cannot grasp the essential meaning.
Now only the Celestial Master can further enlighten me,
causing great awakening,
deep understanding of the meaning,
that I may dare not offend again."
"Very well,
the Perfected One speaks wisely.
My explanation shall be revealed,
the Perfected One should diligently record it accordingly."
"Yes, yes."
"Proceed:
Now the August Heaven possesses the Way,
using it to generate all things,
the teeming multitude
all depend on it for life.
Today's great profound Daoists,
though silently deeply understanding this,
keep it in their bellies,
unwilling to diligently teach others.
Teaching people the Way
is like giving fire to others:
if few come to take it,
the source remains unharmed;
if limitless people come to take it,
the source remains unharmed.
Now we fortunately can share it
to teach all people under heaven,
assisting Heaven in generating things,
helping Earth nurture forms,
aiding the帝王 in cultivating correctness.
Moreover causing all to embrace the Way,
seeking life and detesting death,
enabling governance to assist in ruling people,
no longer violating laws,
practicing evil and violence.
With good hearts,
they assist Heaven, Earth and the帝王 in nurturing the twelve thousand things,
each rejoicing in longevity;
people embracing benevolent hearts,
no longer lightly harming the myriad things,
then Heaven greatly rejoices for them,
Earth greatly delights for them,
the帝王 greatly enjoys peace without worries -
how immensely accumulates this merit!
One person teaching can transform a hundred fools;
a hundred people returning
each teach ten thousand;
ten thousand people teaching
already transform a hundred million;
a hundred million teaching
reaches limitless instruction.
This goodness
above harmonizes with Heaven's heart,
below penetrates the limitless,
people all delight in life and doing good.
The帝王 rules without duties,
so what harm comes to humans
that they won't diligently demonstrate and instruct?
Now people fortunately receive the former teacher's instructions and warnings..."
To possess profound understanding of the ultimate Way yet keep it secluded and hidden,
refusing to teach and demonstrate it to others,
leaves people with no source of spiritual refuge,
causing them to suffer untimely deaths with unresolved grievances.
This is called severing the Heavenly Way,
leading many to lose the Way and act recklessly.
Heaven thereby cannot sustain life long,
Earth thereby cannot nurture long.
Humans must not remain ignorant of the Way,
for petty persons, devoid of the Way, often hold themselves cheap,
jointly engage in rebellion and treachery,
violating celestial patterns and terrestrial principles,
rising as bandits and thieves who harm one another.
They transgress the king's laws,
becoming a heavy worry for the noble-minded,
creating chaos too vast to manage.
The ruler worries over this day and night,
depressed and afflicted by his own sorrows,
causing Heaven and Earth to lose their proper alignment,
with disasters, anomalies, and portents unceasing,
leaving a burden upon the emperor—
I have yet to fully articulate it all.
Severing the Heavenly Way
is a great transgression, a crime so vast
it cannot be fully recorded.
Therefore, I shall briefly outline its main principles,
to show the Perfected what is right and wrong.
Is it not clear that such heavy crimes deserve death?
Even in death, residual faults remain,
hence they extend to affect future generations.
How dreadful!
The Perfected must be cautious of this.
Only the Perfected understand this dread,
and can be said to have attained lasting fortune,
keeping far from harm and calamity."
"Yes, yes,
I dare not disregard your instructions."
"Good,
you are already wise and enlightened,
understanding Heaven's mandate.
You are certain to embrace life and depart from death,
with no further doubts."
"Now that I have respectfully heard the mandate of the Heavenly Way,
I wish to learn of the Earthly Virtue's decrees."
"Well then,
Earth's great virtue
lies solely in following Heaven's Way,
lovingly nurturing the myriad things.
All bustling creatures,
without exception, receive its grace and virtue,
being raised and matured within it.
Therefore, people of great depth and great virtue
should model their conduct on this.
Fortunately, through the efforts of my former teacher,
I have been able to embrace and hold the virtuous Way of the limitless.
Teaching virtue to others
is like leading them to a great river to drink.
If few come to learn virtue,
the source remains unharmed;
if limitless people come to learn virtue,
the source also remains unharmed.
If one teaches with effort and instruction,
enabling all ordinary people to know how to preserve depth and embrace virtue,
each will cherish and nurture their own being.
The good among them can above assist Heaven in nurturing and growing living things,
and below assist Earth in rearing and bringing things to fruition.
All join forces with one heart,
free from malicious intent.
Among them, the greatly wise and enlightened, whose hearts are easily opened and shown,
can be transformed and elevated,
made to be assistants to the ruler.
The worthy among them can serve as officials and teachers,
and even the lowest, the ignorant,
can still act as teachers and elders among the common people.
For all people inherently prefer virtuous transformation and doing good.
Teaching in this manner,
then benefits above for Heaven,
and benefits below for Earth.
This is the fundamental root of great transformation,
assisting the emperor in nurturing the people,
causing them not to commit evil or wrongdoing,
allowing the noble-minded to govern effortlessly and without worry.
Its merit is profoundly significant:
Heaven and Earth cherish it,
and it can lead to official position.
Now, some may possess vast and great virtue,
yet instead pretend to be ignorant and withhold it,
blocking the path of the Way and its virtue,
not assisting Heaven in nurturing life,
not assisting Earth in fostering growth,
not helping the emperor harmonize the people.
This causes foolish people and later generations
to remain benighted and ignorant,
unable to distinguish white from black,
persisting in error without change,
thus becoming petty persons,
directionless,
heedlessly belittling themselves,
following each other into wrongdoing,
accumulating deceit and treachery.
High and low can no longer teach one another,
lost in darkness and confusion,
with no sense of taboo or restraint.
They offend against celestial patterns above,
and violate terrestrial forms below.
Their actions contradict the four seasons,
disrupt the five phases,
becoming a great worry for the noble-minded,
and inciting harm from petty persons.
They become bandits and thieves,
sometimes ruining themselves in turn,
bringing shame upon their parents,
thus ending their lineage.
I am merely outlining the main principles for the Perfected now,
revealing the beginnings,
so that the multitude may awaken and admonish themselves.
Refusing to teach enduring virtue
is called severing Earth's nurturing Way.
The crime of this is as I have described.
Such behavior, being without form, leads to death,
yet still leaves residual guilt,
which then extends to later generations.
Does the Perfected understand this?"
"How dreadful!
How dreadful!"
"Since the Perfected understands this dread early,
it can be said you are likely to survive.
Only be cautious."
"Yes, yes.
I have respectfully received the prohibitions of the Way and its virtue.
I wish to hear about the conduct of the benevolent."
"Well then,
when Heaven and Earth produce all material goods,
they already belong to humanity.
They are made rootless,
neither attached above to Heaven,
nor attached below to Earth.
These things
belong to the harmony of the central realm,
meant to be circulated and put to use,
floating and moving about,
their proper role being to relieve poverty and aid the desperate.
When people hoard gold, silver, and precious objects,
households with abundant wealth,
some possessing millions upon millions of kinds,
let them accumulate and rot unused—
if the wise and knowing instead distribute them to the poor,
they joyfully earn the name of benevolence.
They assist Earth in nurturing physical forms,
and help the emperor preserve good and careful people.
A household with millions
can aid ten thousand families,
giving the old and gathering the new,
without a greedy profit-seeking heart.
Their virtue permeates Heaven and Earth,
heard of in distant places,
and they can constantly obtain new goods,
while the rotting ones are removed.
Among them, the greatly worthy
daily report their achievements to the emperor.
The lesser worthy among them
are daily recommended in their villages and communities.
As for the greatly foolish who do not repay the kindness,
they are at most two or three out of ten.
How could this cause anyone great poverty?
Persisting in good deeds without cease,
the greatly worthy, deep and enlightened, recommend them,
their fame spreading throughout the land,
with people from all four seas thronging the roads to follow the Way.
Enlightened kings and sage rulers, hearing of them,
greatly rejoice at their aid in nurturing the people,
and thereupon summon them to court,
appointing them to high ministerial positions.
Through this, they gain honor and nobility,
enduring for generations without end.
This is still great benevolence,
rare in the world.
They bring no disgrace upon their ancestors above,
and no disgrace upon their descendants below.
Heaven and Earth cherish them,
the hundred spirits benefit them,
emperors treat them as bright friends,
neighbors regard them as parents.
Their merit is engraved upon Heaven and Earth,
never to fade away;
their emolument is fixed in official rank,
never to be demeaned;
their fame is established among the myriad people,
never to be extinguished.
How can one not practice benevolence?
Some may chance upon lands of good fortune and wealth,
acquiring the resources of Heaven and Earth's harmony,
amassing them into millions upon millions of kinds,
with precious objects, gold, and silver in countless millions,
yet instead seal and hide them away in dark rooms,
letting them all rot and decay.
When they see people in poverty coming to seek help,
they curse and refuse to give;
even if they do give, they do not agree readily,
but must seek to double their gain;"
Yet some only increase it once,
or stop after four or five times.
They bestow upon the rich,
completely cut off the poor,
causing them to die of hunger and cold,
acting without reason,
and instead laugh at them.
They create resentment with Heaven,
incur blame with Earth,
and become great enemies of people,
hated by all spirits.
The reason for this is that
these possessions are what Heaven, Earth, and the harmonious middle own,
to collectively nourish people.
These households merely happen upon their accumulation,
like rats in a granary,
always alone and well-fed;
the grain of this great granary
originally does not belong to the rats alone;
the wealth in the minor treasury,
is not meant for one person alone;
those who are lacking
should all take from it.
Ignorant fools,
thinking they should possess it alone forever,
do not know it is the contribution of ten thousand households,
all of whom should receive clothing and food from it.
They love it abnormally, alternating between anger and joy,
unwilling to make efforts to aid the poor and save the desperate,
causing ten thousand households to be cut off,
with nothing to plant in spring,
nothing to harvest in autumn,
their grievances entirely crying out to Heaven.
Heaven is moved by this,
Earth is shaken by it.
Not helping the noble person to aid the poor and save the desperate
makes one the most unkind person between Heaven and Earth.
Even when people seek it for sacrifices,
they still do not give,
so all spirits detest them,
wishing to end their lineage;
the village curses them firmly,
wanting them to die;
when thieves hear of them,
they raise arms and rush
to attack their households;
the family suffers and nearly perishes completely,
yet they stubbornly refuse to give,
instead burying it deep in the ground,
so no one can see it.
Without cause, they cut off the world's wealth,
depleting what is useful on Earth,
instead making a great hoard underground,
which Heaven greatly abhors,
Earth greatly suffers from,
considering it a great fault.
The harmonious middle's resources become increasingly scarce,
thus sitting in insufficiency,
many die of hunger and cold,
becoming heavy enemies of people.
For Heaven only loves the Way,
Earth only loves virtue,
and the harmonious middle loves benevolence.
All things are meant to reside under Heaven and upon Earth,
circulating and providing for all;
yet when people are in need,
it is instead buried away,
sick and depressed, unable to emerge and be seen.
Heaven and Earth
originally do not desire to possess wealth.
Heaven delights in people's birth,
Earth delights in nurturing people.
Ignorant petty people,
instead block the wealth of Heaven, Earth, and the harmonious middle,
preventing it from circulating sufficiently,
killing what Heaven gives life to,
harming what Earth nurtures.
Without cause, they hide and hoard this wealth,
making the state poor,
lacking resources,
unable to save and preserve their people's lives;
causing virtuous rulers
to govern in emptiness.
The use of gold, silver, treasures, and goods,
accumulated through much human labor,
truly toilsome and arduous,
should be for the state's use;
abandoning it without cause,
removing it from above and below,
Earth does not delight in receiving it,
considering it a great affliction,
a great hoard.
Now, foolish people are extremely unkind,
with crimes like these,
should they not die?
Among them are those still insatiably unaware,
disputing and feeling wronged,
instead seizing property from weak, small households,
utterly unaware of stopping.
I still only see you, the enlightened one, diligent,
raising the main points,
seeing the beginning.
The faults of the greatly unkind are numerous,
beyond record,
hard to account for;
you, the enlightened one, should deeply ponder this.
Thus, the three energies of Heaven, Earth, and the harmonious middle detest them,
and even in death, their crimes remain,
destined to affect later generations;
do you, the enlightened one, realize this?"
"Yes, yes.
How dreadful!
I do not wish to hear it."
"If you, the enlightened one, neglect these words,
Heaven will surely take your life,
to make you aware and awakened;
detesting it may yet let you live.
Discipline yourself and be cautious in affairs."
"Yes, yes.
I have reverently received the precepts of the Way, Virtue, and Benevolence,
and wish to hear about those who have knowledge but do not delight in learning the true Way's meaning."
"Excellent,
your words.
For Heaven gives birth to people,
fortunate to have wisdom and knowledge,
enabling them to learn and inquire for long life.
Heaven possesses the Way,
delighting to share it with people;
Earth has virtue,
delighting to share it with people;
the harmonious middle has wealth,
delighting to nourish people.
Thus, in life, people delight in seeking the true Way,
and the enlightened one comes naturally.
Persisting in this without cease,
is like consulting with spirits;
daily singing of good deeds,
goodness naturally returns;
striving to serve the many worthy,
the many worthy together instruct and teach,
no longer distant.
One can preserve their body whole,
not betraying the ancestors' legacy;
while others die prematurely,
one alone attains their full lifespan;
others are all named evil,
one alone becomes a good person.
Becoming a teacher for the multitude,
known in distant places,
inwardly embracing true Way, Virtue, and Benevolence, and possessing them.
Assisting Heaven in producing life,
aiding Earth in nurturing forms,
helping the emperor in transforming the people.
The superior teacher can transform limitless people,
making all fools uphold the Way and do no wrong;
the middle teacher can transform ten thousand people,
the minor teacher can transform thousands or hundreds,
ultimately benefiting the ruler,
making petty people know prohibitions,
not committing hidden evils or wrongs.
Upward, moved to attain office,
not betraying ancestors,
not disgracing descendants;
if learning is like this,
how can one not do it?
Therefore, the sages and worthies of old
