aiding Heaven and Earth in generation and growth,
assisting the emperor in governing chaos;
in the space between Heaven and Earth,
this is the praise of good people.
Some foolish people,
born with innate simplicity,
have knowledge but refuse to strive in learning the true Way,
instead delighting in superficiality,
acting to deceive others:
as children, deceiving parents;
as ministers, deceiving rulers;
as subordinates, deceiving superiors;
named as deceiving Heaven,
their offenses not forgiven.
Some instead delight in vulgar disputes and conflicts,
following each other in wrongdoing,
upon seeing the enlightened one,
instead greatly laugh,
laughing and saying there's no use in learning.
Thus, they remain in darkness,
foolish and unknowing,
yet fond of contention and insufferable,
harshly saying Heaven and Earth have no principles,
worthies and fools are ignorant,
acting willfully,
upward violating celestial patterns,
downward violating terrestrial principles,
coming and going without restraint,
returning not to serve parents,
gathering with groups of fools,
thus becoming wicked children.
Serving as officials for long,
even killing their parents in return,
Unable to reflect and think for themselves,
they flee and become thieves and bandits,
committing harm, injuring, and killing people,
without ever ceasing.
This is precisely what Heaven detests,
Earth condemns,
rulers and emperors worry and suffer over,
all spirits despise,
and parents are distressed by.
This great calamity of harming others
cuts off the lineage of their ancestors.
Now, if one does not diligently study the true way,
but acts in such a manner,
in your esteemed opinion,
should they not deserve death?
Death would still leave them with unexpiated crimes,
afflicting their descendants,
who would then be known as a generation of evildoers,
the offspring of thieves and bandits.
Should such evil indeed be passed on to later generations?
I have only begun to outline the beginnings for you,
for their wickedness is too numerous to record,
and it is difficult to account for all.
Are you aware of this?
You must take caution. "
"Yes, yes, I am deeply terrified! "
"Since you know fear,
you have already begun to rid yourself of evil. "
"I have respectfully heard these four matters in detail;
I wish to hear what follows next. "
"Very well.
Heaven gives birth to humans,
allowing them to emerge only when fully equipped,
and it delights in their practice of the Way and Virtue.
Fortunate are those with awareness,
for they can learn virtue.
Heaven and Earth use virtue to nurture all things,
and they rejoice when humans emulate this.
Thus, the virtuous people of high antiquity endured humiliation,
emulating Earth's nurturing of all things.
When humans learn to do this,
their hearts and minds are constantly joyful,
no longer fond of harming others.
They act cautiously in all matters,
and as days pass, their deeds become good,
with no further desire to do evil.
Gathering by kind,
they rise ever higher and farther,
and through long accumulation,
they become people of abundant virtue,
to whom none fail to respond,
and multitudes turn toward them.
Gathering and persisting in careful obedience and goodness,
they become great profound teachers,
whose virtue then assists Heaven in nurturing things that desire life,
and aids Earth in fostering things that wish to grow.
They also gladly help enlightened rulers transform the people,
making them cautious,
so they no longer know their own凶恶.
With small acts of virtue,
they may transform a thousand or several hundred people;
with great acts of virtue,
they may transform over ten thousand.
Thereby, they cause tens of thousands to become virtuous teachers in turn,
and their transformation knows no bounds.
Persisting in virtue without cease,
all people cannot help but rejoice and delight.
Heaven and Earth love them,
increasing their lifespan;
spirits and gods favor them,
and thus jointly benefit and protect them.
Those with merit
possess the virtue of rulers and officials,
not taking pleasure in harming the multitude.
Delighting and favoring it,
they attain what they seek and dwell in constant solitary joy,
with none wishing to harm them.
This fundamentally stems from learning obedience and goodness to practice virtue,
thus reaching this state,
their fame spreading to distant lands,
their achievements evident to Heaven and Earth,
not failing their ancestors,
nor disgracing their descendants.
Now, some people may fortunately have awareness,
knowing good and evil in their hearts,
yet instead lightly regard themselves,
not diligently learning to practice good virtue,
but following foolish and ignorant世俗之人 in doing evil.
Fond of using aggression and崇尚武力,
their words are often凶悍,
speaking in opposition,
seeking to subdue others.
They claim their own convenience,
yet there are those more convenient than they;
they boast of their own courage and strength,
yet there are those more courageous and strong.
Thus, in all matters under Heaven,
each has its point of subjugation and exhaustion,
and therefore can be controlled.
When a great fire is about to ignite,
it may seem uncontrollable,
but meeting water, it dies.
When humans act wrongly,
in moments of anger,
they may seem ungovernable,
but encountering prison, they are exhausted.
If the mouth seems unrestrained,
illness brings it down.
Thus, Heaven and Earth govern humans
entirely by their own laws and measures.
Humans, endowed with awareness,
if unwilling to diligently learn,
instead lightly engage in wrongdoing,
dwelling in凶险,
with none to love them.
Heaven and Earth detest them,
all spirits despise them,
and rulers suffer distress over them.
They do not become good people
but turn into thieves and bandits themselves;
in death, they still become恶鬼,
and those who use force and violence
in death find no use for it.
All who understand the道理 know this,
yet they easily neglect to do good,
defiling their ancestors' lineage,
failing their descendants,
thus being labeled as凶贼之徒.
None are willing to speak with them,
travelers avoid sharing the same path.
What fault have these children,
bearing the evil of their parents,
that they are still called children of thieves and bandits,
or even meet death?
Come, esteemed one,
if humans lightly regard themselves,
not diligently learning virtue from enlightened teachers,
but following petty people,
how grave their error!
Should they not die with unexpiated crimes? "
"How terrifying!
Heavenly Teacher, need not say more;
the thought alone already pains my heart deeply.
Seeing people not learn,
I considered it a minor matter—
how could I know it leads to this? "
"Humans are very foolish,
resembling ordinary世俗之人;
if they do not deeply reflect,
death leaves them with unexpiated crimes.
Since you, esteemed one, have merit with Heaven and Earth,
take caution. "
"Yes, yes. "
"Do not take yourself lightly.
I have only raised the outline,
showing the beginning;
the evils of not learning
are not fully contained herein.
Having received my writings,
awaken and deeply reflect on them. "
"Yes, yes.
If I may return to a quiet place,
I will study them meticulously and in detail. "
"Indeed, it is so.
To learn without precision—
how does it differ from dreaming? "
"Yes, yes.
I have respectfully received your instructions on my duties;
I wish to hear the teaching on humans having strength but not using it. "
"Very well.
Heaven and Earth together give birth to all crawling beings,
endowing each with strength,
drawing breath from the four seasons and emulating the five phases.
Strength is fundamentally for self-movement and action,
and should be used to secure clothing and food.
Thus, those with constant strength
work day and night without slacking,
accumulating without cease;
no matter the size of things,
they cherish what they obtain.
All things have their own essence and spirit,
and they too favor humans who love them;
loved by humans, they come to归属 them.
It is like the Eastern Sea's love for water:
dwelling lowest,
all waters under Heaven gather there,
thus forming the sea.
The noble person labors without rest,
thereby accumulating wealth and goods in abundance,
and the household becomes rich, lacking nothing.
Ancestors then receive fine offerings,
descendants become prosperous and sleek,
and the entire family shares in the benefits.
Laboring without cease,
when all four directions are impoverished and empty,
none fail to receive their aid,
and the foundation is thus greatly established.
Giving without end,
The multitude greatly praises him,
his fame spreads to distant lands,
his achievements are manifest between heaven and earth.
He constantly exerts strength to aid the destitute and rescue those in distress,
assisting heaven and earth in cherishing all beings,
helping the ruler in nurturing the people.
He ceaselessly relieves poverty and want,
thus heaven and earth increase his allotted span,
all spirits come to partake of his offerings,
and every member of his household is filled with joy.
Because of his virtuous conduct,
some attain high office,
bringing no disgrace to their ancestors,
and leaving no debt to their descendants.
Yet some people, possessing strength, instead take the easy path,
not applying themselves to proper work,
though they could use it to attain wealth,
they instead engage in conflicts and lawsuits,
recklessly undertaking inauspicious deeds.
Seeing their own power to subdue others,
they persist without cease,
ultimately becoming children of great wickedness.
Their households become utterly destitute,
and they turn to banditry and theft,
then hunger and cold arrive together,
unable to restrain themselves from wrongdoing,
the unworthy among them soon perish from hunger and cold.
Their courage and strength are used to harm others,
seeking what is not rightfully theirs,
seizing what does not belong to them,
repeatedly injuring and harming people,
thus creating enmity with heaven,
incurring blame from earth,
making enemies of the noble,
and causing worry to the emperor.
Persisting in these actions without cease,
all spirits despise them,
no longer granting benefits or protection.
Heaven refuses to cover them,
earth refuses to bear them,
misfortunes arise daily,
until they die by the roadside;
some perish in prison,
their parents executed,
calamity extending to wives and children,
all relatives and villagers wishing for their death,
with remaining offenses
passing to later generations,
some becoming descendants of beggars,
or children of bandits and thieves,
a great flaw for posterity.
Come forward, Zhēnrén,
such are the consequences of these faults—
do they not deserve death with guilt remaining?
"I hear the celestial master speak of these matters,
I am greatly alarmed and heart-pained,
fearing I cannot recover on my own."
"Since you, Zhēnrén, feel heart-pain,
you shall soon find life.
But if suddenly you do not awaken greatly,
your death is not far off.
Be cautious—
my words must not be violated,
for violators perish,
not by my hand,
but by the consequences of their own actions.
Do you understand this?"
"Yes, yes."
"I have set forth these six matters for you,
yet have not expressed one ten-thousandth of them.
The virtuous and profound who grasp my teachings
should ponder deeply and consider afar,
not revert to taking the easy path,
nor cease from benevolent deeds.
Strive in learning,
intending to attain goodness, for evil
instead brings downfall upon one.
Each must plan for their own person—
herein lie six deadly sins,
and six great virtues;
all manifest in one's person.
Those who practice goodness shall surely attain goodness,
while those who take the easy path toward evil
daily gain misfortune and wicked offspring.
Take stock and plan for yourselves,
finding no pleasure in self-indulgence.
Be cautious and thoughtful,
reflect and remember—
the mind of the wise and enlightened
must surely open easily.
Virtue, benevolence, and goodness
are entrusted to those of moral character,
while misfortune and evil befall those who lack deep consideration.
This standard method,
if all can emulate my writings to correct themselves,
then under heaven there will be no more wicked people.
This is the ancient, utmost Way of the celestial realm,
capable of transforming people;
once understood, all turn to goodness,
never reverting to wickedness again.
Superior individuals delight in life
and may learn its true Way;
the profoundly virtuous and greatly wise may learn its virtue;
those who love to give may learn its benevolence;
the knowledgeable may learn its wisdom;
the capable may learn its capability;
the strong may learn its strength.
If all can fully apply these,
pondering and mastering them,
they will distance themselves from misfortune and evil.
Heaven and earth will cherish them,
the six directions nurture them,
the emperor will have no further troubles,
and shall govern with enduring ease.
Do you understand this, Zhēnrén?"
"Great joy has arrived,
I am immensely pleased."
"You may be called one who delights in goodness and understands.
Therefore, the sages and worthies of old
taught without ceasing
because they saw heaven's prohibitions clearly,
each planning for their own person.
Thus the teachings of sages and worthies
fill the world with words.
Do you alone not perceive this?"
"Excellent, excellent!"
"Therefore, the sages, worthies, and superior individuals of old all studied,
striving day and night without cease
because they also saw clearly the commandments of heaven and earth.
Thus they dared not take the easy path toward wrongdoing,
nor dared to belittle and neglect diligent study.
Hence they attained lasting auspiciousness without harm.
These various worthies and extraordinary individuals
were originally without knowledge,
but achieved it through diligent study.
The various wicked people herein
all result from not studying diligently,
from self-belittlement and taking the easy path.
My Way
is the gateway to auspiciousness and misfortune—
do you also understand this?"
"Yes, yes.
Thus, the capital's example extends from above to below—
what does this mean?"
"Alas!
Why does your mind not awaken!"
"Hearing the celestial master speak continuously,
now I am further confused and unaware
of what constitutes awakening,
and what constitutes non-awakening."
"Now let me help you understand through practice.
Come forward, Zhēnrén—
the method of heaven's governance
transforms people toward goodness."
"From top to bottom,
how many methods are there?"
"The methods are myriad,
each with different intent.
Yet you, Zhēnrén, remain upright like this,
while ordinary people struggle to awaken,
lost in long-standing delusion."
"I have erred—
only the celestial master [can guide me]."
"Indeed,
to assist the emperor in governance,
there are generally ten methods:
first is governance by primordial qì,
second is governance by spontaneity,
third is governance by the Dào,
fourth is governance by virtue,
fifth is governance by benevolence,
sixth is governance by righteousness,
seventh is governance by propriety,
eighth is governance by civility,
ninth is governance by law,
tenth is governance by force.
These ten complete the sequence—
why?
All things begin with primordial qì,
and end with force,
for force means cutting and slaying,
thus force is the lowest.
Therefore, things originate in the Great Mystery,
mature in the Great Yang,
and finally die by the White Tiger.
Thus primordial qì resides in the north,
while the White Tiger dwells in the west—
this explains it.
Thus heaven employs governance by primordial qì,
using wind and qì to nurture things.
Earth employs governance by spontaneity,
so following goodness yields goodness,
following evil yields evil.
Humans,
obediently receiving heaven-earth's central harmony,
employ governance by the Dào,
actively practicing the Dào.
All matters penetrate and flow—
these three affairs correspond to the signs of heaven, earth, and humanity.
Beyond these three affairs, what follows...
Dérén composes commentaries,
but beyond benevolence,
many are harmed and hard to comprehend.
Thus, my way is always joyful,
fundamentally adhering to the nature of Heaven's precepts,
and in the middle, discarding the nature that has not yet perished.
The origin of all living things follows constant principles,
reaching maturity in the middle,
and descending into chaos at the end.
Once chaos is lost, it cannot be restored to order,
so one must start from the top.
Thus, Heaven always preserves its foundation,
Earth maintains its center,
one cycle,
while humans guard what is below,
three cycles,
hence the frequent chaos in the Way.
Has the Perfected One come to understand this?"
"Yes, yes."
"You now have doubts."
"Following the teacher, I dare speak, but dare not harbor doubts."
"Perfected One, come forward.
When Heaven wishes to bless the emperor,
what serves as clear proof?
When it seeks to benefit the people and officials,
what manifests as evidence?"
"Oh, Celestial Master,
I fall short now—why?
My words often miss the mark,
frequently incurring faults,
so I dare not speak again."
"Alas, proceed."
"Yes, yes.
When Heaven intends to bless the emperor,
it bestows rare texts
that can bring order now,
using them to surpass limits
and harmonize with yīn and yáng.
To benefit minor officials,
it grants them good governance;
to benefit the people,
it lets them bear virtuous offspring."
"The Perfected One speaks rightly,
but is there not more extraordinary discourse?
Yet this suffices.
When Heaven desires to raise up a virtuous ruler,
it begets a sage,
enabling them to convey Heaven and Earth's discourse
and comprehend their intent.
Thus, the Perfected One comes to learn this,
to entrust it to prudent and good people,
awakening their minds,
letting them ponder deeply;
to bestow it upon a highly virtuous ruler,
showing it to all worthies,
so they grasp its meaning and disseminate it to the common folk.
When the people receive it,
they unite in groups of fifteen,
discussing and governing,
resolving injustices—not solely for Heaven, Earth, or the ruler.
Faults originate from one in leadership,
and leaders incur heavy blame from Heaven and Earth,
all stemming from one person.
Some who learn the true Way early
fail to teach and transform others diligently;
those fortunate to know virtue first
do not exert effort to transform;
wealthy families hoarding riches
refuse to practice benevolence through giving;
people with the wisdom to learn
neglect diligent study
to seek the true Way and attain longevity;
those capable of cultivating virtue
to transform themselves
shun diligent learning for self-improvement;
those with strength
avoid hard work to better their lot,
instead falling into poverty.
These are six great faults,
accumulated by humanity and Heaven over time.
Since the creation of Heaven and Earth,
burdens have been passed down,
worsening for later generations,
gathering into great harm.
This causes Heaven and Earth to lose their proper order,
emperors to worry and rule ineffectively,
leading to widespread imbalance
that Heaven deeply detests.
Thus, I urgently convey Heaven's words:
from ancient times to now,
when Heaven and Earth suffer in distress,
unknown to ordinary people,
divine sages always transmit the message—
not I alone, so do not wonder, Perfected One.
Now that I have departed the world,
I cannot return to appear among the people,
so I entrust this text to you, Perfected One.
You, in turn, have left worldly life
and can no longer teach among the people.
Thus, seek out good and understanding folk to pass it on,
hastening to deliver it to a virtuous ruler.
Those who dare delay or obstruct will be held accountable—
how grave the consequence!
Now Heaven aims to cure ills and secure the emperor,
letting the virtuous ruler enlighten all worthies
to transform the people,
each reflecting on their faults
to absolve ancestral burdens.
Let everyone plan for their own well-being,
without negligence,
then Heaven will greatly rejoice,
and order will be established.
If you doubt my words' sincerity,
test my text for truth.
The reason: ancient texts abound in volumes,
yet often fail to bring peace.
If the wise and elders alone harbor doubts,
deeming the texts untrue,
how can a warrior's strength be known untested?
How can the text's divinity be proven unused?
I receive Heaven's words
to test you, Perfected One.
Henceforth, all writings encountered
must be tried, not left as empty falsehoods.
Heaven detests this deeply,
Earth suffers greatly,
considering it a grave illness,
truly unjust and wrathful.
It prevents all things from flourishing,
brings many disasters and premature deaths,
cutting short natural lifespans.
Emperors fret,
officials and people fall into chaos,
no longer upholding order—
the great fault lies here, the sixth sin.
Those with the Way envy it,
refusing to teach the ignorant;
those with virtue envy it,
refusing to transform the ignorant;
the wealthy hoard and envy wealth,
unwilling to give,
though Heaven intends people to share;
the knowledgeable
shun diligent learning of the true Way to enlighten themselves,
instead mocking it;
the capable
avoid diligent learning and teaching,
instead reviling it;
the strong
refuse hard work
that could bring wealth and benevolence,
instead opting for laziness.
When parents teach and learn,
they oppose it.
Thus, I command you, Perfected One, to swiftly share this text,
making all worthies deeply consider the people,
reflecting on their great faults.
Do you understand this instruction, Perfected One?"
"Yes, yes.
Since the divine person has laid out Heaven's laws,
why not simply reach people directly
and spread it among the populace,
rather than through hierarchy?"
"Excellent, excellent!
Now the ultimate peaceful energy descends from Heaven,
all matters must follow order,
hence the hierarchy.
Without it,
rebellious energy arises,
causing disorder in governance—
largely due to such rebellion and disobedience.
Do you wish to add to this, Perfected One?"
"I dare not."
"Thus, adhere to the hierarchy,
and ask no more."
"Yes, yes."
"Go forth, be cautious in affairs,
each planning for themselves.
These six great faults—
the Way of Heaven is stern,
not to be trifled with;
Heaven watches from above."
"Yes, yes.
May I ask one more thing:
when ordinary people obtain the essential Way and virtue,
"Where should it be placed?"
"It should be presented to the ruler above."
"Why must it be given to him?"
"The essential Way is what secures the ruler,"
"governing by it attains the heart of Heaven."
"The essential Virtue is what nurtures the ruler,"
"governing by it attains the intent of Earth."
"To truly know yet refuse to report to the ruler,"
"all constitutes disrespect,"
"their offense cannot be pardoned."
"Why so severe?"
"Observing your words and deeds,"
"you appear completely ignorant."
"As a child, you fail to examine;"
"as a subject, you lack loyalty and trustworthiness,"
"your transgressions cannot be named."
"You, the Perfected One, ask"
"why the severity is equal?"
"Your learning,"
"why does it not deepen daily,"
"but instead becomes shallower?"
"This foolish student truly does not see."
"You still claim not to see."
"Common people conceal and hide,"
"hoarding the essential Way and Virtue,"
"causing their ruler distress and plunging him into ignorant darkness,"
"the fault lies in the true Way and Virtue being obscured and not communicated."
"Moreover, the essential Way"
"is what corresponds to Heaven;"
"the essential Virtue,"
"is what corresponds to Earth."
"Ignorant people cut them off,"
"Heaven detests them,"
"Earth abhors them,"
"their offenses cannot be pardoned."
"You, Perfected One, are fortunate to be uniquely favored by Heaven with longevity,"
"yet your learning remains incomplete,"
"approaching Heaven's prohibitions,"
"you must be cautious in your duties."
"Yes, yes."
Above is the scripture of Heaven's teaching on harmony that keeps people constantly auspicious and far from misfortune.
"I shall depart soon,"
"admonishing you six with one word."
"The Way is profound,"
"without above or below,"
"without surface or interior,"
"preserve its harmonious energy,"
"this is called spirit;"
"seek it closely and you will greatly attain,"
"seek it distantly and you will lose it."
"Thus ancient rulers skilled in governance,"
"began from within their core,"
"truly able to use the Way,"
"governance naturally followed."
"Act without losing its measures and principles,"
"all things order themselves,"
"near in the heart and mind,"
"spreading throughout the four seas."
"The sages of old called this the essential Way."
"Governance desires non-action,"
"careful not to lose this,"
"this rectifies the worthy."
"Now I repeatedly emphasize to enlighten you."
"You six have questioned my writings for days,"
"though the Way divides into different paths,"
"they all concern one matter."
"Thus the tongue can encompass the six extremes,"
"the kingly Way is complete,"
"explaining all things,"
"each with different meanings."
"Heaven and Earth thereby achieve great peace,"
"the ruler thereby achieves non-action."
"My writings know the divine mind,"
"penetrate the six extremes and eight directions,"
"all descend and submit,"
"each harboring good intentions,"
"without ill will."
"The essence resides within,"
"like all things,"
"the heart inside,"
"branches outside."
"When the inner flourishes,"
"the outer prospers,"
"when the inner declines, the outer declines."
"Thus the ancient emperors and sages of the sovereign Way,"
"wishing to rectify the six extremes and eight directions,"
"first rectified the inner."
"Using the inner to rectify the outer,"
"myriads correspond,"
"countless remain connected;"
"using the outer to rectify the inner,"
"myriads go astray."
"Thus the great sages taught people to think deeply and plan far,"
"close the nine orifices,"
"rest the four limbs,"
"make them undifferentiated,"
"like a circle without end,"
"like a child in the womb without duties,"
"then they can grasp its principle."
"My Way takes this as essential."
"Thus return to having each guard their root."
"When Heaven gives birth to humans,"
"it endows all with the true Way and its implements."
"Thus with a teacher opening, guiding, and teaching,"
"one can become omniscient;"
"if the door is not opened,"
"though receiving Heaven's true Way,"
"one remains ignorant."
"Like an infant born,"
"placed in a room,"
"not taught or guided in affairs,"
"knowing nothing."
"What makes people different"
"is only the varied customs of the eight directions,"
"thus their knowledge and learning differ."
"If one person learns,"
"circulating through surface and interior,"
"they can know everything."
"I shall travel far to a destination,"
"there will be others to instruct,"
"I cannot always sit peacefully,"
"guarding you disciples."
"You six carefully study my writings,"
"from top to bottom there are conclusions,"
"if you don't understand the meaning,"
"examine ancient texts to clarify it."
"The superior practitioner Xuánzhēn knows it,"
"the inferior practitioner Shùnzhēn knows it,"
"the eastern practitioner Chūzhēn knows it,"
"the southern practitioner Tàizhēn knows it,"
"the western practitioner Shàozhēn knows it,"
"the northern practitioner Yōuzhēn knows it."
"The Way is largely similar with minor differences,"
"thus it can distinguish yin and yang without limit,"
"transforming into eleven thousand five hundred twenty characters."
"Harmonizing all things in small measure,"
"unable to fully explore Heaven, Earth, yin, and yang,"
"the absolute profundity without surface or interior."
"Thus only examine its nonexistence,"
"lift its guiding principles,"
"see its beginning,"
"making it possible to model and record."
"Recording ancient and modern,"
"the essential order naturally matches the sacred records,"
"like repeated compasses fitting squares,"
"even separated by countless millennia,"
"as if speaking face to face."
"Thus it can serve as Heaven and Earth's constant standard,"
"as the spiritual Way for yin and yang,"
"do not fault my writings for frequent repetition."
"The reason for repetition"
"is fear of loss."
"Moreover, the Heavenly Way is extremely strict,"
"having spoken, I dare not omit,"
"incomplete transmission is called flawed Way,"
"a grave offense."
"I truly pity this,"
"hence though repetitive."
"Like the upper ancient sages,"
"middle ancient sages,"
"lower ancient sages,"
"all born in different eras,"
"their words interconnected,"
"repeating and explaining,"
"mutually examining and clarifying,"
"then the Heavenly Way becomes fully knowable,"
"this is what it means."
"Go now,"
"I have urgent business,"
"carefully guard Heaven's treasure,"
"transmit and entrust it to the right person."
Above is the admonition to the six disciples.
The True Man bowed again and said:
"This ignorant and humble student has been treated by the Celestial Master with the affection due to an infant,
bestowing profound kindness and love.
Though unworthy, I am fortunate to have daily audience.
The Celestial Master's achievements are immense,
beyond proper gratitude.
Now I wish to inquire further about secret essentials,
the hidden ways of Heaven,
yet dare not speak abruptly."
"Speak plainly.
Since you ask on Heaven's behalf,
you should pursue matters to their conclusion,
not abandon them midway."
"Yes, yes.
This humble student observes that what the Celestial Master explains
has no end or limit.
Later disciples will all inherit this celestial understanding.
The Celestial Master profoundly comprehends the essence of Heaven and Earth's interior and exterior, yin and yang.
Your disciples fear that once parted from the Master,
there will be no further opportunity to resolve doubts through questioning.
Therefore, we boldly and presumptuously
ask about prophecies that can long secure the state,
enabling rulers to govern with folded hands,
free from worries,
constantly enjoying zithers and lutes,
making music while roaming,
secure as Heaven and Earth,
never facing perilous times.
Might this be heard?"
"Indeed,
do you True Men seek spiritual progress?
Profound is your question,
seeking the thoroughly penetrating charts and texts of Heaven and Earth's prophecies,
where a single word remains unchanged for ten thousand generations.
Heaven grieves over numerous disasters and sufferings,
thus sending you True Men to resolve doubts?"
"Yes."
"I shall explain Heaven's fundamental principles and essential guidelines for you True Men,
the secret texts and esoteric instructions,
enabling you to [...].
You True Men should follow along and record this."
"Yes, yes."
"Well then,
August Heaven uses the four seasons as branches,
while solid Earth takes the five phases as its body.
Branches govern decline and prosperity,
the body governs standards and measurements.
Deploying these nine spirits,
they circulate throughout the world,
penetrating above and below to the utmost,
their transformations difficult to perceive.
They serve as Heaven and Earth's precious treasures,
as gateways for all spirits.
They possess inherent constancy,
not to be recklessly violated.
Those who follow them enjoy lasting fortune,
those who disrupt them long oppose Heaven and Earth."
"Yes, yes.
We wish to understand their meaning,
might this be revealed?"
"Excellent,
your words, True Men.
I shall now explain fully for you,
but all must concentrate intently,
sit peacefully and contemplate my words."
"Yes, yes."
"Heaven's constant prophetic patterns
establish the South as the ruler's domain.
Thus the sun in the South represents the ruler,
fire in the South represents the ruler,
the Great Yang in the South represents the ruler,
among the four seasons,
midsummer in the South represents the ruler,
among the five sacrifices,
the hearth in the South represents the ruler,
among the five organs,
the heart in the South represents the ruler.
The ruler,
by law should wear red,
symbolizing fire's activity.
Therefore, when the ruler shows unusual signs,
they always correspond to yang,
not to other activities.
Yang makes the sun most brilliant,
serving as chief among all lights,
thus Heaven's prophecies always use the sun to gauge the ruler's strength and decline.
Do you True Men understand this?"
"Yes, yes,
we begin to understand.
The method for human rulers
should always seek to share households with the benevolent,
governing with heart-minded individuals.
Those who can jointly govern
should constantly practice the Way and cherish life.
Even the small and weak,
and ministers who mature into worthy vessels,
the ruler should nurture them,
not harm them.
Thus the East favors life,
the South favors nurturing.
Those without benevolence in their hearts
cannot long share responsibilities,
those without clarity
cannot serve as rulers.
Thus the East represents wood's benevolence with heart,
the South represents fire's clarity.
Heaven's law
dictates that imperial governance should always use the Way and Virtue,
thus the East represents the Way,
the Way governs life;
the South represents Virtue,
Virtue governs nurturing,
therefore the South governs nurturing.
Governance
should emulate Heaven through cultural transformation,
thus the East represents culture,
manifested by dragons bearing it.
The South represents brilliance,
thus properly creating patterns and brilliance.
Brilliance
means great illumination,
thus culture originates in the East,
becoming illuminated in the South.
Therefore celestial patterns
are red,
red
symbolizes fire.
Benevolence and rulers move upward,
the sun should be high and bright,
providing models for humanity.
Thus when wood and fire move,
they invariably ascend,
symbolizing the ruler.
Therefore residing in the East,
relying on benevolence to ascend,
the ruler should consequently govern from the South.
Thus the East represents Lesser Yang,
the ruler's initial birth,
hence the sun rises in the East.
The South represents Great Yang,
the ruler's full brilliance.
Lesser Yang serves as the ruler's household and parents,
Great Yang serves as the ruler's person,
the ruler's position.
Lesser Yang as the ruler's household,
wood as fire's parent,
the ruler takes Lesser Yang as household,
fire being called wood's child.
Do you True Men understand this?"
"Yes, yes."
"You already understand.
Lesser Yin represents ministers,
ministers bend with righteousness,
submitting to Great Yang.
Thus metal follows fire's bending,
in humans representing desires,
ministers should always bend with righteousness,
assisting the ruler's proper desires,
therefore Lesser Yin signifies ministers.
Do you True Men understand this?"
"Yes, yes."
"Great Yin represents the people,
the people flow without ceasing.
Thus water flows unknowing rest.
The people's
duty is to sustain the state's kings and marquises.
Therefore water
should follow to nurture wood.
The East
represents the ruler's household.
Do you True Men understand this?"
"Yes, yes."
"Good,
you already understand."
"Heaven's prophetic patterns
show Lesser Yang fears Lesser Yin.
Thus ministers
conversely oversee records of the state's kings, marquises, and officials.
Great Yang fears Great Yin,
therefore when the state possesses the Way and Virtue,
and rulers and ministers are wise,
the people follow.
When the state lacks the Way and Virtue,
the people rebel.
Thus the essential principle of governing the state
values numerous people as wealth,
few people as great poverty.
Do you True Men comprehend this?"
"Yes, yes."
"Good,
you are already awakened."
"The normative patterns of Heaven
are divided into six sectors.
The southeast belongs to the upper realm of Heaven,
thus all living things grow upward,
and crawling creatures as well as people emerge outward,
belonging to Heaven.
Therefore Heaven manifests colors accordingly:
externally azure representing wood,
internally crimson representing fire.
Does the Perfected One understand this?"
"Yes, yes."
"Proceed,
you have comprehended."
"The cosmic patterns and correspondences
of the west and north
belong to the lower realm of Earth.
Thus when all things reach autumn and winter,
they descend and return to soil.
When crawling creatures and people reach autumn and winter,
they enter burrows to dwell.
Therefore Earth manifests colors accordingly:
externally yellow-white representing earth and metal,
internally containing water thus black,
representing the northern direction.
Does the Perfected One understand this?"
"Yes, yes."
"Heaven's cosmic correspondences
show the east and south positions as noble,
belonging to the upper realm of Heaven,
governing dominantly,
representing rulers, elders, and masters.
The west and north positions are humble,
belonging to Earth,
representing subjects,
the rear palace,
and common people.
Thus Jǐ is
the rear palace of Jiǎ.
Jiǎ represents Heaven,
the fundamental position of kingship,
therefore Jiǎ corresponds to the Heart Star.
The Heart Star,
being fire,
represents kingship.
Thus the east also signifies the origin of kingship.
The Heart Star,
as fire,
operates under the southern domain.
This resembles the sun rising in the east
yet occupying the southern position.
Does the Perfected One understand this?"
"Yes, yes."
"Proceed,
you have understood."
"Heaven's cosmic correspondences
show Bǐng as the leader of fire,
the most brilliant among them,
representing the ruler's position.
Xīn belongs to Bǐng,
as Xīn
is the rear palace of Bǐng.
Does the Perfected One understand this?"
"Yes, yes."
"Proceed,
you have understood."
"Now Jǐ also represents the empress,
and Xīn also represents the empress,
how is this explained?"
"Excellent question,
your challenge
captures the meaning of celestial correspondences.
Indeed, Jǐ pairs with Jiǎ,
and Jiǎ
is the father of Bǐng,
thus Jǐ constitutes the Grand Empress's palace.
Xīn pairs with Bǐng,
and Bǐng
is the son of Jiǎ.
Therefore Xīn
represents the Lesser Empress's palace;
Bǐng
being Jiǎ's legitimate heir,
receives the mandate as imperial ruler.
Does the Perfected One understand this?"
"Yes, yes."
"Proceed,
the Perfected One has understood."
"Gēng belongs to Yǐ,
being the sons-in-law of feudal lords and kings.
Rén belongs to Dīng,
being the husbands of the emperor's younger sisters.
Guǐ belongs to Wù,
being the maternal families of the Grand Empress."
"Excellent,
the Perfected One has understood."
"Now the ten heavenly stems are explained,
each having their affiliations,
may I inquire about the twelve earthly branches?"
"Well asked!
Heaven's operating principle
shows yīn and yáng progressing
while crossed matters maintain separate households.
Heaven's principle remains constant,
yet not all household members follow each other continuously.
Jiǎ takes Yín as its household,
Yǐ takes Mǎo as its household,
Bǐng takes Wǔ as its household,
Dīng takes Sì as its household,
Wù takes Chén and Xū as its household,
Jǐ takes Chǒu and Wèi as its household,
Gēng takes Shēn as its household,
Xīn takes Yǒu as its household,
Rén takes Zǐ as its household,
Guǐ takes Hài as its household.
Thus the Way of Heaven
governs through cyclical movement.
The Way of Earth
manifests through stability.
Hence there is division of territory,
but no division of people,
possessing land without possessing states.
Thus Heaven and Earth remain unmoving,
while Heaven completes one circulation every day and night,
operating through this constancy.
Therefore the twelve branches remain in their positions,
not following the ten stems in movement.
Do you understand this?"
"Yes, yes."
"The ways of Heaven and Earth,
the four seasons and five phases,
their patterns mutually complete each other,
transforming through different expressions,
circulating through obscure mysteries,
without ultimate conclusion,
only known occasionally by great sages of antiquity.
Though I wish to explain everything to you,
it would be impractical regarding resources,
and too elaborate,
instead causing greater confusion,
making virtuous rulers dizzy and disordered,
uncertain of direction,
therefore I stop here.
Not that I begrudge explaining to you all,
but explanations could continue endlessly,
does the Perfected One understand?"
"Yes, yes."
"Proceed,
you have somewhat awakened.
If virtuous rulers govern according to my celestial correspondences,
not one in ten thousand will be lost.
Thus the Way of Heaven
indeed has fixed boundaries.
Using east and south as symbols of rulership,
belonging to Heaven,
thus called the Son of Heaven.
Using west and north as symbols of the rear palace and subjects,
belonging to Earth,
therefore Earth represents the rear palace.
Does the Perfected One understand this?"
"Yes, yes."
"Heaven's cosmic correspondences
show the east fearing the west.
Since the separation of Heaven and Earth,
rulers following military methods,
activating metal energy,
cause the martial sector to diminish the ruler's symbolic energy.
Fire becomes greatly weakened,
leading to chaotic governance.
If the Perfected One wishes to understand celestial correspondences thoroughly,
from high antiquity through middle antiquity to recent antiquity,
rulers abandoning the Way and Virtue,
activating metal energy and military methods,
their governance becomes entirely inauspicious,
filled with bandits and misfortunes.
Therefore sages of high antiquity deeply understood Heaven's fixed patterns
and dared not govern through weapons and martial sectors.
If emperors wish lasting peace and auspiciousness,
they should follow these celestial correspondences,
urgently restrain metal weapons and military preparations,
and promptly activate the Way and supreme virtue,
to mirror Heaven's patterns,
to accord with the August Heaven's heart,
to permanently suppress all treacherous and inauspicious elements,
achieving immediate response without doubt.
Does the Perfected One understand this?"
"Yes, yes."
"The celestial mandate's pattern dictates that
though the Sun is the ruler,
it greatly fears the Moon instead,
which governs the Water element's movement.
Among the sweet and good waters,
wine stands out.
Wine,
is the king of waters,
the foremost,
the finest of all beverages,
its energy belongs to the Kan position,
presiding over theft and robbery at night.
Hence, indulging in wine is named as wanton excess,
for it makes water reign supreme.
When water rules, the Sun declines.
If you, the sincere seeker, wish to understand the true essence of the celestial mandate,
from the great antiquity onward,
through the middle ages to now,
rulers who indulged in wine
all failed to achieve peace,
their governance instead fell into chaos,
their officials engaged in frequent conflicts,
leading to rampant theft,
which is clear evidence.
Therefore, when a virtuous ruler of peace is governing,
the fire essence should shine bright,
not follow the Moon,
allowing the water virtue to rule,
thereby harming their governance,
so wine must be prohibited."
"I wish to understand the prohibition—
what wine exactly is to be banned?"
"Only market wine is to be banned."
"What has the Celestial Master observed or seen
to specifically prohibit market wine?"
"Well,
the market,
corresponds to the movement of water.
Thus, people and goods from all directions
flow and gather there.
Similarly, rivers and seas,
are also the kings and leaders of water.
So all sorts of wealth and goods from streams
flow and accumulate there too.
Water,
is the movement of the Black Tortoise in the north,
hence greedy,
frequently robbing people of their wealth.
The market, gathering from five directions for profit,
breeds thieves and cunning types,
all arising from the market,
as water governs the Kan position.
The law of heaven
responds distantly by category,
so the market is indeed the water element.
Indulging in wine there,
greatly supplying it,
is again named water's kingship.
Market people, getting wine, rejoice in its rule,
called double water kingship.
Its calamity is sixfold.
It suppresses and weakens the fire energy of the Sun,
causing the ruler's governance to decline,
instead leading to treacherous ministers.
Do you understand, sincere seeker?"
"Now hearing the Celestial Master's explanation,
I'm confused and unclear,
I wish to hear the main principle."
"Excellent,
your words.
Since you sincere seekers have come from afar to ask about heavenly matters,
to relieve the virtuous ruler and emperor from the harm of inherited burdens,
I hold nothing back.
All sit comfortably,
I will explain in detail for you,
stating the main idea."
"Yes, yes."
"The celestial mandate's principle,
involves the rise and use of metal and jade.
When humans greatly promote military affairs,
wood exhausts the primal energy,
and earth gains kingship.
Great earthworks arise,
which are the palaces of the grand empress.
The energy belongs to the northwest,
where the Moon gains great kingship,
then treacherous ministers are born,
acting in the rear palace,
losing their way and soaring up,
earth's kingship makes metal prosper,
following in soaring rise,
the energies of Si and Xin both rise to kingship,
soaring and greatly ascending.
The pattern of heaven
then produces many deceivers in the rear palace,
this is not the fault of the rear palace itself,
but rather named as governance losing the celestial mandate,
losing its great boundary,
causing disasters to cycle back and forth.
Since the beginning of heaven and earth,
previous masters and timely cycles have not reached
the point to fully explain heaven's great boundaries.
Causing emperors to lose the law of heaven's governance,
giving rise to these calamities.
Do you deeply understand, sincere seeker?"
"Yes, yes."
"The celestial mandate,
indulging in wine,
is of the water category.
The market is water's movement,
a great gathering place for people and kingship,
and indulging in wine at the market,
is named the great king of water and wine.
Water's kingship weakens fire's energy,
weakened fire turns to ash,
ash transforms into earth,
then it is named fire,
transferring energy to earth.
Earth gaining kingship raises the land,
with metal and water belonging to the northwest.
The Moon belongs to the people,
ministers instead gain kingship.
Later, treacherous ministers are born,
Si energy rises again,
the rear palace violates affairs,
stirring and rising once more,
the disaster leads to theft,
and banditry without end.
Each lies in indulging water,
harming the yang virtue.
Now, the reason I explain this in detail to you,
seeing you come to ask,
so earnestly and diligently,
knowing it's for the August Heaven's wish to aid the virtuous ruler,
thus I clarify for you the great division of heaven and earth's governance,
what should be emulated,
and not violated again,
for violators will again cause confusion and chaos.
Do you understand?"
"Yes, yes.
I wish to ask one doubt."
"Speak."
"Now, the capital gathers crowds and wealth of all kinds;
does the capital correspond to water's movement?"
"Alas,
you sincere seekers in learning,
why at times clear
and at times obscure?
Not reaching it.
But how can one fully reach it?
However, the capital,
corresponds to the center of earth,
where fire can settle and stop.
Not like the market,
merely a place to gather wealth.
The capital should gather both Dao and virtue,
benevolence and worthiness,
to jointly govern the world.
Why then say the capital and its ruler
should only gather wealth?
How greatly foolish you are!
If you doubt my words,
let me explain for you.
From ancient capitals to now,
those gathering Dao, virtue, and worthies
brought peace to the world under their rule,
while those gathering only treasures and wealth without wise men all fell into chaos.
In your view,
should the capital be like a market,
merely a place to gather wealth, or not?
Do you understand now?"
"Yes, yes."
"I shall reiterate for the Perfected Ones the principles of celestial portents.
The sun is born from Lesser Yang,
and flourishes in Greater Yang;
the moon is born from Lesser Yin,
and flourishes in Greater Yin.
The sun,
being the essence of Heaven,
and the brightness of Yang,
is thus regarded as the ruler,
positioned in the south;
the moon,
being the essence of Earth,
and the brightness of Yin,
is thus regarded as the minister,
positioned in the north.
The south corresponds to day,
the north to night.
Therefore, when the sun gains dominance and governs,
the moon and night wane and shorten;
when the moon gains dominance and governs,
the sun and day wane and shorten.
Thus, when the northern qi prevails,
the southern qi declines;
when the southern qi prevails,
the northern qi declines.
Hence, it is essential to promptly restrain the dominance of alcohol,
to sever the decline of water and metal.
Do the Perfected Ones clearly understand this?"
"Yes, yes."
"The divisions of heaven's pattern are thus:
the yang aspect represents heaven,
maleness,
rulers,
fathers,
elders,
and teachers;
the yin aspect represents earth,
femaleness,
ministers,
children,
common people,
and mothers.
Therefore, the southeast corresponds to yang,
while the northwest corresponds to yin.
If you, the Perfected, wish to truly understand heaven's portents,
know that since the separation of heaven and earth at creation,
whenever military preparations were excessively promoted,
rulers were encouraged to indulge in alcohol,
or rulers followed female governance,
greatly heeding such counsel,
it caused those rulers
to align with lesser yin, greater yin, and earth, belonging to the northwest.
Those who followed such directives
later all fell into chaos and suffered calamities.
The benevolent, virtuous, wise, and sagely all belong to the southeast,
aligned with yang,
and with heaven.
Those who follow these words will later achieve order."
"I wish to hear why the worthy and sagely belong to the southeast?"
"The essence of fire becomes the heart,
and the heart embodies sageliness;
the essence of wood becomes benevolence,
hence its symbol lies in the east.
The southeast nurtures and grows all things,
and the worthy and sagely, gentle and bright, also nurture all things,
without harming them.
Thus, the nature of the sagely and worthy is gentle and bright,
wholly benevolent and enlightened,
with benevolence symbolizing wood,
and enlightenment symbolizing fire,
hence they all reside in the southeast."
"Excellent, excellent!
Upon hearing the Celestial Master's words,
I am greatly enlightened."
"Moreover, according to the pattern laws of heaven's portents,
the southeast is where the celestial Dipper's handle points,
governing the four seasons,
and where kings receive their mandate.
The northwest belongs to earth,
as the Dipper's bowl,
associated with death and exhausted energy,
so when lesser yin and greater yin earth cause a ruler to prevail,
overcoming its yang aspect,
it is called opposing heaven and earth,
thus often leading to chaos.
Do you understand this, Perfected?"
"Yes, yes.
We, the unenlightened students,
due to the Celestial Master's compassion,
are taught the secrets of heaven's portents.
I wish to ask a question,
just one point.
Now, the south is yang,
yet the Yìjīng assigns it Xùn, Lí, and Kūn;
the north is yin,
yet the Yìjīng assigns it Qián, Kǎn, and Gèn."
"Well done!
Your challenge is insightful.
You perceive heaven's subtle intent,
for the Yìjīng
is based on the subtle energies of heaven, earth, yin, and yang,
with primordial energy as the beginning.
Thus, the extreme yang of the south generates yin,
so it records its yin;
the extreme yin of the north generates yang,
so it records its yang;
subtle energies
are not yet able to sustain rulership.
Hence, the Yìjīng's initial nine at midnight
is 'hidden dragon, do not act,'
indicating it is not yet fit for rulership,
so it should not be used.
This
merely represents the beginning of primordial energy."
"Excellent, excellent!"
"Proceed,
for you, Perfected, have understood.
What I record of heaven's portents
pertains to heaven's major divisions,
capable of sustaining celestial governance and energy,
serving as the guiding principles for all under heaven.
Do you understand, Perfected?"
"Yes, yes."
"What I now say
is precisely what the rulers of all under heaven should follow as their method of governance.
Your question
touches upon the beginning of proper energy.
Now, if you, Perfected, have doubts upon hearing my words,
I will fully explain the eight boundaries of heaven and earth for all Perfected."
"Yes, yes."
"The boundary of the sun:
it rises at Mǎo,
sets at Yǒu,
with the south as yang,
the north as yin.
The boundary of heaven's gate and earth's door:
Xùn first arises at the southeast corner,
Qián first arises at the northwest corner,
with the northeast as yang,
the southwest as yin.
At midnight's initial nine,
noon's initial six, the east is yang,
the west is yin.
The beginning of spring at the northeast corner,
the beginning of autumn at the northwest corner,
with the southeast as yang,
the northwest as yin.
These are called the eight boundaries of heaven and earth,
distinguishing the positions of yin and yang.
Do you understand, Perfected?"
"Yes, yes."
"Proceed,
you have understood.
Therefore, in the major divisions, the southeast is heaven,
the northwest is earth,
and earth should be submissive.
If a ruler causes heaven to be subdued by earth, it is a reversal of heaven and earth,
hence inauspicious.
When heaven can perform its functions,
and the ruler can subdue earth, it is accord,
each in its proper place,
hence auspicious.
When you, Perfected, receive this text,
ponder it deeply,
and deliver it to a virtuous ruler,
if he reflects on my words and practices them,
it will be no different from the divine,
and heaven will aid him without delay.
Proceed, my explanation of heaven's portents and proofs is briefly concluded;
though I wish to elaborate greatly for you, Perfected,
on all under heaven and above earth,
the utmost reaches of the eight poles and the array of stars and constellations,
explaining each in detail,
circulating through the subtle mysteries of the heavenly way,
some might become dazzled,
not knowing where it leads,
and later cause the true path to be abandoned,
leaving no means to resolve ancient flowing disasters,
again causing distress above.
Thus, I only explain the major, easily comprehensible parts to you,
to awaken your understanding.
Therefore, I do not speak of the subtle and hard-to-grasp,
not out of吝惜, but caution."
"Yes, yes.
I wish to ask about one more point.
Now, the Celestial Master has explained to us, the unenlightened, the ten heavenly stems,
all having correspondences,
and the twelve earthly branches of the earthly way,
also with yin-yang and odd-even pairs,
so why do only the stems receive heavenly correspondences?"
"Excellent!
Your challenge
can be said to grasp the essence of the Way!
However, earth,
compared to heaven,
is purely yin dwelling alone,
yet it inherently has its own yin and yang.
Heaven and earth follow patterns
that correspond above and below:
heaven has Zǐ,
earth also has Zǐ;
heaven has Wǔ,
earth also has Wǔ;
heaven has Kǎn,
earth also has Kǎn;
heaven has Lí,
earth also has Lí;
their correspondence is like this.
Therefore, Chǒu and Wèi
are the rear palace of Yín.
Shēn belongs to Mǎo,
the son-in-law of feudal kings.
Hài pairs with Chén,
Mǎo pairs with Xū.
Chén and Xū
are the daughters-in-law of the grand empress's family.
Yǒu belongs to Wǔ,
the lesser empress.
Zǐ belongs to Sì,
and Sì is the son-in-law of the emperor's younger sister.
Do you understand, Perfected?"
"Yes, yes."
"Thus, the stems represent emperors,
and the branches also represent emperors.
Therefore, Yín
is the branch of Jiǎ,
so Chǒu and Wèi are called the rear palace.
Wǔ,
Bǐng corresponds to the branch,
thus Yǒu is called the rear palace.
Mǎo,
belonging to Yǐ's branch,
hence Shēn is referred to as the son-in-law of feudal lords and kings.
Chén,
the branch of Wù,
is thus called the household of the Grand Empress.
Hài,
the branch of Guǐ,
is thus called the daughter-in-law of the Grand Empress's household.
Zǐ,
the branch of Rén,
is thus called the son-in-law of the emperor's younger sister.
Sì,
the branch of Dīng,
is thus called the emperor's younger sister.
This is the method by which heaven and earth correspond and harmonize."
"Excellent, excellent!
I wish to hear why, regarding this Chén and Xū ruler,
if it is solely male, they gather together,
if female, they marry together,
what is the reason?"
"Subtle and profound!
Your question is challenging.
However, heaven is the ultimate yang,
earth is the ultimate yin.
Earth is abundant,
the leader of all yin.
Yin is always even in number,
hence they combine."
"Now Wù and Jǐ share the same earth,
why do they not combine?"
"Well asked!
Wù and Jǐ,
being the fifth heavenly stems,
are the yang of earth,
their positions belong to heaven,
thus they do not combine.
Does the enlightened one understand this?"
"Yes, yes."
"Proceed,
you have understood it.
Now the enlightened one questions this.
Now the characters of the five phases rotate and complement each other,
to encompass all affairs under heaven.
You have obtained my writings,
and should by category contemplate their underlying meanings,
the six directions above and below, utterly profound, are all already prepared.
Therefore, the sage sees one to know ten thousand,
the great worthy sees one to know a thousand,
the foolish struggle and only meet with confusion,
failing to grasp the true way.
Thus, the way and its virtue are entrusted to the enlightened one,
does the enlightened one understand this?"
"Yes, yes."
"Proceed,
you have understood it.
I wish to ask about one more matter.
Regarding the four seasons of heaven above,
and the five phases of earth,
all speak of the households of emperors, kings, feudal lords, and their rear palaces,
with the way of heaven fully aligning with them,
is there also pairing with the common people and the myriad things?"
"Excellent!
Your question.
Can be said to behold the essence of the great way.
However, this pairing is the same.
The five phases,
at the top are all emperors and kings,
next are ministers,
then subtle energies.
The royal phase,
is the position of emperors and kings.
The ministerial phase,
is the position of high officials.
Subtle energies,
are the positions of minor officials.
After the royal phase, the old energy,
is the position of feudal lords.
After the old energy, the declining energy,
is the position of the imperial clan.
After the declining energy, the sick energy,
is the omen of the imperial clan committing offenses and losing their posterity.
After the sick energy, the imprisoned energy,
is the image of the common people and the myriad masses.
After the imprisoned energy, the dead energy,
is the image of slaves and servants.
After the dead energy, the perished energy,
is the burial mound of the deceased.
Thus, heaven suspends its images,
the four seasons and five phases circulate,
each with one rise and one decline,
the people and the myriad things all follow the method of heaven's images,
also with one rise and one decline.
Therefore, the myriad people and commoners,
are all descendants of the hundred kings,
rising, they become rulers;
declining, they become the people.
Does the enlightened one understand this?"
"Yes, yes."
"You have already understood it."
The above uses heaven's portents to bring long peace to the state and family, to govern and eliminate treacherous ministers, cut off deceit and cunning, and eradicate them.
The Perfected Person cautiously inquired:
"I wish to compile and standardize all the writings previously presented to the Master,
to prevent learners from making reckless statements.
May I hear your guidance on this?"
"Excellent!
How increasingly diligent you have become in a single day.
Indeed, my Daoist methods
extend outward to regulate the yang,
and inward to regulate the yīn;
outward to regulate conduct,
inward to regulate the spirit;
outward to regulate various texts,
inward to regulate various diagrams;
outward to eliminate disasters,
inward to rectify the self;
outward to regulate court learning,
while inwardly regulating the inner chamber.
All matters must have limits.
Those who diligently pursue learning according to their abilities
may conversely lose the constant methods:
external learning leads to superficial elegance,
unable to restrain themselves;
internal learning fails to follow the correct path,
instead descending into great heresy.
Various learners often possess major flaws
they cannot recognize themselves.
Those inclined to external learning
with excessive talent
often fall into superficiality,
causing the Dào to become greatly distorted,
lacking proper texts,
yet falsely claiming it as true Dào,
further deceiving one another.
Those inclined to internal learning with excessive talent
often descend into great heresy,
believing they have attained it;
not speaking with others,
they instead lose methodological standards and spread falsehoods.
Now your doubts
have brought you to inquire again.
As your intention is sincerely earnest,
steadfast and untroubled,
I shall establish guidelines,
setting boundaries for all to observe
as demarcations to uphold.
With numerous ancient and modern texts,
they cannot all be limited.
All who learn should seek genuine understanding
without violating the fundamentals.
Those learning from oral instructions
should not contradict their teacher's words—
this is the primary essential.
The great harm in learning
lies in conforming to external commentaries:
daily superficiality leading to ornate but empty words.
Those integrating internal texts with prognostic diagrams
fail to grasp the essential meaning deeply,
instead uttering errors.
Those pursuing longevity
while aligning with superficiality
ultimately deceive each other;
those integrating internally without grasping essentials
fall into great heresy.
As you come repeatedly with questions,
I thus present these writings,
revealing their limits:
what conforms to methodological standards
is correct;
what does not
is wrong—
this is clear.
One can know through this.
All texts as celestial discourse:
ten out of ten correspondences indicate truth;
nine indicate minor error;
eight indicate minor chaos;
below this, untruth,
unusable.
Called disrupting celestial and terrestrial patterns,
causing Yīn-Yáng displeasure,
myriad entities conflict,
people suffer great calamity.
Contemplating nature-nurturing methods,
internal clarity of form
is correct;
external perception of myriad spirits
is wrong.
Learning any matter:
adhering to original text
while consulting wise interpretations
is correct;
clinging to commentaries while forgetting fundamentals
is wrong,
losing celestial Dào's intent.
Self-transformation into spirit
is correct;
lacking Dào yet claiming divinity,
self-proclaimed spirit summoning
is wrong—
mere document-driven manipulation.
Explanations aligning beginning, end, and center
are correct;
misalignment is wrong.
Entering contemplation with reduced eating,
progressing to breath sustenance,
gradual dissolution
is correct;
claiming attainment without return,
still questioning
is wrong.
All departures should include return;
guided inquiry
is correct;
unguided inquiry
leads to mortal stagnation.
Maintaining clarity in seclusion
succeeding
is correct;
boasting attainment with angry speech
is wrong—
essence-lost individuals.
Daily improvement through learning
surpassing former self
is correct;
regressing through learning,
lacking sincerity
is wrong—
fallen into great heresy.
Reading comprehendingly
seeking master's explanatory keys
is correct;
reading without master's keys,
claiming unique understanding
is wrong—
internally losing Dào's meaning.
Having attained Dào,
still serving multiple teachers diligently
is correct—
this advances daily progress.
Thus ancient sages knowing Dào
still served teachers
unceasingly;
without teachers, studied texts tirelessly.
Learning while claiming essential grasp,
neglecting ancient texts,
self-approving,
disregarding sages
is wrong—
foolish individuals.
All who learn
exhaustively pursuing knowledge
are correct.
All beings likewise:
achieving full lifespan with substance
is correct;
mere existence
without completed lifespan,
lacking reliability
is wrong.
Good deeds yielding appropriate results
are correct;
inappropriate results
indicate external rightness/internal wrongness.
Studying my texts completely
within bounds
gaining substance
is correct;
extracting novelty from reading,
talented but missing essence
is wrong.
Heaven's winds and rains nurturing timely growth
are correct;
winds and rains harming beings
are wrong—
containing toxicity.
Classical Dào daily flourishing
is correct;
not daily advancing,
but daily declining
indicates internal meaning loss—
wrong.
Thus heaven-earth's nature:
goodness
may not immediately manifest on oneself
but flows to descendants
revealing its conduct;
evil
may not immediately stop with oneself
but flows to descendants
also clearly manifesting through erroneous appearances.
Thus good/evil deeds
will inevitably manifest.
Goodness
resembles sunrise—
increasingly bright;
evil
resembles sunset—
increasingly dark.
This is heaven-earth Yīn-Yáng's natural disposition.
Heaven generates myriad beings,
There is no concealment.
Thus, the virtuous ascend,
their destiny belongs to Heaven,
just as the living belong to Heaven;
the wicked descend,
their destiny belongs to Earth,
as the dead are detestable,
hence they descend to the Yellow Springs,
this is what is meant.
Those who obtain my writings,
should deliver them to the virtuous lord.
I possess this text,
daring not to obstruct but to transmit and read it.
The Way of Heaven governs Heaven,
it cannot be fully known,
nor should one trust the words of a single person.
Now, therefore, I establish for you the ancient texts of the sages,
and further consolidate their combined strategies,
clarifying the writings that precede and follow, relying on each other for verification.
Since the creation of Heaven and Earth,
sages and worthies, though born in different eras,
separated by vast distances,
share the same aversions,
jointly discussing the ways of Heaven,
to remedy the gains and losses of the world;
their words are similar,
as if matching compasses and squares,
mutually illuminating through transmission,
inevitably so.
For things of like kind gather and flourish,
their principle is that like attracts like through resemblance,
this is a clear proof.
To correct what was lost before,
and gain what comes after,
examine and unite differences and similarities to form the text.
Adhere to the ancient to clarify the present,
collectively deliberate on these matters,
using the inner text,
to illuminate the outer text,
and with the outer text,
further examine and connect it to the inner text.
So that it may be transmitted for ten thousand generations,
without repeating faults against Heaven.
The words of one person,
should not be followed alone.
The words of the multitude,
deeply strategized by adopting the sayings of ancient sages and worthies,
align with Heaven within,
collectively established and set in place.
When emperors daily understand and resolve,
all confusion and calamitous evils are eliminated,
Heaven has no repeated worries,
those who collaborate will prosper,
those who resist will not have their disasters removed.
The above is the discernment of gains and losses for the learner.
The Perfected Person bowed again and said,
"I wish to inquire about one matter."
"Very well, speak."
"Now the Celestial Master has brought forth the Qi of Great Peace to impart the Way and its Virtue,
thereby reviving the Supreme Sovereign above,
and above there are rulers who love the Way and its Virtue,
which extends down to us foolish and lowly common folk.
This grace penetrates throughout the six directions,
reaches to the eight extremities,
encompassing everything without exception.
Now that I, unworthy and shallow, have obtained a teacher to learn from literature and scholarship,
and ponder upon the Way in my thoughts,
what is the ultimate goal above,
and what is the foundation below?"
"Excellent!
The Perfected Person's question
is indeed subtle and essential!
Do you wish to hear about the profound ultimate,
to know the advances and retreats of the divine spirits?"
"Truly, I am foolish and obscured in darkness,
unable to grasp such matters,
and can only rely on the enlightened teacher to record and show me."
"Agreed.
The Way has nine degrees,
each distinguished by different terms.
Now I shall elaborate their meanings for you in detail,
follow along and record them,
ensuring nothing is lost."
"Yes, yes."
"Now then,
the first is called Primordial Qi and Non-Action,
the second is Coagulated Tranquility and Emptiness,
the third is Numerical Measures and Discernible Distinctions,
the fourth is Spirit Journeying Out and Returning,
the fifth is the Great Way's Spirits Corresponding to the Four Seasons and Five Phases,
the sixth is Thorny Delights,
the seventh is Community Plots,
the eighth is Vast Spirits,
the ninth is Family Ancestors.
Each of these nine matters is further divided into nine,
making eighty-one headings in total,
with diverse aspects and different texts, used subtly,
they collectively form a single great root,
with the spirit as the agent,
and the human as the gateway.
Now I shall expound them for you item by item,
though it is impossible to pre-record everything in full,
you must ponder their meanings yourself.
The upper three nines, twenty-seven in total,
enable transcendence of the world;
the central three nines, twenty-seven in total,
enable the command of true spirit officials;
the lower three nines, twenty-seven in total,
contain many deviations in their paths,
and their spirit essences cannot be constantly employed.
They cause people to become dazed and confused,
among them are often those lacking in essence,
who frequently err and speak recklessly,
as if losing their Qi."
"Now this foolish student hears the teacher's words,
feeling dizzy and disoriented, not knowing east from west,
I beg you to explain them for this lowly foolish student."
"Very well,
the first, Primordial Qi and Non-Action,
involves contemplating one's body,
engaging in no action,
only thinking of one's body as transparent and luminous,
as if entrusting to Qi without form.
Always take this as the method;
once accomplished, there is nothing one cannot do or know.
Thus, when a person lacks the Way,
they are merely human,
but upon attaining the Way, they transform and become divine immortals;
their spirit ascends to heaven,
changing with heaven,
this is what is meant by 'there is nothing one cannot do.'
The second, Emptiness and Spontaneity,
involves guarding the form in transparent emptiness and spontaneity,
without anything extraordinary;
the body illuminated and white within,
from top to bottom like jade,
without any flaws.
Practicing this accumulation over a long time,
is also a method for transcending the world,
this follows the image of Primordial Qi and Non-Action.
The third, Numerical Measures,
involves accumulating essence and turning the vision inward,
counting from the hair on the head down to the feet,
distinguishing the five fingers,
describing the body inside and out,
leaving nothing uncounted.
Knowing its meaning,
one should always keep this in mind,
not missing a hair's breadth.
This too is a minor method for transcending the world,
following Emptiness.
The fourth, Spirit Journeying Out,
involves contemplating the spirits of the five viscera,
their going out and coming in by day,
seeing their travels,
and being able to speak with them.
Following the spirits in thought as they come and go,
one also sees through one's own body,
this enables knowing good and bad fortune,
following Numerical Measures.
The fifth, the Great Way's Spirits,
involves the human spirit going out,
corresponding to the Five Phases and Four Seasons,
green, red, white, yellow, black,
all matching the visceral spirits,
coming and going, entering and exiting.
The spirit officials of the Four Seasons and Five Phases serve humans,
this is called possessing the Way,
and can subdue all evils.
The sixth, Thorny Delights,
involves pricking the ground,
each path spirit has its own canon,
according to their family methods,
summoning spirits to roam,
half resembling the true,
half resembling the false,
rather making people crafty,
cannot be constantly employed,
over time it troubles people.
The seventh, Community Plots,
involves spirits of heaven, earth, the four seasons,
the altars of soil and grain, mountains and rivers,
descending upon people during sacrifices,
making people dazed,
inclined to speak recklessly of these spirits,
violent, vengeful, mad, and false,
should not be recklessly practiced.
The eighth, Vast Spirits,
refers to spirits that are vast and boundless,
their path having no fixed affiliation,
the essential Qi of heaven and earth descending upon people,
causing people to speak recklessly,
half resembling the true,
half resembling the false.
The ninth, Family Ancestors,
involves purely seeing ghosts,
without any true Way.
Those summoned
are purely ghosts of the dead coming.
This is the lowest extreme of the Way,
called the lowest level.
Those who attain the higher Way
can also command the lower,
while those who attain the lower Way
cannot command the higher."
"Now I wish to hear why there are these upper and lower distinctions?"
"Well,
this
is due to what people practice.
Those who guard the root attain the upper,
those fond of their body spirits going out and roaming attain the middle,
foolish people damage their root and guard the branches,
those engaging in other spirit journeys attain the lower.
Those guarding the root can see everything completely,
those guarding the middle see half,
those guarding the branches cannot reflect and see the Way themselves.
Therefore, all learners
must obtain an enlightened teacher;
without an enlightened teacher,
they lose the path.
Thus, transmission from teacher to teacher
is firmer than metal or stone.
Without receiving it from a teacher,
it is called reckless creation,
leading to ominous falsehoods.
