If one does not prepare for them in advance,
and falls ill,
only then seeking means to eliminate them,
one will already have reached great distress
and suffered from the ailment.
Do you understand this?"
"Yes, yes."
"These are still among the smallest and most trivial prepared things in the world,
so what can be said about the vastly greater ones?
Throughout heaven and earth,
there constantly exist these violent ghosts, evil entities, ominous disasters, corpse-related misfortunes, and lethal visitors.
When they come to afflict people,
it is like the arrows of swords, spears, and crossbows poisoning the body.
The affliction causes unbearable pain,
and in its most violent and severe form,
one cannot even exhale before needing to inhale,
cannot lean before needing to stand,
and the body becomes wildly frenzied.
It is like a remote pavilion, far from the emperor's county officials,
where communication is blocked and people's words are cut off,
preventing them from reporting changing events.
At such a time,
only then seeking skilled masters and elders to save oneself,
one is already in dire straits.
When speech is no longer possible,
there is no way left to express it.
Do you understand this?"
"Yes, yes."
"Well,
you have now become aware.
Therefore, I am especially urgent. This
death,
is the gravest inauspicious event in the world.
Hence, my text is earnest, teaching
virtuous rulers to prepare for it.
The superior wise, upon seeing my words,
will surely be greatly awakened;
the middling wise, upon seeing my words,
will be slightly awakened;
the inferior foolish will not awaken,
instead laughing that my text does not cover its fundamentals,
and thus they will have brought themselves to ruin.
Heaven, earth, and emperors
are no exception to this.
Now, as the Great Peace qi arrives,
and the virtuous ruler of Yang governs,
it should last long.
For all deaths under heaven,
it is no small matter.
Once dead,
one will never again see heaven, earth, sun, or moon for all eternity,
with pulses and bones turning into mud and soil.
Death's decree
is a grave matter.
Humans dwell between heaven and earth,
each person gets one life,
and cannot live again.
Those who live again are only the Daoists,
who die and are reborn,
or those who achieve liberation through the corpse.
These are
favored privately by heaven and earth,
not even one in ten thousand.
Thus, once an ordinary person dies,
they do not live again.
Therefore, one should greatly prepare for it.
Even in years of Great Peace qi and joy,
there are still evil qi.
It is like a family that, though good,
still has wicked people within,
merely tolerating each other.
Hence, gathering more Daoist practitioners is advised,
for when there is something amiss,
it should be promptly eliminated.
If not swiftly removed,
it will thrive.
Thus, I teach to prepare and multiply such people.
The great learning is to accumulate more people of virtue and Dao,
so they can be sought and found when needed;
if not stored up in advance,
they cannot be obtained quickly;
if unexpected events occur,
and one wishes to inquire about ancient and modern parallels,
without having deeply virtuous people prepared,
none can promptly respond and explain.
This leaves the ruler in darkness and obscurity.
When sudden doubts arise,
and they are not resolved timely to alleviate worry,
only then seeking distant wise and deeply skilled individuals,
how can it match the urgency of the present moment?
Do you, the Perfected, understand this?" "Yes, yes."
"Well,
you are now greatly awakened."
"Although each time I speak, I risk fault and blame,
not asking would leave me ignorant.
I wish to resolve one matter."
"Speak."
"Now, some may number ten thousand in height,
middling several thousand,
lower several hundred;
how can they be quickly obtained or accomplished?"
"Excellent,
your question.
Simply teach tens of people to accomplish good,
and they will naturally influence each other in turn.
Some will show swift results,
some will achieve success.
Have the superior virtuous Daoist ruler value and cherish them,
rewarding those with merit.
The masses will then aspire to it,
and as they aspire, they will greatly follow,
encouraging them to act.
Those who achieve will be collectively respected and loved.
These are the divine essences of the four seasons, five phases, and heaven and earth.
When seen as respected and beloved,
none are not pleased and joyful,
bringing auspiciousness to people.
The virtuous ruler will long receive their blessings,
and all wise, deep, and even foolish people
will strive to do it.
As doers increase daily,
over a long time,
all, great and small, will be transformed.
When everyone can do it,
then select and gather those with the greatest merit,
appointing the highly meritorious to positions,
rewarding the slightly meritorious.
All under heaven will desire to do it.
Only fear that there may be too many,
too numerous to record.
Why worry about having too few?
How greatly foolish, dark, and ignorant you are, Perfected!
In matters of great decision,
do not employ those who only love grand talk;
such people are of no benefit to others.
But emulate those who,
consistently achieve success;
they are the ones who grasp the Dao's intent,
truly trustworthy people.
Know that those who merely speak often
without significant results
are those who do not grasp the Dao's intent and talk recklessly,
greatly deceitful people,
not to be employed,
as they bring chaos to the Dao.
Do you, the Perfected, understand this?"
"Yes, yes."
"Go now,
be cautious and heedful.
Recite and read my book,
thinking only of its meanings throughout,
categorizing them accordingly,
further comparing and verifying them,
to make them complete.
Then you will greatly understand,
knowing the direction and essence of my Dao."
"Yes, yes."
"I wish to inquire about a great principle:
why does the deity of the East hold a spear?"
"Well,
you need not ask,
for you, the sincere seeker, surely know it yourself."
"The reason I ask is that
the Celestial Master, in his compassion, has established teachings for later generations.
If I do not ask, then those in later ages will not understand the decisive meaning of the Heavenly Way."
"In this case,
it is a symbol of Heaven,
where all things follow their own categories.
The East is where things first sprout and emerge,
fully developing their sharpness,
piercing through the soil to appear.
Their essence resembles a spear,
hence the spear is used;
when its divine officials come,
they take this as their token.
In the South, all things hang their branches and spread leaves like halberds,
so their essence is spirited and holds halberds;
when its divine officials come,
they take this as their token.
The West has bows, crossbows, and axes;
the West represents Heaven's crossbow, a symbol of killing,
for bows, crossbows, and axes
are also the foremost in causing harm;
thus, when its deities come,
they take these as their token.
The North has shields and knives;
the North is where things lie hidden and flee,
and shields are used to conceal the body in escape;
as for knives,
they are wielded by petty persons,
often used to evade and harm others,
not possessed by noble gentlemen;
therefore, when its deities come,
they also take these as their token.
The Center
is represented by thunder, drums, and swords;
the Center
is Earth,
the master of the Five Phases,
and drums are also the chief of the five weapons,
while swords are worn by gentlemen and those of moral virtue,
also the chief of the five weapons;
thus, when the central deities come,
they take these as their token.
These are the true and trustworthy tallies of Heaven and Earth's natural order.
It is like humans being born with heads;
in response, they hold their tokens,
the true tallies that verify and correspond.
If not so,
then it is not the proper deity in action.
If other deities falsely respond,
it all leads to chaotic governance,
and over time, order becomes difficult to stabilize and pacify.
Therefore, all seek the trustworthy tallies.
Do you, the sincere seeker, understand this?"
"Yes, yes."
"This explanation is shallow yet profound;
though it may seem insufficient to speak of,
it should instead harmonize with the qi of Heaven, Earth, the four seasons, and the Five Phases."
"Excellent, excellent!"
"Proceed,
for you, the sincere seeker, understand it now."
Above is the formula for suppressing evil persons and transforming them entirely to follow the Way to save their lives.
Upholding the Way and Virtue and accumulating goodness
leads to thorough harmony with the essential qi of Heaven, Earth, spirits, and deities,
the qi of the people, crawling creatures, all things, the four seasons, and the Five Phases.
Constantly interacting with them,
none fail to recognize the goodness therein.
The first category: Great Compassion and Filial Piety:
Compassion and filial piety
arise from within the heart,
thoughts stored and expressed,
attainable without learning,
a natural art.
Their actions align with the heart of Heaven,
their intentions unite with Earth.
Above, they benefit the sovereign;
below, they serve as models for the common people's prosperity.
They can attract harmonious qi,
setting an example for others as pioneers.
Their conduct is as vivid as paintings,
hence they are ranked first.
The second category: Understanding the Way and Virtue with Great Gentleness:
Mastering the classics and the Way and Virtue,
leading the common people,
learning to love the Way,
skillfully accumulating virtue,
preventing theft and robbery,
benefiting the sovereign's transformation above,
this is the most auspicious and genuine.
The third category: Filial Piety and Fraternal Respect Beginning to Learn and Transform Toward Goodness:
Starting to learn and desiring to do good,
with some hope in the heart,
turning from evil to righteousness,
yet only beginning to form humane conduct, not fully transformed.
The fourth category: Diligent and Cautious Farming Families:
Farming families of diligent and careful sons,
working from dawn,
resting at sunset,
not avoiding toil and hardship,
accumulating daily,
harmonious at home,
supporting their parents,
benefiting from the land's bounty,
following the Way of Heaven,
daring not to do wrong,
benefiting the local officials.
The fifth category: Greatly Unbenevolent Sons and
Unrighteous Youth Fond of Weapons and Gathering for Evil:
Unrighteous persons,
unbenevolent sons,
disregarding reason,
cursing Heaven and striking Earth,
not supporting parents,
always carrying weapons,
terrorizing the village,
frivolous and young,
contributing nothing to the transformation of Heaven and Earth,
instead causing great harm.
Joint efforts should capture them,
discarding them in ditches,
not allowing burial.
The sixth category: Disharmonious Families,
Deceiving the Elderly and Favoring the Young,
Sharing Food but Holding Separate Wealth:
The family is bound to decline,
kin are discordant,
unable to teach each other,
spreading falsehoods and interactions,
evading one another,
abandoning the root for the trivial,
their calamity beyond rescue.
The seventh category: Repenting of Faults and Abandoning Weapons:
Born in impoverished neighborhoods,
rarely hearing or seeing much,
unaware of good and evil,
having faults under Heaven,
actions not aligning with Heaven,
relying on an enlightened ruler
to guide them toward goodness.
Knowing little in youth,
regretting it when grown,
having good and wise people mark their areas with five-foot poles,
eventually leaving the category,
scholars should examine and question them,
so that one day all people may become good.
The eighth category: Repenting of Faults and Returning to Goodness:
If learning at home fails,
disasters and chaos arise,
but relying on an enlightened ruler
who knows their circumstances;
enabling them to repent of faults,
even becoming teachers for others.
The ninth category: Greatly Evil Persons, Corrupt and Ruining Transformation:
Holding sinecures, wicked, greedy, and thieving,
deceiving superiors and harming subordinates, great hypocrites,
termed official thieves,
in human form,
with the greed of beasts,
benefiting neither Heaven, Earth, yin, nor yang,
their deep calamities deserving execution and demise.
The tenth category: Eliminating Faults, Restoring Righteousness, and Regretting Misdeeds:
Repenting of faults, changing conduct, and transforming the heart,
having little goodness in youth,
disasters frequently occurring,
reforming morning errors by evening,
they are called good people.
These ten categories
are the methods of the ancient sages and worthies,
encouraging people to do good,
preventing mutual harm,
desiring each to live out their natural lifespan,
returning to the Way,
cutting off the roots of evil,
to witness the qi of great peace.
All spirits use regulations to correct,

The revered positions of heaven and earth,

heaven's law,

Carefully ponder these words,

enabling self-awareness of gains and losses.
In learning, what is most urgent?
Thus, two matters are presented,
clarifying the signs of success and failure for scholars.
Since the beginning of creation,
two urgent practices exist,
the rest may be known or not,

What heaven, earth, and the sages prioritize,
what should be promoted and greatly attained,

Longevity
means sharing the same care as heaven and earth.
Filial piety
means sharing the same strength as heaven and earth.

sharing the essence with heaven.
The filial
obediently support those above them,

These two matters
capture the intent of heaven and earth,
and harm naturally recedes.
Deeply contemplate this meaning,
for it is the principle of great peace,
the essence of long life.
Among those wishing to do good,

the ruler

Therefore, these three
are the gateways to life and destiny.
Deeply ponder these words,
and all harms are eliminated.
Longevity and filial piety
are beloved by the spirits.

attract all misfortunes.
This Way follows nature effortlessly,

observe how it aligns with human intent toward good or evil.
The mind plans affairs within,

note the correspondence like shadow and echo.
The heart, through intent, is the gateway to fortune and misfortune.

the ministers erred too.
Intent

not to be disturbed recklessly,
lest it disrupt harmonious energy,
giving rise to daily disasters.

"May I ask why the three luminances of heaven

partially comprehending its meaning,

now the sun is Great Yáng,

If you do not practice them and have many illnesses and disasters,
it is Heaven's anger and distress,
you obstructing and hindering the Way.
For fire's misfortunes, do not ask others;
take the effect from this,
clear as the sun and moon.
What Heaven's will desires to do,
you must not be incautious;
not practicing and not complying
causes people's hearts to be confused.
Sincere seeker, be cautious of this."
"Yes, yes."
"Go now,
and I admonish you, the Perfected One, once more.
If Heaven does not wish it to be carried out,
and you alone pursue it,
you will surely suffer illness.
My text takes this as a testament;
from this time onward,
it shall all be thus.
The text has already been repeated,
and I shall not add more words to lengthen it,
lest the Way become difficult to comprehend."
"Yes, yes."
"Go now,
and I admonish you once again:
these calamities and illnesses
are not the fault of a single generation;
their origins stretch far back in time.
Do not hastily retaliate against them,
but instead practice the Way of Heaven
to dissipate and eliminate them.
By doing so,
you will attain what is called the will of Heaven.
If you do not follow the words of my text,
and again wrongly hasten with punishments,
calamities will increase daily,
and Heaven will not be pleased.
Do you understand this, Perfected One?"
"Yes, yes."
"I venture to ask: in ancient times when the Fire Phase prevailed,
it too should have brought about Great Peace,
yet it did not rectify the Divine Way.
Why is it that now the Celestial Master uniquely causes the Fire Phase to rectify the Divine Way?"
"Excellent!
Your question is profound.
Thus, a hundred people have a hundred intentions,
a thousand people have a thousand intentions,
and ten thousand people have ten thousand intentions;
their strategies differ, each unique,
so most fail to grasp the will of Heaven.
Your words, Perfected One, are correct.
Now it is precisely the Fire energy that is most abundant;
the Supreme August energy has arrived,
which is but an auxiliary.
In ancient times when the Fire Phase prevailed,
after the era of Great Peace energy,
since the opening of Heaven and Earth,
there has never been anything like this."
"Why is it that when Fire energy is abundant,
the Divine Way must be rectified?
I wish to hear the meaning behind this."
"Indeed,
Fire
is the heart of Heaven.
The heart governs the spirit;
if the heart is upright, then the spirit will be clear.
Therefore, Heaven sent me down to regulate the Divine Way."
"But the Divine Way is inherently divine;
why must it be regulated?"
"Excellent,
your words.
The spirit
is the rightful official of Heaven.
Now there are many evil spirits,
so the rightful spirits cannot occupy their proper places;
within the Heavenly Divine Way, there is great chaos,
and all have lost their abodes.
Now the celestial energy is disordered,
causing emperors and kings to worry and suffer,
and people do not understand the essential meaning.
If you wish to know it joyfully,
this is comparable to human affairs.
Now many evil people hold positions,
collectively disrupting the governance of emperors and kings,
so that upright people cannot find their place.
Heaven and Earth thus lose their harmony due to these evil energies.
Where evil is abundant, it collectively harms the upright;
where uprightness is abundant, it collectively restrains evil.
These two aspects
are the natural art of Heaven and Earth.
Do you understand this?
Therefore, I cause the Sun's energy to be most abundant,
unprecedented.
The Yang is called divine,
hence Heaven is divine.
The Yin is called evil;
thus, treacherous energy often moves within the Yin,
not daring to travel by daylight.
If treachery travels by daylight,
it is named Yin riding the Yang's path;
if illness arises by day,
it is named Yin flourishing,
causing Yang to lose its way.
The ruler's decline and intervals have been thus for a long time.
Therefore, Heaven commands me to rectify the Divine Way,
so that it dares not act thus again.
Do you understand this?"
"Yes, yes.
Excellent, excellent!"
"May I ask, when the ultimate supreme harmonious energy arrives, there is nothing that cannot be governed.
Thus, the Celestial Master examines how ulcers, scabies, and parasites harm people.
Is this verified solely by this?
What about the other parasites?"
"Excellent!
You, the sincere one, are inquiring about matters this morning.
Is Heaven urging you to ask this?
Heaven greatly despises people doing evil,
cunning officials and commoners defy Heaven and oppose Earth,
together deceiving their superiors,
secretly harboring treachery and accumulating it over time,
just like parasites harming people,
Heaven fiercely detests this.
Hence, it makes you repeatedly question it.
However, parasites harming people
are what is called governing through parasites.
Their disasters are the most severe,
representing rebellious energy disrupting the proper order.
Now that the emperor's harmonious energy has arrived,
such responses should not occur.
You, the sincere one, are entrusted to the virtuous ruler,
wishing to understand the profound harmony of the Way,
yet not having the common people fully transfer the names of the parasite masters,
what are the types of parasites causing harm, large and small?
I refer to ulcers, plagues, wounds, and scabies,
all originating from the three types of parasites in the abdomen,
all transfer the master names.
Those with many transfers
certainly have many parasites governing people below.
Where these parasites are absent,
there are no parasites governing people below.
Where there are few,
few parasites govern people."
"Excellent!
I, ignorant and dim,
observing this, thought it was the nature of Heaven,
so does it respond to governance in opposition?"
"You are indeed foolish,
how deeply pained you are.
In the nature of Heaven and Earth, humans are noble,
parasites are the lowliest,
yet they all harm people in reverse,
this is opposition to the proper order.
It symbolizes base people without virtue,
using parasites to harm others.
Thus, Heaven clearly sees this phenomenon,
so it makes sages and worthies strategize,
to correct the proper order.
All disasters and anomalies appear according to their categories,
hence the sages and worthies of ancient times could understand them.
If not categorized by type,
they cannot be contemplated or strategized.
The reason they hide internally
symbolizes those below conspiring in treachery,
not daring to appear externally.
The external
is yang.
Yang
is Heaven,
the ruler.
Heaven rectifies the emperor.
Thus, parasites hide internally and secretly harm people,
symbolizing ministers without merit,
hiding internally and secretly gnawing at people like silkworms."
"How alarming!
I am deeply afraid of it."
"You know to fear Heaven,
that is right;
if not fearing Heaven,
you would have died long ago.
Be cautious, sincere one."
"Yes, yes.
Therefore, in ancient governance,
with spirits, true spirits were invoked to govern;
with ghosts, ghosts were invoked to govern;
with creatures, creatures were invoked to govern;
with parasites, governing parasites was used to govern;
why fear?
I wish to hear about it."
"Now, spirits act
in harmony with Heaven's heart,
in agreement with the divine will.
Thus, spirits
are Heaven's envoys,
loved by Heaven.
Ghosts act
avoiding places where people are,
ghosts rely on the yin realm,
secretly using hidden words like ghosts,
hence invoking ghosts.
Creatures act
collectively deceiving their superiors,
cunning like creatures,
hence invoking creatures.
Parasites act
profiting from people,
collectively profiting from their superiors,
their intentions mixed and varied,
hence invoking parasites.
Heaven and its transformations correspond,
all like this.
When the virtuous ruler of Great Peace receives writings from the world,
tracing the intent behind disasters and anomalies to respond,
the correction is divine indeed!"
"Excellent, excellent!
The calamitous energy is already thoroughly harmonized."

"Seeing the Celestial Master's correction,

hence it is harmonized."
"You may be said to understand the intent of the Way!"
"May I ask, what do the repeated characters govern?
They govern guiding correctness,
guiding correctness to open the spirit for contemplation.
Focus and enter the chamber,
using it as a guarantee,
how is it done?
May I hear about it?"
"Yes,
easy to know yet subtle and secret,
these words are light yet weighty,
not to be recklessly transmitted.
Those who are refined swallow them,
it is called divine;
those not refined swallow them,
it is called not divine.
The unrefined swallowing them
is called false speech.
Therefore, the Way
is transmitted only to the right person to be practiced.
In all matters,
with the right person, it becomes clear;
with the wrong person, it is called reckless practice,
the fault returns to affect the person,
do you understand, sincere one?"
"Yes, yes.
I dare not act recklessly,
truly entrusting it to the right person."
"For one like you, I will explain:
use cinnabar for the characters,
starting from the top first,
then proceeding downward to instruct others,
they must bathe and focus their essence,
facing north, west, south, or east to receive instruction,
have them solemnly use good wine,
like clear water after drinking,
contemplate the characters,
eternally making it their practice for the body.
And say, towards correct and peaceful good energy arriving,
illness is thereby removed,
face increasingly moist and radiant,
or see the characters,
contemplate according to where the illness resides,
called returning essence to nourish the form.
If done by those without illness,
they become more tranquil daily.
If the body has strong evil spirits or entities,
they may resist and struggle,
even if fiercely contending, remain as is,
strive to contemplate without confusion,
eventually they will submit and leave.
After this,
Heaven delights in people being upright,
using other texts for it,
celestial spirits also assist from above,
following human intentions back and forth.
Superior practitioners see others swallowing characters,
contemplate similarly upon return,
even one swallowed character can teach.
Thus, it is said the Way of Heaven acts in a single morning.
My way of practice
does not emulate mere words,
but establishes correspondence with Heaven's Way in resonance,
thereby becoming divine.
Be cautious, sincere one.
Once celestial spirits are opened,
the Way returns to the virtuous ruler,
entrusted to the worthy and good,
people establish themselves correctly,
clearly benefiting the ruler's governance.
The virtuous ruler and enlightened teacher inform them,
using authority as solemnity,
all reported healings are validated,
witnessing spirits and deities,
be careful not to speak of it.
Superior practitioners thus achieve transcendence,
middling practitioners reach non-action,
lower practitioners attain balance.
What people gain varies in depth,
celestial spirits command according to talismanic writings,
hence say not to transmit it,
their contemplations must not differ.
If different,
they cannot communicate.
True and easy!
Such is the Way.
Essential and concise!
Such is the aspiration for longevity.
Thus, learning it,
the person will naturally become compliant."
To improve oneself,
there are divine spirits,
transforming their hearts and minds,
making them joyful.
If today they absorb my words,
later they can all teach through other texts,
teaching tens, hundreds, and thousands in mutual response,
the Way unfolds in an instant,
circulating through the eight directions and six realms,
with the spirit following along to heal illnesses.
Hence, from this time onward,
all people under heaven will swiftly correct their conduct,
all delighting in the true texts,
no longer engaging in deceit and falsehood.
If the Zhēnrén wishes to delight in and pacify the Way of heaven and earth,
making it swiftly upright,
it is foremost to practice the threefold method of circulating texts."
"I wish to hear about the aforementioned method."
"Excellent,
your inquiry.
The foolish are hard to correct,
they disrupt governance like chaos,
causing the virtuous ruler distress.
Thus, circulating texts is proposed first,
so that all, high and low, great and small,
may mutually correct each other,
and common people avoid the harm of isolated arguments and contentious scholars."
"Excellent, excellent!
I wish to hear about the threefold method of circulating texts,
why not just compile one set of texts to circulate,
but necessarily have numerous texts before and after."
"Excellent, excellent!
Your words,
align with the will of heaven,
the reason for having sequential and challenging inquiries
is to make common people deeply aware of their own faults.
Solitary speech is a grave ailment,
without seeing the evil of isolated words and single texts,
one cannot perceive the goodness of compiled circulating texts,
not transmitting their errors,
distinguishing their major faults,
all to enlighten people's hearts,
only then can they be saved.
If hearts are not enlightened,
and they do not understand their actions,
it leads to prolonged and great error.
When people's hearts awaken, they are easily corrected.
All my writings,
are like this,
not solely this instance.
Do you understand?"
"Yes, yes."
"Proceed,
you have understood.
Zhēnrén, be cautious in affairs,
the texts are sufficient,
do not lightly ask numerous questions,
though I wish not to explain to you,
fearing to disappoint your intent,

Now, the great texts of the Way,
and the Way of heaven cannot be fully grasped in phrases,
grasping its intent,
heaven greatly rejoices,
failing to grasp its intent,
contradicts the Way of heaven,
instead bringing blame upon heaven,

Go forth."

"Now this ignorant student has received the Celestial Master's writings,
compiled various texts and medicinal formulas,
returned to live in quiet seclusion,
carefully contemplating their essential meanings.

and I wish to ask about one matter to speak of it.

those with perfect ten-out-of-ten cure rates
are administered by celestial spirits;
those with nine-out-of-ten cure rates
are administered by earthly spirits;
those with eight-out-of-ten cure rates
are administered by human essence spirits.
Beyond this below,
they cannot be used.
This ignorant student believes that only those which obtain their restraining force can control things,
being able to mutually govern them;
those that don't obtain their restraining force
cannot mutually govern them."
"Excellent!
Your words, O Perfected,
grasp the difficult meaning.
Indeed, all that permeates the infinite cosmos,
what the eye sees,
what the ear hears,
all creeping creatures,
are entirely born by Heaven;
if Heaven didn't birth them,
they wouldn't exist.
Consequently, each has its own spirit ruler,
with life belonging to each accordingly.
Compare it to the six domestic animals:
their lives belong to humans,
their death and life depend solely on humans;
humans are thus the life-controlling spirits of the six domestic animals.
Thus, all twelve thousand things receive Heaven and Earth's governance to function;
if one thing is missing,
then Heaven's governance has an insufficiency,
therefore making them control and subdue each other.
Accordingly, each is again given its own hierarchy of noble and base, rulers and subordinates,
so the Heavenly Way can entirely govern and control them.
Obtaining what they fear,
and those with perfect ten-out-of-ten cure rates,
means their lives belong to Heaven.
Do you understand this, Perfected?"
"Yes, yes."
"Proceed,
you already know it."
"May I ask about one doubt,
though it's very disrespectful;
how can I not speak of it?"
"Speak calmly without taboo."
"Now, when robbers and thieves plunder people,

can they be considered as having天命 (Mandate of Heaven) as rulers?"
"Excellent!
Your challenging question.

merely act without righteousness,
arbitrarily and wrongly subduing people;
they cannot subdue them permanently.
Once they subdue people wrongly,
they immediately incur heavy punishment,
with officials pursuing them relentlessly.
How can you say this is天命 (Mandate of Heaven)?

All humans in life take the king as their ruler
and as their destiny.

"Now I greatly understand."
"Excellent, excellent!
Practicing learners should refine this;
also do not question recklessly,
for Heaven will reprove humans."
"Yes, yes."
"There is fault, there is fault or not;
be reverent and cautious,
do not merely speak like common folk who speak as they wish."
"Yes, yes.
Now, whenever this ignorant student speaks, there is severe fault;
but not speaking,
there's no way to gain understanding.
Now wishing to ask more questions,
I dare not speak abruptly."
"Speak calmly."
"Now, since all things individually have their rulers,

"Ah!
How profoundly subtle and far-reaching is your challenging question!"
"Now I know my question is disrespectful,
not meeting the occasion for the Celestial Master's inquiry,

"Indeed,
Heaven takes the highest at the central pole as its ruler;
Earth takes the Kūnlún ruins as its ruler;
the Sun takes the kingly days as its ruler;
the Moon takes the great months as its ruler;

the hundred rivers take the rivers and seas as their ruler;
armored creatures take the divine turtle as their ruler;

flying winged creatures take the fènghuáng as their ruler;

naked insects take humans as their ruler;
humans take the emperor as their ruler.

too many to record;

showing the beginning;
do you understand?"
"Yes, yes."
"You should deeply contemplate its meaning yourself;
it also cannot be fully recorded,
being difficult for material use."
"Yes, yes."
"Now therefore, regarding crawling creatures with awareness,
those currently in their bodies,
not awaiting completion of affairs,
why not recklessly kill or harm them?

Now the Great Peace energy arrives,
we should join forces with virtuous rulers to govern,
not recklessly harm,
else we disrupt the Great Peace energy,
causing governance to become chaotic."
"How can such small things affect Heaven,
making its governance chaotic?"
"Ah!
You remain foolishly ignorant,
not greatly understanding.
Now, each has its own ruler;
like lowly persons from distant four borders,
the lowliest under the emperor, worse than ants and evil men,
beyond comparison.
If people without cause injure or kill these hundred-plus persons,
their families, feeling wronged,
petition the emperor;
the emperor, hearing it, becomes greatly angered,
issues orders to investigate with documents,
causing commotion in provinces, commanderies, and counties as a major affair,
resulting in many facing danger and destruction;
not just one person.
Do you understand?"
"How terrifying!
How terrifying!"
"Proceed,
knowing great terror,
you will then attain long life."
"Yes, yes."
"Therefore, the sage kings of antiquity knew Heaven's laws and patterns were clear and manifest,
thus dared not recklessly use punishments;
this was the pinnacle of deep thought and far-reaching consideration.

not using brute force,

because they were deeply cautious.

and through inherited burden afterwards,
each had gains and losses,
making governance difficult to pacify.

"Yes, yes."
"Now the Great Peace energy arrives,

"Yes, yes."
The above collects difficulties about medicinal formulas, life belonging, and things each having their own rulers.
"I wish to ask why yang alone is esteemed and honored,
while yin alone is named lowly and humble?"
"Excellent!
Your question
nearly grasps the meaning of the Way and its Virtue.
The reason yang alone is named esteemed and honored
is that it holds to the root, is constantly full and overflowing, and possesses substance;
the reason yin alone is named lowly and humble
is that it is empty and void and lacks substance,
hence it is seen as detestable and lowly."
"This ignorant student, endowed by Heaven's mandate,
is deficient and young, lacking knowledge,
obscured and dim, difficult to enlighten;
I wish the Celestial Master would fully analyze and explain its meaning."
"Why does your learning not fully observe the meaning of Heaven's Way,
why?
If even you, the Perfected, do not yet understand,
how much more so are ordinary people, benighted and fixed in their ways.
Indeed, the names 'yin and yang,' 'male and female' by Heaven
originate from the primal pneuma's initial arising,
the gateway of yin and yang.
The place where humans receive their mandate and are born
is their root.
Thus, the reason the male receives the mandate
is that he is full and overflowing with surplus;
below him, left and right,
there are still two substantial entities each.
The upper is full and overflowing with surplus,
constantly bestowing it upon the lower yin;
having surplus accumulated, he constantly possesses substance.
The upper bestower corresponds to the Great Yang, moving in Heaven's course;
there is nothing it cannot produce,
nothing it cannot complete.
Below, there is accumulation,
corresponding to the Great Yin,
corresponding to Earth,
and having patterns corresponding to field paths.
The left substantial entity corresponds to humans,
the right substantial entity corresponds to the myriad things.
'Substantial entity'
means the core substance;
thus, being benevolent and fond of bestowing,
and again having a core substance,
is why yang gains the title of esteemed and honored.
Do you understand this?"
"Yes, yes."
"Yin is female;
the reason she is lowly and humble
is that the place where she receives the mandate,
the portal, is empty and void,
without surplus,
and without substance,
hence she is seen as lowly and humble.
Originally named yin and yang, male and female,
these are the two matters.
As for the rest of the body, above and below,
they are entirely without names.
Originally named yin and yang,
these two matters distinguish them.
Consider that a woman's head, eyes, face, ears, limbs, and body
are all equal to a man's;
her goodness and virtue may even surpass a man's,
yet she is instead lowly and humble
because of this.
A man's head, face, and limbs,
his goodness and virtue may not reach a woman's,
yet he is named esteemed and honored
precisely because of this."
"Excellent, excellent!"
"Indeed,
you may be said to have already awakened to this knowledge.
Therefore, Heaven's Way values the root and guards the beginning;
thus, the sage observes Heaven's models and images to gain clarity.
Hence, one should return to the root and guard the origin,
correct characters and examine writings,
to resolve delusions and confusions.
Thus, one can enable Heaven and Earth to be long at peace,
and the state to be joyful.
Therefore, guarding the root and having substance,
being fond of bestowing and giving, makes one a good person.
Being fundamentally empty and void without a core substance,
constantly insufficient and instead fond of seeking, makes one an evil person,
a lowly person;
this is what is meant."
"Now I wish to ask decisively about one doubt."
"Speak it."
"When a woman is seen to be pregnant,
as the Celestial Master says, it is substantial;
how is it without substance?"
"Alas!
Your mind is empty and void,
somewhat resembling a person without the Way;
but Heaven, seeing you,
diligent and single-minded,
thus sent you to inquire about matters!
Now, when a woman conceives a child,
yin is originally empty and void;
but yang goes to transform and bestow substance within yin,
and yin, being lowly and humble, fears yang,
submits and nurtures it,
not daring to remove it.
Yang is Heaven,
the ruler;
yin is Earth,
the minister.
Therefore, she heavily esteems and honors yang's bestowal,
thus nurturing it,
and dares not remove it.
If you wish to know the reality,
it is like a king having a guest
entrusted to a humble household;
the humble household nurtures him,
not daring to send him away.
The guest thus becomes fat and greatly grows to adulthood,
exactly this.
Common sayings state,
'yang generates, yin completes,'
but yin follows and nurtures to complete yang's substance.
My writings often explain nurturing in this way.
I see that you, Perfected, wish joyfully to know the core of the true Way,
Heaven's most essential meaning,
hence I speak concisely for you.
Do you understand?"
"Yes, yes."
"Good,
you have already awakened."
"Now I wish to ask: is it only humans who have male and female,
that can distinguish yin and yang's substance?
Are Heaven, Earth, and the myriad things all like this?"
"Alas!
You are still as if foolishly confused and uncomprehending.
Excellent!
The Perfected's difficult question.
Indeed, by the nature of Heaven and Earth,
the myriad things are all like this.
I will tell you one matter,
from which above penetrates and below reaches.
You should still open both ears and listen,
without losing a hair's breadth."
"Yes, yes."
"Well then,
when yang is outside,
all things above conceive in the upper branches and leaves;
at that time, Heaven's yang pneuma is outside,
not yet returned to the lower roots;
hence, all are substantial on the surface.
Creeping beings, the multitude of living beings, and people also accumulate outside;
when the yang pneuma returns and is inside, in the earth,
the categories of the myriad things,
above are all empty and without substance,
below all conceive and are substantial below,
in the earth nurturing roots and leaves;
creeping beings and people also enter and accumulate substance inside;
this is the great clear evidence of August Heaven testifying to yang's substantial core.
Therefore, those who hold the yang way have a substantial core;
those who guard the yin way lack a substantial core;
hence, the sages of antiquity in governing always modeled themselves on Heaven,
not daring to model themselves on Earth."
"I wish to hear,
what is called modeling on Heaven?"
"Modeling on Heaven means
gathering the benevolent, worthy, wise, Confucian, those with the Way's arts, sagely, and intelligent;
this is named modeling on Heaven.
Gathering wealth, goods, petty persons, the unworthy, ignorant, and writings without substance
is named modeling on Earth."
"Excellent, excellent!
I wish to hear why these benevolent, worthy, wise, Confucian, those with the Way's arts, sagely, and intelligent
model on Heaven?"
"Heaven is
the benevolent, worthy, wise, Confucian, those with the Way's arts, sagely, and intelligent;
furthermore, Heaven is
able to ride the pneuma and fly;
these six kinds of people,
those of superior talent and sincerely devoted to the true Way without slackening,
can also reach the ability to ride the pneuma and fly,
hence they belong to Heaven and model on Heaven.
Therefore, the sages of antiquity deeply understood the intent of August Heaven,
hence did not dare to lose it."
"I wish to hear why gathering wealth, goods, petty persons, the unworthy
models on Earth?"
"Indeed,
wealth,
when gathered below, turns into mud;
mud transforms into dung;
dung transforms into earth.
Petty persons, foolish and unworthy,
gather deaf, dark, and unknowing of the Way's arts;
they enter凶 portals,
and will early dwell underground.
If not buried,
over time they become deeply harmful to Heaven and Earth;
governing with them,
then together they disorder Heaven's patterns and Earth's principles;
the five phases daily conflict!
The four seasons lose their order,
the three lights diminish in brightness,
Heaven and Earth detest them,
the hundred spirits do not love them.
They are of no benefit to the principles of division;
they should end and die early, like this wealth."
Does the enlightened one know this?
"Yes, yes.
How alarming!
How alarming!"
"If you know to be alarmed,
you may be said to be on the path to longevity;
if you do not know to be alarmed early,
you will share grave blame with Heaven and Earth."
"This humble student is deeply fearful of it."
"If you know to fear this heavenly law,
Heaven will grant you life;
if you do not revere and fear it,
it is the same as with all living beings.
As for fortune and misfortune,
they are not originally from Heaven,
but faults,
which people bring upon themselves.
Do you know this?"
"Yes, yes."
"Go now,
and take this warning."
"Yes, yes."

"Before the True Man,

correct texts and words
are the true roots of Heaven, Earth, humanity, and all things.
Thus, the great sages of high antiquity who acted according to correct texts and words
had Heaven and Earth rectified for them,
the three lights (sun, moon, stars) rectified for them,
the four seasons and five phases rectified for them,
and the people and all things rectified for them.
This shows that correct texts and words
are the great evidence of the true roots for Heaven, Earth, humanity, and all things.
If you wish to deeply understand its truth,
it is like people using correct texts and words to praise before the ruler,
enabling the ruler to become greatly wise and comprehending,
succeeding in all endeavors,
with no deviations from correctness.
Then superiors and inferiors attain the intent of Heaven and Earth,
the three lights do not stray from their courses,
the four seasons and five phases do not err,
the people are all joyful,
all saying 'excellent',
and all things find their proper places.
Grace permeates the spirits,
and fame spreads to distant lands,
auspicious responses and rare objects emerge joyfully from the assembled spirits,
all worthy scholars of the world gladly come to assist their ruler,
without concealment,
immortal beings and divine spirits bring the recipe for agelessness and give it,
monsters and anomalies are extinguished,
the people practice good governance,
and with correct texts and words, there is no more mutual hatred,
so grievances and blame cease.
All goodness in the world emerges,
all evil is hidden,
and the virtuous ruler need only govern with folded hands (effortlessly),
with no worry of danger or demise,
this is the clear evidence that our correct texts and words are the roots of goodness,
should we not diligently correct them?
Do you understand, true person?"
"Yes, yes.
How awe-inspiring!
Hearing the Celestial Master's words,
I have greatly awakened,
this humble student knows the world is already at peace.
If the virtuous ruler listens and applies this,
his life will be prolonged."
"Excellent!
You may be called an understanding student,
having deeply comprehended it.
Rejoice, rejoice!
Heaven's worries are resolved,
Earth's ailments are removed,
how do you know this, true person?"
"Well,
all these evils should be removed,
the great ailments of Heaven, Earth, humanity, and all things are already cured.
Now that correct texts and words have been compiled and collated,
I know the great ailments of Heaven and Earth are eliminated."
"Excellent, excellent!
You have already understood it.
If the emperor diligently practices our texts,
he will be favored by Heaven and Earth,
with no more calamitous encounters.
Excellent, excellent!
Let me tell you a key point, true person.
When a highly virtuous ruler obtains our texts,
he should employ officials according to the heavenly model,
from the highest divine beings
down to the lowliest and humble,
altogether these nine types.
Divine, perfected,
immortal, daoyist,
sage, worthy,
common people,
slaves, servants,
these nine, if they possess true faith and loyalty,
delight in goodness and the true Way,
and come to assist the virtuous ruler,
should all be questioned about their abilities and employed accordingly,
carefully not assigning them inappropriate positions,
nor arbitrarily dismissing them.
Arbitrary dismissal goes against their earnest and devoted hearts.
Heaven does not reject people,
but employs them based on their capacities,
inquiring about their strengths,
then there is nothing that cannot be governed.
The virtuous ruler should test them,
promoting those who show daily good results,
being careful not to err,
and quickly dismissing those without results.
This is called defiling and confusing the heavenly offices,
preventing the arrival of upright energy,
and the fault lies with these evil persons.
For upright and good people,
their hearts always desire to secretly aid and care for all affairs,
hence they are called true good people.
Evil people have evil hearts,
not wishing to secretly benefit and aid all affairs,
thus they bring evil,
this is the natural law of August Heaven.
Therefore, they should be dismissed immediately,
for not dismissing them angers Heaven,
causing Earth to emit killing energy,
so they must be quickly removed,
this is a major matter.
Do you understand, true person?"
"Yes, yes.
This humble student greatly fears it."
"Since you know to fear it,
you may be called an understanding student,
and Heaven will protect you."
"I dare not, I dare not."
"There is no need to decline this,
it is not I who make you receive Heaven's protection,
you do good,
and naturally attain it.
Thus, the sages of old in their actions
dared not deviate from the standards,
for they observed Heaven's warnings,
clearly knew good and evil,
each for their own sake.
Hence, they always sought to govern with the worthy,
fearing to anger Heaven.
To offend Heaven
leaves no one to pray to.
Therefore, the emperors of antiquity,
with enlightened hearts,
dared not recklessly share affairs with the foolish,
thus they alone achieved lasting auspiciousness.
Do you understand, true person?"
"Yes, yes."
"Since middle antiquity,
people have been half foolish,
considering the selection of officials a minor matter,
not examining it carefully,
half obtaining the wrong persons,
half confusing the heavenly offices,
and governance half ominous.
Recent antiquity further inherited the neglect from middle antiquity,
making it even easier,
without careful examination,
often failing to select the right people;
defiling and confusing the heavenly offices,
causing the three lights to be incorrect,
the evidence appearing above to Heaven,
and Heaven is displeased.
Hence, many calamitous years continue unceasingly,
and when they cease, they arise again,
not knowing that Heaven greatly resents and detests this.
People do not deeply blame themselves,
instead saying it is the fate of the times.
There were such cases in antiquity.
The Way of Heaven does not reject people,
yet they attribute their excesses to Heaven,
the foolish below do not reflect on their own faults,
instead collectively blaming and shifting faults to the emperor.
Heaven then names them greatly rebellious people,
When those below transgress and deceive their superiors,
treating evil as good,
and good as evil,
together they bring about this calamity,
yet instead attribute it to Heaven above.
By attributing it to Heaven,
they further shift blame onto their ruler,
making them utterly treacherous subjects and unruly people under heaven.
Now, the spirits of heaven and earth jointly detest and abhor them,
so Heaven personally intervened,
sending me down to assist the virtuous ruler,
to reform and establish new laws.
In selecting and appointing individuals to official positions,
one must be meticulous and thorough.
If you wish to understand the true nature of these wicked subjects,
it is like parents in a household,
who have raised several children,
and the children collectively deceive their parents,
engaging in evil deeds;
the parents sit quietly in a room at home,
how could they know
that their children have already committed violent acts, theft, and robbery?
Yet people instead blame their parents.
The parents are deemed evil,
hence they gave birth to us, the evil ones.
When county officials apprehend them,
they do not straightforwardly execute the wicked children,
but instead repeatedly hold the parents accountable.
Now, when parents bear children,
they all wish for them to be virtuous and good—
when would they ever desire you to act wickedly?
To instead blame the parents
is the act of a greatly rebellious and unfilial child.
Similarly, when a ruler appoints ministers,
he always desires them to be good—
when would he ever teach them to be evil?
Yet the people and ministers below collectively engage in violent and wicked conduct,
and when disasters from heaven and earth occur,
they instead blame and hold the ruler accountable,
causing the common people to suffer in distress.
Then, cunning officials also join in blaming Heaven above,
which is called the people and ministers collectively rebelling,
a crime that cannot be forgiven.
When collective blame against the ruler reaches its peak,
it has already invoked severe retribution.
Still, they go further to accuse Heaven above
and blame Earth below—
such is the extent of human rebellion;
should they not have their lives shortened and be swiftly executed?
Therefore, in later ages, all fall under harsh fates,
with life and death occurring unpredictably.
It is like a household wanting to slaughter a domestic animal:
if they suddenly decide to kill it,
they simply kill it.
For a good animal, its death is still mourned;
for a wicked animal, its death from illness is welcomed.
Do you understand this, truth-seeker?"
"Yes, yes.
This humble student deeply fears the majesty of Heaven."
"Proceed,
you have now awakened.
Take this text,
and have the virtuous ruler show it to all wise scholars;
be careful not to conceal it,
for Heaven delights in its urgent dissemination."
"Yes, yes."
"I impart to you, truth-seeker, a crucial point:
when a greatly virtuous ruler has appointed ministers, each fitting their role,
and aligned with the heart of Heaven,
then they should understand the methods to govern the people and eliminate harm.
Those who hide in the four directions
are very difficult to discern.
The most foolish people,
each seeking their own gain,
instead collectively deceive their superiors;
the virtuous ruler must join with the wise and enlightened to correct this,
for only when all is set right will it match the intent of heaven and earth,
bringing great joy
and ensuring the emperor's lasting fortune.
Heaven, aware that people in later ages are foolish and hard to govern,
deliberately issued this documented text, named the Celestial Book.
The method of writing
is to record
and illuminate.
All under heaven should use it to record events,
as a common guide for action,
capable of documenting the writings of all people.
Thus, such documents
are meant to be read by all under heaven,
not created for a single isolated individual.
Therefore, all under heaven use them to record all matters;
sages use them to record the patterns of heaven and earth;
the worthy use them to record the words of sages.
All people should study and read them together,
only then grasping their meaning.
As for the categories of writings,
they should be jointly examined, discussed, recorded, and recited,
so that there is no deceit.
Thus, from ancient times to the present,
the texts of sages and worthies—
how many have been collated?
How many transmitted?
How many verified?
How many collectively affirmed?—
yet still there remain excess false texts and erroneous words,
preventing pure implementation.
Therefore, great sages and various Daoists
travel extensively throughout the world,
examining phrases and studying speech,
observing differences and similarities,
to enlighten the ignorant;
yet still they mislead the innocent,
allowing reckless promotion of their teachings, which is unacceptable;
recklessly appointing such individuals makes them unfit to be ministers to the emperor.
Hence, with a single original text,
numerous interpretations lead to divergent statements.
This causes the way of heaven and earth
to fall into great disorder and neglect,
giving rise to the disaster of inherited burden.
Do you understand this, truth-seeker?"
"Yes, yes."
"Proceed,
you have now awakened.
Listen further,
and I will tell you a great admonition.
The reason people in later ages long lost the heart of Heaven,
causing heaven and earth constant distress,
is that rulers relied on isolated and chaotic statements,
verifying affairs inaccurately,
clearly losing sight of the intended meaning.
If you, truth-seeker, only present this upward,
and have all the worthy under heaven jointly examine the texts yet remain unknowing,
all will be misled in their learning,
hence disasters and anomalies arise incessantly,
and Heaven greatly detests this,
leading to chaos and illness,
with the forces of yīn and yáng clashing endlessly.
Therefore, Heaven commanded me to descend
to restrain and correct this.
Since the mid to ancient times,
trusting in solitary and fragmented words,
they often regarded the texts sent from above as disrespectful,
collectively using this to judge and punish,
thus relying on isolated statements,
and in response, handling affairs through submitted documents,
thereby creating conflict and disorder with Heaven.
The official documents of Heaven are meant to have everyone discuss right and wrong together,
yet instead, they let one person secretly dictate the words.
Even sages cannot fully comprehend the way of heaven and earth alone,
hence sages and worthies across generations produced varied works,
with Heaven stating that each excels in one aspect,
unable to completely eliminate disasters;
thus, Heaven instructed me to collect and collate them all.
Now, to instead trust the words of one person—
how can that be acceptable?
Therefore, I teach the method of threefold document circulation:
having men and women, great and small, worthy and unworthy, participate together in cross-examination,
jointly discussing right and wrong,
all ensuring the verification is solid [gap],
only then may it be submitted.
If one among them seeks to deceive,
it is recorded;
thus, the afflictions of heaven and earth are removed,
and the emperor is freed from the burden of inherited blame.
Heaven and earth, freed from affliction, rejoice;
the emperor, attaining self-security, rejoices;
the worthy, achieving self-fulfillment, rejoice;
the common people, resolving their own grievances and seeing no injustice, rejoice;
households becoming wealthy and self-sufficient rejoice;
servants and slaves finding their masters,
and committing no wrongs, rejoice;
the four seasons and five phases flowing smoothly,
with people cautious not to offend them, rejoice;
the myriad beings each in their proper place,
unharmed, rejoice;
spirits and deities seeing the virtuous ruler accumulate good deeds,
also rejoice;
malignant energies no longer obscuring the sun, moon, and three luminaries, they too rejoice;
the supreme harmonious energy arrives to govern,
and the ruling king exercising authority rejoices;
malignant energies subdued and hidden,
not emerging to incite punitive campaigns, rejoice;
barbarians dwelling peacefully in their lands,
no longer frequently coming to battle for Heaven, rejoice;
armies and their weapons resting unused,
soldiers not dying in war, rejoice.
Throughout heaven and earth,
such joys are numerous,
beyond full record.
I have given you, truth-seeker, the broad outline,
showing you the beginning;
ponder its meaning yourself.
For all matters, extrapolate by analogy,
and you will grasp it fully.
If the virtuous ruler acts accordingly,
all under heaven will submit.
Thus, Heaven urgently emphasizes this threefold document circulation:
be careful not to neglect it again,
or disasters will not cease.
To cut off the celestial texts,
To govern by turning a deaf ear and a blind eye repeatedly.
Governing with deafness and blindness,
is the root of chaos and peril,
the calamity that leads to self-destruction.
Should one not be cautious?
As for writings,
they are what all people under heaven ought to collectively examine and follow,
and one must not trust the words of a single individual.
Thus, since the opening of heaven and earth,
documents and human speech
have been passed down and cross-referenced for verification.
Without verification, they cannot be followed alone;
to trust and act solely on one person's words
leads to danger and ruin.
This is a great fault and injury to all under heaven.
Therefore, my writings dare not accommodate isolated statements or solitary words.
Hence, I teach the Perfected to compile and compare ancient, middle, and recent texts to illuminate each other,
and to gather and verify the words of all people under heaven for mutual confirmation.
Only then can what lies between heaven and earth be rectified,
and what is between yīn and yáng be free of ailments.
Using my writings to investigate past and present celestial texts, terrestrial spirits' records, and human speech,
they will surely resonate like an echo,
no different from the spirits,
and thus my Dào can be trusted.
Therefore, in practicing the Dào,
I do not speak untested words;
rather, I seek to test them through practice to see if they hold.
How else could I know that my Dào corresponds with heaven and is trustworthy?
Practicing it today,
it is as if speaking with heaven:
ten out of ten, five out of five,
none are missed.
How divine is the Dào practiced thus!
Truly, it can be called great joy.
Do you understand, Perfected? 」
「Yes, yes. 」
「Go forth,
and enlightenment will arise in affairs.
I tell you a great secret:
this foundation lies in guarding the One and specializing in goodness,
grasping its meaning,
thus one can enter the Dào,
and so it is followed by texts on the Dào.
Practicing the Dào leads to entering the chamber,
entering the true Dào,
and entering the chamber necessarily means knowing the spirits,
hence it is followed by spiritual precepts.
Attaining the guarding of the One, attaining the Dào, and attaining the spirits,
one must then be able to serve above as a virtuous ruler or good minister to the emperor.
As ministers,
they must assist the virtuous ruler emperor,
together bringing peace to heaven, earth, the six directions, and the eight caverns.
Grasping this intent,
the state can then be long at peace.
To achieve this peace,
one must correct writings, words, and speech.
Therefore, by compiling and comparing texts and phrases,
one attains great rectitude,
and surely many wise and superior scholars will emerge,
collectively assisting the emperor,
serving as his ears, eyes, and limbs.
Thus, it is followed by the nine officials.
Each of the nine finds their proper place,
and together they should pacify heaven and earth,
with all under heaven uniting efforts and hearts as one.
They must constantly communicate with each other,
reporting good and evil,
hence it is followed by the three methods of circulating documents.
Once people all know to guard the One,
have entered the Dào,
have entered the spirits,
have entered correct writings,
and with officials of high and low rank
each in their proper place,
and once documents are circulated,
and the six affairs are united in effort,
all is thoroughly accomplished,
and all under heaven share one heart,
with none daring to hate each other again.
All will then love and benefit one another,
as if born of the same parents.
Thus, the virtuous ruler deeply attains the heart of heaven,
delighting in being free of troubles.
Fearing that there might be omissions in the Dào,
leaving the celestial and terrestrial writings incomplete,
it is further followed by the difficulties of great compilation,
to resolve doubts.
The profound lies at its foundation,
all writings are brought forth,
and the texts are entrusted to a virtuous ruler.
Once all under heaven swiftly turn to plan,
they resonate with goodness and govern themselves.
Its ease is like fire spreading over dry heights,
or water flowing downward:
without being taught to act,
it moves naturally,
and cannot be stopped.
Therefore, for the Great Imperial Heavenly Dào's transformation and education,
its establishment can be awaited.
The virtuous ruler practices it,
and is then named the spiritual son of heaven,
titled the Supreme Sovereign,
resembling the primordial qì of heaven and earth.
Thus, all the spirits under heaven
can be fully employed.
Since the opening of heaven and earth,
there has never been celestial texts or spiritual writings
that made a Perfected transmit them as a record of the true Dào.
Entrusting them to the virtuous ruler,
they are called the mother of the Dào.
The qì of the great yáng,
belongs to the fire element,
and obtaining and practicing it,
one attains its truth.
Not knowing how to practice it,
then it is not genuine.
Do you understand, Perfected? 」
「Yes, yes.
Sincerely entrusting it to the cautious people,
we go to deliver it to the virtuous ruler,
not daring to keep it long. 」
「Go,
you have understood it.
Celestial writings cannot be kept long.
The celestial spirits examine people,
bringing them misfortune.
Be cautious of this,
go forth. 」
「Yes, yes. 」
The six investigations harmonize and penetrate to the utmost; the seven completions,
arrange texts by category to make them correspond,
so that disasters all vanish,
leading to the auspicious writings of ultimate penetration.
「Perfected, come forward. 」
「Yes, yes. 」
「Now, I admonish you with a great precept.
My Dào is for ordering heaven and earth,
pacifying the emperor,
and nurturing what heaven and earth love—
which should be the true Dào and true virtue.
For heaven
is the truth of the Dào,
the guiding principle of the Dào,
the trustworthiness of the Dào,
that by which the Dào acts and depends.
Earth
is the elder of virtue,
the discipline of virtue,
that by which virtue rests and depends.
Thus, it can long be the mother of all things,
constantly enduring humiliation and dwelling below,
without speaking of its toil and suffering.
I, in teaching the virtuous ruler to transform the ignorant below,
take these two matters of heaven and earth as the foundation.
Thus, I always follow the laws and measures of heaven and earth,
not losing their gateway.
My writings are the speech of heaven and the language of earth,
deeply and uniquely corresponding with the spirits as if inner and outer.
Each step follows like compass and square.
Therefore, those who follow accordingly attain the intent of heaven and earth,
while those who lose it face misfortune and decline.
Now, in admonishing you, Perfected,
you should ponder my words and always be cautious. 」
「Yes, yes. 」
「Go,
seeing your love for the true Dào and virtue,
and your rare dedication to goodness,
I will show you one more saying.
Now, superior scholars mostly delight in the true Dào and good virtue,
middling scholars half like them,
while inferior scholars are without merit,
utterly devoid of Dào and virtue,
all corresponding to those greatly rebellious and without Dào.
Those greatly inauspicious and without virtue
have no comparison within heaven and earth,
are not known to them,
are not pardoned by heaven's constant ways,
nor loved as children.
Thus, those without Dào and virtue
have no place in heaven and earth,
sharing the same lot and fate as beasts. 」
「Now I do not understand;
I wish to hear the essential meaning. 」
「Very well,
the six Perfected, listen clearly. 」
「Yes, yes. 」
「Well then,
heaven is purely Dào,
earth is purely virtue.
These people without Dào and virtue
are cut off from heaven and earth,
having nothing to emulate.
Emulating heaven's conduct,
one should possess the true Dào and love life;
emulating earth,
one should possess good virtue and love nurturing growth.
People today lack the Way and lack virtue,
thus Heaven and Earth do not pardon their children.
If you wish to know the clear evidence of this,
it is like those who follow the Way recognize others who follow the Way,
and virtuous people recognize other virtuous people;
they naturally gather together,
thus their destinies mutually reside with each other.
Therefore, those who follow the Way delight in promoting others who follow the Way,
and virtuous people delight in promoting other virtuous people.
People with the Way and virtue do not associate with those without the Way and virtue,
thus they refuse to gather together,
and their destinies are not tied to Heaven."
"Excellent, excellent!
I wish to hear the meaning of sharing the same fate with beasts."
"Good that you ask,
you have deeply grasped the principle.
Indeed,
the fate of beasts is tied to the four directions,
their nature is to contend with each other,
lacking the Way and virtue,
where the victor dominates.
Those without virtue, the lowest fools,
also delight in clashing and provoking,
where the victor dominates.
Their energy is the same as that of beasts,
thus they share the same fate.
Heaven's Way serves as the standard,
using this to distinguish the superior from the inferior among people,
thus it is known.
All names and destinies under Heaven belong
to categories that follow their kind,
thus we know to which destiny they belong.
Therefore, those who embody much of the five virtues resemble Yang and are benevolent,
those who embody much of the six emotions resemble Yin and are greedy,
those who receive more Yang influences become male,
those who receive more Yin influences become female,
those who receive more royal and prime energy become noble and long-lived,
those who receive more depleted, wasted, or imprisoned energy often fall ill and die early,
and also become extremely poor.
Thus, for all living people,
their resemblance depends on which elemental energy they embody,
their destiny is tied to the six Jia cycles and which calendar,
predicting by category,
not one in ten thousand is missed.
Therefore, the sages of old deeply examined all matters,
understanding human nature through this.
Does the enlightened one understand?"
"Yes, yes.
Excellent, excellent!"
"Now, people of this late ancient era,
bearing the consequences of their ancestors' misdeeds,
gradually together abandon the Way and virtue,
day by day accumulating over time,
cut off from Heaven and Earth,
their essential energy not flowing through,
not knowing each other's destinies,
instead sharing the same fate as four-legged creatures,
thus Heaven and Earth detest them,
spirits and essential energies therefore do not protect them,
illnesses are countless,
deaths come unpredictably,
their great fault lies herein.
Now, the highly virtuous ruler,
whose destiny is tied to Heaven and Earth,
should further emulate Heaven and Earth in governing with the Way and virtue,
thus I further elucidate the Way of Heaven to impart to him.
Heaven delights in his good deeds,
not wishing to let him have any remnants
of the four-legged people's behavior.
Therefore, my writings repeatedly emphasize,
wanting to bring about great awakening.
Thus, I present the six extremes as a great collection of difficulties to entrust to you.
Does the enlightened one understand?"
"Yes, yes.
How awe-inspiring!
Joyful, joyful!"
"How does the enlightened one know it is awe-inspiring and joyful?"
"Well,
this humble student hears the Celestial Master say
that true morality emerges,
and people transform overnight,
all upholding the Way and virtue,
emulating Heaven and Earth,
no longer behaving like four-legged people.
Each person follows the Way,
each person embodies virtue,
thus I know the great joy of this ultimate intent."
"Excellent,
the words of the enlightened one
cannot be surpassed."
"Now I wish to ask the Celestial Master one more thing."
"Speak."
"When people seek the Way and virtue, and ordinary people act,
what should be the most urgent task?
How can one come to know it?
How can one resonate in response with Heaven and Earth?"
"Good,
your question.
It must be done with utmost sincerity, with genuine feelings from the five viscera,
then it can be attained.
If not done with genuine feelings from the five viscera,
it is what the Way and virtue resent,
goodness cannot be sought,
and spirits will not respond."
"Now I wish to hear how utmost sincerity moves Heaven, Earth, and the spirits."
"Alas!
The enlightened one is particularly foolish here;
studying my texts,
are you still so stubbornly uncomprehending?"
"This humble student is indeed ignorant,
my obscurity is long and deep,
difficult to enlighten in one day."
"Well,
you are also very humble.
Proceed,
listen more clearly,
I will explain the intent of moving Heaven and Earth with utmost sincerity."
"Yes, yes. I hear and obey."
"Now,
utmost sincerity,
named as such,
means one looks upward to Heaven and acts,
emulating the Way of Heaven as a guide;
looks downward to Earth and acts,
following the virtue of Earth as it shifts.
Reflect that Heaven and Earth, like parents, gave me growth,
not wishing me to delight in evil,
then examine it in the heart before acting.
The heart
is the most treasured abode of the spirit.
The heart
is sacred, pure Yang,
the activity of fire.
Fire
moves upward,
sharing light with Heaven.
Thus the sun,
being the king of fire,
is the rectitude of Heaven,
illuminating everything.
Therefore, when a person is utmost sincere,
the heart's uprightness responds with keen awareness.
The heart's spirit is supremely sacred,
then reports upward to the sun,
and the sun reports upward to Heaven.
Thus, utmost sincerity within the five viscera
moves the spirits.
Hence, can one not be cautious?"
The enlightened one said:
"How fearful!
How fearful!
This humble student erred in asking,
this is very frightening."
"Your fear
is the root of life;
if you knew no fear,
it would be the gate of death;
safety and danger lie in yourself,
not in any other place."
"Although I am often frightened when asking the Celestial Master,
asking leads to understanding and great resolution;
not asking, I'd have no way to know."
"Indeed,
your words are right;
being dark and unwilling to ask,
when will one ever become enlightened?"
"Speak on,
what do you wish to ask?"
"Now I have carefully heard about moving Heaven with utmost sincerity;
I wish to hear about moving Earth."
"Excellent!
Your words grow ever deeper,
do not hold back.
Proceed,
sit at ease,
I will explain it to you.
Not speaking might miss the chance with you.
It's as if Heaven particularly grieves that later generations are not sincere,
thus sending the enlightened one to question it."
"Agreed."
"Now I will explain it to you.
Listen clearly."
"Yes, yes."
"Proceed,
a person's utmost sincerity,
when there is something to ponder,
the heart feels pain for it,
thus one may even forgo food from the depths of one's being.
The one who ponders
is the heart,
the mind.
When the heart and mind do not forget,
the liver, being most benevolent,
has the eyes as its agents shedding tears,
this is the ultimate sincerity of refined thought.
The essence of intelligence resides in
the heart.
That which thinks without ceasing is
the will,
the spleen.
The heart is pure yang,
positioned in heaven.
The spleen is pure yin,
positioned on earth.
Utmost sincerity can focus thoughts,
leading to heartfelt pain and tears,
as the heart directs the will to govern actions,
informing distant realms.
The will,
being yin,
when troubled, should report to yang,
hence reporting upwards to the celestial deities and spirits.
The spleen,
being yin
and rooted in earth,
thus reports downwards to the earth.
Therefore, heaven and earth shift for it,
and all spirits are moved by it.
If you wish to know its great effect,
I do not deceive the true person.
Simply sit peacefully in a deep, secluded chamber,

"To resolve this fault,

if ten out of nine,
