all doubts should deeply contemplate this meaning with sincere heart,
the heart generated from fire,
return it to fire,
emulate this in governing the people,
then extend years and increase longevity,
never failing even once out of ten thousand,
I do not deceive you.
Show this to the virtuous ruler,
show this to ordinary people,
the worthy should each contemplate its meaning,
none dare violate it.
Using this is called self-enrichment and self-nourishment,
not using this is called self-worry and self-suffering.
Divine indeed!
This Way of mine,
is purely heaven's will.
It can only advance, not retreat,
can only follow, not oppose,
following it purely obtains heaven's heart,
opposing it brings disorder to affairs.
Chaotic disasters surge,
human will goes west,
heaven's will goes east,
this is called differing from heaven's will."
"Excellent, excellent!"
"Go now,
you can be considered to have awakened to this knowledge."
"Before the True Men,
when ordinary people recommend scholars,
to present to the emperor,
entrust to the state,
how auspicious is it to get the right person,
how inauspicious is it to not get the right person,
what achievements can be made with the right person,
without the right person,
what failures may occur,
may the True Men carefully respond."
"Yes,
there are four auspicious outcomes with the right person,
and four inauspicious outcomes without the right person.
With the right person,
all directions and distant lands under heaven and earth are peaceful;
without the right person,
all directions and distant lands under heaven and earth are unsettled."
"I wish to hear the essential meaning."
"Yes,
when the recommended scholar is the right person,
the ruler can govern effectively,
achieving success and constant peace,
daily benefiting the ruler,
this is the first great auspicious outcome.
The recommended person is capable and reliable,
becomes accomplished,
the second auspicious outcome.
Becoming accomplished,
they can glorify their teacher's doctrines,
extending grace to their teacher,
the third auspicious outcome.
The recommended person is trustworthy and effective in duties,
and again earns the ruler's trust and employment,
the fourth auspicious outcome.
All join forces with one heart,
their endeavors daily achieve success,
monthly become more illustrious,
yearly more prosperous,
heaven and earth are joyful,
all good omens appear,
evil things hide away,
when heaven and earth are joyful, then all spirits are pleased.
If maintained without loss,
the highest can transcend the world,
the middle can achieve fair governance,
the lowest can preserve completeness,
living out their natural lifespan.
Recommending scholars and getting the right person
brings such goodness,
and heaven above recognizes this as the talisman for prolonging life."
"May I ask why it is precisely called the talisman for prolonging life?"
"Yes,
the reason it is called the talisman for prolonging life
is that when the recommended scholar is the right person,
danger turns to safety,
chaos to order,
failure to success,
inauspiciousness to auspiciousness,
death to life.
The highest can transcend the world,
the middle achieve fair governance,
the lowest live out their natural lifespan,
preserving their physical form.
If the recommended scholar is not the right person,
it does not benefit the emperor above,
the state's governance becomes chaotic,
the emperor is distressed,
heaven and earth are displeased,
bandits, disasters, and myriad anomalies arise,
this is the first great inauspicious outcome.
The recommended person cannot manage their duties,
deceit and falsehood daily increase,
long-lasting instability ensues,
they cannot preserve their natural lifespan,
either harmed by heaven, earth, or spirits,
or killed by others,
shame extending to their parents,
evil flowing to wife, children, and descendants,
even affecting future generations,
thus known as wrongdoers for their faults,
this is the second great inauspicious outcome.
The person is evil,
then their learning is abandoned,
defiling the legacy of former sages and worthies,
disaster extending to their teacher,
this is the third great inauspicious outcome.
Moreover, the recommender is untrustworthy,
collectively deceiving their superior,
presenting an unsuitable person,
disrupting heavenly order,
defiling the constellations,
heaven detests it,
earth resents it,
the ruler dislikes it,
sages and worthies condemn it,
this makes them great deceitful and false-speaking individuals in the world;
they should be held accountable for this,
if not punished by heaven, earth, and spirits,
then people will harm them,
shaming their ancestors,
disaster reaching wife, children, and descendants,
this is the fourth great inauspicious outcome.
Committing these four great inauspicious acts,
by recommending an unsuitable person,
causes the emperor distress,
governance to be clouded and chaotic.
All harmful energies rise and move,
uncontrollable,
past and future unmanaged,
further accumulating negative consequences.
Heaven and earth are greatly angered,
spirits battle,
all directions are displeased,
distant lands become disordered,
eternally unmanaged,
heaven above names this the talisman for reducing years and shortening life."
"Why is it called the talisman for shortening life?"
"Yes,
governance should be long-lasting,
but instead becomes short;
years should be many,
but instead become few;
endeavors encounter misfortune,
with no benefit to oneself,
heaven and earth are displeased,
deducting from one's allotted lifespan and reducing years,
therefore heaven above names it the talisman for shortening life."
"Excellent, excellent!
This humble student has heard the command."
"Yes,
you can be said to understand it clearly.
Carefully present this heavenly text to the virtuous ruler,
show it to all worthies,
and down to the common people.
Those in authority seeking scholars,
must not be careless;
those below recommending scholars,
must not be disloyal.
Future generations transmitting
(carefully) reciting this text,
engraving it in their hearts and minds,
if hastily recommending scholars is not like this,
heaven and earth will not be pleased again.
Knowing yet deliberately violating,
their offense is grave!
True Men, be cautious of this."
"Yes, yes.
Truly receiving the instruction,
not daring to violate the prohibitions,
I will strive to implement it."
"You can be called cautious in affairs,
having obtained the mandate of heaven."

The above is the celestial and terrestrial strategy on recommending scholars: four auspicious and four inauspicious outcomes, the talisman for shortening life and the talisman for prolonging life, securing the state, gaining the favor of heaven and earth, and the joy of all spirits.
The Way of high antiquity,
cultivates the self and corrects one's own conduct,
not daring to violate what the spirits have recorded,
thus daring to seek life and beg for survival from the Heavenly Sovereign,
not daring to act recklessly,
fearing incompleteness.
Daily thinking of the intent of life,
serving as subjects to the spirits,
manifests their kind.
Wishing to offer utterly loyal and upright words,
with the spirits who oversee various departments,
each clearly distinguishing right from wrong,
then daring to trust in reasoning about right and wrong,
how could there be a day forgetting even for a moment?
Above there are those who observe people,
fully knowing right and wrong,
what is there to conceal,
what is there that is not believed?
Therefore, one can manage oneself,
seeking to remember the root,
never having the slightest realm of impropriety.
But cherishing the chance to be human,
relying on the primordial qì,
enabling even crawling creatures,
to not see disasters and anomalies.
But people break faith in their oaths,
neither trusting the other,
hence there is unease.
Heaven, Earth, the harmonious center, above and below,
each has its own faithfulness,
humans cannot know its essence,
yet why say there is solely good and evil?
Disasters and anomalies all arise from this.
Humans consume the qì of the five constants,
nothing is not received,
nothing is not relied upon,
nothing is not practiced,
why alone not revere knowing that ancients had knowledge passed down to us?
This is losing goodness and following evil,
causing life to be incomplete,
why is this alone so?
Thus the Heavenly Sovereign says,
there is good and evil,
the good can be made uniform.
The reason for this,
is to have distinction,
not to follow one's own will,
good should ascend,
evil should be punished,
how can evil be associated with good?
Speaking from human perspective,
it is also understandable,
there are those who naturally uphold justice.
Thus evil is established to clarify the intent of Heaven, Earth, the four seasons, and the five phases,
making known the importance of achieving life,
increasing one's destined years;
humans obtain the way of life and growth,
adhering to its prohibitions,
not daring to violate taboos.
Speaking from this,
Heaven knows foolish people are very shallow and lack intent of retribution,
opposing what Heaven bestows,
falsifying what Heaven bestows,
adding to what people practice wrongly,
among their kind, instead they should let evil thrive and harm good.
Thus sages know the convergence of yīn and yáng,
worthies manage right and wrong,
resolve their ignorance,
making each know their boundaries without resentment.
Good naturally leads to long life,
evil naturally leads to short life,
what is there to doubt or resent?
Are all people not like the six domestic animals, flying birds, running beasts, or aquatic creatures?
Thinking humans are without virtue,
Heaven made it so.
Heaven equally desires them to do good,
not wanting them to do evil.
If good and evil share the same suffering and joy.
Wealth, honor, longevity, and old age,
Heaven above acts,
unable to distinguish beauty from ugliness,
letting ignorant people get qì and raise their voices,
saying I am equal to you all.
Doing good, why must it come to this,
hence advancing to increase goodness,
enabling long life,
those shallow ones think of it as equal.
Compared to evil losing life,
then wanting to truly repent,
seeing good, engage with it,
seeing evil, retreat and stop.
Day and night, restrain oneself and reflect,
what is owed is then repaid.
A small life can be equal to others,
though not transcending to immortality,
can complete what is received,
not dying prematurely,
this is acceptable.
What ordinary people value is but a moment.
Not thinking of long life,
they could ascend to know scholars,
having the mind to seek life,
hence not doing evil.
Heaven sees their goodness,
enables them to peacefully act,
further seeking wealth and descendants,
though not fully obtained,
there is still hope,
why do evil and long perish,
self-thinking they should complete their years.
Not knowing Heaven dispatches spirits to record it,
faults great or small,
Heaven knows them all.
Registers of good and evil are recorded in detail,
yearly, monthly, daily examined and collated,
successively deducting calculations and reducing years;
if their evil does not cease,
then the ghost gate appears.
Earth spirits summon for questioning,
whether their statements match or not,
again bitterly thinking to correct them,
after correction, they then submit.
Names sent up to the Life Registry to report,
calculations exhausted, they should enter the earth,
faults flowing to later lives,
is this not caused by evil?
Why do people not desire life?
People without illumination see thus,
what is there to resent or blame?
Born in the same tenth month,
why alone are they not good,
spreading evil unceasingly,
how can they last long?
The plans of foolish scholars,
why not align with small goodness?
Practicing again the minor, non-urgent matters,
all that people do,
each with different plans,
self-thinking it acceptable,
what they encounter and violate,
all desire to profit from others,
others also do not wish to profit them.
Good profit allows life for a moment,
evil profit does not last,
because goodness does not long dwell on earth.
Thus, are Heaven and Earth not aware?
Heaven enables humans to do good,
hence gives them life,
yet they instead do evil.
Thus, spirits overseeing evil long follow them unceasingly,
even if resolved, they do not stop,
other spirits report it,
immediately creating affairs,
hence making them follow people incessantly.
Are you not aware?
This text first advances good and retreats from evil,
it is the writing of past and present.
Not following its long life but approaching evil,
there is no other way,
ghosts make it impossible to clear.
Thus, those with faults,
vanish physically into the earth,
their spirits uneasy,
not knowing where to stop,
whose fault is it?
People should carefully ponder themselves,
choose convenience and peace, avoid wrong,
the words spoken,
repeatedly overlapping,
what they speak of is not one matter,
hence repetition.
Human life is near within you,
why beat the breast and cry out to Heaven?
Having a self not purifying itself,
who should purify?
Having a self not loving itself,
who should love?
Having a self not perfecting itself,
who should perfect?
Having a self not remembering itself,
who should remember?
Having a self not blaming itself,
who should blame?
Again think on these words,
do not resent ghosts and spirits.
Seeing good, report good,
seeing evil, report evil,
all are different.
Do you understand again?
Words cease briefly,
evil unceasing,
documents unending,
only stopping when people perish,
this warning shows that doing evil,
burdens oneself,
does not burden others,
do you understand again?
Act according to what is said,
ponder without leaving the heart,
leaving it leads to failure.
Cannot be governed again,
one who keeps company with ghosts,
how can they survive?
Thinking of life leads to life,
this is wisdom;
evil gatherings shall end,
they cannot last long,
do you not know this?
Actions again resemble minor tales,
humans dwell between heaven and earth,
all are granted to be human,
how can one forget the grace of heaven and earth?
What manner of thing is this?
Their foolishness is thus,
unable to reform,
what hope remains?
To desire heaven's reward,
one must reproach oneself,
walking with sincere tears streaming down.
Saying I have received grace to become human,
distinct from all other beings,
heaven made me different,
able to speak and converse,
discerning beauty and ugliness,
knowing what is permissible and impermissible in good and evil,
one must be careful and cautious,
if one's words oppose heaven's decrees,
causing disobedience,
this is a person of great rebellion and impiety,
how can heaven long engage with them?
Therefore, malevolent spirits are appointed,
observing ancient times, their words match the deeds,
such a person naturally does not favor goodness.
Tiānjūn says:
"Previously, documents have ceaselessly stated,
the overseeing authorities below collect their souls,
flesh and bones are delivered to the earth deity,
without delay,
evil people must not be frequently heard of,
hence I diminish my majestic wrath,
returning to refinement and elegance,
changing their wickedness,
gathering all that is good,
embedding it within,
placing heart within heart."
A spirit says:
"I receive the teachings and commands of heaven's heart,
tasked to follow human hearts,
there must be no slight negligence,
for good and evil are always noted by spirits who then understand the heart."
The spirit's words grow even more sorrowful,
uncertain of fortune or misfortune,
thus fearing to be among the ranks of the wicked.
Day and night, I reflect,
unsure how to position myself,
so I dare not harbor any ill intent.
I only beg the spirits for leniency,
allowing me to reproach myself,
if I disregard the spirits' warnings,
I would not resent being punished."
Tiānjūn sends a great spirit down to say:
"This person has reproached themselves and repented of their faults,
not violating the prohibitions,
leniency, grant leniency;
if there is wrongdoing later,
it is not too late to deal with it then."
Hearing the spirit's words,
I sigh deeply day and night,
fearing my faults are not fully eradicated,
long deprived of communion with the sun's essence,
and placed among the ranks of the dead,
growing even more distressed,
not knowing what to do.
Having received the command but failing to comprehend fully,
I quietly reflect in solitude,
reproaching myself for my burdens,
to apologize to heaven, earth, the four seasons, five phases, and all the overseeing spirits.
Tiānjūn listens attentively,
urging me to ponder deeply.
People of high antiquity,
all possessed wisdom and foresight,
daring not to break prohibitions,
cultivating and rectifying themselves,
fearing any misstep,
acting always in compliance,
lest they lose their years.
For this reason,
they dared not relax even slightly.
Offenses were always met with punishment,
thus they examined and cherished themselves,
respecting taboos,
daring not to contravene or err.
Facing further reprimands and questions,
my heart is often filled with fear,
disheartened and dispirited,
betraying heaven's heart,
if my words slightly miss the mark,
it is considered verbose,
and I am interrogated for verification.
What is said and trusted,
can bring reputation,
but if one lacks trustworthiness,
they long lose their human years.
Hence, I reflect again,
not losing my heart,
anxious and terrified,
daring not to be at ease.
Moving with my breath,
I constantly yearn,
eager to follow in unity with heaven, earth, the four seasons, and five phases,
daring not to err even slightly.
My heart chides itself,
deeply understanding the ultimate intent before and after,
not losing constancy,
remembering grace without betraying essence,
craving life and hoping to live,
how could minor evils be reported above?
With body and actions in continuous service,
how dare I entertain negligence,
fearing I cannot grasp the highest intent,
not knowing what to do.
My heart grows even more fearful and urgent,
finding no comfort in complacency.
Heavenly longevity is hard to attain,
once lost, it cannot be regained.
Long estranged from vulgarity,
yet faltering midway,
looking down with regret,
this brings sorrow,
so I simply discipline myself in trepidation.
Often fearing that any inadequacy might lead to dismissal,
worry and bitterness fill my heart,
reproaching and blaming myself.
Having received heaven's grace,
to unfold my previous destiny,
the feelings of hunger and thirst I dare not forget,
merely seeking to survive.
May the great spirits pity and consider,
recording and showing to the humble,
receiving essence from heaven's kitchen,
riding the celestial energy.
Yet my actions are shallow in what I oversee,
with numerous prohibitions to guard against,
there must be no loss or omission.
Though my body is lowly and base,
unworthy of honor and favor,
nor because of incompetence,
should I be viewed with suspicion.
Truly, with heart I seek progress and life,
only asking the great spirits to consider my words,
allowing me to witness the generation of the four seasons and five phases,
and again see the sun and moon, hard to repay,
hoping not to be abandoned midway.
A person of sincere effort,
dares not distance themselves,
prostrating in devotion.
The great spirit says:
"This person has self-cultivated to this extent,
why worry about lacking guardians?"
"In the past, there were such people,
heaven, pitying them,
kept them close at hand.
Now, seeing them long in service,
full of wisdom and foresight,
their every word and speech,
none fails to win Tiānjūn's inner trust."
So, act upon it,
the disciple, prostrate, weeps and speaks,
awakened by the command,
thus with ancient heartfelt loyalty,
advancing in understanding,
embracing all that is heard,
how dare I compare to the ancients?"
The great spirit says:
"Holding this, trustworthy people speak,
wishing to foster mutual growth and hopeful comparison,
for some fall short in time."
The disciple says:
"The great spirit has enlightened me greatly,
among many like me,
I alone am distinguished,
granted enlightening thoughts,
this grace is extremely heavy,
when can I repay the great spirit?"
The great spirit says:
"Thoughts emerge from within,
fervently remember them as repayment."
The disciple says:
"I, in my portion, do not know what to offer,
though heaven has rare and delightful treasures,
I think to present them above,
seeing the command, I fervently remember,
this is sincere acceptance,
these words are not mere oral repayment with embellishment,
truly, day and night I ponder,
daring not to relax."
The great spirit says:
"The admonishments are numerous,
the counsels are not for one person alone,
holding this, we speak for long-lasting
Sincerely, I value life itself,
and your words show particularly deep compassion and special concern."
The Heavenly Lord heard this,
and called to the Great Spirit, saying:
"From where did this student arise,
to attract such extraordinary words from you, Great Spirit?"
The Great Spirit said:
"Seeing this scholar's exceptional faith,
I therefore explained the difficulties and ease of the Way."
The Heavenly Lord said:
"When you see goodness, advance it,
enabling it to reach this point—
this is fitting."
The Great Spirit said:
"Heavenly Lord, summon and question this faithful student."
The student said:
"I dare not hope to reach the left side of Heaven,
but wish to be in a position without official duties,
striving with my own strength to be utterly loyal."
The Great Spirit said:
"All should have their assigned overseers,
only then is faith and order seen."
"If so, I am truly fortunate,
greatly obtaining my portion,
and dare not be in the least unworthy."
The Great Spirit said:
"This student, having received transformation,
is thus;
it is fitting to further advance him,
so he may reach the ancients."
The student said:
"I dare not seek advancement to longevity,
for that is what men covet."
The Great Spirit said:
"This is Heaven's wish."
The student said:
"This is originally due to the Great Spirit's protection,
I dare not neglect the Great Spirit's admonitions."
The Heavenly Lord, knowing these two admonishing each other,
deeply approved of it,
having them teach each other.
Only the way of the ancient sages
emerged from spontaneity.
Their minds knew the governance of Heaven,
and all that was implemented was foreknown.
Their voices penetrated through,
and they knew forms and appearances in return,
seeing their own minds clearly, with understanding intent.
They knew what needed saving,
the meetings of fortune and misfortune,
all clearly knowable.
Their hearts were joyful within,
thus knowing they had received Heaven's blessings.
They were shown what lay ahead,
all admonished sincerely and conveyed.
Reflecting on receiving grace and favor,
being able to hold fast with the various six spirits over time,
repeatedly taught and warned,
kept from danger.
Gazing beyond the four horizons,
penetrating above and below,
increasing in compassion.
Hearts joyful,
again gaining extended time,
even including what was unheard of,
all this is the transforming grace of the Heavenly Lord and Great Spirit.
The Great Spirit said:
"This is known to all the spirits;
those extended have their fate,
the registers of records hold the truth.
Before birth, individuals are pre-recorded with their year, month, day, and hour in the Bureau of Longevity,
their years set to ascend,
then names bestowed, each communicated,
overseen by the Realized One of the Northern Pole.
Their bone structure transformed,
bodies lightened, moistened, glowing,
timely receiving the elixir,
to complete the essence.
Wherever they act,
nothing is unaccomplished,
entering the obscure, exiting the hidden,
in the space of a hair's breadth,
what does not penetrate?"
The Sage said:
"Truly, there is this following of customs,
food comes from the earth,
the yin spirit emerges—
how can it not be heavy?
To change it to lightness,
is precisely this change above.
The Great Spirit's grace cannot be repaid,
its merit vast in bestowal;
reflecting on such great grace,
I fear I fall short.
Allowing me a deep respite for revival,
is beyond words to repay."
The Great Spirit said:
"This is Heaven's endowment of human fate and lot, correspondingly;
truly, it is not the Great Spirit's intent to bestow.
Seeing goodness and recommending it
is the spirit's blessing—
what is there to repay?
Fearing future doubts,
for those who impose restrictions,
let the sages know to teach and warn,
so later generations understand clearly.
Sages have their own knowledge,
needing no commands."
The Sage said:
"Having already received recompense,
though recorded among the living,
there may still be teachings I miss."
The Great Spirit said:
"This student's words are appropriately humble."
"The student, valued, presents his words again,
fully prepared from start to end.
Only by the Great Spirit's accomplished grace and intent,
does the student see himself as a mere human,
and dare not excuse himself,
nor be arrogant or negligent.
I ask to exert strength again in quiet solitude,
as the Great Spirit teaches and bestows,
hoping you remember this unworthy student."
The Great Spirit said:
"All words before and after are understood;
I have no further warnings.
In parting, each should heed what has been said."
The student said:
"From the day I received the admonitions,
I have not dared to relax even for a moment,
only fearing I may not complete them fully.
I only beg for support,
to regain the hope of sight and breath,
leaning anxiously in heart,
that the Great Spirit may constantly remember and teach me—
this grace is no small matter."
The Great Spirit said:
"This student's words are fitting."
The student said:
"Yes, yes.
I dare not rely on my own defenses."
The Great Spirit said:
"Those who achieve fame,
diligent progress benefits them,
and they unite multiple overseers."
The Heavenly Lord heard this,
the Great Spirit's admonitions to the Sage in dialogue,
for those with knowledge
should not lightly dismiss them.
Lifespan may reach immeasurable longevity;
each should return to their assigned duties,
and when seeing goodness, advance it to the Great Spirit.
The Sage said:
"Together, we receive the Heavenly Lord's teachings,
striving with effort to show results;
having results, I dare not weary in time."
The Heavenly Lord said:
"Those who perfect others perfect themselves."
"Yes, yes."
Only those who attained the Way in ancient times,
even before laws and measures existed, had records,
which were inscribed in the texts of longevity.
When the destined year, month, and day for ascension arrived,
they were transmitted to the Central Pole.
The Central Pole, also known as Kūnlún,
would dispatch officials to record the person's name,
ensuring no omissions.
Repeatedly, they were sent to move and shake the limbs and joints,
bending, stretching, turning, and tilting,
with repeated teachings and admonitions,
commanding them to follow the spirit's flexions,
administering medicinal drinks,
to open and refine the bone joints.
Even if not seen in person at times,
it was known whether they could remain steadfast or not,
demonstrating their unwavering resolve.
Craving life and fearing death,
they aspired to walk with the spirits of heaven.
Repeatedly sent to verify the years counted,
they were then ordered to reverently receive the incomplete texts,
speaking from the heart,
to understand the precautions and prohibitions in their conduct,
transmitting and showing them to learners.
If the divine texts were not used,
and they claimed to have brought their own books to completion,
the spirits would know and converse with them,
also connecting over years and months,
accumulating 1,320 days,
then leading them to meet the great spirits together,
communicating with the primal breath,
acting in accordance with nature.
The Celestial Lord reviewed the secret decrees,
ensuring that all actions were without private trust,
transforming the heart and mind,
so that conduct was without error.
The great spirit said:
"Having calculated what the spirits have borrowed and received,
always on the last day of the eighth month,
records are made of the ledgers from mountains, seas, hills, pools, flowing waters, river bridges, Huái, Jì, rivers, and lakes, detailing all inflows and outflows clearly.
The Celestial Lord has ledgers for rewards and bestowals,
and personally reviews them repeatedly, stored in the golden chamber's records.
Those with a devoted heart are appointed to handle the Celestial Lord's inquiries,
always accepting the teachings,
should day and night without slack,
entrusted to the chamber's keepers not to lose what is sought by their departments,
separately ensuring that those with a devoted heart can know what they deserve,
must be determined by the fixed records.
There will be spirit envoys in charge of tallying names for those due to ascend or descend,
a hundred days in advance, all documents must be submitted without omission.
If documents do not match,
the accounting department failing to report will be held jointly responsible.
First, decree that the divine texts must not be violated;
it is said that after these texts emerge,
in three years and eight months,
they may be shown to ordinary people.
If there are those who believe in the Way,
they may greatly be shown."
The Celestial Lord instructed:
"This person previously had inherited burdens,
decree the spirits to remove and
store them away,
those not yet stored, store them."
The great spirit said:
"This person has long been impoverished and empty,
fearing they cannot sustain themselves,
having the Celestial Lord's trust,
then order the spirits to store them away.
If not stored, when the time comes for those not yet stored,
fear it may not be as said.
Previously begged to decree, bow in thanks for the grace received,
though the date has not yet arrived,
all should be informed a month in advance."
The Celestial Lord said:
"To the subordinate spirits, generals, officers, and masses in the fields,
do not miss the time to store away,
assign them names,
make the local spirits respectful and cautious,
so that divine spirits may come and go,
and those with desires and wishes to seek,
listen to them.
If they are trustworthy,
later, be cautious."

Therefore, divine beings are sent
to show these writings.
Heed the warnings, cease evil, and spirits won't report you;
you may still briefly eat grains and food,
but be careful not to burn mountains or break stones,
harming plants and trees,
breaking flowers or injuring branches,
selling them in markets and alleys,
adding metal blades,
destroying stems and roots entirely.
Their mother will then anger,
reporting to the father above,
who spares no years of human life.
People also need grass for sustenance,
but only take what is withered and fallen, not flourishing—
this is following the norm.
Heaven and Earth give growth,
as people wish to live;
why act recklessly,
harming future generations?
Those with understanding
should not violate prohibitions.
Some harm others intentionally,
merely relying on accomplished deeds,
not taking the young to feed others;
their lives may be slightly prolonged.
Ultimately, records are kept;
do not raise weapons,
harming, threatening, or robbing people of life.
Heaven decrees for such persons
they cannot live long.
Evil begets evil,
troubling and distressing the spirits,
essences, energies, ghosts, and beings,
each unable to rest.
Is this not due to human faults?
Those who did evil earlier
bring calamity down upon themselves.
Hence, children are born
inevitably on inauspicious days;
or during pregnancy,
amid thunder and lightning,
on full moons, new moons, or dark days,
blood忌 or reverse支 days,
when yin and yang unite.
The child born will not thrive,
and misfortune will surely follow.
Summoned by earthly energies,
yet they blame the azure wolf.
Evil repaid with evil—
what more can be hoped for?
Unaware of transformation and change,
their official duties are doomed to extinction without lineage,
their deaths not equal to the masses.
Officials and soldiers in these units,
specifically sent to desolate and unclean places,
barely covered by earth,
devoured by foxes and dogs,
their bodies uncollected,
abandoned by the roadside,
their souls and spirits both suffering,
toil incessantly.
Some cling to plants and trees,
eaten by livestock,
when will they be reborn;
punishing evil and rewarding good is known to all,
why not reform oneself.
Heaven rewards the meritorious,
not the virtueless.
Reflect on it, reflect on it,
rewards and punishments can be understood.
One may die alone in extreme suffering,
the lifespan of good and evil should wane and wax,
examine it carefully, be cautious,
to avoid blame.
Thus, with stern warnings,
to prompt self-repentance.
The convergence of fortune and misfortune,
lies ten thousand miles apart,
hence this text is issued below,
mutually instructing and cautioning,
do not blame heaven or fault earth,
good and evil must be distinguished.
Its words are recorded,
knowing evil to do good,
souls and spirits toil to the extreme.
The foolish do not understand,
so the text's words are repeatedly emphatic,
spreading the message around,
do not create blame for future generations.
Using this to prove oneself,
what more is there to complain about,
nothing left to regret,
each attains their due order.
This text should be transmitted,
without cessation.
The wise may have shortened years,
the foolish write the book themselves,
not heeding its words,
only bringing suffering upon themselves!
In ancient times,
the divine sages foreknew events to come,
governing together with Heaven,
distributed across the four directions, above and below, and the center,
each with their own assignments,
ordered by rank high and low,
looking up and down to one another,
achieving order without severity,
all acting for the good.
Fearing any inadequacy,
they were all of one heart.
Heaven had its envoys,
running to carry out tasks,
using clouds and mists as chariots,
driving flying dragons.
Immortals following them,
each in their own ranks,
all holding record books,
aligning spontaneously without movement.
Fearing any inquiries,
their actions followed rules,
each fulfilling their duties.
In spring, they promoted vital energy,
in summer, nurtured growth,
in autumn, gathered harvests,
enabling people to make offerings,
in winter, stored surplus grains,
ensuring continuity,
without interruption.
The blessings of the spirits,
none failed to flourish under,
their grace extended to crawling creatures,
and even plants and trees,
is this not the grace from above?
Each received their due.
Food was always made abundant,
the old and new succeeding each other,
how could one forget this?
Having gained the people's support,
the spirits were without regret.
Good people were always rewarded,
believing they should further share and suffice,
Heaven made it so,
none could hoard,
leaving others hungry and cold.
Thus, families with wealth were commanded,
to lend and aid the poor,
exchanging old for new,
enabling survival and growth,
passing it to descendants,
with divine protection and aid,
is this not the great grace widely practiced?
Ignorant fools,
unwilling to give thanks,
thinking it their duty by default,
instead harbored discontent,
forcibly taking others' belongings for their own glory,
without a thought of repayment,
disregarding hardships,
believing they could live out their natural lives.
Hence, the texts are reiterated.
Divine beings and true seekers look for good people,
who can transmit writings and understand their use,
then such persons may extend their lives and increase longevity,
harmonizing more with heaven and earth,
transforming together into spirits.
Again, they may ride forth,
circulating through above, below, and the center,
reaching all six directions,
is that not excellent?
Why not ponder deeply,
keeping it always in mind,
where spirits reside,
observing human actions,
not self-righteous,
knowing what is attainable,
should serve in succession,
avoiding calamity and seeking fortune,
not allowing even minor discord with Heaven's will.
Heaven, earth, the four seasons, the five phases, and all divine officials record human destinies,
should they not be revered,
remembering to repay their grace?
Unwilling to do good deeds,
opposing the celestial spirits,
Heaven sends winds and rains awry,
shifting energies,
cold turns warm,
warm turns cold.
Farming misses its seasons,
farmers resent,
unwilling to manage for others.
Grains are disdained,
fed to dogs and pigs,
farmers then depart.
In a virtuous land,
where planted, harvests are meager,
trees wither and fall,
people lack surplus grain.
They harm each other,
striving only to win.
Not considering the true future,
they become impoverished,
gathering nothing,
wandering as drifters.
Before reaching lands of cheap grain,
they starve by the roadside,
dizzy and vision dimmed,
walking erratically,
days without food,
dying hungry, unburied.
Families, big and small,
all suffer disasters,
yet blame Heaven.
Their country empties,
granaries hold no grain,
meat is scarce,
no stored money,
worsening each year,
unable to supply the court.
Many are exempted from taxes,
storehouses receive nothing,
the Minister of Agriculture faces empty records with no supplies,
salaries are cut or removed,
the central state has little to use,
people rely on the nation,
yet none contribute,
facing times of hardship,
all this is despised by Heaven.
The earth cannot long sustain them,
do the wicked know?
True seekers, urgently give this text to virtuous lands,
each urging self-reflection and awareness,
so they may complete their natural lifespans.
The ignorant are like beasts.
Longevity cannot be forced,
it comes through one's actions,
without blaming Heaven.
Ponder the text in detail,
always think of filial piety, loyalty, trust, benevolence, and charity,
confess faults oneself,
then have descendants,
the words are not empty.
In lands without virtue,
Heaven offers no rescue,
the celestial mechanisms hasten urgently,
sun and moon rush with little light.
In virtuous lands,
the mechanisms slow,
sun and moon shine bright.
This is Heaven's way,
the mechanisms, sun, moon, and stars,
all should shine for goodness.
If they dim instead,
it's due to one's actions,
what cause for complaint?
Sharing the same heaven, earth, sun, moon, and stars,
those who see Heaven and earth's response witness their light.
When the five stars lose their course,
warfare runs rampant,
barbarians invade internally,
subjects rebel.
The state dispatches armies,
some return by fate,
others, losing fate, do not come back,
this is the fault of the great men.
Sons lack filial piety,
the state has few loyal ministers,
conduct is impure,
thus causing mutual conflict,
lasting until year's end.
Therefore, the Scripture of Ultimate Pervasion is bestowed,
named Great Peace.
Those who practice it gain blessings,
others are left to reflect deeply,
gathering themselves without departure,
retribution always fair, never wronging people,
those who don't, spread evil to others.
Often said, people high or low,
are all born of Heaven,
but records and destinies may not preserve them.
Love them, be cautious, remember them,
careful not to do what shouldn't be, wronging others,
encroaching and overcoming what isn't theirs.
Heaven won't reward this,
earth won't sustain it,
baleful spirits follow,
denying long, joyful life.
Those who neglect themselves, don't hope for life,
utterly lacking the record for longevity,
forcibly entering immortal fasting households.
All who sacrifice to spirits,
seek immortal transcendence.
Immortals check the records,
find no name of life for you,
prayers and sacrifices, spirits won't partake.
Begging and pleading,
appealing to various spirits,
the spirits anger at them.
Devoured by fierce beasts,
flesh and bones utterly gone.
Bitten by a fox,
one does not return to their hometown.
Neighbors in the same county,
instead claim to have attained immortality,
yet there is no credible report,
how can one prove oneself?
Thus it is said,
it is hard to clarify.
When there is a report,
witnessed by the masses,
then it is considered an ascension.
Otherwise, suffering punishment,
claiming to have gained a little relief,
such a person, if mad or misguided, may be subdued,
yet mistaken as genuine.
All enter the realm of death,
descending to the underworld,
unable to act freely.
Those with virtue and measure,
have records in life,
and when their years are full, they ascend,
with escorts arriving promptly.
The ignorant and naive,
how can they ascend?
Only wasting resources,
abandoning home and sacrificing themselves in the wilderness.
The Way naturally grants status and fortune,
it cannot be forced.
If one torments oneself,
neglecting livelihood and caring for parents,
while wife and children regard one as a worthy scholar,
but fear lies in lacking filial piety, loyalty, and trustworthiness,
one may merely complete their years,
with no punishment in the underworld, only joy.
Surplus wealth,
passed from son to grandson,
should also be used,
do not torment yourself.
Whether descendants are worthy or not,
each must live their own life,
without leaving troubles for others,
this is good conduct.
Hence, this text is recorded to enlighten the wise,
fools ignore it, indulging in reckless joy and anger,
avoiding punishment and harm marks the worthy,
if three admonitions fail, it is best to stop.
Heaven blesses the good,
not the wicked.
Each must be cautious,
do not blame each other.
Each plans for themselves,
actions should be known to all,
without fault against Heaven,
as records dictate,
do not forcefully seek,
seeking is futile.
The reason for this,
is that Heaven does not bless
the wicked and rebellious.
Do not leave your home or city walls,
bones and joints connect like paths,
tendons strive to form sturdy walls,
vessels weave through as networks for bones,
flesh within the skin clothes the vessels.
The spirit resides within, guarding,
overseeing human good and evil.
Why need distant worries,
the Seven Governors await at the spirit's gate.
Seek the Way to gain life,
without leaving your home,
transform and unite with the spirit's virtue,
what more need you seek from the Way?
Thus, virtuous texts are placed in Heaven's register.
The register of immortals differs from the mundane,
when the time to ascend comes,
the deity in charge of the register and guarantors arrive,
then one knows the overseer who upholds teachings,
each has their order,
one must advance and leave some things behind,
cannot act on one's own.
Deities govern together,
selecting those who align with Heaven's will.
Those born earlier,
all have clear minds and vision,
without boundary thoughts,
their actions and origins,
are unknown to others.
All precede heaven and earth,
transforming above and below,
never straying from the Way,
though spirits are not all present.
Thus, order is established,
years and months flanking,
each assigned left and right,
stars distinct,
each with its domain,
striving to advance loyalty,
enabling division of duties.
Seeing good, one should advance it,
seeing evil, retreat from it,
why any doubt?
Actions rely on one's own strength,
do not be misled by spirits.
Thus, success is achieved,
earning the title of Heavenly Lord.
Those in charge of Heaven keep records,
never missing the measure,
overseeing deities across the four directions.
Each direction has its first, middle, and last,
taking turns above and below,
named Tàisuì.
Tàiyīn follows behind,
overseeing geography.
Four seasons are also set,
generating all that exists,
distributed across the wilds,
with late and early grains and grasses.
Those near people do not live long, unlike distant folks,
yet they too endure,
trees in groves and shrubs grow modestly.
Changing eras brings execution,
extending to grandchildren.
The reason for this,
is dwelling in insecurity,
leaving the old for the new,
allows the spirit to return.
Each person has a life-tree in the heavenly soil, passing through phases,
born in spring, three months with the mulberry life-tree,
summer-born, three months with the jujube or plum life-tree,
autumn-born, three months with the catalpa or stalk life-tree,
winter-born, three months with the locust or cypress life-tree,
these are what common people belong to.
There are officials in charge of each tree,
as life nears its end,
the tree half-lives;
when life ends, it withers and falls,
the official cuts the tree.
How can such a person survive?
To live long without death,
change your heart and will,
transplant your tree near the heavenly gate,
named Chángshēng (Long Life).
Divine officials oversee it,
all pure and radiant,
naturally born in heaven's domain,
protecting the spirit's honor and glory.
Just maintain an unsullied name,
Heaven has eternal decrees,
generations bask in glory,
even without protection from above,
in time, the essence is known.
The reason for this,
is being far removed from the mundane,
destined for heavenly duties,
must not fail or err.
Deities inspect each other,
like ink on a string line,
how can one act freely?
Hence, they do not descend.
Do not find it strange.
Merits will be seen,
unlike the mundane world,
though some think it benefits not the family,
inwardly, one is honored,
is that not good?
Thus, shown to later generations,
to awaken their minds,
do not hide the writings,
for there is punishment yearly.
Do not engage in flattery or deceit,
harbor unfilial or disloyal thoughts,
all should not contradict the text's words,
or face reprimand again,
must one not be cautious?
Pass it to the right person,
ensuring they can be recommended.
Do not violate the divine texts,
do not test the divine words,
heed the spirits' advice,
for Heaven repays all.
Do not offend lightly,
lest troubles follow,
minor offenses bring slight demotions,
major ones are beyond rescue.
Thus, deities are made to monitor and report appropriately,
if untrue,
they will be disciplined again.
Matters must be interconnected,
no private dealings.
So, deities inspect and restrain each other,
why doubt regrets later?
Stopping midway,
also faces scrutiny.
Not confessing the truth,
scrutiny followed by confession leads to demotion,
thus advance or halt is examined.
Otherwise, it remains as before,
this is what it means.
Do not offend lightly,
have no fox-like doubts.
The divine laws are profoundly weighty,
thus one must be cautious and detailed about them,
contemplate and reflect upon them,
for the path to longevity and enduring life,
how can it not be valued?
Therefore, this text is presented below to show,
that those who should fill the voids,
by performing good deeds,
will inherit without evasion or loss.
Doing good brings merit and lengthens years,
leaving no room for doubt.
The way of nature has no end,
but through awakening and mutual correction,
even a slight deviation is met with suspicion.
Heaven has music that pleases the various spirits,
and the spirits listen to it.
The good are rewarded,
while those out of tune with the melodies also face judgment.
Each has their own master,
and one cannot lack foundation or order,
or nothing will be accomplished.
All partake of the heavenly granary,
clothed by the Minister of Agriculture,
changing garments with the cold and warmth,
reflecting the respect for yang and humility of yin.
Coarse and fine things, treasures like gold, silver, silks, pearls, and jade,
are each distributed fairly,
with no arbitrary gifts,
only for those who have merit.
None may receive heaven's food and clothing without merit.
As stated in previous texts,
now reiterated,
to prevent resentment,
and remove all suspicion,
for this is heaven's emphasis on the fate of the spirits.
At year's end, records are compiled and submitted,
from mountains, seas, and lands,
various shrines and communal altars,
each reporting their gains,
ensuring nothing is missed or lost.
Residences and their guardians,
observe the offenses of the people,
submitting monthly records yearly,
with the Minister of Agriculture and ritual officers
promptly exchanging documents.
The Great Yin Legal Bureau,
calculates the burdens carried,
deducting from one's allotted years.
After the tally is exhausted,
the underworld spirits are summoned,
along with the earth's treasury,
to collect the physical form,
and examine the soul.
All must be recorded in ledgers,
matching or not matching,
with those in charge guilty of deceit or favoritism,
penalties assigned according to the severity of the examination.
Any records not authorized by heaven,
or involving ghosts and spirits,
must not harm people.
Instances should lead to self-correction,
and mutual reporting.
Offenses severe enough for death,
result in banishment to build bridges, mountains, or seas,
each according to the law's severity,
fitting the deed,
with no omissions.
Each region has its officials and overseers,
who inspect according to the law,
not wrongfully harming ghosts or spirits.
Thus, from top to bottom,
documents circulate in harmony,
each following the established orders.
From ancient times to now,
each has their division,
operating vertically and horizontally,
with responsibilities to receive and give.
As straight as a carpenter's line, without error,
how could one not see the secret of life and death?
Each should be cautious,
not offend the spirits,
fulfill their duties,
and carefully not neglect fate.
It can be recorded in detail,
the good should be promoted,
the evil demoted.
Gatherings of fortune or misfortune,
each according to their wishes.
One must only comply,
not oppose the will.
If the mind is not upright,
and one resents the divine messengers,
the consequences are self-incurred,
whom to blame?
Some people are hard to transform,
knowing they are lacking,
yet all suffer calamities.
Failing in their actions,
they boast with full mouths.
In human affairs, lacking wisdom and foresight,
they see only the present,
ignoring what follows,
attracting disaster and losing love,
slandering the good.
Acting as if heaven perishes above,
earth vanishes below,
unaware of the spirits.
Those who record it,
resolve people's grievances,
offer plenty of wine and dried meat,
indulging in sweet delights.
Acceptable at the time,
but later criticized by others,
lightly cursing and insulting,
uttering imprecations and wrongdoing,
deceiving and defaming,
stealing others' women,
waiting day and night.
Seizing opportunities,
selling for self-sustenance,
desiring fine clothes and shoes,
competing in disputes and arguments.
Not following reason,
wanting to live,
how can it last long?
Fools may be called wicked children,
when officials hear of it,
subordinates arrest them,
swiftly punishing their bodies,
disaster reaching kin and strangers alike,
all sharing the blame.
The poor should strive on their own,
not wavering in resolve,
for this person's fate is recorded,
born from what they've received.
Evil ghosts follow them,
how can they endure?
Such people are numerous,
with meetings before and after,
destined to encounter without cease.
The reason for saying this,
is that evil ghosts take them,
be cautious of the slightest error,
or carelessness will ruin oneself.
Evil cannot be enacted,
for it brings human resentment and blame.
Tolerable at the moment,
but without thought for the future,
heed the warning and stop,
to regain a bit of life,
and complete the remaining tally.
There are records of good and evil,
the origin of lifespan,
the time for added years,
essential to be virtuous.
Without seeing the sages,
wisdom and foresight abound.
Reflecting on life and fearing death,
ascending to immortal scholars,
life can be long-lasting.
Why abandon the world,
letting calamities flow from birth,
while children in the womb say they are the same as born from parents?
All this is blaming heaven and earth,
saying evil should be separated,
not mixed together,
pure and impure divided,
like ruler and servant.
Thus, those who follow the great way live,
those who do not become earth,
similar through ages.
There is good,
and there is evil,
passed down through generations,
never ceasing,
only more or less.
Heaven knows much rebellion,
hence this text is issued to emphasize it.
After heeding the warning,
there can be no doubt,
with hundreds matching tens,
when would there be a lapse?
Heaven and Earth also follow the primordial beginning,
thus forming the essence and spirit,
upholding nature,
generating and transforming all things,
none fail to flourish.
Due to their arrangement,
the sun, moon, and stars,
with mechanisms and balances governing the seasons,
along with the five planets,
each hold their positions,
each performing their duties.
Clouds and rain bestow nourishment,
the people worry over agricultural affairs,
the primordial energy remains and lingers,
all grains, plants, trees, crawling creatures breathing and wriggling,
all contain the primordial energy,
flying birds and walking beasts,
those living in water are likewise,
enabling the people to use them for offerings and for their own sustenance.
Only take those that cause harm for self-provision,
oxen, horses, mules, and donkeys that are no longer serviceable,
provide them for all under heaven.
When the earth spirits have surplus,
gather to share and eat together.
Do not kill those that are serviceable or
those with few teeth,
for this is the way of Heaven,
revered by the spirits.
The myriad people, foolish and ignorant,
recklessly kill and harm,
some with fetuses in the womb,
destined to live but instead die,
this is cutting off life,
to serve human mouths.
At the moment of death,
all are fearful,
knowing closely that survival is unseen.
Thus Heaven truly pities and sympathizes with them,
establishing prohibitions for protection,
offenders are punished for it.
Even the six domestic animals are kept away from clear affection,
unable to bear injuring them,
yet humans do not value themselves,
instead becoming bandits and plunderers.
What they take is not uniform,
recklessly using metal blades to kill people without punishment.
Though not immediately executed,
Heaven accumulates their transgressions,
killing and destruction do not cease,
corpses vanish downstream, the unborn,
such ones also will not encounter good fortune.
Ghosts and spirits detest them,
the overseers are ahead,
when is there ever a time to escape?
Therefore, recording good and evil emphasizes it,
so as not to offend.
Divine beings and true humans use this text to show the masses,
its meaning not hidden,
to make them aware without self-blame,
hence following customs to write clearly.
It can be known that sages and worthies do not offend,
fearing the foolish will not cease.
Teachers have predecessors and successors,
do not forget their origins,
remember the root to approach the new,
cherish and admire as at the beginning,
this is the way of life.
Merits have small and great,
what is received differs.
One should uncover the secrets of the unknown,
the meanings not yet understood,
the thoughts not yet known,
the words not yet heard,
the aspirations not yet realized,
making both sides clear,
this is the will of Heaven.
The way of generation and completion,
emerges from this.
Gain trust from Heaven,
gain trust from Earth,
gain trust from the central harmony,
gain trust from the four seasons,
gain trust from the five phases,
all these are the trustworthy rewards from Heaven.
Not losing a hair's breadth,
do you understand this or not?
This is what the formless concentrated energy naturally follows and transforms.
Thus the Three Platforms and Seven Stars,
assist in upholding Heaven's majesty,
the sun and moon illuminate and examine right and wrong,
ensuring there is natural order,
then there will be none who regret midway.
Therefore, again instructing all the overseers of various departments,
each to make things clear,
accepting punishment without complaint,
this is what it means.
Do not judge right and wrong,
others will naturally become upright.
Admonitions, no matter small or great,
can be taken as models.
Not forgetting these words brings lasting blessings,
it is fitting to cautiously practice them,
not losing discipline.
Hence, the saying tests through self-reflection.
The writings are not yet employed,
the emperor does not yet trust them.
Flatterers are at the side,
the writings do not manifest their principles.
Disasters and harms arise together,
where can the people find rest?
The Tàipíng scriptures will only manifest their principles again after three jiǎzǐ cycles,
not as effective as ten admonitions to make known.
Moreover, reflect on living to seek knowledge,
the wise and sages, having knowledge, can be reached.
Sages ought to elevate the worthy,
following them to seek life,
not disliking those next in rank.
The registers of immortals are at the North Pole,
connected to Kūnlún,
the ruins of Kūnlún have true humans,
above and below there is constancy.
True humans oversee those with recorded names,
names listed in sequence.
The lofty attain the lofty,
the middling attain the middling,
the lowly attain the lowly,
especially none who slap their cheeks begging.
The first-born teacher,
honored as a ruler,
called a father.
Therefore, teacher, ruler, and father must not be unclear,
ministers must not be disloyal,
disciples must not be disobedient.
Respectfully follow those above,
transferring upward to reach.
Thus Heaven does not forget the teacher's grace,
Earth does not forget the teacher's nurture,
humans do not forget the teacher's gifts.
Hence, there is loyalty, filial piety, and trustworthiness,
thinking of life without malice to draw near and enlighten oneself,
Heaven's light shines down below the Yellow Springs,
Earth's light shines up to the space between heavens,
the light of central harmony unites above and below.
Thus, when the three lights converge, harmony is achieved.
Heaven names the three lights as sun, moon, and stars,
shining down on the central harmony and the underworld,
without ceasing or resting.
In a virtueless state,
yin energy obscures the sun,
causing it to have no light.
The people are fearful,
grains scarcely propagate,
floods and droughts are irregular,
people again wander to lands with grain.
Heaven truly pities them,
enabling them to reach living villages to dwell,
where there is an enlightened ruler, the state prospers,
wanderers return to plow fallow lands,
various grains can be sown,
grow to maturity,
people again obtain grain.
Further, honoring the ancestral predecessors,
ghosts and spirits are pacified.
Among them, the wise and intelligent,
seeking immortality,
in the ledgers and registers,
have their names recorded.
They shall again ascend to become Heaven's officials,
inspecting among the people,
harmonizing wind and rain,
enabling peaceful governance,
using this text to show later generations.
Therefore, one should do good,
benefiting Heaven.
From this time onward,
can admonish descendants,
the time of extended years,
can it not be reached?
Though the writings are repetitive,
Heaven greatly loves humans,
wishing to let them complete their years,
earnestly and repeatedly,
entrusted to the spirits.
Good deeds are promptly recorded above,
evil loses its name.
Do not disobey this text,
think of goodness with heartfelt reflection,
constantly not abandoning intent,
should seek the will to live, always mindful of achievement.
The reason for this is,
because human will ought to reach it,
