The Great Spirit says:
"Good,
goodness should also bring fame through grace,
it is fitting to complete the merit to the end,
this is the constant admonition of the spirits. "
"Though the text's words are many and weighty,
it is because the Way of life is vast. "
"Do not fear it.
The discourse shall pause here,
each return to your words. "
With intent and mindful words, I assent,
daring not to forget.
I reflect that throughout history there have been people of great sincerity and integrity,
each fulfilling their purpose,
accumulating merits toward Heaven,
thus daring to step forward.
In every action and cessation,
there has never been the evil of even minor errors.
They constantly harbor compassionate benevolence in their deeds,
spreading kindness and bestowing favors,
benefiting the masses.
They do not fail in small matters of trust,
nor do they fail to revere Heaven and Earth,
following the cycles of the four seasons and five phases,
aiding in the process of growth and completion,
never daring to entertain thoughts of failure,
thereby endangering themselves,
causing unrest.
Hence, they restrain themselves and reflect on their faults and shortcomings,
fearing they are not absolved,
and again being recorded by the multitude of spirits,
with registers reported to the Supreme Sovereign,
which is why they dare to be at peace in their time.
From ancient times to the present, succession continues,
good and evil flow together,
how could there ever be an end?
Therefore, they remain calm and composed,
never slackening,
nor forgetting the acts bestowed by Heaven.
They only reflect on those who seek virtue,
comparing themselves in heart.
Seeing others with good intentions,
they rejoice for them;
seeing others with evil intentions,
they feel alarmed and fearful.
They believe the celestial spirits know of this,
and each makes progress.
Again, they reflect inwardly,
originally born in the mundane world,
their hearts often yearn for the great transformation,
coveting the path of life,
departing from the realm of death,
clinging to the essence and light,
desiring it to reside in their bodies,
making them love one another,
so their hearts may find peace.
Otherwise, they fear being excluded from the realm of constant presence.
Only the various celestial spirits,
at times, may not fully comprehend,
guiding their advances and retreats,
they must uphold Heaven's will,
without any failure.
Lest minor misdeeds reach the ears of the Supreme Sovereign.
Thus, through the spirits, they seek knowledge and broad inquiry,
hoping only for acceptance without rejection,
so they are not doubted.
For receiving a share of grace as a child,
they dare not forget even a hair's breadth.
They only hope for reflection on their words,
desiring to see Heaven's admonitions,
to perfect their selves,
and avoid falling into peril.
This is the day of the spirits' favor and grace,
they dare not rest,
nor fail to remember the great kindness requiring repayment.
Before the spirits report to the Celestial Sovereign,
upon hearing of the dispatch,
the spirits on duty,
receive the order to appear.
They inquire about the person's words and actions,
fully questioning their intent,
having the spirits interrogate them,
then report back clearly.
Speaking of the people of harmony,
they claim their own good deeds,
having accumulated merits over time,
coveting long life.
Humbly stating they often reflect inwardly,
fearing faults and shortcomings,
never having intentions of slackening or rest,
they recount their efficacious deeds to the spirits.
The spirits, sent to report,
say to each other,
"This one has merit and virtuous deeds,
among the people of harmony,
mindful to repay Heaven's great kindness;
having practiced good deeds for long,
wishing through the spirits,
to speak of their own merits and virtues,
yet each harbors doubts,
daring not to report to the Celestial Sovereign,
often relying on the spirits for trust,
having merits toward Heaven,
those with such should be advanced."
And the spirits observe and assess,
their conduct over time,
why not report?
The spirits all speak with fear,
"Originally, we did not know of this person's arrival,
fearing it may not be entirely accurate."
And each considers the intent,
unaware the Celestial Sovereign has heard.
Thus, the spirits lack a clear leader,
rightly seeing a person with good deeds and merits,
yet not reporting it in time.
The envoy sends spirits to investigate accumulated deeds,
finding their conduct highly meritorious.
These spirits have each acted improperly,
lacking merit or goodness themselves,
and with divided loyalties,
thinking the Celestial Sovereign does not know; the spirits each understand commands,
for what purpose are they used,
only for benefit,
should each be at ease?
The spirits apologize,
each, recognizing their duty, removes their cap in apology.
Saying, "Minor spirits performing duties,
each striving to fulfill loyal sincerity,
yet incurring this charge of fault without cause,
await death at the gate."
The Celestial Sovereign issues an edict, saying,
"Wait outside for now,
order the spirits to prostrate,
for they should stand in peril on duty."
The edict commands the spirits, saying,
"The Celestial Sovereign does not wish to spare the spirits,
yet cannot bear to harm them.
They are sentenced to exile in the harmonious land,
in the capital Luòyáng for ten years,
selling medicine to cure illnesses,
not allowed to take much money from patients.
After the exile ends,
the superior ones will be recorded in the registry office,
if meritorious for one year,
then restored to their former status."
The spirits, seeing the Celestial Sovereign,
guilty of a capital offense,
receive only light exile.
Sincerely aware of their faults,
they feel crushed,
not hoping for life,
unable to bear the intent to harm,
apologize again with matters.
The Celestial Sovereign says:
"Inform the registry officers to descend quickly,
do not delay the time,
let the spirits act promptly to oversee it."
The registry reports:
"We will send them down as the Celestial Sovereign commands."
The Celestial Sovereign orders the registry,
again informing the great spirits,
to examine the documents,
and show them to the spirits.
The registry transmits the documents for the great spirits to see,
sending them to their departments,
each following their duties,
seeing those with merit and goodness,
those eager for advancement should be promoted.
Previous matters fully reported are known.
The Celestial Sovereign commands the great spirits, saying:
"Quickly observe this person early,
and see if it matches the words of the envoy spirits or not."
The great spirits say:
"Sent to observe this person,
accumulating the days,
viewing the efficacy, then return.
Clearly ordered by decree,
to observe the meritorious people of harmony,
report back as the envoy spirits said."
The Celestial Sovereign also notes that for such meritorious people,
the spirits in charge do not report in time.
The Celestial Sovereign becomes aware,
then states the intent,
is this not due to lack of effort?
They receive exile in the harmonious land by register,
from now on,
it can serve as a warning.
Having merits unreported,
when the Celestial Sovereign hears of it,
they receive punishment and exile themselves.
Each must carefully perform duties and dispatch spirits,
guiding and transforming the people,
helping them become spirits,
increasing their essence and light.
For examining the registers,
those not listed above,
inscribe their names and report them.
The great spirits receive the order and return to the registry,
checking the registers for such names.
Reporting to the registry,
"The documents have this record,
please check the Celestial Sovereign's internal register,
to see if it matches or not."
The Celestial Sovereign produces the document and examines it,
finding it the same as the external record.
Orders it to be reported immediately.
The great spirits say:
"Unclear if the term is full or not,
please allow re-examination in detail."
The Celestial Sovereign states:
"Great spirits, you are placed as eyes and ears,
yet do not fully observe it.
"And shall we return to the case?"
The Great Spirit excused himself due to his duties.
The Heavenly Sovereign said:
"Quickly proceed with the case and return swiftly."
The Great Spirit then examined the person in question,
whose years were already fulfilled;
having failed to report omissions without justification,
he deserved to await punishment and face execution.
The Heavenly Sovereign said:
"For now, assign him to observe the duties,
and do not slack off again.
Summon that person to ascend,
do not let him fail in his minor post's effectiveness,
so he knows how to dedicate his efforts."
"Yes, yes.
I request to follow the Heavenly Sovereign's command."
"Agreed.
Great Spirit, bring that person forward,
appoint him to a minor position,
and observe his conduct."
"The time is still short;
I ask to verify the truth again;
if there is great proof of trustworthiness,
truly fill any vacancy by appointing him to the lacking post."
The Heavenly Sovereign said:
"We shall heed what the Great Spirit has reported,
do not have any slackening intent."
The Great Spirit said:
"Yes, yes,
I request to send an envoy spirit to observe him closely."
The Heavenly Sovereign said:
"Good."
In the heavens, there are sagely and enlightened individuals,
each assigned to their departments and duties,
all fulfilling their loyalty and conduct,
not failing those above,
each exerting their strength in their actions,
without losing their purpose.
They all anticipate what the Heavenly Sovereign will enact,
always listening intently,
wishing to understand his intent,
constantly observing the documents of the reserve officials and civil departments,
so they may be distinctly informed.
They await the sovereign's summons at any time,
not daring to leave privately,
only going out for public affairs,
and always reporting their intentions to inform,
then daring to depart.
Wherever they go and roam,
under decree to carry out inspections,
they dare not linger even for a moment.
Only after fulfilling public duties do they dare speak of private matters,
sincerely submitting themselves without daring to act selfishly.
If they do not deserve to preserve their lives fully,
they regret day and night and blame themselves,
often fearing they lack steadfast usefulness.
Each manages their own person,
wishing to align with the Supreme One's intent,
never daring to slacken at any time,
afraid of losing propriety.
Striving daily to advance themselves,
without needing divine words.
Thus, they seek to perfect themselves,
desiring long life,
engaging with the various spirits of the heavens,
regardless of rank, high or low,
all interconnected and aware.
They can undertake actions but not unrighteousness,
not acting on their own authority,
fearing suspicion,
informing each other with every move,
with no time for rest.
The reason for this is,
each person has their own will,
each has their own thoughts,
each achieves their own accomplishments,
their plans differ.
Each has their own views,
each has their origins,
each desires to gain something,
each knows their place,
and thus their hearts are clear.
In such matters,
it is essential to value life,
life being the foremost.
For the rest, each plans their own actions.
Vital energy attaches to the human body,
never departing from it.
They guard and complete each other,
and the spirits also value obtaining their renown.
Transforming, entering, and exiting,
through the smallest openings,
free in size and movement.
Ordinary people,
do not see the forms of the spirits,
but spirits know each other,
their forms all made of energy—
what could remain unaccomplished?
Great spirits and minor spirits,
their essence and light increase or decrease,
each having their distinctions.
Their lifespan increases by nine,
thus they have their years.
Through great transformation and virtuous conduct,
longevity becomes limitless,
above there is no top,
below there is no bottom,
entering and exiting without barriers,
without outer or inner,
resembling a cycle.
Wishing to stop, they stop on their own,
wishing to move, they move,
breathing becomes divine,
with glorious splendor.
Above and below have their times,
when it is fitting to act, they return in due season.
Yet they cannot act entirely freely,
constrained by hierarchy.
Each serves the other,
each has their records,
each has their duties,
should have the right mindset,
holding to their purpose without deviation,
clarifying their actions.
Each sees their merits,
each contributes what they know,
without selfishness,
acting always under instruction,
not straying from the teachings.
And with diligent progress toward their aims,
constantly without ceasing,
they stop only upon receiving a decree.
This is the aspiration of the life-giving spirits,
always having tallies and passes as tokens of faithful conduct.
For all inspections carried out,
the provisions due,
should not exceed the documents,
following the amount allotted.
In the heavenly relay stations,
there are their own records,
those not entitled to stay should not remain.
This the Heavenly Sovereign always teaches, to avoid recklessness,
fearing the station-keeping officers might use authority and power.
Officials have ranks, high and low,
one must not falsely claim high position,
and claim long stays at relay stations.
Officers always receive the Heavenly Sovereign's decrees,
those passing through stations,
must report their name, rank, and affiliation,
without concealment or deceit.
The Heavenly Sovereign also knows this himself,
how could there be private understandings?
Each is treated according to their merit.
Only then can one avoid disobeying orders and decrees,
with records frequently submitted.
Otherwise, essence and light are lost,
lifespan reduced and diminished—
this can be known,
one ought to be cautious in time,
not daring to act on one's own,
without accepting the teachings from above.
The spirits in heaven,
investigate and report on each other,
also without rest.
Later generations, high and low, should know these prohibitions,
the sagely and enlightened naturally do not violate them.
Fearing that later generations might not see these warnings,
therefore, texts are issued throughout the world to inform and guard against violations.
This is the great kindness of the Heavenly Sovereign,
lest there be offenders.
It is because the Heavenly Sovereign wishes to cultivate good hearts,
that he provides these texts,
and speaks also to ordinary people.
Though ordinary people are few in understanding,
they know within the central harmony,
there are various taboos.
Documents circulate under heaven,
among the people in central harmony,
farmers on the paths,
in fields, villages, and gatherings,
huts, houses, official residences,
gates, wells, and stoves,
punishments and virtues each oversee their affairs,
and one must not commit evils.
Again, records are kept in detail,
noting down names,
accumulating numerous cases for the sagely and enlightened to manage,
further made known in the bright hall for the Heavenly Sovereign to learn,
again reducing people's years,
up to the point of death—
Can one not be cautious?
These texts are issued repeatedly because
later-born people
do not believe previous admonitions.
Therefore, relying on those with knowledge and prudence,
who do not violate prohibitions, to disseminate them,
letting the common world know,
that not following the written words,
one's life cannot be preserved whole.
The record of evils accumulates daily,
with little time for reduction.
Thus, decreed texts are given first as warnings,
to prevent violations,
for violating them shortens life—
doubt this not.
One should follow the texts' words;
minor faults might still be redeemed,
but major faults—how can they be pardoned?
The warning texts are not just one scroll,
one must be deeply cautious, deeply cautious.
The celestial writings cannot be taken lightly;
those with understanding
rarely commit offenses,
though sometimes mistakes occur,
Heaven also pardons them,
not listing them among the wicked.
But if one persists in evil,
linked with the register of death,
handed over to the earthly office,
their physical form buried—
when will they emerge again?
The essence and soul imprisoned,
questioned about life's deeds,
if their words do not match,
again subjected to interrogation and punishment,
the soul in extreme suffering—
whose fault is it?
Born together among humans,
why commit evil deeds?
Each should guard themselves well.
Heaven endows human life,
which cannot be regained.
If one's evil deeds decrease year by year,
how could there be a time when they bring benefit?
This is the moment that should be taken charge of,
for the Celestial Sovereign seeks sincerity,
daring not to overlook people's wicked deeds,
so as to enable them to live long,
is this not understood?
The writings repeatedly admonish before and after,
yet since the people do not reform,
they merely cause one to wish to live out their full lifespan.
If one does not wish to do good,
they bring incompleteness upon themselves,
and what can be done about such a person who persists in evil without cease?
One may briefly set aside the written admonitions,
and reflect on their consequences later;
if there is any lack,
then reflect on it again.
Only those with aspirations
have minds free from confusion.
They follow the transformations of Heaven,
and should be the ones to guide.
Each is allowed to follow their own wishes,
thus acting according to their heart.
All twelve thousand things are born in the neutral earth,
growing and thriving,
each naturally covering itself,
shading its roots below.
Their flowers and fruits serve to nourish the body and mouth,
aiding the grain supply,
enabling sour, salty, vinegar, and mild flavors at will.
Transforming water into salt,
to season various tastes.
Using beans to make fermented seasoning,
assisting salt in enhancing flavors.
Thickness or thinness as one pleases,
vegetables and all sorts of plants,
whatever is meant to be eaten,
are all made for the people to consume.
Using them for warmth and fullness,
to grow in form and appearance,
with descendants carrying on.
Even the unusable among the six domestic animals,
are allowed to be eaten,
all the fatty, delicious, sweet, and crispy kinds are made available.
This is the duty of the spirits appointed by Heaven,
to harmonize and balance,
letting each follow their wishes,
without depriving them of their peace.
Is this not bestowing grace and benefiting the people?
Is it not?
Why does Heaven give without seeking repayment?
When has Heaven ever sought reward for its gifts?
It is only because the common people receive great kindness yet do not return thanks,
that it is sought.
Heaven feeds on the essence and vital energy,
naturally not needing the people's repayment or thanks,
but valuing the intention.
Yet people do not consider what Heaven's energy has produced,
allowing them to eat.
That among the people there are those who know yet do not repay is thus,
thinking it their duty as Heaven's envoys.
Those who perform their duties,
inspect among the people,
sending flying insects to issue orders,
urging farmers to hasten their crops,
the cuckoo calls daily.
Making the people heed its words,
families large and small,
all who can eat grain encourage each other day and night,
sowing seeds in moist soil,
Heaven makes them grow,
with timely rain and wind swaying,
moving the branches and leaves,
forming their bodies fully by day,
ripening to feed people—
is this kindness not profound?
From year to year,
when does it ever end?
Yet some act without filial piety,
harboring rebellious hearts—
what benefit is that to Heaven,
to long nurture the wicked,
letting them see edible things?
Does Heaven truly not know?
Why should it long nurture the unfilial and rebellious?
Thus, ominous spirits are set to follow them;
the unfilial and rebellious are removed,
subjected to strict prohibitions,
their crimes leading to heavy misfortune,
with no time for pardon seen.
Think, should people be like this?
Why offend,
bringing upon themselves shortened lives,
losing their years and fate?
Should they not see how the filial and good alone gain longevity and descendants?
Good and evil should be compared;
short life with short life has its parallel,
not being born and death should be starkly different.
Doing good with filial piety and kindness,
lets each live out their years,
some even gaining extended life,
with descendants in succession,
without untimely death.
This is the result of good and filial conduct by Heaven,
should it not be compared?
Why act wrongly?
What is given to others?
Heaven deeply detests it,
often cutting short their lives,
bringing blame upon their descendants—
this is caused by evil,
what hope can there be?
Heaven delights in the good,
not in wicked children.
One should ponder the words of this text,
its content complete,
enabling self-protection,
surely gaining Heaven's blessing.
Need not long suffer self-sorrow,
filling the belly with worry.
Further, with anxious energy knotted unresolved,
day and night grieving, sighing deeply,
brooding over scattered wealth,
fearing it cannot long be kept.
Illnesses year after year,
never leaving the bed,
not cured by doctors,
the knotted energy unresolved.
Thinking on it,
day and night growing weaker,
eating even less,
unable to digest grain fully,
the five organs unsettled,
the spleen not grinding.
This is precisely in the realm of deficiency, short of breath,
unable to keep food down.
The family sees it,
calling it hard to survive.
Those with wealth,
have some savings stored;
those without,
see their property exhausted,
inside and out all poor,
unable to help each other.
When death arrives,
no coffin is seen,
simply buried in the earth.
Only if one managed life with wealth,
could it be provided.
Among the mutually poor families,
wealth gone, people scattered,
when can they reunite?
Families separated,
unable to save each other.
Thus, no coffin is seen,
becoming ghosts without coffins,
drifting without homes,
with none to offer food.
Dead as ghosts,
starving, begging for food,
with no end in sight.
This is the result of evil deeds,
unaware of losing their clan.
Alas, how painful!
Death with nothing to rely on.
Such are those who accumulate faults and calamities,
bringing upon themselves no descendants or legacy,
Heaven deeply pities them too.
Thus, sometimes a posthumous child is left,
unknown if boy or girl.
The child born not yet grown,
the mother leaves to remarry.
When the child grows older,
asking distant relatives,
"Where are my parents?"
The relatives say,
"Your father, in youth,
could not be restrained by his parents,
frivolously following others,
careless of home,
robbing and stealing,
never stopping himself,
executed by the authorities,
wandering elsewhere,
property all gone,
not returning to his hometown,
long in another region,
unclear where he went,
life or death unknown."
All families suffer the poison,
relatives near and far all gone.
"Your mother, while pregnant with you,
seeing you born to continue the line,
felt joy in her heart.
But the family elders,
with no one to depend on,
poor and unable to sustain themselves,
made her serve another.
Following her husband as a wanderer,
with no return in sight."
The posthumous child says,
"Everyone lives relying on parents,
only I live without seeing mine."
When quite grown,
asking where his father is.
People say,
"Your father did evil,
abandoned his parents far away,
roamed other places,
life or death unknown,
whereabouts none."
Travelers say he's already dead,
but where is unknown.
His parents worried over him,
fell ill and never rose,
thus failing as people.
Property all exhausted,
Both externally and internally, all is in decline,
the fault lies in having few relatives and distant connections,
with no bonds of kindness from the start.
I cannot help but look up to the sky and weep bitterly,
tears falling and soaking my clothes.
My father committed wicked deeds,
bringing upon himself the fate of not returning home.
I blame myself,
with no relief in sight.
At that time, as a traveler,
I hired myself out to a wealthy family,
serving as their slave.
Earning a few thousand a year,
clothing expenses came from it,
leaving little to spare,
but after more than ten years,
I could save enough to return to my hometown.
I search for my father,
weeping and lamenting day and night,
with no one else to rely on,
how profound is this pain!
My father's past misdeeds
left me with no support,
tears flow like a stream,
never drying.
Heaven, in its great compassion,
often grants strength and health,
so that making a living brings profit,
enabling me to take a wife,
and have descendants,
then my heart finds a little peace.
I tell this to my son,
saying, "My father acted wickedly,
strayed far to another land and did not return.
When others went to inquire,
consulted diviners,
we could not discern whether he was dead or alive, nor find his whereabouts,
and searched for him in vain.
After years away, striving to make a living,
Heaven pitied this poor man,
granted me some profit,
and I accumulated a little money.
Then I sought a wife to help in livelihood,
thus you came to be.
I resent my father for his youthful misdeeds,
hence I caution you.
From now on,
you must only do good,
do not follow my father's example of wandering far to other places.
So I reflect on my own faults,
and Heaven pities me.
Strive with all your heart to be good,
do not roam idly,
manage your livelihood orderly,
do not take others' wealth,
just enough to sustain life.
Each of you, attend to your duties,
do not drink recklessly,
or engage in gossip and disputes,
lest you face loss again.
Carefully consider your parents' words,
and you may avoid blame.
When Heaven above hears and knows,
you will become a better child,
and may attain a long life, fulfilling your years.
I, as your elder,
use this as a warning.
When the various spirits hear and know,
they report it to Heaven.
Heaven commands good spirits to accompany you,
your livelihood will prosper,
wealth will increase again,
children born will be healthy,
and you will have sufficiency,
all this is Heaven's grace.
In spring and autumn, and at seasonal festivals,
always repay Heaven's kindness,
and without negligence,
strive to do good,
and you will naturally gain blessings.
Be cautious in your speech and actions,
and also take care of yourself.
Heavenly spirits are always by people's side,
do not speak wildly.
Be careful even in small deviations,
for carelessness can cost your life.
Upon hearing this warning, examine yourself,
do not blame others;
this precept should be understood.
Those who wish for great longevity,
must not disregard these admonitions.
In the world where humans dwell,
each has their appropriate place,
each has their accomplishments.
None have their wishes taken away,
each follows what brings them ease and comfort.
Freely pursuing what they enjoy,
engaging in trade or farming.
Some wish to become officials,
or serve as physicians, shamans, craftsmen, or masters,
each enabled to achieve success,
all paths leading to fulfillment,
providing what the people can use.
This is the transformation by the Celestial Master,
how could anything not be accomplished,
enabling self-sufficiency.
One should always remember to follow the ways of Heaven,
the bestowal of gracious portions,
the responses to the four seasons,
all ensuring that incense and purity never cease.
This is how to repay Heaven's grace.
Long persistence in good deeds,
being beloved by the spirits,
is the result of virtuous conduct,
how could there be any who do not follow?
Thus Heaven constantly watches from above,
overseeing human rights and wrongs,
sending spirits to come and go,
knowing what people do,
reporting good and evil without fail,
how could there be any omissions.
If some think little of this and believe otherwise,
Heaven therefore shows them its echoes and shadows,
making them hear sounds as proof.
The timing of wind and rain,
all can be known,
how could there be any doubt.
Actions always differ,
writings and records succeed one another,
yet never lose their principles.
People should also know what is permissible and what is not,
how can they act willfully without obeying Heaven?
Heaven personally receives the primal breath of spontaneity,
follows its teachings and commands,
not daring to have the slightest intention of disobedience.
Fearing there might be loss,
and what people achieve through effort.
Violating Heaven's laws,
not avoiding the nets and traps.
This is why Heaven decrees self-admonishment,
for the sake of long life,
to be among the good people.
How can humans truly be free?
Therefore, spirits are sent to follow those who do evil,
overseeing their improper actions,
always reporting the matters,
faults great or small,
all heard above by Heaven.
These are human faults,
why complain about Heaven's writings?
The writings contain warnings, yet if one does not follow them in conduct,
only when illness comes does one panic,
how can escape be possible then?
Truly, the folly of the people,
what benefit is it to Heaven?
Causing spirits to toil in heart and mind,
physicians and shamans to perform exorcisms.
Wishing to seek life,
forgetting the time when faults were committed.
When doing evil,
it was like this,
why not immediately repent and blame oneself?
Only after falling ill does one seek life,
but many die afterward.
All prayers and sacrifices to the spirits,
minor faults may be resolved,
serious ones are not pardoned.
Instead, many summons are issued,
calling upon deceitful illness-causing spirits,
knocking heads and beating oneself,
hoping to beg for life,
with numerous written pleas,
yet the name of death is fixed,
how can one escape again?
Physicians, shamans, and spirit households,
only desire people's money,
saying they can be cured,
demanding much rich food, wine, and dried meat,
invoking great spirits,
entrusting one's essence and spirit to them,
claiming they will surely release you from death.
But the name on the register does not remove itself,
money and goods are exhausted,

All that is influenced by sound undergoes movement,
each leading to specific outcomes.
Thus, in harmony and union,
those who grasp the meaning achieve good,
those who do not grasp the meaning incur evil.
When sounds move,
first the spirits of all things come to pay homage before movement occurs,
revealing their forms.
Therefore, when moving musical sounds,
one should always strive to understand their affairs,
and carefully grasp their meaning;
then Great Peace can be achieved,
and baleful qì can be dispelled.
Perfected One, examine this in detail."
"Yes, yes.
May I ask, how do musical sounds move and influence?"
"Excellent!
Your question
hits upon the essential meaning.
It is like spring acting first:
the Great Jué string moves Jiǎ.
On Jiǎ days, it influences the Year Star above,
and below the Heart Star, it influences the Eastern Peak.
The qì then stirs Shàoyáng,
the sound stirs the Wood phase,
the spirit stirs Gōumáng,
the creature moves the Azure Dragon,
the position influences the Green Emperor,
and the spirit attracts the Green-robed Jade Maidens.
Penetrating above and reaching below,
all come to pay homage according to their kind,
delighting in the joyful sounds.
Explain one to seek its category,
and there is no end.
By carefully searching for the essential meaning yourself,
you will fully attain it.
Combine it with all written texts,
to form a model.
Thus, in raising music,
those who grasp its highest meaning
can transcend the world;
those who grasp its middle meaning
can achieve peace
and eliminate calamities;
those who grasp its lower meaning
can bring joy to people.
Grasping the highest meaning
can please the spirits and deities;
grasping the middle meaning
can please the essences;
grasping the lower meaning
can please the body;
if all meanings are grasped,
the sovereign can roam without troubles,
music arises and punishments cease,
as spirits and essences satisfy each other."
"I wish to hear the meaning of music arising and punishments ceasing."
"Excellent,
your words.
Indeed, music
is the essence of the Great Yang;
punishments
are the essence of the Great Yin.
When Yang is abundant, Yin submits;
when Yin is abundant, Yang submits.
Therefore, when music is abundant, punishments cease.
Why is music considered Yang,
and punishments Yin?
Where the sound is harmonious,
that region attains harmony and goodness.
Where the sound is not harmonious,
that region is baleful and evil.
At the appropriate time,
listen carefully to its sounds.
Those who understand sound
fully know the auspiciousness or inauspiciousness of affairs;
those who do not understand sound
cannot know it."
"Musical sounds are
the language and discourse of music.
Whether divining the distant or the near,
all should harmonize with them.
The day, time, surname, and given name,
the delineation of boundaries,
the phases of flourishing, stability, decline, and abandonment,
are mutually selected and combined,
to form discourse.
The refined listener perceives them without error."
"Excellent, excellent!
May I ask about using music to eliminate disasters, harm, deceit, and wickedness,
modeling the methods of heaven and earth as numerical principles?
Should the emperor, at dawn or early, shake his musical instruments,
and begin to intone their sounds,
to dispel the energy of sorrow and suffering,
thereby bringing about great peace?"
"Excellent is your question,
how consistently skillful!
The August Heaven has long been distressed by calamities,
pitying the emperor's worries and sufferings,
thus sending you, the enlightened one, to inquire about all doubtful matters, is it not?
Yes, yes.
Sit peacefully,
I dare not conceal anything,
for hiding it would risk Heaven's reprimand,
causing me to long endure severe punishment,
with no benefit to my heavenly allotted years.
Sit calmly and listen in detail,
as I explain the essential meaning to you point by point.
The Way of Heaven is like a cycle,
revolving and starting anew.
Initiating music
should always align with the timing that enhances its flourishing energy,
establishing the direction based on the Dipper's position,
facing that direction,
and activating its sounds.
One may sing it,
each according to their own tone.
The numbers follow the six jia and the five phases.
The five, six jia, and five phases
are the numbers of heaven and earth.
The seasonal energies
are what heaven and earth resonate with,
and what they promote.
For instance, on the day of the Beginning of Spring,
when the Dipper points to Yín,
it is called the time of the Supreme Deity,
first activate the jué note.
At mid-month, add Jiǎ;
in the second month, the Dipper points to Mǎo,
at mid-month, add Yǐ;
in the third month, add Chén.
Other movements follow this pattern.
Each follows its seasonal energy,
with early or late timing as its measure.
First activate the imperial note and imperial string,
then the kingly note and kingly string,
next the minister note and minister string,
followed by the marquis note and marquis string,
and then the zhǐ note and zhǐ string,
each according to their numbers.
This is called receiving Heaven's teaching,
complying with Earth's energy;
heaven and earth will naturally delight in using it,
how much more so humans?
Humans are
the most honored among beings,
the children of Heaven.
Heaven delights in humans reverently using its numbers,
Earth delights in humans carefully following its numbers.
This is like a filial son's obedience,
following parental instruction;
how could parents not love and favor him?
Now Heaven has sent you to inquire,
I speak on behalf of Heaven,
establishing the numbers for supreme peace,
daring not to omit anything,
fearing the reprimand of heaven and earth,
daring not deceive you enlightened ones,
daring not conceal anything.
Only if not asked,
but when asked, I speak.
I see your inquiry is profound,
knowing Heaven wishes to speak,
hence I explain fully to you.
You, enlightened one, receiving my Way,
ponder its meaning deeply,
and pass it to later generations,
that they may emulate and act accordingly,
to eliminate all kinds of disasters,
above to pacify the energies of heaven and earth,
below to assist the emperor in governance.
So that all people's hearts
are peaceful and not inclined to evil,
and the twelve thousand beings each attain their place,
is that not joyous?"
"Great, great!"
"You enlightened ones may be said to understand."
"May I ask about the affairs of the six caverns and eight directions,
which are the most auspicious and good,
and which the most inauspicious and evil?"
"Good your question.
Now listen in detail,
as I explain the meaning.
The most harmonious and mutually joyful are good and auspicious,
the most conflicting and mutually sorrowful are inauspicious and evil.
Harmonious and joyful produce good sounds,
conflicting and sorrowful produce evil sounds.
Thus, music that is solely joyful,
harmonious and joyful, is good music;
auspicious events allow music-making,
evil events must not have music,
having music for them is called false joy,
increasing inauspiciousness daily.
Therefore, times enhanced with imperial, ministerial, and subtle energies,
all before the Heavenly Dipper, are auspicious events.
What heaven and earth delight in,
they wish to promote;
what heaven and earth share,
they are about to employ.
Thus, one should delight in, comply with, and prosper them.
The energies of decline and abandonment,
heaven and earth jointly reject and weaken,
so they should be discarded,
not fit for joyful promotion.
Promoting them with music opposes heaven and earth's will,
termed great rebellion,
non-compliance with seasonal energies.
Seasonal energies are
the correct energies of Heaven's timing.
Heaven and earth set the standard:
flourishing and ministerial energies govern peace,
imprisoned, abandoned, and severed energies govern calamitous years.
Flourishing and ministerial energies produce much,
many good deeds.
Thus, in years of peace,
all things flourish,
many good things,
this is clear evidence,
a great manifestation of heaven and earth.
Heaven and earth's joy in goodness manifests
even in the people and myriad beings,
serving as great proof and verification.
Therefore, the ancient sages deeply divined and observed this,
knowing their own conduct's successes and failures,
clearly using similarities in kind, affair, and energy to divine and observe.
Obtaining images of the same energy and kind,
they altered their nature and changed their actions,
daring not to do wrong.
The language of heaven and earth
uses this as proof,
not communicating face-to-face with humans.
Observing the images and kinds obtained,
one can know for oneself.
Imprisoned, abandoned, dead, and severed energies produce little,
achieving no good deeds.
Thus, in calamitous years,
little can grow,
no good responses,
no good things,
this is their shared affair and energy.
Therefore, those approaching peace
may fully make music;
music should comply with and delight the flourishing energy,
as balanced energy arrives.
First, regarding the Way in calamitous years,
one must not make music,
must not without cause initiate music;
imprisoned and abandoned energies rebel against heaven and earth,
hence in calamitous years and events,
music must not be made.
Thus, flourishing and ministerial energies
are where virtue resides.
Imprisoned and abandoned energies
are where punishment resides."
"Therefore, virtuous rulers who cherish life,
are permitted by Heaven to create music;
while rulers without virtue,
are not allowed to create music.
This is clear evidence from Heaven.
Do you understand this, truth-seeker?"
"Yes, yes.
How awe-inspiring!
Today, having inquired of the enlightened teacher of Heaven,
I fully comprehend the intent of Heaven's music;
when I did not ask,
I thought creating music was merely a trivial matter,
something any person could do at any time.
Now that I have asked,
I dare not act recklessly hereafter."
"Excellent, insightful student,
you may be said to understand the profound principles of the texts,
and have grasped Heaven's intent.
When great peace arrives,
all calamitous energies will depart."
"I humbly wish to reiterate and ask about doubts in my heart."
"Proceed,
speak plainly without reservation."
"Yes, yes.
Now the energies of heaven and earth,
are half flourishing and half dormant,
comparable to day and night,
without cessation.
Should music then be performed all day long?
Or only when directed towards the flourishing direction,
during times of flourishing energy?"
"Only begin its creation
with the inception of imperial energy,
never commence with dormant energy.
So it is with the year,
so with the month,
so with the day,
so with the hour."
"This humble student does not yet fully grasp the meaning,
but if one wishes to delight the year,
the year resides in the east at Mǎo,
so perform music in the second month of spring.
To delight the month,
align with its respective month;
for days, choose the dominant day;
for hours, choose the dominant hour.
Acting thus may be called following Heaven's way,
and calamitous energies will depart.
If not done this way,
it all disrupts Heaven's order,
giving rise to ominous disasters.
Therefore, the sage kings of antiquity,
deeply understood the intentions of heaven and earth,
and dared not delight in inauspicious affairs.
If inauspicious affairs are delighted in,
then inauspicious affairs will daily increase,
and once increased, cannot be remedied,
hence they should not be delighted in.
Heaven endows nature,
each having its own essence.
Delight in goodness,
and the essence of goodness arrives;
delight in evil,
and the essence of evil arrives.
This is the nature of spontaneity,
nothing strange about it.
It's just that foolish people do not deeply consider it."
"Excellent, excellent!
Truth-seeker, if you wish to know its great effect,
this is comparable to the way of Heaven.
All that is pure and clear delights in returning to heaven,
all that is heavy and dense delights in returning to earth,
each follows its kind,
and there is nothing to fault.
Hence, delight in goodness and receive goodness,
delight in misfortune and receive misfortune,
just as water flows downward,
and fire rises upward,
without missing a hair's breadth.
Truth-seeker, take this text and entrust it to a virtuous ruler,
to show to ordinary people.
Now that the energy of great peace has arrived,
Heaven promotes goodness,
causing all to delight in goodness,
and there should no longer be any who without reason delight in inauspicious affairs.
Those who delight in inauspicious affairs
make themselves enemies of Heaven,
and incur blame from Earth,
their transgressions unforgiven.
Now, in heaven, such delighters in inauspicious affairs are named
as great rebels and traitors.
Heaven's ominous energies,
and all Earth's calamities will descend and return to them."
"May I ask, if there is a sudden urgency,
and one must use music,
to delight in auspicious affairs,
but there is no time to wait
for the flourishing direction or the Dipper's front,
what should be done then?"
"Good indeed,
your question,
hits the essential meaning.
Well then, have musicians reside in the flourishing direction;
if they cannot reside there,
have the musicians and the people
also face the flourishing direction in request,
using their tones,
and using their numbers.
Even if only by the person's surname and given name,
upholding the pitch standards and calendar,
with corresponding tones and energies,
one can also follow the flourishing and assisting seasonal energies,
and according to the person, have them perform music;
this too is permissible.
Those who act thus
are all following and applying the teachings of heaven and earth,
ensuring no disasters or harms.
If not done this way,
there will be those who align with ominous and imprisoned energies,
all giving rise to inauspicious affairs.
Moreover, when raising voices and initiating music,
it should also be with auspiciousness,
auspicious tones and good affairs.
For the energy of flourishing and assisting,
is like a ruler among people,
who also does not wish to hear of inauspicious affairs,
inauspicious words,
or inauspicious tones.
The reason for this is that
the energy of flourishing and assisting acts as the sovereign of heaven, presiding over life,
presiding over the completion of good deeds,
thereby assisting Heaven in generating and completing.
Evil tones and inauspicious affairs
do not assist Heaven in generating all things.
Therefore, the flourishing energy does not wish to hear them delighted in,
nor does the energy before the Dipper
wish to hear them delighted in.
Hence, the sages, worthies, and emperors of antiquity
all accumulated good words and good deeds,
not admitting ominous and evil affairs.
Those named as uttering ominous words
were executed for their crime;
if their crime did not warrant death,
it was due to abhorring their ominous and inauspicious words,
hence they were killed.
Truth-seeker, do you realize how severe this prohibition is?"
"Yes, yes.
How awe-inspiring!
How awe-inspiring!"
"If you know to be awed early,
you may long endure;
if you do not know awe,
it is the root of death."
"First, by first following and delighting to move the imperial energies of heaven, earth, four seasons,
one matter multiplied threefold to delight Heaven,
causes Heaven to be greatly joyful,
the emperor to age with longevity,
ominous evils to perish,
heavenly disasters and harms to all be removed,
the solar energy not to battle in anger,
and the nation's borders to be peaceful.
And those who know to always first act by following and delighting in this,
the way of Heaven will rise for them,
true spirits will emerge for them,
even those hidden in caves and dwelling in seclusion
will all delight in coming to aid the righteous, how
magnificent!
"Second, by first following and delighting to move the flourishing energies of heaven, earth, four seasons,
doubled to delight Earth,
causes Earth's energy to be greatly joyful,
not battling in anger,
enables the king to be long-lived,
cunning, crafty, thieves, robbers, weapons, and armor to vanish,
and the nation's borders to flourish with goodness.
Those below all delight in receiving and following those above,
the moderately worthy all emerge,
to aid in governing the state,
Earth's spirits follow and nurture, how
magnificent!
"Third, by first following and delighting to move the assisting and subtle energies,
causes the harmonious energy to be greatly joyful,
rulers, ministers, and the people to be compliant and cautious,
each safeguarding their place,
then flattery, deceit, thieves, and robbers do not arise,
and the borders are preserved.
Hence, harmonious energy daily increases,
flourishing energy is generated,
and all things incline towards goodness."
"Fourth, be cautious not to stir the qi of death and destruction through music,
as it will lead to rampant banditry and theft,
and many sudden deaths.
The nation's borders will remain perilous and unstable,
attracting numerous evil spirits and ghostly entities,
causing severe harm,
which is termed chaos and disturbance.
The extreme yin qi brings about reversals and adversities—
be cautious, be cautious.
"Fifth, do not stir the qi of imprisonment and decay through music,
as it will lead to an increase in thieves and robbers,
with prisoners and legal disputes,
punishments and crimes proliferating,
making peace very difficult.
People will harm each other,
resulting in many incurably ill individuals.
"Sixth, do not stir the qi of decline and stagnation through music,
as it will cause many to fall ill and weaken.
It also breeds deceitful and cunning people who cheat one another,
with much malicious gossip,
leading to scarce resources within the nation's borders,
and widespread poverty among the people.
By delighting in the subtle qi of the three realms of the Supreme Emperor and the Noble King,
heaven, earth, and humanity are pleased,
bringing timely blessings,
and eliminating disasters and calamities,
which is called aligning with the benevolent qi of heaven, earth, and humanity,
leading to auspicious outcomes.
If one delights in the lower three realms,
the qi of death, destruction, imprisonment, stagnation, and decline will bring about adversities and disasters,
untimely rains,
and numerous evil harms,
impossible to prevent or guard against.
Stirring these decayed qi through music
will cause malignant qi to erupt greatly,
with wise scholars going into hiding,
officials losing governance,
and the people becoming difficult to rule,
affairs descending into chaos—
one must be vigilant and cautious of this.
In all matters of heaven and earth,
there are constant, fixed laws.
In regions with vibrant qi,
one should aspire to delight in the noble, not in qi-less areas.
It is inappropriate to delight in decline and death.
Thus, those who delight in goodness are termed by heaven as following righteous governance,
while those who delight in evil are termed by heaven as defying decrees.
Followers of righteous governance gain heaven's strength,
while defiers of decrees incur heaven's punishment.
Those who gain heaven's strength achieve longevity,
while those who incur heaven's punishment meet with misfortune.
The reason for this is
that heaven's governance is like an echo or shadow,
never depriving people of their peace.
Delight in goodness brings goodness,
delight in evil brings evil—
what more is there to say?
Good and evil, safety and danger,
each follows its kind,
never straying from this principle,
only the foolish fail to consider it.
Therefore, those who delight in the Way will have the Way gather around them,
those who delight in virtue will have virtue gather,
those who delight in martial prowess will have martial prowess gather,
those who delight in righteousness will have righteousness gather,
those who delight in wickedness will have wickedness gather—
has it ever been otherwise?
Thus, I deeply ponder heaven's laws
to caution you, the true person. How profound!
Heaven's laws must not be violated.
Hence, I repeatedly urge you, my child."
"Yes, yes."
"The reason for delighting threefold in the qi of the Emperor and the worthy is that
the Emperor's qi is the most supreme and unparalleled,
symbolizing the honor of heaven,
hence the multiplied delight.
Heaven,
which governs earth and humanity,
is thus tripled in delight,
symbolizing heaven, earth, and humanity.
When heaven, earth, and humanity are delighted and principles flourish,
all things find their proper place,
with auspicious signs and benevolent beings, twelve thousand in number, fully emerging—
hence, delight in them first.
In delighting, one should listen attentively with a focused mind,
sit upright in deep contemplation,
with a joyful heart,
feeling serene and content.
Be loyal, faithful, and utterly sincere,
free from any malicious intent,
as if sitting before an emperor,
daring not to be deceitful or corrupt.
Heaven responds to such conduct,
and all monstrous evils and disasters will invariably depart,
relying on heaven's majesty,
and the authority of the Emperor's qi,
naturally following heaven's proclaimed laws—
thus, achieving great peace is not difficult."
"Excellent, excellent!"
"The reason for delighting twofold in the qi of the King and the strings is that
the King's qi symbolizes earth.
Earth coexists with humanity,
hence the doubled delight,
delighting in earth.
When earth and humanity are delighted and pleased,
all things are harmonized and principles are attained.
"Moreover, the earth is lowly,
thus its music is less than that of heaven."
"Excellent, excellent!"
"Furthermore, the kingly qi is weaker than the imperial qi,
being one grade lower than the imperial qi,
hence it is lesser.
The principle of hierarchy between noble and base,
its division is natural."
"Excellent, excellent!"
"The reason why the music of the ministerial qi and subtle qi is of one level
is that the ministerial qi and subtle qi resemble the harmonious person.
Now, the harmonious person is lower than heaven and earth,
hence their music is less.
Humans are primarily responsible for ordering the myriad things for heaven and earth,
when humans are joyful, they are happy and do good,
and when they do good, the myriad things are ordered.
When humans are not joyful, they do evil,
and when they do evil, the myriad things become inauspicious."
"Excellent, excellent!"
"Moreover, humans
are the leaders of the harmonious myriad things.
If their leader is happy and orderly,
then the myriad things are well-ordered,
if their leader is chaotic, then the things become chaotic.
Therefore, first bring joy to their leader,
in order to follow the way of joy for heaven, earth, and humans."
"Excellent, excellent!"
"Therefore, the qi of supreme goodness is the noblest and best,
hence its music attains three layers,
to rejoice in goodness.
This is why in ancient times, when emperors and kings governed well,
and attained the will of heaven,
they obtained abundant music,
which is clear evidence of this.
Now the Taiping qi has arrived,
hence it teaches them to promote music.
The qi of decline and disorder corresponds to inauspicious years,
thus one must not promote music;
if music is promoted,
it is called promoting music of inauspicious decline,
and heaven names it as great rebellion,
the root of disasters,
from whence calamities arise.
Should one not be cautious?"
"Excellent, excellent!"
"Therefore, the next level of music is of two layers,
as the kingly qi is not like the imperial qi,
hence the music is less.
Thus, when governance has little goodness,
the music is accordingly reduced.
The reason for the reduction
is that the qi is declining and not greatly good,
hence one dares not have abundant music.
There is inauspicious qi within,
so one dares not have complete music.
It is like a household having seven parts good and three parts evil,
then the heart is not fully joyful,
this is what is meant."
"Excellent, excellent!"
"Now, with seven good and three evil,
good is more, evil is less,
can one be at ease and stop the music?
Although the human heart is joyful,
when remembering the three evils,
it is not purely joyful,
this is the nature of heaven.
Only when it is entirely good,
with not a single worry remaining,
can there be great joy.
Therefore, music is for rejoicing in goodness,
not for rejoicing in inauspiciousness."
"Excellent, excellent!"
"My words are a clear contract of heaven,
not a single character in the writing is missing.
Therefore, the next level of music is of one layer,
the ministerial qi and subtle qi have little to be content with,
human virtue is the least,
not like the qi of heaven and earth.
Hence it is subtle and little,
not like heaven and earth,
thus its music is little.
The ministerial qi and subtle qi have little to transform.
Even in the Central Kingdom,
there is indeed much evil and little good,
hence one dares not have abundant music.
On the contrary, it is called music of inauspicious evil,
as the goodness is little,
thus the music is little.
The reason for its scantiness
is that one only rejoices in the good within it,
and dares not rejoice in the inauspicious evil within.
To rejoice in the inauspicious evil within,
is like a petty person,
having seven parts inauspicious and three parts good,
the three parts good barely earn three portions of joy.
With seven parts inauspicious evil, there are instead seven sorrows and sufferings,
how can one be melancholy and yet follow joy?
The reason for this
is that taking ten as the standard,
ten is divided into three parts.
The imperial qi is entirely good in all ten,
the kingly qi has two good and one evil,
the ministerial qi has two evil and one good.
Therefore, the imperial qi resembles heaven,
and heaven always delights in life,
having no harmful intent,
desiring to bestow and give,
the Three Sovereigns resemble it,
always purely good and kind,
without evil or harmful intent.
Heaven is like the Three Sovereigns,
the Three Sovereigns are like heaven.
Thus, the person of supreme goodness has not a single evil,
but always desires to do good.
They resemble heaven,
do they not resemble the true spirit?"
"Excellent, excellent!"
"The kingly qi resembles earth,
earth always nurtures and loves virtue,
the Five Emperors resemble it.
Although earth nurtures, it is also named as killing,
hence in the time of the Five Emperors, there were punishments."
"Excellent, excellent!"
"The ministerial qi and subtle qi resemble humans,
humans have no constant law,
frequently changing,
the Three Kings resemble this,
having no constant law.
Now harmonious qi changes,
sometimes advancing, sometimes retreating,
thus there is no constancy in high and low.
The harmonious one, upon seeing hardness, follows it,
upon seeing softness, also follows it,
hence there is no constancy.
The qi of decline, death, imprisonment, and demise resembles the myriad things,
frequently changing and chaotic, with no proper coming and going,
the Five Hegemons resemble this,
their qi is chaotic and inauspicious,
hence they cannot have music.
Now, the nature of heaven and earth
is to rejoice in goodness,
not to rejoice in evil.
The martial aspect of heaven and earth is to punish evil,
not to punish good.
The pattern of heaven and earth
cannot be reversed."
"Excellent, excellent!
May I ask about the joy that delights the good heart,
I wish to hear the great secret,
so that this ignorant student's mind may fully understand,
and dare not ask again,
is it possible to hear it?"
"Do you still not comprehend it yourself?"
"I have humbly understood a little.
But I fear that people of later antiquity,
accumulating ignorance and delusion over long days,
even if given the text,
would still fail to understand,
and again cause them to violate heavenly prohibitions,
therefore I dare not refrain from asking for the great secret in an easily understandable form."
"Excellent are your words,
you have grasped the meaning.
Well then. Sit peacefully and I will explain it in detail.
Indeed, in years of supreme goodness and great joy,
all things are born in goodness,
every person is joyful,
hearts are constantly happy, desiring to sing and dance,
people naturally love one another,
without conflict or strife,
joy arises spontaneously,
superiors and subordinates do not overcome or harm each other,
all delight together.
Thus joy is born from goodness and delights in goodness,
Heaven makes it naturally so."
"Excellent, excellent!"
"In greatly calamitous years,
among all things not a single one is good,
every person suffers hunger and cold,
crying out and weeping,
overcoming and harming one another in turn.
Naturally they generate sorrow, bitterness, and resentment,
their hearts find no joy,
how could they sing, dance, and be happy?
Naturally they become desolate and cut off.
Therefore in calamitous and evil years there is no joy,
Heaven makes it naturally nonexistent.
This is clear evidence that Heaven does not delight in calamity and evil.
Thus joy is produced for delighting in goodness,
while military action is initiated for rising calamity.
Therefore when ancient emperors and kings were about to flourish,
they obtained correspondence with delight in goodness;
when about to decline,
they obtained correspondence with evil.
This
is the natural law.
Thus joy produces goodness,
goodness produces joy;
calamity upon calamity produces joyful military action,
military action produces calamity;
non-action produces joy,
joy produces non-action;
military action produces disorder,
disorder produces military action;
joy produces song and dance,
song and dance produce joy;
calamity and evil produce sorrow and bitterness,
sorrow and bitterness produce calamity and evil.
Using my text to be seen by people of later antiquity,
causing them to reflect upon it and delight in it,
the explanation concludes briefly here."
"Excellent, excellent!"

The above is the great secret of how the five notes of music should move and stir, before and after obtaining the intent of Heaven, Earth, and human hearts to bring about great peace, eliminate disasters and wickedness, and generate harmonious energy.
"Now you, Perfected One, accumulate goodness and are virtuous,
understanding all matters.
Now the heavenly supreme sovereign's penetrating balanced energy is fully present,
and Heaven above urgently desires to obtain something,
do you perhaps know what it is?"

Using this as proof,
thus it can completely govern yīn and yáng,
leaving none neglecting their duties.
So it is on earth too,
for perfectly comprehensive imperial peace.
Today heaven issues texts,
spirits produce strategies, talismans, and sacred writings,
sages create texts and classics,
words of superior worthies,
these are all expressions.
Thus heaven, earth, spirits, sages, and superior scholars exhaust their efforts for humanity,
through words accumulated over years,
they can establish heaven and earth,
and eliminate disasters.
If emperors apply them,
they can roam carefree without troubles,
ascendents achieve immortality and extended years,
gain heaven's favor,
with continuous lineage for descendants,
never cut off.
When the world declines, it renews into great prosperity,
all under heaven look up and obey,
none fail to attain the six directions, eight distances, and utmost caves of heaven and earth,
yīn and yáng are both pleased,
heaven's ailment of wind and rain becomes timely,
thunder and lightning do not erupt,
sun and moon shine brighter,
the three luminaries do not stray from their courses,
the four seasons and five phases proceed smoothly,
each finding its proper place.
This is achieved by the sacred good words,
their merit is immensely great.
The heavens above differ in their aspects,
each possessing the natural primordial qi of yin and yang,
similar to my writings.
Follow your own customs,
record my words and act upon them,
then great peace will be achieved.
The boundless three luminaries in the heavens differ,
each possessing the natural primordial qi of yin and yang,
similar to my writings.
Follow your own customs,
record my words and act upon them,
then great peace will be achieved.
The central dwellings in the heavens differ,
each possessing the natural primordial qi of yin and yang,
similar to my writings.
Follow your own customs,
record my words and act upon them,
then great peace will be achieved.
The three luminaries in the heavens differ,

Follow your own customs,
record my words and act upon them,

Follow your own customs,

The spirits and deities differ,
each possessing the natural primordial qi of yin and yang,

Follow your own customs,
record my words on good and evil and act upon them,
then great peace will be achieved.
If not taught according to their fundamental nature,
great chaos will ensue.
Remember this!
Heaven commands me to fully present this text,
to cure the ailments of heaven, earth, yin and yang, emperors, people, and all things.
All sufferings and afflictions of the people and myriad things
shall be entirely eliminated.
Thus, I teach you to use methods without limit to show this,
gathering and examining the sacred texts of past and present sages and immortals,
along with the common sayings of ordinary people,
combining and greatly scrutinizing them,
so that the illnesses of heaven and earth
may all be eradicated.
Once eliminated,
emperors will prolong their years,
ruling effortlessly without worries.
Heaven
is the great yang.
Earth is the great yin.
Humans reside in the center,
and so do all things.
Heaven constantly descends and bestows,
its qi flowing downward.
Earth constantly seeks upward,
its qi ascending to merge.
The two qi meet at the center.
Humans,
residing there, embody correctness.
These two qi constantly interact and function,
merging at the center,
then jointly give birth to all things.
All things receive these two qi to take form,
combining to create their nature and emotions;
without these two qi,
they cannot be generated or completed.
Thus, the life of all things depends on these two qi,
which interplay within their forms.
Therefore, when one does good,
heaven and earth know it;
when one does evil,
heaven and earth also know it.
Thus, the virtuous people of antiquity,
who inwardly understood heaven's intent alone,
constantly acted rightly and did good.
The celestial prophecy states:
Those who return joy shall receive joy,
those who return goodness shall receive goodness,
those who return evil shall receive evil,
those who return delight shall receive delight,
those who return compliance shall receive compliance,
those who return truth shall receive truth,
those who return to the Dào shall attain the Dào,
those who return contentment shall receive contentment.
For all that is returned,
Heaven, Earth, and the multitude of spirits likewise respond with corresponding echoes!
Those who return refinement shall have refinement returned,
those who return falseness shall have falseness returned,
those who return sophistry shall have sophistry returned,
those who return flattery shall have flattery returned,
those who return martial prowess shall have martial prowess returned,
those who return opposition shall have opposition returned,
those who return malevolence shall have malevolence returned,
those who return wickedness shall have wickedness returned.
For all that is returned,
Heaven, Earth, and the multitude of spirits completely respond in kind.
All methods concerning fortune and misfortune, safety and danger,
lie in what one returns.
Among ordinary households, those with strong labor power
often accumulate private wealth,
yet later mostly end up impoverished and unfortunate—
why is this?
The divine person says,
this is because some with great wisdom instead deceive those with less,
or those with strong power instead bully the weak,
or the younger generation instead disrespect the elderly—
all these are contrary actions.
Thus Heaven does long protect them.
Why so?
Indeed, the wise ought to nurture the simple,
but instead deceive them—
this is the first transgression.
The strong ought to support the weak,
but instead bully them—
this is the second transgression.
The younger generation ought to care for the elderly,
but instead disrespect them—
this is the third transgression.
Being at odds with the heart of Heaven,
they are inevitably destined for misfortune.
As for wealth,
it is the surplus between Heaven and Earth.
It is like water,
always flowing and following its course,
always humbly staying low.
Those who obtain abundant wealth
are the humble who receive much.
Therefore, those who are greedy,
Heaven does not protect them.
Since the loss of the Dào from the three methods of Yīn, Yáng, and central harmony of Heaven and Earth,
excess calculations have accumulated in Heaven,
stored up and not put into practice—
why is this?
I wish to hear the meaning.
Now, the lifespan granted by Heaven,
the highest is one hundred and thirty years,
called the Yáng calendar intercalary surplus.
The next is one hundred and twenty years,
called the annual count excluding eras.
The next is one hundred years,
called the harmonious calendar material era.
All people should take these as their model years.
Now, since losing the three methods,
many do not complete their destined years.
The surplus calculation is one tally per year,
recorded in Heaven,
but human conduct has lost the Heavenly Dào,
and none can claim it.
Now, following my text,
those who practice good deeds,
Heaven will fully bestow these calculations to increase their lifespan,
some may achieve transcendence of the world,
or have their years extended.
Since Heaven and Earth ◇◇,
emperors and kings have solely worried about the world's inequities,
taking the loss of rightful duties as their concern.
Beyond this,
there is nothing to worry about.
The good people of the world,
loyal ministers and filial children,
all share this worry.
But by practicing my text,
this worry is eliminated.
It is said in Heaven,
when Yáng energy greatly flourishes,
ghostly beings cannot recklessly act to cause harm—
why is this?
When Yáng flourishes, Yīn must decline,
thus beings cannot recklessly act to cause harm.
Who restrains them?
The essence of Yáng restrains them.
How does the essence of Yáng restrain them?
The essence of Yáng is spirit,
belonging to Heaven,
associated with red,
governing the heart.
The heart-spirit
is the spirit of Heaven.
The essence
is the essence of Earth.
Ghosts
are the ghosts of humans.
Earth is the mother.
Ghosts are the children.
By the principle of mother and child acting together,
they reside in the path of Yīn.
When the Tàipíng energy arrives,
Yáng energy greatly rises,
the Heavenly Dào is strict,
the spirit path is bright.
When bright, Heaven will cause people to rise together and utilize it;
when the spirit path is used,
it serves to subdue and eliminate the path of ghostly beings.
The spirit path rises
and walks together with the noble person.
The path of ghostly beings
walks together with the petty person.
Thus, the noble person governs with fairness and justice,
and spirits also govern with fairness and justice.
The petty person governs with deceit and falsity,
and ghostly beings also govern with deceit and falsity—
this illustrates the principle of shared energy types.
Now, as the Yáng path rises like fire,
weapons and blades should vanish,
suppressed by fire.
For weapons accumulate abundant Yīn energy,
while fire accumulates abundant Yáng energy;
abundant Yáng eliminates weapons—
this is a natural resonance.
Human life must rely on Heavenly energy:
the highest good is entrusted to Heaven,
the middle good to humanity,
the lowest good to the fields.
Therefore, the highest scholar studies to transcend the world;
the middle scholar should govern the people;
the lowest scholar should manage the fields.
The highest scholar should come riding clouds;
the middle scholar rides a carriage;
the lowest scholar should walk on foot.
These three types of people have distinct duties,
not hindering each other.
The highest scholar transcends the world to ascend to Heaven,
to harmonize and adjust wind and rain;
the middle scholar serves the county officials,
should govern the people;
the lowest scholar should manage property.
Each has their duty,
not interfering with each other.
In Heaven, the methods of all those who study the Dào
involve humans refining their pursuit of the Dào.
Minor alignment with the minor Dào
allows seeing various spirits as a minor attainment of the Dào;
if the gateway does not align with the middle Dào,
one may then reach the great Dào.
Reaching the great Dào,
one can then summon the true spirits.
Minor alignment with the minor Dào summons minor spirits;
alignment with the middle Dào summons middle spirits;
alignment with the great Dào summons great spirits.
Only when great spirits arrive can one transcend the world and endure long.
And upon reaching this stage,
there are always great evil spirits and ghosts
who do not wish people to transcend the world,
adept at confusing people to cause negligence,
making them retreat and speak of strange transformations,
mixing truth and falsehood.
Only at this point can one distinguish evil from righteous,
and then transcend the world.
The world calls the superior person one who,
from birth to death,
harbors no evil intent,
and is thus beloved by all common people,
with officials and people from all directions bestowing gifts upon them.
The average person is beloved by their neighbors,
who collectively bestow gifts upon them.
The inferior person lacks a good-hearted intention,
receives no gifts or offerings,
but instead steals from their own household to give away.
This is the chaff-like behavior of people in the world.
What is meant by chaff?
The superior person is purely good,
their heart free from evil,
representing the highest yang.
The average person's heart is half good,
representing the middle yang.
The inferior person's heart is entirely without goodness,
representing the lower yang,
hence called chaff.
Chaff bears no grain,
hollow inside without rice,
symbolizing a lack of true trustworthiness.
Those without trustworthiness are chaff-like people.
When the superior person receives gifts from officials and all directions for their family,
it signifies not forgetting their ancestral roots.
When the average person receives gifts from the four neighbors for their family,
it signifies not forgetting their parents.
The inferior person, conversely, steals their family's wealth to give to neighboring households,
resembling chaff:
empty inside but appearing solid outside,
betraying their origins.
All such actions harm the heavens above,
as turning against one's family
leads to household discord,
all stemming from such individuals.
If ministers engage in external alliances,
the state will surely be emptied;
if family members engage in external alliances,
the household will surely be emptied;
the calamities of heaven all arise from this.
Safety and danger originate within a person's heart,
and divine spirits manifest from afar,
moving up, down, and sideways,
penetrating millions of miles—
should one not be cautious?
The Way of Great Peace,
its texts concise,
enriches the state;
it is heaven's mandate,
the body's treasure.
Emerging from the heart and mind,
it circulates throughout the world.
Practicing these texts,
the state can be secure,
the family prosperous.
The laws of heaven and earth decree
that the good should govern the evil,
the upright should govern the wicked,
the pure should govern the turbid.
One must not use evil to govern good,
wickedness to govern uprightness,
turbidity to govern purity.
Reversing this
leads to unceasing banditry and theft,
daily growth of treachery and wickedness,
culminating in great chaos,
all arising from this.
When emperors and kings appoint ministers,
they must carefully select them,
aligning with the heart of heaven.
Only when the constellations align
dare they be appointed.
The sun represents
the virtue of the ruler.
The moon represents
the virtue of the minister.
If the constellations do not align,
peace cannot be achieved,
and treachery and wickedness will arise.
Explain: what are the provisions, clothing, and shelters in the postal stations of the eight directions, above and below, and the center of heaven and earth?
Those who practice the Way and Virtue yet harbor doubts
should resolve them with this divination.
Now, in heaven, there are official postal stations to host and await,
on earth, there are official postal stations to host and await,
all present in the eight directions and the center.
The heavenly official stations
house divine immortals.
The earthly official stations
house sages and worthies.
The subterranean official stations
house the great yin's good spirits and benevolent ghosts.
The official stations in the eight directions' distant and nearby famous mountains and great rivers
house the spiritual humans and immortals of the world who have not yet ascended to heaven.
Those in clouds and winds house the North Pole and Kūnlún.
Official postal stations await sages, worthies, and good spirits who have merit.
The Way is the head,
Virtue the abdomen,
and Benevolence the feet that walk them.
Heaven establishes official postal stations,
where one may reside upon attainment.
To gain heaven's power, practice the Way;
to gain earth's power, practice Virtue;
to gain human power, practice Benevolence.
These three
are the endless path;
losing these three
is the root of chaos;
not following these three
is called opposing heaven.
Thus, the sage embraces the Way and Virtue, practicing Benevolence;
beyond this,
it pertains to the actions of all things.
I ask: the divine qi of the four seasons assists in governance to promote good and eliminate evil—
which attracts great spirits?
Which attracts medium spirits?
Which attracts minor spirits?
Contemplating the sun, moon, and imperial qi of the establishment attracts great spirits;
contemplating the mutual qi attracts medium spirits;
contemplating the killing qi attracts minor spirits;
contemplating the aged qi after the moon's establishment attracts old beings;
contemplating the sickly and declining qi after the moon's attraction attracts evil ghosts;
contemplating the death qi after the moon's establishment attracts pure ghosts;
contemplating the breaking qi after the moon's establishment attracts destruction, killing, misfortune, and harm.
The vital qi belongs to heaven, yang, and what is ahead.
The heavenly Way generates through divine qi,
hence the six spirits ahead of the Dipper all generate;
the six spirits behind belong to earth and yin.
The heavenly Way treats death qi as ghosts,
as beings of misfortune and harm.
If you wish later generations to be constantly cautious and faithful,
self-respecting and self-loving,
the divine, bright, essential qi
must not leave their bodies,
then they will not know old age or death.
The divine, bright, essential qi
follows the thoughts and moves,
not leaving the body's form.
If the divine and bright are ever-present,
one does not fall ill or age,
and actions do not encounter evil.
If the divine and bright are lost,
the sick die immediately,
and actions meet with misfortune—
this is the great proof.
To avoid illness,
one should carefully guard oneself.
All affairs do not surpass the natural;
without spirit in nature,
all affairs fail to achieve divinity.
Without surpassing the Great Way and the nature of heaven and earth,
lacking great spirit within,
they still do not succeed,
unable to preserve themselves.
Thus, the Way of heaven and earth
operates based on spirit and nature.
Therefore, all affairs, great and small,
possess spirit:
the great have great spirit,
the small have small spirit.
Each nurtures its own spirit,
hence able to endure long.
Spirit diminishes with age,
spirit lost leads to death—
this is the natural division.
How can one forcefully contend?
In all affairs, safety and danger
depend entirely on spirit.
Thus, the physical form is the home,
with qi as the carriage and horse,
spirit as the chief official,
governing rise, fall, and transitions—
the master of order.
To have a form without spirit
is like having fields, homes, and walls without a chief official.
The chief official
is the arbiter of the people's fate,
what loyal ministers, filial children, and greatly obedient people should practice.
If a person's body
is not loyal to superiors,
not filial to parents,
they betray themselves,
incur punishment,
and lose their foundation.
Constant thoughts of goodness
attract spirit to gather and follow the person;
thoughts of evil
also attract spirit to gather upon the person.
It enters the person's abdomen,
following wherever their thoughts go,
causing anxiety and making it unforgettable.
May I ask about the child in the womb,
who does not eat but takes in energy.
In the abdomen,
it is the energy of nature.
Once born,
it breathes the energies of yīn and yáng.
Upholding the Dào and diligently learning,
one reverses the energy of nature.
Reversing the energy of nature,
the mind becomes like an infant's,
and thus life is sustained.
If one merely follows the breathing of yīn and yáng energies,
then death ensues.
Ordinary people cannot restrain each other,
so they control their own fate.
Committing evil deeds,
Heaven will punish them.
Thus, petty people are punished by average people,
average people are punished by superior people,
and superior people are punished by great people.
If petty people lose the law,
they bring danger and ruin upon themselves.
The punishment by spirits, whether great or small, is also like this.
If one cannot restrain oneself,
Heaven will surely punish them.
Heaven fears the Dào,
and the Dào fears nature.
Heaven fearing the Dào means
Heaven acts with utmost conduct.
If the Dào is abandoned and not practiced,
