then the heavenly order becomes chaotic and destroyed.
If the heavenly order is chaotic and destroyed,
then there is no return to law and order in danger and ruin.
Thus, nature ensures the preservation of the ways of Heaven and Earth,
practicing the Dào tirelessly,
yīn and yáng transmit to each other,
entrusting and generating one another.
The Dào governs life;
if the Dào is cut off, all things do not grow,
and if all things do not grow, there are no generations,
nothing to transmit to one another.
If all things do not generate and transmit to one another, they perish.
How could Heaven and Earth exist then?
Heaven, Earth, yīn, and yáng must transmit and generate one another.
If they are cut off now, it leads to extinction,
so Heaven fears the cessation of the Dào and the ensuing danger and ruin.
The Dào fearing nature means
if the heavenly Dào does not follow nature,
it cannot be accomplished.
Thus, all things are accomplished by following nature;
without nature, it is difficult to achieve anything.
If forced to accomplish,
it all becomes false and deceptive,
and such accomplishments cannot last.
Although Heaven and Earth are far apart,
their control over fate allows no escape.
May I ask:
"When the Tàipíng energy arrives in full,
and one wishes to always use good intentions to eliminate wickedness and evil,
what should be prioritized first?"
"The nature of Heaven and Earth
is half yáng and half yīn.
Yáng represents goodness,
governing rewards.
Yīn represents evil,
with evil governing punishments,
and overseeing deceit and falseness.
If there are many rewards,
there are few punishments.
If there are many crafty and deceitful people,
and few rewards,
the gate of wickedness opens.
The reason for this is
that punishments involve many penalties,
governing killing and harm.
Those who break the law all become wicked criminals,
so the gate of wickedness opens,
and crafty and deceitful people increase.
Yáng governs rewards,
and if giving is abundant,
then virtue reigns and prevails.
Yáng and virtue govern nurturing and life,
this is the natural law.
Thus, day is yáng, the sun, the ruler, and virtue;
night is yīn, the moon, the minister, and wickedness.
The nature of Heaven and Earth
is half good and half evil.
Therefore, the noble person uses supreme goodness to close off wickedness.
Those who promote goodness attain goodness,
those who promote evil attain evil.
This is like using a dou to strike a dou—
what is not a dou naturally moves away;
using a chǐ to strike a chǐ—
what is not a chǐ naturally falls.
Just as square and round do not match,
compass and square do not align,
vertical and horizontal do not combine.
Thus, when yáng arises, it must act according to its kind.
Therefore, when fire is abundant, thunder roars,
and the Vermilion Bird is within it.
This is why there is thunder in summer,
while in winter, it hides.
All things follow their origin,
and thus the heavenly Dào can be understood clearly.
Without following their categories,
how could sages and worthies deeply comprehend them?
Therefore, since the beginning of Heaven and Earth,
the goodness, evil, truth, and falseness of people
can be observed through their actions.
Seek by category,
observe their achievements,
and the gains and losses of good and evil,
the worthy and unworthy can be seen.
Why must one sit and argue about it?"
May I ask:
"From ancient times to the present,
the worthy,
the enlightened,
the wise,
the eloquent,
the strong,
and the brave—
these six types of people all possess ten-thousand-fold talent;
how could there be good and evil among them?"
"These six types of people all have ten-thousand-fold talent and ability;
if their abilities can harmonize Heaven and Earth,
preventing all kinds of wickedness and harm from arising,
enabling emperors to be long without worry and live long lives,
and they can eliminate their own illnesses,
each fulfilling their natural lifespan,
spreading kindness to ordinary people—
then this worthiness, enlightenment, wisdom, eloquence, strength, and bravery
are greatly beneficial and good.
But if they cannot harmonize with Heaven and Earth,
enable emperors to be without worry and live long,
and they themselves have illnesses,
suffer disasters they cannot dispel,
or die prematurely,
no different from ordinary people—
then these six types of people are of no benefit.
Simply evaluate their achievements;
there is no need for further questions.
Those who succeed are right;
those who do not succeed are wrong.
If matters are evaluated this way,
it deeply aligns with the will of the August Heaven,
emperors will have extended lifespans because of it,
and all things will be well-governed."
May I ask:
"When things sometimes do not grow,
and sometimes are not nurtured,
failing to mature,
where do these great faults entirely come from?"
"What should grow but does not is due to Heaven;
what should be nurtured but is not is due to Earth.
Heaven and Earth are the dwelling of all things,
and worthy people are the craftsmen of all things.
The emperor symbolizes Heaven,
always desiring growth;
the empress symbolizes Earth,
always desiring nurture;
ministers symbolize humanity,
always desiring to contemplate success.
When these three unite their efforts,
all things, from birth to end,
will remain unharmed.
To emulate the way of peace,
those who establish laws must act accordingly."
May I ask:
"Does the Way of Heaven assist the weak?
Or does it assist the strong?
Does it assist the few?
Or does it assist the many?"
The divine person said:
"The Way of Heaven assists the weak."
"Why is that?"
"The weak,
are the function of the Way;
the few,
are the essence of the Way.
Thus, the North Star is a single star,
yet all other stars belong to it,
using few to govern the many.
The Way's essence is one, and all things belong to it.
Therefore, the king of a state is extremely few,
yet the world assists him in governance,
this is the effect of assisting the few.
Parents are extremely strong,
yet they assist the infant,
this is the effect of the strong assisting the weak.
The most virtuous people are few and weak,
while the non-virtuous are strong and numerous;
being numerous actually makes them few,
being strong actually makes them weak.
Thus, the noble person seeks weakness, not strength,
seeks fewness, not multitude.
Therefore, the Way of Heaven protects them.
Hence, they do not contend with others,
yet others naturally contend;
they do not strive to be strong with others,
yet others assist them to become strong.
Thus, without contention, they excel at winning.
Distinguishing the Way of Heaven, the essence of the body, and virtue without confusion.
I inquire:
"If the Way is examined and one delights in practicing it,
what constitutes a clear sign?"
The divine person said:
"I received this text from the heavenly deities,
and the deities said,
I have heard it corresponds with yīn and yáng, wind and rain, cold and heat,
and this is the great sign.
Heaven delights in the practice of its Way,
but humans are not yet clearly convinced of it,
so they use prayers for rain or stopping rain to demonstrate its clear signs.
Practicing the Way of Great Peace,
all prayers and requests are answered;
not practicing the Way of Great Peace,
prayers and requests go unanswered;
this clarifies that the ultimate Way of Heaven lies in Great Peace.
Thus, when all things fail to be born,
the fault lies with the Great Yáng;
when born but not nurtured,
the fault lies with the Great Yīn;
when nurtured but not brought to completion,
the fault lies with Central Harmony.
Therefore, giving birth is the father;
nurturing is the mother;
completing is the child.
Giving birth is the Way;
nurturing is virtue;
completing is benevolence.
If one thing is not born,
one Way is blocked and does not flow;
if one thing is not nurtured,
one virtue is not cultivated;
if one virtue is not completed,
one benevolence is not practiced;
if you wish to know whether you possess the Way, virtue, and benevolence,
observe things and you will know for yourself.
These five—
emperors, kings, rulers, fathers, and teachers who deeply wish to know the relative strengths of the Way, virtue, and benevolence—
need only observe this.
Therefore, the highest good in principle
is none other than delighting in giving life,
the next good is delighting in nurturing,
and the next good is delighting in giving.
Thus, giving life resembles Heaven,
nurturing resembles Earth,
and giving resembles benevolence.
These three
are the great principles of Heaven, Earth, and humanity.
Beyond these, what comes after
is merely preparation for extremity before being used.
In this way, the celestial energy naturally becomes peaceful,
evil energies naturally vanish,
good people naturally arrive,
evil people naturally depart,
all responding without exception.
The one who clarifies it is the teacher,
meaning the one who knows first is called teacher,
who should take charge of evidence and make it clear.
From ancient times to the present,
all texts that emerge are from Heaven and Earth,
thus Heaven and Earth produce them first;
the one who clarifies them is the teacher,
so all texts that emerge have a teacher,
and the one who practices them is the government.
In ancient times, emperors and kings received the will of Heaven,
accepted the teachings of the teacher,
and exerted effort to eliminate disasters and harms,
thereby satisfying the heart of Heaven,
gaining extended years and increased lifespan—
this is what it means.
It is created by Heaven,
clarified by the teacher,
practiced by the emperor—
these three matters depend on each other to achieve completion.
If Heaven does not produce texts,
the teacher has no means to know;
if the teacher does not clarify the texts,
the emperor has no way to know governance.
Therefore, when Heaven is about to prosper an emperor,
there must be extraordinary texts emerging;
the enlightened teacher causes the teaching to reach the emperor and government,
enabling them to gain extended years and increased lifespan—
this is the clear evidence of Heaven's aid to the emperor. "
"When all people and things are not born,
or born but not nurtured,
or nurtured but do not grow,
or grow but instead do not complete,
not fulfilling their natural lifespan,
where does the fault lie?"
"When all people and things are not born,
it is Heaven's fault;
when not nurtured,
it is Earth's fault;
when they grow but do not complete,
it is humanity's fault."
"Is the fault with humanity?"
"When things do not get born in their season,
it is the ruler's fault;
when born but not nurtured,
it is the ministers' fault;
when they grow but do not complete,
it is the people's fault.
Heaven and the ruler/father are in charge of birth,
this is the growth of the Great Yáng,
the ancestor of life.
If Heaven does not wish to give life,
things cannot be born;
if the father does not wish to give,
things also cannot be born;
if the ruler does not wish to give life,
things also cannot be born;
therefore, Heaven and the ruler/father are in charge of birth.
If the ruler/father constantly thinks of giving life,
not delighting in killing,
then all things will fully live.
One thought of killing causes one thing to die,
ten thoughts cause ten things to die,
a hundred thoughts cause a hundred things to die,
from this up to ten thousand thoughts,
all are like this."
"Does Earth Mother and the ministers, receiving the giving of yáng,
in charge of nurturing and growing all things,
constantly think of nurturing and growing?"
"One thought of not nurturing and growing
causes one thing to be harmed,
ten thoughts harm ten things,
a hundred thoughts harm a hundred things,
from this up to ten thousand,
it is like this.
Therefore, when appointing ministers, the ancient emperors
always sought compassionate and benevolent ones,
who were good at nurturing and growing all things and governing with them;
in the middle antiquity, they were half compassionate and benevolent,
so things were half harmed;
in later antiquity, they did not carefully select ministers when appointing them,
so all things were entirely harmed.
Their virtue is Huáng,
the word for king means resplendent.
Dì,
acts as wisdom between Heaven and Earth,
preventing falling into misfortune and evil,
hence called Dì.
Wáng,
means the people and all things return to the king without harm,
hence called Wáng.
Wáng
means 'to go to.'
Jūn means each secures their own territory,
people attach themselves to them without harm,
hence called Jūn.
Jūn
is a title.
Lì means to govern,
and to assist superiors in governing things,
ensuring that all people and things, great and small,
do not lose their governance,
then they can be called Lì.
Shī understands all the words under heaven,
only then can they be called Great Teacher,
meaning able to understand all the writings under heaven.
Therefore, they can be called Huáng, Dì, Wáng, Jūn, Shī.
Thus, the Way of Huáng is the head,
the Way of Dì is the abdomen,
the Way of Wáng is the thigh,
Lì are the hands and feet.
The Way of Shī,
with the ink-line as law and standard,
upper and lower depend on each other to stand.
Therefore, good rulers constantly think of the Way of Huáng,
in the middle think of the Way of Dì,
and below think of the Way of Jūn and Lì.
Constantly reciting the methods of the Great Teacher,
then adhering to their ink-line,
afterward the heart of Heaven can be pacified,
the will of Earth can be obtained,
the four seasons naturally follow,
the five phases do not conflict,
the three lights constantly shine,
ghosts, spirits, essences, and energies do no harm,
the five officials and five soils each get their place,
thieves and robbers do not arise,
the emperor rules effortlessly,
all exclaiming 'Long live!'
The Way of Heaven as law is like this;
if not following my text,
it is truly difficult!
Carefully ponder its meaning,
practice these two matters,
and also be cautious!"
The nature of Heaven and Earth is such that,
the essence, energy, spirits, and ghosts act upon, govern, teach, and instruct humans.
Spirits reside in the yin aspect of the human heart,
essence resides in the yin aspect of the human kidneys,
and ghosts reside in the yin aspect of the human liver.
When a person's thoughts are upright and good,
they guide humans to do good;
they often dwell in the hidden yin of humans,
urging people toward evil,
teaching them to do evil,
and also driving them to commit evil.
In ancient times, the wise and sage individuals within their hearts,
constantly harbored hidden thoughts of goodness,
thus receiving good responses.
Ordinary people often harbor hidden thoughts of evil in their hearts,
so they receive evil responses,
unable to restrain themselves.
The fault lies in constantly thinking of good and evil in secret,
and thus spirits and ghosts drive them toward good or evil,
which verifies the placement of ghosts here.
When the Tàipíng energy prevails,
winds and rains come in season,
all things grow abundantly and flourish,
and the earth is also well fertilized,
so the land becomes increasingly robust and rich,
enabling long life.
In calamitous years, rain does not fall timely,
and the earth produces things sparsely and scantily,
short and stunted,
unable to self-fertilize,
then the land becomes increasingly impoverished and thin,
incapable of nurturing all things.
The operations of Heaven and Earth
still require yin and yang to harmonize and unite,
only then can Tàipíng be achieved,
leading to the officials of the four seasons and five phases.
The emperor's establishment of months, before and after,
should correspond to the emperor's energy,
driving out the officials of wickedness and evil.
The establishing energy and royal energy
are the imperial energies of Heaven's four seasons and five phases.
The assisting energy and eliminating energy come first,
firstly to rectify what is ahead,
they are the officials with sharp points directed straight forward.
Where they point, treachery submits,
unable to act again to cause harm,
the energy that fills and pacifies ahead,
all are good and virtuous officials.
The first five holders stand in front,
preparing for the emperor's energy,
holding and eliminating great evils.
Establishing the first five generals,
all receive Heaven's upright energy,
they are all Heaven's divine officials,
should act as Heaven's envoys,
no matter the size, all among the twelve thousand beings,
should be clothed in their virtue and follow their transformations.
When facing the royal energy, it means death,
when facing the monthly establishment, it means destruction,
this is the most dignified and primary energy,
thus it cannot be opposed.
Those who oppose it die,
named the killing energy, greatly depleting.
After the monthly establishment comes closure,
blocking and sealing off evil and treachery,
fearing that resting and submissive energies later might interfere with the emperor's establishing energy.
Thus Heaven closes what follows,
later opening it,
to repel and rest evil energies, teaching them to leave.
What follows becomes accomplished treachery,
and should then be restrained.
The later five are peril,
peril means their place is near Heaven's hold and great slaughter,
one turn to break means immediate strike,
thus it is peril.
These later five generals,
Heaven intends to rest them,
sharing energy with Earth,
responsible for closing and storing evil and treachery,
dwelling together with ghosts and spirits,
and cannot be employed.
A question asks:
"The north is the beginning of huáng,
the east is the beginning of dì,
the south is the beginning of wáng,
the west is the beginning of bà.
Now Heaven has the six jiǎ and twelve branches,
where should the way of huáng begin?"
"Indeed,
Heaven has three unities,
each has its great beginnings.
The first is the Heavenly Huáng,
the second is Dì,
the third is Wáng,
the fourth is Bà.
Heavenly Huáng begins from the upper jiǎzǐ,
Earthly Huáng begins from yǐchǒu,
Human Huáng begins from bǐngyín,
the way of Bà begins from dīngmǎo,
this is the calendar and numerical energy of Heaven.
The earthly calendar:
the way of Huáng begins from zǐ,
the way of Dì begins from chǒu,
the way of Wáng begins from yín,
the way of Bà begins from mǎo.
These four,
initially receive the subtle energies of Heaven and Earth to create life,
and cannot have punishments.
Having punishments harms the way of Huáng,
the way's law cannot be harmed.
Thus zǐ punishes mǎo,
chǒu punishes xū,
yín punishes sì,
all emit punishing energy,
and do not dwell together."
A question asks:
"Heaven enfeoffs people by ranks,
Earth enfeoffs people by ranks,
humans enfeoff people by ranks,
may I hear about this?"
The answer:
"Heaven enfeoffs people with the Dào,
Earth enfeoffs people with nurturing virtue,
humans enfeoff people with official salaries and food."
"Why so?"
"Heaven,
distinguishes itself by the Dào for long,
thus enfeoffs with the Dào,
granting longevity,
enabling one to feed on wind and energy and be satisfied.
Earth is mainly responsible for nurturing good land.
Earth makes people rich,
thus it enfeoffs people with virtuous wealth.
The ruler enfeoffs people with official salaries and food,
bestowing them with clothing.
These three matters are all good.
Those who love the Dào unwaveringly,
thus gain enfeoffment by Heaven.
Those who love virtue and cherish Earth,
knowing how to assess land and dwell accordingly,
avoiding misfortune and gaining luck,
receive enfeoffment by Earth.
Those who love learning and benefit the ruler's governance,
the ruler or father cannot keep them distant,
needing them to manage affairs,
thus they gain enfeoffment by humans.
Therefore, the ancient sages and worthies diligently studied,
daring not to neglect these three matters.
Thus some attained the Dào and departed,
some avoided the world and went to recover the land,
and some gained the ruler's official salaries and food."
A question asks:
"As for those who delight in the five tones,
what happens when they attain the correct tones?
What happens when they do not attain the correct tones?
May I hear about both?"
"The tones
are not empty;
they bring about true events,
using emptiness to attain substance,
a method of summoning physical forms with formless bodies.
Music uses sound and resonance to summon events,
just as when a person opens their mouth to utter sound,
there is good and evil,
the good brings auspiciousness,
the evil brings inauspiciousness.
These utterances all come from human mouths,
yet bring responses of good and evil,
musical sounds are the language of Heaven, Earth, yin and yang, and the five phases.
Listen to their sounds,
know the sentiments of Heaven and Earth,
the harmony of the energies of the four seasons and five phases,
and one can know exhaustively.
Thus superior individuals grasp their meaning,
using it to fairly manage and measure;
middle individuals practice it,
to assist the ruler in governance,
and achieve longevity;
worthy individuals practice it,
to attain freedom from worry.
Sound
is that which multiplies one into ten thousand,
ten thousand multiplies into infinity,
and all under Heaven is completely prepared."
Question:
"Why is the Tàipíng Jīng intended to be in 170 volumes?"
Reply:
"The number one
marks the beginning of counting.
Thus, before heaven and earth separated,
accumulated qi all converged into one.
Divided into two,
they formed husband and wife.
Heaven bestows upon earth,
conceiving in the profound darkness,
designated as jiǎzǐ;
spreading roots in the northeast,
chǒu initiates yín;
appearing in the east,
the sun rises at mǎo;
fully growing in the southeast,
chén with sì hanging branches in the south,
nourished at wǔ;
aging towards the southwest,
wèi with shēn;
maturing in the west,
the sun sets at yǒu;
completely stored in the northwest,
xū and hài.
Hence, counting starts from one
and ends at twelve.
The basis of the heavenly stems,
the root of the five phases.
Thus, one multiplies to form ten,
and a hundred is thereby complete.
Therefore, when heaven generates things,
spring echoes for a hundred days seeking to complete the cycle.
Thus, the celestial dipper establishes at chén,
and breaks at xū.
Establishing
means to stand,
all things are fully born at chén.
Breaking
means to decay,
all things completely die at xū.
Therefore, numbers
follow the eight directions from heaven to earth,
completing with ten;
yin and yang establish and break,
moving back and forth in sevens,
returning to their origin.
Following the celestial dipper's direction to clarify affairs,
thus the dipper has seven stars,
to illuminate the beginning and end of yin and yang.
Therefore, the Tàipíng Jīng is made in 170 volumes,
symbolizing heaven and earth through numbers,
corresponding to yin and yang as the method,
following the four seasons and five phases as conduct,
daring not to lose even a hair's breadth.
Losing it would mean neglecting heavenly affairs,
having no basis,
not aligning with the intentions of heaven and earth,
not following the numbers of heaven in composing the scripture,
it would be of no benefit for governing the world,
not resembling the laws of heaven and earth,
unable to remove harm.
To know its effect,
collect the trivial writings of the world,
pile them up for thirty lǐ,
even reaching the heavens,
and practice them,
yet they cannot dispel calamities and disasters."
Under the vast heavens,
there are eighty-one regions,
and within them, eleven thousand states,
each possessing its own documents,
all aiming to eradicate evil and cultivate goodness,
to dispel calamities.
Now, gathering and compiling them all,
even if they span a hundred li in circumference,
and could be raised up to the heavens,
they still cannot eliminate disasters.
Though this text is brief,
if emperors and kings can practice it,
they will surely await clear results.
The foremost divine beings of high antiquity,
the second rank of perfected ones,
the third rank of transcendent beings,
the fourth rank of those who follow the Way,
all emulated heaven and attained the true meaning of the Way.
They dazzled their vision with inward contemplation,
using the mind to order the inner self,
where darkness and light reversed and penetrated the great yang,
uniquely grasping the essentials of the Way within.
It is like using fire to illuminate the inside,
not shining outward,
ensuring eternal preservation without chaos.
Those who now learn to transcend the world,
emulating the ancients by turning inward in contemplation,
this is what it refers to.
Over time, as it was passed down, it flourished and then declined,
until people grew weary of its practices,
transmitting it without the true meaning of the Way,
unable to illuminate inwardly,
increasingly disordered.
Thus, heaven produced sages,
to pattern themselves on celestial principles,
so the patterns of heaven became self-evident.
When the patterns of heaven are correct,
heaven is also correct;
when the patterns of earth are correct,
earth is also correct;
when the patterns of humanity are correct,
humanity is also correct;
when heaven, earth, and humanity are all correct,
all things are correct.
Humanity is
the foremost among all beings.
If humans fail in their duties and are harmed,
dying untimely deaths,
all things follow suit,
and so do heaven and earth.
Malevolent energies surge,
and people fall ill, not completing their natural lifespans.
The actions of past and present
each have their proper sequence,
not overstepping one another.
The most revered of the supreme divine beings,
calls himself the Duke of Entrusted Qi,
also known as the Great Spirit,
always at the side of the Celestial Lord,
primarily managing the documents of the Hall of Light,
ensuring they are clearly distinguished,
overseeing major duties.
He is to facilitate the connection to divine transcendents for the lord,
recording those yet to be born,
each with their names,
setting the year, month, day, and hour.
When the time for ascension arrives,
he sends spirits to guide and transform their bodies before they ascend.
Each has their name,
with the year, month, day, and hour set,
until the time for ascension comes,
when spirits are sent to guide and transform their bodies before they ascend.
According to their wisdom and ability, high or low,
each is made to remember their assignments and distinctions,
each made aware,
compelled to state their capabilities,
before being appointed.
When reported to the superior,
it is declared:
The Great Spirit, as the chief, leads all spirits,
each with their own departments,
should obey and understand clearly,
leaving no room for doubt.
To ensure long life records,
one must be diligent.
The sage and enlightened are mindful,
should live fully as if in broad daylight.
Further, with records and calculations clarifying each other,
they may serve in the Office of Accounts,
managing wealth, treasures, and precious items.
All who are to report their accounts
must inform in advance,
and those in the Office of Accounts,
specifically report to the Minister of Agriculture,
on the thirtieth day of long months,
or the twenty-ninth of short months,
gathering at the Hall of Light of the Great Spirit,
not missing the deadline,
as instructed by the Celestial Lord,
all must be present within the three ke before dawn.
The Great Spirit of the Hall of Light receives reports gathered by the fifth ke,
acting according to the Celestial Lord's established decrees.
The Great Spirit receives the lord's command,
instructs the Minister of Agriculture,
who, upon receiving the command,
directs the subordinate commanderies, provinces, and states.
Informing the leaders of their jurisdictions,
those due to submit records to the Minister of Agriculture for transfer,
each must send their documents upon arrival.
If negligent and not sending in time,
the Minister of Agriculture reports to the Great Spirit of the Hall of Light,
who informs the Celestial Lord,
issuing a decree to the Minister of Agriculture,
ordering the commanderies and states to expedite,
not to delay subsequent documents.
Set times and water-clock intervals are assigned,
each with distinctions,
avoiding confusion,
all using the same script,
each with duplicate copies.
Thus, heaven naturally has no floods or droughts,
no records of increases or decreases.
When transfers are due,
do not delay or make excuses,
fearing私自接受,
for those who detect it have superiors,
and heaven will know,
crimes will not be pardoned.
Each must be cautious in their duties,
each clear about their tasks.
The Celestial Lord knows all in advance,
not speaking aloud,
so one should carefully consider inquiries,
not disregarding these words.
Floods and droughts are unpredictable,
calamities arise together,
people suffer illnesses,
countless lives are lost,
all due to not heeding the Celestial Lord's teachings.
The Celestial Lord issues decrees to inform the Great Spirit,
documents to high officials and ministers,
all spirits in office,
must exhaust their loyalty,
must exhaust their conduct,
to satisfy the Celestial Lord's heart.
The Celestial Lord, with various masters, transforms them,
rectifying those destined for ascension.
Each is made to achieve divine radiance,
following the transformed spirits according to their rank,
all assigned positions and official subordinates in order.
The Celestial Lord commands the Great Spirit to constantly transform and complete them.
People each measure themselves,
their aspirations daily rising,
yearning for ascent.
Their transformed beings shine brilliantly,
visible even at midday,
penetratingly pure, true spirits,
floating together beyond the eight directions.
Observing heaven's actions,
knowing its movements,
each follows what is appropriate.
Audiences with heaven have fixed days,
naturally on set dates.
At the beginning of the month,
great and minor spirits,
differentiate themselves in order,
ranking by seniority.
Ministers' audiences do not exceed the dawn assembly,
all spirits clearly know their assignments,
inspections are unscheduled,
focusing on clarifying documents,
supervising and holding accountable those with duties,
first addressing their responsibilities,
as per the Celestial Lord's decree.
If there is something to report,
open the Hall of Light,
then speak.
Each has their clarity,
each carries their responsibilities,
ensuring no lack of efficacy.
The Celestial Lord commands the Great Spirit,
gather all officials,
each correct in their demeanor,
avoiding faults,
differentiated by laws and decrees,
each inspecting their own departments.
Heaven is aware,
and faults will not be excused.
Each must be cautious in their duties,
not to be found lacking by the spirits.
The Celestial Lord commands the Great Spirit, saying,
Within the commanderies and states,
those with sage wisdom and intent,
constantly mindful of ways to cherish life,
wishing to walk with the spirits of life,
in harmony with heaven's thoughts.
Desiring to bestow kindness upon people,
thinking of creation and growth,
aiding heaven in managing life,
assisting earth in nurturing forms.
Admire benevolence and promote transformation,
submit their names to the Great Spirit,
so that the departments possess literary eloquence,
frequently report achievements,
and are trustworthy and reliable.
The departments express their intentions,
the Celestial Lord shall have his own calculations,
and all spirits recommended shall each be ensured protection.
This selection across commanderies and states
must strive to choose the most virtuous.
The Celestial Lord commands the Bright Hall,
all who are to manage various duties for the Celestial Lord
must pacify their hearts.
Each shall oversee their appointed celestial regions,
ensuring proper division and management,
all demonstrating utmost loyalty,
communicating their knowledge,
striving to accomplish their tasks,
and diligently managing their responsibilities.
Each with sincere and thorough reputation,
should advance their thoughts,
as the sounds they utter,
even if their intentions harbor unspoken words,
the Celestial Lord already hears their speech beforehand—
why conceal and not exhaust sincere honesty?
A question asks:
"Now wishing to further clarify the methods of sages' and worthies' benevolence and completely eradicate heretical texts,
how can this be illuminated further?"
"Heaven is troubled by these false and deceitful texts,
commanding their removal,
to grasp the clear Way of Heaven.
The writings of ancient and modern sages
are what bring order to heaven and earth.
When the sages' writings are clear,
then the Way of Heaven is greatly ordered.
When the August Heaven is angered and displeased,
thus there is conflict,
floods, droughts, and disasters unceasing.
Rulers are distressed,
all saying the sages' writings gradually become disordered and unclear,
hence the Way of Heaven is clouded and difficult to order.
When the sages' writings are disordered,
the Way of Heaven is also disordered;
when the sages' writings are abandoned and unused,
the Way of Heaven is also abandoned and unused."
A question asks:
"In ancient times, without writings,
the Way of Heaven was not disordered.
At that time, the celestial covenant text had not yet appeared,
the supreme divine beings managed ancestral origins,
originally sharing substance with the August Heaven,
but over time drifted far from the Way of Heaven,
leading to loss and chaos,
no longer knowing Heaven's intent.
Thus Heaven issued the covenant,
having sages and teachers write and transmit it,
for sages do not remain long in the world.
Therefore, it was recorded and preserved,
to bequeath to later generations.
Thus when the era of Great Peace arrives,
the Way of Heaven shall be ordered."
A question asks:
"Now wishing to order the vital energy and attain long life,
may I hear how this is possible?"
"Yes,
carefully ponder my words:
The August Heaven has constant laws;
those who serve as rulers over people
should emulate Heaven in their actions,
taking the Way, Virtue, and Benevolence as the three guiding principles.
If a ruler desires to be free from troubles,
at dawn constantly reflect on the Way,
at noon constantly reflect on Virtue,
at dusk constantly reflect on Benevolence—
then there will be no troubles."
"I wish to hear why reflect on the Way at dawn,
why reflect on Virtue at noon,
and why reflect on Benevolence at dusk?"
"Well,
the Way of Heaven can be followed,
but not opposed.
Those who follow Heaven prosper,
those who oppose Heaven perish."
"Now I wish to hear its essential meaning."
"Well,
Heaven has four seasons and three periods:
dawn governs birth,
noon governs nurturing,
dusk governs giving.
Thus the southeast corresponds to birth,
the southwest to nurturing,
the northwest to giving.
Therefore, humans emulate Heaven in their actions:
in the southeast, plant and give birth,
in the southwest, nurture and grow,
after mid-autumn,
during summer, reside internally, marry, and propagate lineages—
this is the natural teaching of the August Heaven.
Thus people silently follow it;
those whose governance can constantly emulate this
thereby grasp Heaven's intent;
those who cannot emulate this
are called opposing Heaven's teachings,
hence often suffer harm.
Harm to the young injures spring things,
harm to the robust injures summer things,
harm to the old injures autumn things,
harm to the pregnant injures winter things—
this is the natural law.
Ancient sage kings
constantly contemplated the Way of Heaven in their actions,
not daring to err by even a hair's breadth."
A question asks:
"Wishing to attain lasting harmony with the earth,
may I hear how?"
"Yes,
those who constantly follow Heaven's actions
long remain in harmony with Heaven;
those who lightly oppose it
long hold enmity with Heaven.
Thus, the governance of ancient sage kings
first was constant birth,
second constant nurturing,
third constant giving.
Acting thus,
carefully upholding and revering the Way of Heaven avoids the name of disorder.
Fourth is punishment leading to disorder,
fifth is killing—
this is its extreme.
Differentiating thus:
the first type of ruler is purely life-giving,
the second purely nurturing,
the third purely giving,
the fourth purely punishing,
the fifth purely killing.
Life-givers prolong life and prosper the state,
nurturers increase longevity,
givers remain without fault,
punishers suffer illness,
killers meet violent ruin.
Ancient sage kings,
observing Heaven's prohibitions clearly,
dared not act recklessly.
Ancient sage kings, on days with the subtle energy of the six jia and royal phases,
neither angered nor spoke evil matters.
On such days,
they instead spoke good deeds,
ate, drank, and made music,
to stop calamities and dispel ominous evils.
Thus the royal energy always desires to be respected.
Therefore, people of high antiquity who transcended the world,
and sage kings governing accordingly,
could thus lie down in governance and contemplate,
ending with not a single trouble.
In spring, head eastward,
in summer, head southward,
in autumn, head westward,
in winter, head northward,
in the four seasons, head toward their corners.
When rulers, ministers, and people all know this method,
evil energies in the world all vanish.
The celestial standard law
often takes royal days to retrieve stored weapons
and manage them underground.
Only on days of rest and decay are they brought out—
hence thieves and bandits do not arise,
and weapons of war cease."
Question asked:
"Heaven alone is angry and does not respond to humans,
can we know why?"
"Indeed,
heaven's principle uses qi as its language,
manifested in the four seasons.
If the spring's jiǎo qi is not understood,
the liver pulse does not move,
the jiǎo pitch is not harmonious,
and clear sounds do not respond,
this is heaven being displeased and not speaking.
When ancient sage kings observed this,
they would contemplate the principles of gain and loss to reverse it.
However, where the king's qi resides,
it attains benevolence to assist its principle.
These two qi together generate life here.
When instead idle and destructive凶qi arrives,
coming to assist its principle,
this becomes three qi.
If the petty person's qi appears here instead,
without authority over the heavenly position,
it thus resembles a petty person.
Heaven sees and illuminates,
recognizing its kind,
commanding the wise and sage to strategize and ponder,
they should seek reclusive道德persons, virtuous persons, and benevolent persons to restore their qi,
then establish mutual response.
Therefore, the king governs the heavenly way,
taking the people and ministers as limbs and aides;
if governing poorly,
then the way is disrupted.
When ancient sages were about to govern the heavenly way,
they sought道德, benevolence, worthies, and the wise to govern together,
thus achieving peace and stability.
Hence, the道德person belongs to heaven,
the virtuous person belongs to earth,
the benevolent person belongs to central harmony.
When these three systems are not harmonious,
three worthies manage them.
Thus, when the太平qi arrives,
all things are properly ordered."
Question asked:
"How can all the people become entirely benevolent?"
"Indeed,
heaven's way generates virtue,
and virtue generates benevolence.
If the ruler takes the道德person as teacher,
adopting the way as model.
When the ruler models the way,
his ministers become virtuous.
The people then model themselves on the ministers,
if ministers are virtuous then the people become benevolent.
Commands below imitate those above modeling,
and those above model heaven.
Transforming and generating each other,
how could the people not become entirely benevolent?
When ancient sage kings took the great道德person as teacher,
it was to transform and influence those below.
The highest ruler governs like heaven,
the middle ruler governs like earth,
the lower ruler governs like humans.
Governing like heaven means,
not losing heaven's intent,
serving the great way as father.
Governing like earth means,
not losing earth's intent,
serving the earthly way as mother.
Governing like humans means,
not losing human intent,
delighting in obtaining the way of central harmony.
When sages see all things fully growing,
they know the principle values the way;
seeing all things fully nurtured,
they know true virtue;
seeing all things fully accomplished,
they know true benevolence.
Those who manage the true way,
only have a heart for growth;
those who manage true virtue,
only have a heart for nurturing;
those who manage benevolence,
only have a heart for giving.
Without these three systems of道德and benevolence,
one cannot be called a太平ruler.
Heaven's superior scholars are born of heaven,
receiving formless entrusted qi at birth.
Knowing heaven's superior scholars,
what could they not know,
what could they not understand,
what could they not see?
Natural primordial qi,
shares duty and acts together.
Heaven's superior scholars,
constantly reside in the limitless hall,
processing documents with heaven.
Above and below not failing in their duties,
thus knowing what can be born;
returning to earth's forms below,
enabling completion,
all things receive glory.
Heaven's superior scholars,
respected by heaven,
admired by all spirits,
like the emperor's crown prince,
who would dare show disrespect?
The heavenly sovereign is entrusted with qi,
thus named heavenly sovereign,
supremely honored without equal;
whatever is commanded or taught,
who would not obey?"
Question asked:
"When the太平ruler's way is flourishing,
his virtue ranks next to heaven.
Obtaining writings to practice uniquely,
transforming flows throughout the world,
then there can be no inequality.
The great spirits are none beyond heaven and earth,
the great lights are none beyond sun and moon,
yet both require two halves to form one.
Heaven and earth each contribute half strength,
uniting hearts and desires in harmony,
only then can they generate all things.
Day and night each contribute half strength,
to form one day.
Spring, summer, autumn, winter each contribute half strength to form one year.
The moon begins born in the west,
grows eastward,
traveling until the fifteenth day called yang,
after fifteen days waning,
called yin.
Each contributes half strength,
to form one month.
Man and woman each contribute half strength,
uniting intentions in harmony,
to form one family.
The way of heaven and earth,
is one yin one yang,
each contributing half strength,
combining as one,
only then jointly completing one.
Thus ruler and minister unite hearts and combine strength,
each contributing half strength,
humbly thinking alike,
then achieving太平order."
Question asked:
"Though contemporary writings are numerous,
and they claim everything is complete,
disasters and bandits always remain.
And people constantly experience sorrow and suffering,
worrying about these凶days,
officials and people jointly rescue,
yet cannot save.
What ends rises again,
now I can long supplement what is lacking,
to prevent recurring disasters.
Since ancient celestial covenant writings emerged,
all worthy and sage documents,
could there be identical ones?
All are different.
Thus heaven commands the master to emerge,
eliminating凶virtue,
covering the people and ministers,
light reaching the four corners,
far and near responding,
grace reaching grass and trees.
This is their heart's intention opening,
their writings all being different."
Question asked:
"The essential Way through the ages
all speaks of guarding the One,
by which one may endure long and not grow old.
Those who know to guard the One
call it the Way of the Limitless.
Humans possess a single body,
constantly united with essence and spirit.
The form governs death,
while essence and spirit govern life.
Constant union brings auspiciousness,
separation brings calamity.
Without essence and spirit, there is death;
with essence and spirit, there is life.
Constant union makes them one,
enabling long endurance.
Often the problem is essence and spirit scattering,
not gathering within the body,
instead letting them wander following human thoughts.
Thus the sages teach guarding the One,
saying one should guard the single body.
With unceasing mindfulness,
essence and spirit come naturally,
all in mutual response,
all illnesses vanish spontaneously—
this is the tally of long life and enduring vision.
The yang aspect guards the One,
the yin aspect guards the two,
hence it is named mortality.
Thus day is yang,
when human souls constantly dwell together;
darkness is yin,
when soul and spirit struggle in movement as dreams,
losing awareness of the form,
dividing into two,
leading even to death.
When essence and spirit are completely lost,
only the form remains.
Guarding the One means
genuinely uniting into one.
Human life's essence and spirit
are all fully present,
and guarding them undispersed
leads even to transcending the world;
becoming good people's parents,
meeting the ruler of Great Peace,
beloved by the divine spirits."
First is called the Divine Way texts,
second the texts examining affairs,
third the records removing superficiality,
collectively called the Way of Great Accord.
Tài (great)
means dà (great);
dà (great)
means tiān (heaven);
heaven can cover and nurture all things,
its achievement is greatest.
Píng (level)
means dì (earth),
the earth being level,
thus able to nourish all things.
Jīng (classic)
means cháng (constant);
heaven takes sun, moon and five planets as its constants,
earth takes mountains, rivers and streams as its constants.
When heaven and earth lose their constant Way,
all things suffer disaster.
The emperor models above on august heaven,
below on queen earth,
centrally on the warp and woof,
stars and constellations, mountains and rivers,
nourishing all things.
Hence it is called the Way of Great Accord.
In ancient times, divine people naturally discerned right and wrong,
obtaining or not obtaining,
their affairs immediately observable.
Not merely obscure,
but clearly pure.
The Divine Way is most numerous,
influencing body and spirit,
rectifying heart and mind,
achieving no concealment.
Good emerges,
evil hides,
thus knowing the method of auspicious and inauspicious,
like the pattern of mirror reflection.
At this time,
the wise and bright find peace naturally,
the time does not come again,
things do not respond doubly.
Then singular flourishing is attained,
reaching distant regions,
thus affairs manifest,
their responses appear,
carefully without refusal or opposition,
compiling them as precious vessels
may be called obtaining heaven and earth's heart-mind.
Its affairs are timely,
all matters assume their offices,
the Divine Way arrives,
the worthy strategize,
auspicious people come,
the wicked do not approach,
clarity and brightness appear,
the four directions rejoice,
recluses and hermits emerge,
heaven's heart is obtained,
governing methods are acquired,
wickedness does not arise,
natural attainment is reached,
perfected beings come to assist,
all under heaven responds well,
each according to their affairs arrives,
confusion and disorder depart.
This response emerges from the abdomen,
issuing from the chest and heart,
like the responsive evidence of thunder and lightning.
Indeed, auspicious responses come from within the chest,
following thoughts coming and going,
in a brief moment,
circulating throughout the world.
What the heart desires,
moves august heaven,
yīn and yáng shift accordingly,
sincere words move heaven—
this is precisely it.
Thoughts can bring correctness,
but can also bring wickedness,
all arising from will and intention.
They can move heaven and earth,
harmonize yīn and yáng,
unite all things,
inwardly enabling self-transcendence,
outwardly enabling fame establishment,
worthiness and unworthiness both arise from this.
Thus the worthy excel at mastery,
never missing even one.
"When humans have faults in their abdomen,
why do they turn red-faced?"
"The heart
is ruler of the five organs;
the ruler is king,
the king upholding correctness,
having faults then reports to heaven."
"When startled, why
does the face turn blue?"
"The liver is the ruler;
humans have worries,
contrarily harming liver and gallbladder produces anger,
hence blue emerges upward."
All spirits have their governance,
corresponding with all things.
Thus people should constantly be careful and good,
following heaven and earth,
so disasters cannot arise again.
External learning is abundant,
internal learning is scarce,
external affairs flourish daily,
internal matters decline daily,
hence people are often ill,
hence there is much superficiality.
Superficiality refers to
the surface.
Ornamentation refers to
the trivial.
The Way of Heaven, when distant, enters into deviance,
unable to return on its own.
What is called the writings of the divine way,
the root and foundation,
harmonizes with yīn and yáng,
aligns with the spirits.
Texts that scrutinize affairs
examine similarities and differences, doubts and errors without omission.
Records of superficiality,
having strayed far from the root,
reside in the wilderness;
their texts are disordered,
not fit for constant use,
only occasionally recordable.
Those who uphold the root
govern as if divine;
those who uphold the middle way
experience little chaos but much vexation;
those who uphold the trivial are deluded.
Thus, the wise uphold the root and guard against the middle,
daring not follow the trivial.
Those who can persist in this without cease,
as goodness comes from all directions,
neither reject nor oppose,
compile them into precious vessels,
unchanged for ten thousand generations.
Can those who strive for goodness by their own efforts be hindered?
Will evil and barbarians retreat?
Will weapons and armor vanish?
Will staffs and whips fall silent?
Will the four directions be peaceful?
Will roads be open?
Will rulers be enlightened?
The divine strategy:
Great men uphold it and move the four directions;
middling scholars practice it and command loyal ministers;
petty men follow it and do not harm one another.
Its words are concise,
its methods clear;
consulting the divine texts, how could one not act?
If unable to uphold it,
be cautious not to harm or constrain with deceit?
Follow the four seasons and five phases,
internally and externally think rightly,
disperse evil from the body,
ward off inauspiciousness,
contemplate the symbols and focus on preservation,
act in harmony with the qì of the four seasons,
balance yīn and yáng,
govern ghosts and spirits with a net of order,
preventing them from recklessly harming people.
From the start of winter to the start of spring,
predominantly use the qì of great yīn,
subtly employ the qì of lesser yáng.
Constantly observe its intent;
identify what ailments afflict people;
its spiritual officials wear black clothing.
Meditate on it in seclusion for forty-five days,
up to ninety days,
to sharpen one's hearing and vision.
At the start of spring, abundant virtue lies in benevolence,
qì governed by lesser yáng,
the ruling qì shifts to the east,
activating the wood phase;
its qì is gentle and benevolent,
its spiritual officials wear blue clothing.
Meditate on it in quiet seclusion for forty-five days,
up to ninety days,
to dissolve illnesses.
Persisting without cease prolongs life,
encouraging daily acts of kindness.
Before the spring equinox,
predominantly use the qì of lesser yáng,
subtly employ the qì of greater yáng,
to support lesser yáng.
Observe its intent without doubt,
deeply ponder its meaning,
and all evils will submit.
At the start of summer, abundant virtue is in fire,
the ruling qì shifts to the south,
the qì of greater yáng governs with balance and harmony.
Its spiritual officials, when understood correctly,
bring sweetness to the mouth;
spiritual officials in red clothing guard it,
driving all ghosts a thousand lǐ away.
On the summer solstice,
abundant virtue is in the qì of greater yáng,
the qì of balance and harmony;
meditating on its spiritual officials can cure all illnesses.
In late summer, the sixth month,
abundant virtue combines in governance,
the ruling qì shifts to the southwest,
returning to the central palace;
its spiritual officials wear yellow clothing; meditate on them,
bringing sweetness to the mouth,
especially on the eighteenth day of each late summer month.
At the start of autumn, abundant virtue is in metal,
the ruling qì shifts to the west,
completing and severing all things;
its spiritual officials wear white clothing.
Meditate on them for forty-five to ninety days,
to eliminate illness,
grasp their intent,
strengthening bones and ensuring longevity.
On the autumn equinox, the qì of lesser yīn,
subtly employs the qì of great yīn;
reverse ailments by following it.
At the start of winter,
abundant virtue is in water,
the ruling qì shifts to the north;
its spiritual officials wear black clothing.
They sharpen the will and hearing,
preserved through forty-five to ninety days of meditation,
eliminating all illnesses.
This qì of the five phases and four seasons
internally can cultivate the body,
externally can counteract evil.
Thus, Heaven uses it for clarity,
Earth uses it for tranquility.
Heaven uses it for life,
Earth uses it for storage,
humanity uses it for prosperity.
Those who can follow the seasonal qì
are called loyal ministers and filial children.
This is named the great harmony with the Way of Heaven, Earth, yīn-yáng, the four seasons, and the five phases.
Thus, the Way emerges for the benevolent and wise,
not born for the foolish.
At age ten,
one has twenty years of spirit.
At age twenty,
one has forty years of spirit.
At age thirty,
one has sixty years of spirit.
At age forty,
one has eighty years of spirit.
At age fifty,
one has a hundred years of spirit.
At age sixty,
one has a hundred and twenty years of spirit.
At age seventy,
one has a hundred years of spirit.
From age eighty to one hundred and twenty,
the spirit is exhausted.
In youth, spirit increases;
as age declines, spirit diminishes.
This refers to the essence-spirit of the five viscera,
the inner signs within.
One thousand two hundred and twenty benevolent spirits serve as its messengers,
advancing and retreating, overseeing and waiting.
Ten thousand spirits are its people,
all following the person's prosperity and decline.
This is the constant principle of heaven and earth.
If one can skillfully govern the spirit as if sharing a city with it,
calming the body and preserving the spirit,
then illness will not afflict,
longevity will be prolonged,
and the divine light will protect them.
Thus, heaven and earth establish the body with tranquility,
guard it with spirit,
and prosper it with the Way.
Therefore, if a person can be pure and still,
embrace essence and spirit,
and not lose thoughtful consideration,
then malevolent evils cannot enter.
When the true spirit is within,
it makes a person constantly joyful,
happily without desire for wealth and treasures,
arguments and disputes,
or contention for merit and fame.
After a long time, one can naturally see the spirit.
The spirit is two feet five inches tall,
adorned according to the five phases and five viscera.
If the ruler is benevolent, the Way prospers;
if the ruler is gentle, virtue arises.
If the center harbors even a little evil intent,
distant places will fall into chaos because of it.
The spirit-qi circulates everywhere,
faster than thunder and lightning.
Quickly return to the divine light,
to illuminate the inner self,
so illness heals itself and the person governs themselves.
Thus, in human life, over one hundred twenty is high longevity,
eighty is medium longevity,
sixty is low longevity.
Beyond these, all are premature deaths.
This is because the spirit wanders outside,
while illness attacks within.
Thinking of the root and correcting conduct
makes people love each other.
The ancients sought longevity
by not losing the Way.
Heaven and earth have constant operations;
one must not depart from the root.
Therefore, those who seek peace and long existence
must carefully not forget this fundamental origin of the Way.
Hence, pictures are drawn to show later generations.
They depict the time when humans and beings receive life,
from ancient times until now,
never losing the transmission of yin and yang,
mutually generating and enduring long,
for tens of thousands of generations,
which must not be lacking.
One declines, one flourishes;
high and low balance.
Flourishing, one becomes a ruler;
declining, one becomes a commoner.
Flourishing means attaining the Way;
declining means receiving punishment.
As for filial piety,
nothing is greater than preserving the body,
for it continues the ancestors' lineage,
spreading fame to later generations.
This is called a good person and a careful citizen.
Heaven and earth love them,
the five phases work for them,
the four seasons benefit them,
hundreds of kings employ them,
myriad people like them,
ghosts and spirits protect them,
and the spirits of the five viscera remain with them.
Encountering one, they gain life;
losing it now,
they part from their divine vessel,
returning to dust and soil,
changing unpredictably,
transforming again into the myriad things.
The Way gives birth to humans;
originally, all are essence and qi,
all possessing spirit.
Temporarily named as humans,
foolish people do not know to return and complete their spirit and qi,
thus losing the Way.
If one can return and reverse their spirit and qi,
they will fulfill their natural lifespan,
or even double it—
all are highly capable.
Some seek to overcome calamities;
the method for this
is to prepare a purification chamber,
secure its doors,
so no one arbitrarily enters.
Go there daily to test oneself;
if not refined or unsettled, come out again—
do not force it.
Repeating this process,
gradually, as refinement and familiarity grow, one becomes settled.
Once settled, one no longer wishes to leave,
the mouth does not wish to speak,
one observes food and drink,
and does not wish to hear human voices.
Close practice and accumulate goodness,
close the eyes and inwardly observe one's form and appearance.
The image appears as if residing in a mirror,
or as if glimpsing one's reflection in clear water—
this is minor achievement.
Without whips, yet strict;
without weapons, yet awe-inspiring;
all matters govern themselves.
Is this not divine?
This is called the path to entering spirit.
Guarding three is not as good as guarding two;
guarding two is not as good as guarding one.
Deeply ponder these words,
and you will grasp the profound mystery of the Way.
Heaven gives birth to humans,
with all things fully prepared.
Thus, born after ten months,
they begin and end with all things,
so they can measure disasters and calamities,
and bring about great peace.
Superior individuals learn the Way
to assist emperors and kings,
and should favor life and accumulate merit for long endurance.
Middle individuals learn the Way
to save their families.
Inferior individuals learn the Way
merely to escape their bodies.
The Way emerges for the wise and bright,
not for the foolish.
Those who can use it are auspicious;
those who cannot use it—
how could they be without harm or injury?
The superior scholar reveres the wise,
regardless of the size of matters,
holding them in complete awe;
the middling scholar half-reveres them,
while the inferior scholar has nothing to fear at all.
The reason the superior scholar fears them
is that they reflect upon themselves,
not blaming others.
Their hearts are open and minds comprehending without prejudice,
understanding the root of primordial energy and spontaneity,
honoring heaven and valuing earth.
The sun, moon, and arrayed stars,
the five phases and four seasons,
the six jia and yin-yang,
all things that crawl, move, and shake—
none are born in vain.
Between the six directions, ghosts, spirits, and essences,
the inner and outer winds, clouds, thunder, and lightning do not act emptily.
All these have deities and rulers,
akin to humans having leaders,
hence they are feared,
and one dares not act recklessly.
The middling scholar half-fears them
because they do not understand the methods of primordial energy's spontaneity above,
only knowing the wind, rain, clouds, and living things they see now;
they still sometimes say heaven has no spirits,
not fearing the arrayed stars, sun, or moon,
only recognizing the great fire and the Northern Dipper.
The inferior scholar does not know the vastness of the land, mountains, and rivers to be feared,
only knowing how to plow fields,
plant what they have,
and manage their family's methods;
they do not know how to follow the four seasons and five phases,
but merely plant accordingly,
reaping the benefits;
they do not know the six jia and yin-yang as spirits,
claiming they do not exist.
The foolish learn and become worthy,
the worthy learn ceaselessly and become sage,
the sage learns ceaselessly and attains the Way,
the Way learner continues and becomes immortal,
the immortal learns ceaselessly and becomes true,
the true learner continues and becomes divine,
all achieved through accumulated, unceasing learning.
One is called prolonging life.
The barbarians naturally submit to myriad laws,
their kinds differ,
yet all attain longevity.
Heaven and earth cherish them,
their bodies free from harm.
The reason for this
is named the great compliance with the Way.
When the Way is perfected throughout the body,
one shares the realm with heaven and earth.
The ancients who practiced this
naturally gained myriad spirits,
if you wish to know its effect,
auspicious signs arrive on their own,
calamities subside by themselves.
Emperors and kings govern by this,
without using physical strength,
able to practice this,
the barbarians submit naturally,
persisting in practice leads to becoming a true person.
Thus, the teachings of the sage
do not require force or coercion to achieve,
but establish instruction based on natural disposition.
The reason emperors and kings can pacify the world
is that each pacifies it according to the hearts of the people,
hence they win the hearts of the world.
This Way cultivates ancient texts,
humans at birth are called divine,
sharing authority, body, form, spirit, essence, energy, affairs, duties, and abode with heaven and earth.
Therefore, they are in three places.
One energy becomes heaven,
one energy becomes earth,
one energy becomes human,
the remaining energies scatter to prepare all things.
Hence, heaven is honored, earth valued, and humans esteemed.
Thus, the Three Sovereigns and Five Emperors all had teachers,
those with doubts knelt to ask.
Therefore, the state was often well-governed,
and even disasters could be overcome.
The path of great compliance
enables kings to be free from worries and affairs, bringing about great peace.
When heaven and earth do not greatly shake,
wind and rain do not run rampant,
all spirits dwell in peace,
the world is without disaster.
All things reside in their places,
then there is joy without sorrow.
How to achieve this?
Benevolence makes emperors and kings constantly joyful,
the Way frees them from sorrow and suffering.
If the emperor is sorrowful,
the world is unsettled.
The emperor,
is the heart of the world;
the ministers,
are the limbs;
the common people,
are the hands and feet.
If the heart is sorrowful, the limbs act recklessly,
the hands and feet move without rest,
the people wander adrift.
This is their natural interaction,
and heaven is also like this.
If heaven loses the Way,
clouds and energy become chaotic,
if earth loses the Way,
it cannot store.
The king is connected with heaven.
The son delights in his father,
the minister delights in his ruler,
earth delights in heaven,
heaven delights in the Way.
Then the energy of great peace can be brought about,
heavenly energy will be uniformly governed,
the supreme sovereign's peace will descend.
Heaven and earth harmonize and unite,
the emperor practices our Way,
what fault can there be?
The Way is
the heart of heaven,
the head of heaven.
When the heart and head have acted,
how can the limbs not follow?
Distinguish the domains of the three energies,
return the spirit to guard the body.
The solar heavenly energy is thus called spirit.
The form,
is governed by the lunar earth spirit,
nurturing all things,
hence the essence-spirit resides in the abdomen,
so the earth spirit is called the deity.
The essence,
is the neutral harmony of all things' essence.
Thus, it advances and retreats without constancy;
the essence of heaven, earth, yin, and yang
jointly gives birth to all things,
this is the calendar of the three unities.
The spirit governs life,
the essence governs nourishment,
the form governs completion.
These three together form a divine vessel,
the three model ruler, minister, and people,
hence none can be lacking.
Thus, if the heart-spirit is agitated,
it makes the form unsettled,
preserving it without neglect.
If it benefits from what can pacify, it stays;
if not using what can pacify, it departs.
Beginning learners use what is suitable,
pacifying and teaching them,
over time, they naturally become entirely settled and do not leave.
Yin energy and yang energy rub against each other,
then they can generate each other.
Human energy also circulates throughout the body,
spirit and essence ride it in and out.
Spirit and essence have energy,
like fish have water,
if energy ceases, spirit and essence scatter,
if water is gone, fish perish.
Therefore, the way of nurturing life
is to pacify the body and cultivate energy,
not wanting frequent anger or joy.
The ancient enlightened teachers
taught emperors to pacify their bodies,
making them free from worry,
then the emperor naturally focuses.
Heaven delights when the energy of great peace emerges,
all things are born and grow.
Heaven resents when the energy of punishment emerges,
none are not killed or harmed,
all things are poisoned by it,
hence they share the sorrow.
If heaven does not guard its spirit,
the three lights do not shine;
if earth does not guard its spirit,
mountains and rivers collapse;
if humans do not guard their spirit,
their bodies die;
if all things do not guard their spirit,
they are damaged.
Thus, returning to it is called strength,
not returning to self-guarding is called dissipation and extinction.
From heaven there is earth,
from sun there is moon,
from yīn there is yáng,
from spring there is autumn,
from summer there is winter,
from day there is night,
from left there is right,
from surface there is interior,
from white there is black,
from light there is darkness,
from firm there is soft,
from male there is female,
from front there is back,
from above there is below,
from ruler there is minister,
from first there is second,
from zǐ there is chǒu,
from five there is six,
from trees there is grass,
from female there is male,
from rooster there is hen,
from mountain there is hill.
This is the root and handle of the Dào.
The pivot of yīn and yáng,
the ultimate meaning of divine spirits.
Three qì share one unity,
forming the spiritual root.
One is essence,
one is spirit,
one is qì.
These three,
share one position,
fundamentally the qì of heaven, earth, and humanity.
Spirit is received from heaven,
essence is received from earth,
qì is received from harmonious balance,
mutually forming one Dào.
Thus spirit rides qì to move,
essence dwells within it.
The three assist each other in governance.
Therefore, those who wish for longevity,
should cherish qì, honor spirit, and value essence.
Those who wish to rectify great affairs,
should use non-action to rectify them.
Non-action gives birth to non-action,
this is the constant law of heaven and earth,
the method of spontaneity,
like shadow and echo.
Superior persons use it to pacify the state,
middling persons use it to prolong years,
inferior persons use it to manage households.
This can be called accomplishing without doing,
governing without managing.
The great Dào is level and broad,
not far from one's body,
cherish our body internally,
its governance naturally returns.
How about governing the body with virtue,
and how about bringing great harmony qì to the myriad people?
Good but not penetrating,
how can there be peace?
How about governing the body with benevolence,
righteousness,
and how about governing the myriad people?
Good but not penetrating,
how can there be peace?
How about governing the body with ritual,
and how about governing the myriad people?
Good but not penetrating,
how can there be peace?
How about governing the body with culture,
and governing the myriad people,
good and restrained,
preventing wrongdoing?
Good but not penetrating,
how can there be peace?
How about governing the body,
and governing the myriad people?
Good but not penetrating,
how can there be peace?
How about governing the body by eliminating military weapons,
and how about governing the myriad people?
Good but not penetrating,
how can there be peace?
Yet these seven matters,
cannot be absent,
nor can they be purely practiced.
Ancient spiritual persons governing their bodies,
all had foundations,
governing people required great methods.
Making all things live,
each attaining its proper place,
enabling the six directions and eight points near and far to rejoice,
all things not losing their proper places.
Should be natural,
able to pacify the eight directions and four distances,
spreading grace without missing a hair.
Now if unable to nurture both root and branch,
how can governance be achieved?
Now these superior virtue,
benevolence, righteousness,
ritual, culture,
law, military - seven matters each govern differently,
all good but not penetrating,
each has its strengths,
cannot be abandoned,
nor purely practiced.
Governing body, pacifying state, achieving great peace,
requires deeply grasping the essential method,
mastering this is the Dào.
Unified in guarding the one,
divided without limit,
the supreme deity practices it,
so profound it cannot be fathomed,
named the pattern of penetrating illumination.
Heaven produces humans in three categories:
first heaven-born,
second earth-born,
third human-kind.
Those receiving mandate from heaven become rulers,
those receiving mandate from earth become ministers,
those receiving mandate from humanity become common people.
Rulers correspond to heaven in action,
ministers correspond to earth in action,
obediently supporting their superiors;
common people belong to ministers,
serving in turn.
Only when these three qì share one governance,
can success be achieved.
Thus when superiors are peaceful,
their ministers are excellent.
When ministers' duties are orderly,
their people follow constants.
When people and ministers are both good,
their ruler is enlightened,
their governance enduring.
Great peace comes through practicing Dào,
all three qì completely good,
harmonious and patterned,
embracing Dào and virtue without mutual injury.
Thus great persons govern through Dào,
to pacify all under heaven,
save the four seas,
extend grace to barbarians,
prevent calamities from arising,
their good evidence daily growing,
inauspiciousness unable to come.
Middling persons learn Dào to become state ministers,
assisting in governance,
protecting their households,
avoiding disasters.
Next in governing through Dào,
damage their parents,
travel far away instead,
virtue alone small and thin,
barely escaping with their lives,
how can they assist enlightened kings and help the state?
Those who can pacify the four seas receive heaven's help,
those who are ministers assist in governance,
consulting with earth;
those barely escaping,
their Dào narrow and small, unable to govern.
These three types all transcend the world,
aging with longevity of varying degrees?
The divine being said:
Act with clarity and emulate the Way,
but see upon whom destiny depends?
It makes people awaken with clear understanding,
knowing whence destiny comes.
The method examines who
holds to its correctness.
Humans are born through the method of yīn and yáng,
where yáng is constantly upright,
and yīn is constantly wicked;
yáng is constantly present,
yīn is constantly absent;
yáng constantly flourishes,
yīn constantly declines;
yáng constantly gives life,
yīn constantly brings death.
Humans undergo three transformations daily,
symbolizing the three energies,
whose governance differs greatly,
contending and conflicting with each other,
not following one another.
Yet by practicing to make this constant,
preserving one's human form and appearance,
is auspicious.
Only those with the true Way
can concentrate their essence and naturally stand apart.
Those who do not learn
will not know the effect of the spirit's coming and going;
what is immediately visible
cannot be hidden.
Thus the noble person controls the corpse but not the ghost.
When a person is not sleeping,
walking, sitting, speaking,
distinguishing clearly between white and black,
acting uprightly, staying, standing,
using language as the standard,
this is when the human spirit is present.
And when they close their eyes to sleep,
the light and scenes are hidden within,
what they think of is obtained,
only they do not speak,
the spirit is within.
And when they sleep deeply,
the essence and spirit wander away,
the body cannot move,
the mouth cannot speak,
the ears cannot hear,
uniting with various evils,
only the vital breath remains,
this is clear evidence.
Therefore, the essence and spirit must be constantly guarded;
guarding them leads to long life,
losing them leads to destiny's exhaustion.
Those who attain the Way
do so through their will and thoughts;
those who lose the Way
also do so through their will and thoughts.
The great Way changes without constancy,
yet stretches ten thousand lǐ in mutual view;
above and below without end,
circulating through the six directions;
guarding it brings auspiciousness,
not guarding it brings injury,
yīn and yáng opening and closing make it constant.
It is bestowed upon those who have the Way,
enabling good people to practice it,
their lifespan lasting as long as heaven and earth.
Now virtue has superiority and inferiority,
affairs have root and branch,
all matters follow the Way,
those about to flourish obtain goodness,
those about to decline obtain evil.
This is like land,
obtaining fertile soil is good,
obtaining poor soil is evil.
Goodness ascends to join heaven,
baseness gathers in marshes.
Those who sit are the hosts,
those who walk are passing guests.
This fully expresses the Way,
good people's actions create blessings,
evil people's actions create disasters.
Good people obtain it as fortunate virtue.
The noble obtain it to ride in carriages,
the humble obtain it to walk on foot.
Sages and worthies obtain it to transcend the world,
petty people obtain it,
without mutual conflict and harm.
This is all the Way.
Teaching does not repeat itself,
time does not come again.
Urgently teach the emperor,
to practice the Way of great peace.
When the Way is practiced,
one personally attains world transcendence,
merit benefiting all living beings throughout the six directions.
